entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:3402}{ctl.FA:0B01}あ、あなたがハンターの方ですか？{ctl.FD}はやく モンスターを{BR}退治してくださいね。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:3402}{ctl.FA:0B01}Ah, you're the hunter, are you?{ctl.FD}Please exterminate those monsters{BR}quickly, won't you?
entries.us: Are you a hunter? Are you here to exterminate the monsters?

entries.jp: ありがとうございました！{BR}これで安心です！！
entries.en: Thank you! Now we can rest easy!
entries.us: Thank you very much! I feel much safer now.

entries.jp: いつぞやは お世話になりました。
entries.en: Thanks again for your help.
entries.us: Thank you again for you assistance.

entries.jp: これからいったい どうなるんだ？
entries.en: What happens to us now?
entries.us: What's going to happen now?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:3402}{ctl.FA:0B01}1ヶ月くらい前から 地下室に{BR}怪物が現れるようになりました。{ctl.FD}おそろしくて研究どころじゃ{BR}ありませんよ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:3402}{ctl.FA:0B01}Monsters started appearing in the{BR}basement a month ago.{ctl.FD}I'm too scared to get any research done!
entries.us: About a month ago, monsters began to appear in the basement. I'm so frightened, I can't even think about my research!

entries.jp: おお、やってくれましたか！{BR}ありがとうございました！
entries.en: Oh, you've done it for us!{BR}Thank you, truly!
entries.us: Oh, you've completed the job! Thank you so much!

entries.jp: いつぞやは お世話になりました。
entries.en: Thanks again for your help.
entries.us: Thank you again for your assistance.

entries.jp: これからいったい どうなるんだ？
entries.en: What happens to us now?
entries.us: What's going to happen now?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA04}{ctl.FA:3403}{ctl.FA:0B02}{ctl.FA:0801}学長に頼まれたハンター？{BR}おまえみたいなガキが！？{ctl.FD}だいじょうぶなのか？ 泣きべそ{BR}かいたって助けに行ってやらないぞ
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA04}{ctl.FA:3403}{ctl.FA:0B02}{ctl.FA:0801}The principal hired YOU as his hunter?{BR}A kid like you?!{ctl.FD}Are you sure you're up to it? Snivel all{BR}you like, I won't come to your rescue.
entries.us: You're the hunter commissioned by the principal? A kid like you?! Are you going to be able to handle it?

entries.jp: お、きれいな おねえちゃん！{BR}そんなガキより俺とつきあわない？{ctl.F4:02}きえな！！！！
entries.en: Hey there, gorgeous! Why not go out with{BR}me instead of a brat like that?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Get lost!!!!
entries.us: Wow, hey gorgeous! Why don't you go with me instead of that kid? Buzz off!!!

entries.jp: モンスターを やっつけたって！？ねえちゃんとガキが……？{ctl.FD}…あっと、いや何でもありません！何でもありませんとも！ あはは！
entries.en: You put the monsters down!?{BR}A girl and a kid, the pair of you...?{ctl.FD}...Ah -- no, I said nothing!{BR}Nothing at all! Ahaha!
entries.us: I can't believe that lady and the kid defeated the monsters. Oops, ah, nothing. Nothing at all! Ha, ha!

entries.jp: 見おぼえあるけど……{BR}誰だったっけ？
entries.en: You look familiar... who were you again?
entries.us: You look familiar... Who are you?

entries.jp: たっ、助けてくれ！
entries.en: H-help me!
entries.us: He...help!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:4201}ここモタビア・アカデミーは{BR}宇宙の真理を探求し、学問を広めるモタビア星最大の研究機関です。{BR}どうです、りっぱでしょ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}おもしろそうな所だね、ライラ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}そぉ？ あたしは興味ないなぁ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:4201}This place, Motavia Academy, is the{BR}greatest research institution on the{ctl.FD}planet, seeking out the truths of the{BR}universe and advancing knowledge.{ctl.FD}Well? Pretty impressive, isn't it?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}It seems like an interesting place, huh{BR}Laila?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Does it? It does nothing for me.
entries.us: Here at Motavia Academy, we search for the truth of the universe. This is the largest research facility on the entire planet. What do you think? Isn't it grand? It looks like an interesting place, doesn't it, Alys? Really? It doesn't interest me one bit.

entries.jp: ここモタビア・アカデミーは{BR}宇宙の真理を探求し、学問を広めるモタビア星最大の研究機関です。{BR}どうです、りっぱでしょ？
entries.en: This place, Motavia Academy, is the{BR}greatest research institution on the{ctl.FD}planet, seeking out the truths of the{BR}universe and advancing knowledge.{ctl.FD}Well? Pretty impressive, isn't it?
entries.us: Here at Motavia Academy, we search for the truth of the universe. This is the largest research facility on the entire planet. What do you think? Isn't it grand?

entries.jp: 何なんだ、あの大穴は！
entries.en: What IS that huge crater?!
entries.us: What's that big hole!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:4202}{ctl.FA:0A01}おんや？ 見なれない顔だね。{BR}うわっ！{ctl.FD}ぶっそうな物ぶらさげてるなぁ！{BR}ち、近よらないでくれたまえ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}何だい、失礼なヤツ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:4202}{ctl.FA:0A01}Well? An unfamiliar face.{BR}Gah!{ctl.FD}That's a dangerous-looking thing you're{BR}carrying!{ctl.FD}S-stay away from me!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}What the... what a rude guy!
entries.us: Huh? Do I know you? Yikes! What are you doing with such lethal weapons? Get out! Hmmph! How rude!

entries.jp: ハーン！ そんなヤバンな連中を{BR}つれてくるのはやめてくれたまえ！っ{ctl.F4:02}たく、いけすかないヤロウだね！ちょいと シメてやろうか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}ああっ！{BR}そんなものしまってくださいよぅ！
entries.en: Hahn! Do stop bringing savages of that{BR}sort in here, would you!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Honestly, what an insufferable man.{BR}Should I go teach him a little lesson?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Aaah!{BR}Put that away, I beg you!
entries.us: Hahn! What are you doing in the company of those uncivilized animals? What a jerk! Maybe I'll have a little fun with him. Ahhh! Please put that away!

entries.jp: まったく、ハーンがこんなヤバンな人間と知り合いだとはな！
entries.en: Honestly. To think Hahn keeps company{BR}with savages like these!
entries.us: Really, I didn't know Hahn knew such uncivilized people!

entries.jp: たっ、助けてくれ！
entries.en: H-help me!
entries.us: He...help!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:4202}{ctl.FA:0A01}ぼくは歴史の勉強をしてるんだけど昔からこの星ってロクな事ないね。おまけに ここんとこの異常気象、土地の砂漠化、出生率低下……{ctl.FD}将来を悲観しちゃうよなぁ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}クラい。クラいわ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:4202}{ctl.FA:0A01}I'm studying history, and this world has{BR}never had much luck, it seems.{ctl.FD}And now, on top of everything -- the{BR}freak weather, the land turning to{ctl.FD}desert, the falling birth rate......{ctl.FD}It makes a person pessimistic{BR}about the future.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Gloomy. He's a gloomy one.
entries.us: I'm studying history. This planet has bad problems from the beginning. Presently, we have an abnormal climate, soil depletion, and a decreasing birth rate! It doesn't make for a promising future. This guy is too depressing. Let's get out of here.

entries.jp: ぼくは歴史の勉強をしてるんだけど昔からこの星ってロクな事ないね。おまけに ここんとこの異常気象、土地の砂漠化、出生率低下……{ctl.FD}将来を悲観しちゃうよなぁ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}クラい。クラいわ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}無理ないですよ。ここ最近とくに環境悪化が激しいですからね。
entries.en: I'm studying history, and this world has{BR}never had much luck, it seems.{ctl.FD}And now, on top of everything -- the{BR}freak weather, the land turning to{ctl.FD}desert, the falling birth rate......{ctl.FD}It makes a person pessimistic{BR}about the future.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Gloomy. He's a gloomy one.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}You can hardly blame him. Lately, the{BR}environment has really gone downhill.
entries.us: I'm studying history. This planet has had problems since the beginning. Presently, we have an abnormal climate, soil depletion, and a decreasing birth rate! It makes me pessimistic about the future. This guy is too depressing. I don't blame him. Recently, the rate of environmental degradation has increased.

entries.jp: ぼくは歴史の勉強をしてるんだけど昔からこの星ってロクな事ないね。おまけに ここんとこの異常気象、土地の砂漠化、出生率低下……{ctl.FD}将来を悲観しちゃうよなぁ。
entries.en: I'm studying history, and this world has{BR}never had much luck, it seems.{ctl.FD}And now, on top of everything -- the{BR}freak weather, the land turning to{ctl.FD}desert, the falling birth rate......{ctl.FD}It makes a person pessimistic{BR}about the future.
entries.us: I'm studying history. This planet has had problems since the beginning. Presently, we have an abnormal climate, soil depletion, and a decreasing birth rate... It makes me pessimistic about the future.

entries.jp: やっぱりロクな事ないんだ、{BR}この星は…！
entries.en: No luck at all on this world... I knew it!
entries.us: I'm right. This planet is full of problems!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:0B02}{ctl.FA:0A01}モンスターがこわくて{BR}にげだしたいのは やまやまだが、学長が市民にシラをきっている手前おとなしくしてなきゃいけなくてな
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:0B02}{ctl.FA:0A01}I'm terrified of the monsters and I'd love{BR}nothing more than to run away,{ctl.FD}but with the principal playing dumb to{BR}the townsfolk, I have to stay quiet.
entries.us: I'm so scared of the monsters. There's nothing I'd like more than to leave town. But the principal won't allow it.

entries.jp: モンスターがこわくて{BR}にげだしたいのは やまやまだが、学長が市民にシラをきっている手前おとなしくしてなきゃいけなくてな{ctl.F4:03}体面をとりつくろうのだけは{BR}いっしょうけんめいですからねー。
entries.en: I'm terrified of the monsters and I'd love{BR}nothing more than to run away,{ctl.FD}but with the principal playing dumb to{BR}the townsfolk, I have to stay quiet.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}The only thing he truly cares about{BR}is keeping up appearances.
entries.us: I'm so scared of the monsters. There's nothing I'd like more than to get out of here, but since the principal feigns ignorance before the citizens, we've got to stay quiet. Well, you're certainly trying hard to keep up appearances.

entries.jp: モンスターをやっつけたって？{BR}やれやれ、ほっとしたよ。
entries.en: You beat the monsters? Well, what a{BR}relief.
entries.us: You've exterminated the monsters? What a relief.

entries.jp: こんな、こんなことって！
entries.en: How... how could this be!
entries.us: Oh, such a thing!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}学長室なら そこの一番奥だよ。{ctl.FD}でも最近態度がおかしいんだよね。なんかビクビクしちゃってさ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}The principal's office is at the very back.{BR}He's been weird lately. Jumpy, somehow.
entries.us: If you're looking for the principal's room, it's way in the back. But recently, he's been acting strangely. I think he's scared of something.

entries.jp: 学長室なら そこの一番奥だよ。
entries.en: The principal's office is at the very back.
entries.us: If you're looking for the principal's room, it's way in the back.

entries.jp: こんな、こんなことって！
entries.en: How... how could this be!
entries.us: Oh, such a thing!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:4201}半年ほど前から地殻変動が激しい。怪物たちも異常発生してきとる！{ctl.FD}このままでは{BR}この星は おしまいじゃよ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}なげいてばかりじゃ{BR}どうにもなんないよ、おっさん！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:4201}The crust has shifted badly these six{BR}months, and the monsters breed like mad!{ctl.FD}At this rate this world is finished...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Moaning fixes nothing, old man!
entries.us: For the last year there have been violent changes in the planet's crust, as well as an abnormal outbreak of monsters! At this rate, the planet will be doomed... Hey, it's not going to do any good just moaning about it!

entries.jp: 半年ほど前から地殻変動が激しい。怪物たちも異常発生してきとる！{ctl.FD}このままでは{BR}この星は おしまいじゃよ…。
entries.en: The crust has shifted badly these six{BR}months, and the monsters breed like mad!{ctl.FD}At this rate this world is finished...
entries.us: For the last half year, there have been violent changes in the planet's crust. There has also been an abnormal outbreak of monsters! At this rate, this planet will be doomed...

entries.jp: ホレ見ろ、もうおしまいじゃよ…。
entries.en: See? I told you. It's all over...
entries.us: See! We're doomed...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA01}千年前、マザーブレインの破壊で{BR}社会生活は混乱し、その上…{ctl.FD}惑星パルマの爆発によって{BR}その破片がモタビアを直撃した。{ctl.FD}こうして 過去の文明は消滅した。これを「大崩壊」と呼ぶ。{ctl.FD}…おっと君たち、学生じゃ{BR}なかったのか。こりゃ失礼。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA01}A thousand years ago the fall of Mother{BR}Brain threw society into chaos, and...{ctl.FD}Palma exploded, and debris struck{BR}Motavia head on.{ctl.FD}The old civilization died. We call it the{BR}Great Collapse.{ctl.FD}...Ah. Not students, are you. My apologies.
entries.us: A thousand years ago, our society was thrown into confusion by the destruction of Mother Brain. After that, Motavia sustained a direct hit by a fragment of the exploding planet Parma. Our civilization was almost destroyed. We call this 'The Great Collapse.' ...Oh. I didn't realize you weren't students.

entries.jp: 世の中 色々あるもんですなぁ！
entries.en: All sorts of things happen in this world,{BR}don't they?
entries.us: There sure are many kinds of universes!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA01}かつてアルゴル太陽系には{BR}三つの惑星があったが、{ctl.FD}「大崩壊」の時に{BR}第一惑星「パルマ」は失われ、{ctl.FD}今は「デゾリス」と、この{BR}「モタビア」を残すのみじゃ…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA01}The Algol system once held three{BR}planets,{ctl.FD}but in the Great Collapse, the first of{BR}them, Palma, was lost to us,{ctl.FD}and now only Dezolis and this planet,{BR}Motavia, remain......
entries.us: Once, there were three planets in the Algo solar system, but during The Great Collapse, the planet Parma was lost. Now only Dezolis and this planet remain.

entries.jp: こんなバカな事があるなんて…！
entries.en: I can't believe something this ridiculous{BR}could happen...!
entries.us: I can't believe there could be such a crazy thing...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:6501}千年前、我々は宇宙を駆ける船{BR}までも持っていたらしいですね。{ctl.FD}でも今は 遠く空にうかぶ{BR}デゾリスも望遠鏡でながめるだけ。ああ！ 一度でいいから{BR}デゾリスに行ってみたいな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}別の星に行くなんて{BR}夢みたいな話だね。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:6501}It seems that a thousand years ago,{BR}we had ships that crossed space.{ctl.FD}Now Dezolis just hangs there in the sky{BR}and we watch through a telescope.{ctl.FD}Just once I'd love to set foot there!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Another world? Sounds like a dream.
entries.us: Apparently, a thousand years ago there were ships that could travel through space. Today, the only thing we can do is view Dezolis through a telescope. Ah! Just once, I would love to go to Dezolis! It sounds like a dream. Traveling to another planet.

entries.jp: 千年前、我々は宇宙を駆ける船{BR}までも持っていたらしいですね。{ctl.FD}でも今は 遠く空にうかぶ{BR}デゾリスも望遠鏡でながめるだけ。ああ！ 一度でいいから{BR}デゾリスに行ってみたいな！
entries.en: It seems that a thousand years ago,{BR}we had ships that crossed space.{ctl.FD}Now Dezolis just hangs there in the sky{BR}and we watch through a telescope.{ctl.FD}Just once I'd love to set foot there!
entries.us: Apparently, a thousand years ago there were ships that could travel through space. Today, the only thing we can do is view Dezolis through a telescope. Ah! Just once, I would love to go to Dezolis!

entries.jp: 宇宙よりも 今は{BR}地面にあいた穴ですよ！
entries.en: Never mind space, worry about the hole in{BR}the ground!
entries.us: What we've got to deal with right now is not outer space but this hole in the ground!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:02}ルディ、探したよ！{BR}どこほっつきあるいてたんだい？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ライラ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}さ、ついといで！ 学長に会って{BR}くわしい依頼内容を聞かなきゃね。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:02}Rudy, I've been looking for you!{ctl.FD}Where on earth have you been{BR}wandering off to?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Laila!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Come on! We gotta see the principal and{BR}hear the full details of this request.
entries.us: Chaz, where have you been? C'mon, let's go! But... We have to see the principal and get the details about this commission.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA01}おや？{BR}お客さんだ、めずらしい。{ctl.FD}失礼。ここは学園都市だから{BR}宿屋なんて はやらないんですよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA01}Oh? A customer.{BR}A rare sight.{ctl.FD}Forgive me. This is a college town, so an{BR}inn doesn't do much business here.
entries.us: Oh my? A customer! Oh, excuse me. You see, this is a university town, so there really isn't much need for an inn.

entries.jp: もう宿屋どころじゃないねぇ！
entries.en: We've got bigger things to worry about{BR}than an inn now!
entries.us: Forget about inns! We've got more serious matters, don't we?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}こわい怪物が出るから夜は家の外に出てはダメだと言ってるんですが…
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}I keep saying not to go out at{BR}night with those monsters around...
entries.us: We've been telling him not to go outside after dark because of the scary monsters, but...

entries.jp: これで安心して{BR}子供を遊びにやれますわ。
entries.en: Now I can let the children out to play{BR}again.
entries.us: Now, I can let my children go out to play.

entries.jp: 何？ 何ごとですか？？
entries.en: What? What's going on??
entries.us: What? What are you talking about?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}少しくらい へいきだよ！{BR}ママは心配しすぎなんだ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}A little while is fine! Mama worries too{BR}much.
entries.us: It's only for a bit. It'll be OK! You worry too much, Mommy.

entries.jp: 何も出なくなったんじゃ もう{BR}夜 抜け出すのもつまんないな！
entries.en: Nothing comes out now, so sneaking out{BR}at night is dull!
entries.us: Now that no monsters come out, it's no fun to sneak out in the middle of the night!

entries.jp: 何があったの？{BR}ねぇ、教えてよぅ！
entries.en: What happened? Come on, tell me!
entries.us: Did something happen? Come on, tell me!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA01}アカデミーの学生ったら、{BR}もう毎日うるさくって！{ctl.FD}この間も{BR}そこの噴水に飛び込んで大騒ぎ！{ctl.FD}まわりの迷惑を考えないのかしら？何とかしてほしいわ…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA01}Those academy students make such a{BR}racket every day!{ctl.FD}They jumped in that fountain the other{BR}day, screaming!{ctl.FD}Don't they ever think of the neighbors?
entries.us: The academy students are so noisy day in and day out! Like the other day, when a group of them jumped into that fountain, what a scene! Don't they think about being considerate to others? I wish something could be done about them...

entries.jp: どどどどうすればいいんでしょう！逃げ出したいけど あては無し…。
entries.en: Wh-wh-what am I supposed to do!{ctl.FD}I want to run, but there's{BR}nowhere to go...
entries.us: Wh...what should we do? I want to escape, but I have nowhere to go...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA01}北東にいったマイルの村ってとこにぼくの実家があるんだけど、{ctl.FD}最近 仕送りがこないんだ。{BR}忘れてるのかなぁ。{ctl.FD}仕方ないからバイトでも探そっと。ハンターなんてカッコいいかもね。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA01}My family home is out northeast, in a{BR}village called Mile.{ctl.FD}My allowance has stopped coming lately.{BR}Have they forgotten about me, I wonder?{ctl.FD}No choice but to find some work, I guess.{BR}I bet being a hunter would be cool, huh.

entries.jp: マイルの村が死の街になってるっていうのは本当なのか！？{ctl.FD}おやじ…おふくろ…！！
entries.en: Is it true that Mile has become{BR}a ghost town!?{ctl.FD}Father... Mother......!!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}なんかモンスターが増えたなぁと{BR}思っていたら、{ctl.FD}最近街の中にも出るらしいんです。これは何かの前兆なのでしょうか？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}I'd been thinking there seemed to be more{BR}monsters around,{ctl.FD}and now they're apparently turning{BR}up inside the town itself.{ctl.FD}Is this some kind of omen?

entries.jp: モンスターは街の中にはもう出ないんだそうですよ。よかったよかった
entries.en: They say the monsters don't come into{BR}town anymore. What a relief.

entries.jp: こ、この世の終わりだ…！
entries.en: Th-this is the end of it all!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}この街の壁は がんじょうで{BR}どんな怪物も入っちゃこられんよ。だから最近出るヘンなモンスターは街の中に原因があると思うんだな。オレは アカデミーのヘンな研究があやしいと にらんでんだ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}The walls of this town are solid. No{BR}monster gets in from outside.{ctl.FD}So whatever these monsters are, the{BR}cause must lie inside the town.{ctl.FD}And my money is on that peculiar{BR}research they do at the Academy.

entries.jp: モンスターは なんとかっていう{BR}ハンターがやっつけたんだって？
entries.en: So it was some hunter or other who put{BR}the monsters down, was it?

entries.jp: 穴から毒が出ているって？{BR}おい、本当か！？
entries.en: Poison from the hole? Hey, is that true?!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}あたし見たわ！{ctl.FD}真夜中、あやしい男たちが 大きな荷物をアカデミーに運びこんだの！しばらく前の話だけど、{BR}いったい 何だったのかしらね！！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}I saw it, I did!{ctl.FD}In the dead of night, shady men carried{BR}some giant crates into the Academy!{ctl.FD}It was a while back now, but{BR}what could it have been?!

entries.jp: 今思うとあの大荷物はモンスターと何か関係があったのかしらね！！
entries.en: I wonder if those crates had something{BR}to do with the monsters!

entries.jp: 穴があいた、ってだけじゃ{BR}何がなんだか…！
entries.en: A hole opened, and that's all anyone can{BR}tell me...!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA01}なんだい、あんたたち。{BR}なれなれしく声をかけないでくれ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA01}What do you want? Don't talk to me like{BR}we're old friends!

entries.jp: たっ、助けてくれ！
entries.en: H-help me!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA01}あたしは地質学をやってるのよ。{ctl.FD}最近 地質が悪くなる一方で、{BR}この農園も全然作物ができないの。農学部のカレだって泣いてるわ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA01}I study geology. The soil quality has been{BR}worsening. This farm grows nothing now.{ctl.FD}My boyfriend in agriculture is in tears!

entries.jp: 突然、地面が陥没したというだけ{BR}では片づけられない状況だわ！
entries.en: This isn't a situation that can simply be{BR}dismissed as the ground caving in!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA01}ここはまだ平気だけど、マイルの村では 井戸もかれてきてるってさ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA01}We're fine here, but they say the wells in{BR}Mile are running dry!

entries.jp: マイルがダメなら、{BR}ここも もう危ないぞ！
entries.en: If Mile is done for, we're in danger too!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA01}いやぁ、こないだ この噴水に{BR}飛び込んだらしいんだけどさ、{ctl.FD}それが全然おぼえてないんだよ。{BR}ま、とにかく楽しかったね！{ctl.FD}君たちも たまには我を忘れて{BR}ウサを晴らすと いいんじゃない？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA01}Ha, apparently I went and jumped into{BR}that fountain the other day,{ctl.FD}and I don't remember a thing about it.{BR}Well, it was a fun time, I'm sure!{ctl.FD}You people should try letting loose and{BR}blow off some steam now and again too.

entries.jp: あわわわわわ！
entries.en: A-a-aaaah!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}学長の命令で 今はどなたも{BR}ここを通すわけにはいきません！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:0C01}By the principal's order, I cannot let{BR}anyone through here right now!

entries.jp: ここは学園都市ピアタ。{BR}学問にたずさわる者の街です。
entries.en: This is the college town of Piata.{BR}It's a town for scholars.

entries.jp: ここはピアタですが、{BR}それどころじゃありません！{ctl.FD}この北、マイルの近くに{BR}謎の大穴が！！
entries.en: This is Piata, but we have bigger{BR}problems!{ctl.FD}North of here, near Mile, a huge crater{BR}has opened!!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:02}なぁんか うさんくさいわねー。{BR}あの学長、おちつきがなさすぎる。{ctl.F4:01}モンスターが{BR}コワいんじゃないのかなぁ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}どうも それだけじゃなさそうね。ちょっとおもしろくなってきたよ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:02}There's something not right here.{BR}That principal is far too jittery.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Isn't he just frightened of{BR}the monsters?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}I don't think that's the half of it.{BR}This is starting to get interesting!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:2A05}{ctl.FA:2703}{ctl.FA:2602}{ctl.FA:4401}ここはモタビア・アカデミーの{BR}学生寮だよ。{ctl.FD}わたし？{BR}わたしゃ 管理人ですけどね。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:2A05}{ctl.FA:2703}{ctl.FA:2602}{ctl.FA:4401}This is the Motavia Academy student{BR}dormitory.{ctl.FD}Me?{BR}I'm the manager here, that's all.

entries.jp: ほっとけば じきに戻ってくると{BR}思ってたのに、まだ……{ctl.FD}あ、いやいや{BR}こっちの話ですよ！！
entries.en: I thought she'd come back on her own, but{BR}still...{ctl.FD}Ah, never mind!{BR}Talking to myself!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} フ
どうか、{BR}よろしくお願いしますよ。
entries.en: Please. I'm counting on you.

entries.jp: どうもありがとうございました！{BR}寮の体面がなんとか保てました。{ctl.FD}報酬は規定通り、ギルドの方に{BR}お送りしておきますね！{ctl.FD}それと…この件はなにとぞ、{BR}内密にお願いしますよ。
entries.en: Thank you so much! The dormitory keeps{BR}its good name, more or less.{ctl.FD}Your fee goes to the guild as{BR}stipulated!{ctl.FD}And... keep this between ourselves,{BR}please.

entries.jp: お世話になりました。
entries.en: Thank you for your help.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}明日までのレポートを まだ{BR}一枚も書いてないんだ。とほほー。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}My report is due tomorrow and I haven't{BR}written a page. Oh, woe is me.

entries.jp: 「不可」…！！{ctl.FD}結局、レポート間に合わなかったんだから、当然か…とほほー。
entries.en: A failing grade...!!{ctl.FD}I never did finish it, so what did I{BR}expect...{ctl.FD}Oh, woe is me.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:2A02}{ctl.FA:2601}アカデミーに行くより ここで{BR}のんびりしてた方が楽しいな！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:2A02}{ctl.FA:2601}Lazing about here is a great deal more{BR}fun than going to the Academy!

entries.jp: となりの部屋の女の子？{BR}そういえば最近見かけないなぁ。
entries.en: The girl next door? Come to think of it, I{BR}haven't seen her lately.

entries.jp: となりの部屋の子、戻ってきたの？そりゃ知らなかった。
entries.en: The girl in the next room is back?{BR}Well, I had no idea.

entries.jp: こう騒がしいと、ますます{BR}アカデミーに行きたくなくなるぞ。
entries.en: With all this noise I want to go to the{BR}academy less.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:2A02}{ctl.FA:2601}となりの部屋の女の子が{BR}ヘンな宗教に かぶれちゃってさ。この前から行方がわからないんだ。いったい どこへ行ったのかなぁ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA03}{ctl.FA:2A02}{ctl.FA:2601}The girl next door got mixed up in some{BR}weird cult.{ctl.FD}She's been missing a while. Where could{BR}she have gone?

entries.jp: となりの部屋の女の子、{BR}まだ帰ってこないんだよ。{ctl.FD}どこで何をしているんだろう…。
entries.en: The girl next door still hasn't come home.{BR}What is she doing out there?

entries.jp: となりの部屋の女の子、{BR}戻ってきたんだ！{ctl.FD}でも いなかった間の記憶が{BR}ないみたい…心配だな。
entries.en: The girl next door is back!{ctl.FD}But she seems to have no memory of the{BR}time she was gone. That's worrisome.

entries.jp: 何があったって？
entries.en: What happened?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:6501}きゃああ！ 着替え中よ！{BR}出てって出てって！！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA02}{ctl.FA:6501}Eeek! I'm changing!{BR}Get out, get out!!

entries.jp: まだまだ着替え中よ！{BR}出てって出てって！！
entries.en: Still changing!{BR}Get out, get out!!

entries.jp: それでも着替え中よ！{BR}出てって出てって！！
entries.en: Even now I'm changing!{BR}Get out, get out!!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DA01}あたし…今まで{BR}何をやってたのかしら？{ctl.FD}思いだそうとすると{BR}頭痛がするのよ…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DA01}What... have I been doing all this time?{BR}When I try to remember, my head aches...

entries.jp: 何か…ひどく頭が痛いわ…。{BR}これは…いったい…！？
entries.en: My head... it hurts...{BR}What... what is this...?

entries.jp: ああ、ギルドから来たハンターさんですか？ た、助けてくださいっ！実はこの学生寮でお預かりしている女子学生が一人、行方不明でして！なんでも、とある宗教に心酔して{BR}でていったらしいんですわ。{ctl.FD}じきに熱が冷めて戻ってくると{BR}思っていたのですが、いまだに…！こちらは人様の子をお預かりする、非常に責任のある立場！{ctl.FD}それがこの失態では、アカデミーの信用にも傷がつきかねません！{ctl.FD}どうかコトがおおっぴらになる前に探して連れてきて欲しいのです！{ctl.FD}お手数ですが、{BR}よろしくお願いしますよ。
entries.en: Ah, the hunter from the guild? P-please,{BR}help!{ctl.FD}One of the young women in my charge has{BR}gone missing!{ctl.FD}They say she fell for some religion and{BR}walked out.{ctl.FD}I thought the fever would pass, but{BR}there's still no sign of her!{ctl.FD}I'm entrusted with other people's{BR}children. The responsibility is enormous!{ctl.FD}A blunder could stain the academy's good{BR}name!{ctl.FD}Please find her and bring her back{BR}before word gets out!{ctl.FD}I'm counting on you.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}あれ？ うろうろしてたら{BR}ライラとはぐれちゃったよ。{ctl.FD}ライラを探さなきゃ…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Huh? I've been wandering around and{BR}got separated from Laila.{ctl.FD}I'd better go and find her...
entries.us: Oops! I wandered around and now I've gotten separated from Alys. I've got to find her...

entries.note: trailing bytes, no terminator

entries.jp: 外の流砂を見たかい？{ctl.FD}あれがどんどん広がってきてる！{BR}この街もいつまでもつやら……。
entries.en: Seen the quicksand outside? It keeps{BR}spreading! How long can this town last...

entries.jp: このあたりも以前は土が肥えていて農業がさかんだったんだけどねぇ。今じゃ、井戸も畑も{BR}かれる始末だよ…。
entries.en: The soil around here was rich once,{BR}and farming did well enough.{ctl.FD}Now the wells have run dry,{BR}and the fields have withered away...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:3301}バースバレーなら{BR}ゼマって村に行ってきいてみな。{ctl.FD}ゼマなら ここから{BR}さらに北東だ。だがな…{ctl.FD}最近 人の気配がないって話だ。{BR}みんなで夜逃げでもしたのかねぇ？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:3301}If it's Birth Valley you want, go and{BR}ask in the village of Zema.{ctl.FD}Zema lies further northeast of here.{BR}Although...{ctl.FD}there's been no sign of anyone there{BR}lately. Did they all flee in the night?

entries.jp: バースバレーなら{BR}ゼマって村に行ってきいてみな。{ctl.FD}夜逃げしてた連中が{BR}帰ってきているらしいよ。
entries.en: If it's Birth Valley you want, go and{BR}ask in the village of Zema.{ctl.FD}The ones who fled in the night seem{BR}to be coming back now.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}最近 ヘンな宗教が{BR}はやってるんだって？{ctl.FD}なんでも 黒装束に身を固めた男が広めているっていうじゃないか！{ctl.FD}名前を何といったかなぁ…。そう、ジオ！ ジオっていったよ、確か。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}Some strange religion is catching on{BR}lately, I heard.{ctl.FD}And it's being spread by a man dressed all{BR}in black, apparently!{ctl.FD}What was his name again...{BR}Zio! Zio, that was it, I'm sure of it.

entries.jp: 例の宗教の話を最近聞かないなぁ。{ctl.FD}最近の若いやつは{BR}あきっぽいからな！
entries.en: Haven't heard about that religion lately.{BR}Young folk tire of things so fast!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}流砂の向こうに見える城…。{ctl.FD}一晩寝て起きたら もう建っていたような気がするんだけど…。{ctl.FD}やっぱり 気のせいだよね！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}The castle that you can see beyond the{BR}quicksand...{ctl.FD}I could swear it wasn't there when I{BR}went to bed, and suddenly there it was...{ctl.FD}It must be my imagination, though!

entries.jp: 流砂の向こうに見える城…。{ctl.FD}一晩で建ったと思ったら 今度は{BR}一晩でなくなっちゃったよ。{ctl.FD}き、気のせいだよね？
entries.en: The castle that you can see beyond the{BR}quicksand...{ctl.FD}It went up in a single night, and now it's{BR}gone in a single night.{ctl.FD}I-it's my imagination, isn't it?

entries.jp: はいてもはいても砂が飛びちるの。もう やんなっちゃう！
entries.en: No matter how much I sweep, the sand{BR}just blows right back in again.{ctl.FD}It's so frustrating!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:3301}ゼマ全滅！！！！{ctl.FD}……か？{ctl.FD}だれか確かめに行ってくれよ。{BR}オ、オレは忙しいからダメだぜ？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:3301}Zema has been wiped out!!!!{ctl.FD}......Or so they say?{ctl.FD}Somebody go see, would you.{BR}N-not me. I'm a busy man.

entries.jp: ゼマ復活！！！！{ctl.FD}これは本当らしいよ、ウン。
entries.en: Zema lives!!!! That's actually true, I hear.

entries.jp: モタビア・アカデミーに{BR}ひとり息子を やっているんですが最近の不作続きで{BR}仕送りも ままなりません。{ctl.FD}ちゃんとごはんを食べているのか、心配で心配で……。
entries.en: I've sent my only son to Motavia{BR}Academy, but...{ctl.FD}with one bad harvest after another I can{BR}barely send him any money.{ctl.FD}I worry constantly about whether he's{BR}getting enough to eat...
entries.us: Our only son is enrolled in the Motavia Academy, but recently we've had a series of bad harvests and we haven't been able to send his allowance. We've been so worried whether he has enough to eat.

entries.jp: どんなに畑をたがやしても、{BR}土はやせてゆくばかりじゃ…。
entries.en: However much I till the fields,{BR}the soil just keeps getting poorer...
entries.us: Whatever field we try to cultivate, the soil just becomes infertile.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}ぼくも モタビア・アカデミーに{BR}入学するために勉強しているんだ。おばさんたち、じゃましないでよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}お、おばさん……！？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:4201}I'm studying so that I can get{BR}into Motavia Academy, too.{ctl.FD}You ladies, don't get in my way!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}L-ladies......?!
entries.us: I'm studying so that I can enroll in Motavia Academy. Hey, stop bothering me! Kids...

entries.jp: ぼくも モタビア・アカデミーに{BR}入学するために勉強しているんだ。
entries.en: I'm studying so that I can get{BR}into Motavia Academy, too.
entries.us: I'm studying so that I can enroll in Motavia Academy too.

entries.jp: ほんとは 農業をついでほしいのにうちの息子は…。{ctl.FD}でも畑が あのありさまでは{BR}しかたありませんわね。
entries.en: I really wish my son would take over the{BR}farm, but......{ctl.FD}With the fields in the state{BR}they're in, I guess it can't be helped.
entries.us: Actually, we wanted him to keep the family farm going, but...  What with the fields in such a state, I suppose there's no use.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:1D06}{ctl.FA:1C05}{ctl.FA:1B04}{ctl.FA:1A03}{ctl.FA:1902}{ctl.FA:1801}{ctl.FA:3501}ここはマイルの村。そしてこれが{BR}新しくできたサンドワームの牧場だどうだい？ かわいいだろ？{BR}これから観光客が集まるぜ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:1D06}{ctl.FA:1C05}{ctl.FA:1B04}{ctl.FA:1A03}{ctl.FA:1902}{ctl.FA:1801}{ctl.FA:3501}This is the village of Mile. And this{BR}here is my sand worm ranch, newly built!{ctl.FD}Well? Aren't they charming?{BR}The sightseers will come flocking now!
entries.us: Hmm, 'The Sacred Area of Life'... Why is it called that, and why is it worshipped in that way? I'm such a feeble-minded old man, I don't understand.

entries.jp: ここはマイルの村。そしてこれが{BR}サンドワームの牧場だが………{ctl.FD}エサのやりすぎか、サンドワームがだいぶ大きくなってきちまった！{ctl.FD}なんだかもう怖いくらいだよ。{BR}ど、どうしたらいいと思う…？
entries.en: This is the village of Mile. And this{BR}here is my sand worm ranch, but......{ctl.FD}I've overfed them, I'd say. The{BR}worms have grown a good deal bigger!{ctl.FD}It's frightening, honestly it is.{BR}Wh-what do you think I should do...?

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ニ
は、早く{BR}なんとかしてくれよ。
entries.en: P-please, do something quickly.

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ネ
ありがとうよ、ハンターさん{BR}報酬はギルドで受け取ってくんな。
entries.en: Thank you kindly, hunter.{BR}Go and collect your reward at the guild.

entries.jp: ここはマイル…おお、あんたか。{BR}いつぞやは世話になったな。{ctl.FD}次は何をやろうか、思案中なんだ。楽しみにしていてくれよ！
entries.en: This is Mile... oh, it's you. Thanks for your{BR}help last time.{ctl.FD}I'm pondering what to try next. Look{BR}forward to it!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:1B03}{ctl.FA:1902}{ctl.FA:3501}うちのひと、なけなしのお金で{BR}サンドワームの牧場を作ったけれどあんなのを見に来るひとって{BR}いるのかしらね…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:1B03}{ctl.FA:1902}{ctl.FA:3501}My husband spent the last coin we had{BR}on building that sand worm ranch,{ctl.FD}but I do wonder whether anyone will ever{BR}want to come see those things...
entries.us: That city, Aiedo, beyond Nalya, is a real big city, isn't it? I'd like to go there someday.

entries.jp: うちの牧場のサンドワーム、{BR}大きくなってきて気味が悪いよ…。
entries.en: Our ranch's sand worms have grown so{BR}large it's unsettling...

entries.jp: ハンターさん、サンドワームの件、よろしくお願いしますよ…。
entries.en: Hunter, about those sand worms.{BR}I'm counting on you......

entries.jp: あのままにしておけば、いずれ{BR}村のみんなに迷惑がかかります。{ctl.FD}そうなってからでは{BR}遅いんです。{ctl.FD}サンドワームにはかわいそうだったけど、これでよかったのよ……。{ctl.FD}ハンターさん、{BR}お世話になりましたね。
entries.en: If they'd been left as they were, sooner{BR}or later the village would have suffered.{ctl.FD}And by the time that happened it would{BR}have been too late.{ctl.FD}I feel sorry for the sand worms,{BR}but it was for the best......{ctl.FD}Thank you, hunter.{BR}We're in your debt.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:1B03}{ctl.FA:1902}{ctl.FA:3501}あたしは宿屋のひとり娘。働いて{BR}少しでも 家の助けになれば…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:1B03}{ctl.FA:1902}{ctl.FA:3501}I'm the only daughter of the innkeeper.{BR}If working helps the family a little...
entries.us: That city, Aiedo, beyond Nalya, is a real big city, isn't it? I'd like to go there someday.

entries.jp: 小さかった頃は、それでも{BR}少しは愛敬があったのに…{ctl.FD}あのサンドワーム、{BR}もう怖くて…。
entries.en: They had some charm back when they{BR}were little...{ctl.FD}But now those sand worms just frighten{BR}me...

entries.jp: 牧場のサンドワーム、{BR}なんとかしてくださいね。
entries.en: Please do something about the{BR}sand worms at the ranch.

entries.jp: おとうさん…{BR}また失敗して…。{ctl.FD}父が好き勝手できるのも、母が{BR}しっかり宿を守っているおかげ。{ctl.FD}そんな母も、めげない父も{BR}あたしは大好きなんですけれどね。
entries.en: Father... he's gone and failed at{BR}something again...{ctl.FD}He can chase his whims because Mother{BR}keeps the inn together so soundly.{ctl.FD}I love them both. Mother for that, and{BR}Father for never being downhearted.

entries.jp: あ、あんたらがギルドから来た{BR}ハンターさんかい？{ctl.FD}この牧場で育ててたサンドワームが大きくなって手に負えねぇんだよ！たっ、頼む！ なんとかしてくれ！どうなっても文句は言わねぇから！
entries.en: Y-you're the hunters from the guild?{ctl.FD}The sand worms I've been raising on this{BR}ranch have grown beyond our control!{ctl.FD}P-please! Do something about them!{ctl.FD}I won't complain about the consequences,{BR}just handle it!

entries.jp: ああああ。やっとのことで{BR}餌付けに成功したサンドワームが…牧場が…オレの夢が…{ctl.FD}………{ctl.FD}ありがとう、ハンターさん。{BR}終わっちまったもんはしかたない。スパッとあきらめて、{BR}次にまたがんばらなきゃな。{ctl.FD}報酬は送っておくから、{BR}ギルドで受け取ってくれよ。
entries.en: Aaaah. The sand worms I'd finally managed{BR}to tame... the ranch... my dream......{ctl.FD}.........{ctl.FD}Thank you, hunter.{BR}What's done is done.{ctl.FD}Better to move on and put all my{BR}efforts into the next thing.{ctl.FD}I'll send the fee over, so{BR}collect it at the Guild.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D904}{ctl.FA:B603}{ctl.FA:B302}{ctl.FA:C001}{ctl.FA:1443}やぁ、あんたたちが ぼくらを{BR}助けてくれたのか。ありがとうよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D904}{ctl.FA:B603}{ctl.FA:B302}{ctl.FA:C001}{ctl.FA:1443}Ah, you're the ones who came to{BR}our rescue. You have my thanks.
entries.us: Oh, so you're the guys who saved us. Thank you!

entries.jp: なんだい、あの妙な機械は？{BR}おっそろしいなぁ！
entries.en: What in the world are those weird{BR}machines? They're absolutely terrifying!
entries.us: What is that, that strange machine? It looks frightening!

entries.jp: あれ？{BR}どっかで見た顔だなぁ…。{ctl.FD}ああ、あんたらか。{BR}あのときは世話になったね！
entries.en: Hm? Your face is familiar...{ctl.FD}Ah, it's you guys.{BR}Thanks for the help from before!
entries.us: Hey? Haven't I seen your face somewhere? Oh, it's you guys. Thanks for your assistance the other day!

entries.jp: もう だいじょうぶだって？{BR}ほんとかね！ ひゅー！
entries.en: All safe now?{BR}Really! Whew!
entries.us: So everything's OK now, you say? Phew!

entries.jp: ヘンなマシンは{BR}出てこなくなったけど…。
entries.en: The odd machines have stopped coming,{BR}but...
entries.us: At least the strange machine is not appearing anymore.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D905}{ctl.FA:B604}{ctl.FA:B303}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:3401}{ctl.FA:143E}村の北にある橋が壊れてるんだよ。{BR}あれもジオのしわざなんだろうな！{ctl.FD}今 大急ぎで直しているから、{BR}もうすぐ 渡れるようになるぜ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D905}{ctl.FA:B604}{ctl.FA:B303}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:3401}{ctl.FA:143E}The bridge north of the village is{BR}broken. Zio's doing, I'll bet!{ctl.FD}They're working on it, so you'll be able to{BR}cross before long.
entries.us: The bridge north of the village is broken. I bet that's also Zio's doing! Right now, we're fixing it as fast as we can. You should be able to cross it shortly.

entries.jp: おお、あんたたちか。{BR}北の橋、直ったから渡れるぜ。
entries.en: Ah, it's you. The northern bridge is fixed.
entries.us: Hey, it's you guys. When the bridge up north is fixed, you'll be able to cross it.

entries.jp: せっかく北の橋が直って、あちこち出歩けると思ったのに…{ctl.FD}怪しげなメカが出るんで、{BR}また街にこもりっきりだ！
entries.en: The northern bridge was fixed at last{BR}and I thought I could go exploring,{ctl.FD}but now these suspicious machines are{BR}around, so I'm cooped up in town again!
entries.us: Once the bridge was fixed, I thought we'd be able to go to all sorts of places. But, with that eerie mechanical thing appearing, we're still cooped up in this town!

entries.jp: あんたたちか、{BR}また世話になるなぁ。
entries.en: Oh, it's you guys.{BR}Looks like I'm in your debt again.
entries.us: So it's you guys. I guess we're going to ask for your assistance again.

entries.jp: やってくれたか。{BR}ありがとうよ。
entries.en: You did it.{BR}Thank you.
entries.us: Oh, you've done it. Thanks so much.

entries.jp: 南の方が騒がしいが…。
entries.en: It's noisy to the south...
entries.us: It's kind of boisterous down south.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D904}{ctl.FA:B603}{ctl.FA:B302}{ctl.FA:C001}{ctl.FA:1438}北の橋の向こうに{BR}でっかい隕石が落ちたのよ！{ctl.FD}ナルヤの村が近いはずだけど、{BR}無事だったのかねぇ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D904}{ctl.FA:B603}{ctl.FA:B302}{ctl.FA:C001}{ctl.FA:1438}A huge meteorite fell beyond the{BR}northern bridge!{ctl.FD}Nalya village is near there. I hope they're{BR}safe.
entries.us: A big meteorite fell beyond the bridge to the north! It fell close to the village of Nalya. I wonder if they're OK.

entries.jp: 何なの、あの機械人間は！{BR}ろくにおもても歩けないわよ！
entries.en: What are those machine men?! I can't{BR}even walk outside!
entries.us: What was it, a mechanical human? It just walks around right outdoors!

entries.jp: ギルドからきたハンターさんって{BR}あんたたち？ 頼むわよ！
entries.en: You're the hunters from the guild? I'm{BR}counting on you!
entries.us: Are you those hunters that have come from the guild? Please help us!

entries.jp: あんたたち、{BR}けっこうやるじゃない？
entries.en: You guys are pretty good, aren't you?
entries.us: You guys, you're pretty good.

entries.jp: せっかく、マシンが{BR}出なくなったと思ったのに…！
entries.en: And I thought the machines had{BR}stopped...!
entries.us: Just as I thought, we've got the machines to stop appearing!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D902}{ctl.FA:B602}{ctl.FA:C001}{ctl.FA:1433}怪物は出る、ジオは来る…。{BR}この村は呪われているのか…？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D902}{ctl.FA:B602}{ctl.FA:C001}{ctl.FA:1433}Monsters appearing, Zio coming...{BR}Is this village cursed...?
entries.us: We've got monsters appearing and Zio is coming... Is this village cursed?

entries.jp: 怪物は出る、ジオは来る、おまけにおかしなキカイまでがうろついて…もぉぉぉぉぉおおイヤだ！！
entries.en: Monsters coming out, Zio coming, and{BR}now strange machines prowling around...{ctl.FD}Mmmnnnngh, I have had enough of it!!
entries.us: We have monsters appearing, Zio is coming, and now some strange machines are roaming around... I'm fed up!

entries.jp: もぉぉぉぉぉおお 何も{BR}出たり来たりしないんだよな？
entries.en: Mmmmnnngh. Nothing else is going to come{BR}crawling out now, right?
entries.us: Well, I hope now we won't have anything else suddenly appearing!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D904}{ctl.FA:B604}{ctl.FA:B303}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:3401}{ctl.FA:1430}だいたいあのバースバレーっての、わかんないんだよな。{ctl.FD}聖域っていうから あんまり{BR}近づかないようにしてたけど…{ctl.FD}ときどき うなるような音が{BR}奥からするんだぜ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D904}{ctl.FA:B604}{ctl.FA:B303}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:3401}{ctl.FA:1430}I never did understand that Birth{BR}Valley, if I'm honest.{ctl.FD}They call it a sanctuary, so I've{BR}always kept well away from it...{ctl.FD}but every so often, a low rumbling sound{BR}comes up out of the depths of it!
entries.us: The thing is, I just don't know what to make of Birth Valley. I hear it's a sacred area so I haven't gone too close to it. Sometimes a groaning sound can be heard coming from there!

entries.jp: バースバレーの入口がふさがって{BR}静かになったのはいいんだけどさ、音がしなきゃしないで{BR}かえって 気になるもんだな！
entries.en: It's nice that the entrance to Birth{BR}Valley is blocked and it's gone quiet...{ctl.FD}but when there's no sound at all, that's{BR}just another source of unease!
entries.us: Since Birth Valley's entrance is sealed it's nice and quiet, but on the other hand, when it's quiet it makes you all the more uneasy!

entries.jp: バースバレーが気になるのは、{BR}人間ばかりじゃないようだな！
entries.en: Seems it's not only humans who are{BR}interested in Birth Valley!
entries.us: It's not only the humans that are uneasy about Birth Valley!

entries.jp: あのキカイども、バースバレーの{BR}様子をうかがっていやがるんだ！！…まだ何か{BR}あるっていうのか！？
entries.en: Those machines are scouting out the{BR}situation at Birth Valley!!{ctl.FD}...Does that mean there's something still{BR}in there, then!?
entries.us: Those machines, they're trying to see what's going on in Birth Valley! Do you mean to say there's something else!?

entries.jp: キカイども、{BR}来なくなったみたいだな！
entries.en: The machines seem to have stopped{BR}coming!
entries.us: Those machines, it seems that they're not appearing any more!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D903}{ctl.FA:B603}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:4201}{ctl.FA:142B}調査隊なんかが来てバースバレーを荒らすからこんなことになるんだ！モタビア・アカデミーの{BR}人間は もう帰ってくれ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}……………
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D903}{ctl.FA:B603}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:4201}{ctl.FA:142B}This all happened because those survey{BR}teams disturbed Birth Valley!{ctl.FD}Motavia Academy people, go home,{BR}all of you!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}...............
entries.us: It's because that investigation team came upsetting things in Birth Valley that we're having problems! We want the people from Motavia Academy to go home!! Hmmph!

entries.jp: 調査隊なんかが来てバースバレーを荒らすからこんなことになるんだ！
entries.en: This all happened because those survey{BR}teams disturbed Birth Valley!
entries.us: It's because that investigation team came upsetting things in Birth Valley that we're having problems!

entries.jp: もう…もうイヤだぁああ！！
entries.en: I've... I've had enough!!
entries.us: I'm fed up!

entries.jp: 本当にもう安心なんだろうな？{BR}信用できないぜ、まったく！
entries.en: It's really safe now? I don't trust it, not{BR}a bit!
entries.us: I wonder if it's really safe now? I really can't trust anything!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D903}{ctl.FA:B603}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:3401}{ctl.FA:1427}ここはゼマ。{ctl.FD}バースバレーってのが奥にあるけどかかわらん方がいいんじゃないかね
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D903}{ctl.FA:B603}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:3401}{ctl.FA:1427}This is Zema. Birth Valley lies beyond, but{BR}best not meddle with it.
entries.us: This is Zema. Birth Valley is located further on, but I think it's better not to have anything to do with it.

entries.jp: ここはゼマ。{ctl.FD}バースバレーってのが奥にあるけど入口が ふさがっちまったよ。
entries.en: This is Zema. Birth Valley lies beyond, but{BR}its entrance is blocked now.
entries.us: This is Zema. Birth Valley is located further on, but the entrance is all sealed up.

entries.jp: ここはゼマ。{ctl.FD}最近、ヘンな機械人間が{BR}街のまわりをうろつくんじゃ！
entries.en: This is Zema. Strange machine men prowl{BR}around the town of late!
entries.us: This is Zema. Recently, some strange mechanical humans have been roaming the town!

entries.jp: ここはゼマ。{ctl.FD}もう 安心できる街じゃよ…。
entries.en: This is Zema. A safe town again at last...
entries.us: This is Zema. You can feel safe in this town now.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D904}{ctl.FA:B604}{ctl.FA:B303}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:3401}橋が壊れてしまったおかげで{BR}ウチの主人…{ctl.FD}アイードに行商に行ったきりなの。帰れなくて困ってるに違いないわ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D904}{ctl.FA:B604}{ctl.FA:B303}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:3401}With the bridge broken, my husband...{ctl.FD}went to sell his wares in Aiedo and hasn't{BR}returned. He's stranded, surely!
entries.us: Because the bridge is broken my husband... has not come back from peddling his wares in Aiedo. I bet he's in a dilemma trying to get home!

entries.jp: 橋が直ったんですって？{ctl.FD}これで、ウチの主人も{BR}帰ってきてくれるわ。うれしい！
entries.en: So the bridge is fixed, I heard?{ctl.FD}Then my husband can come home to us{BR}at last. I'm so glad!
entries.us: You say the bridge is fixed? Now my husband will be able to return. I'm so glad!

entries.jp: いろんな騒動も もうおさまったと思ったのに、謎のメカが…。
entries.en: I thought the trouble had settled, and{BR}now these strange mechs...
entries.us: Just as I thought all these crises were over with, now we have these strange mechanical things.

entries.jp: ハンターさん、{BR}よろしくお願いしますわ。
entries.en: Mister hunter, I'm counting on you.
entries.us: Mr. Hunter, please help us.

entries.jp: あのヘンな機械、{BR}出てこなくなったみたい…。
entries.en: Those weird machines seem to have{BR}stopped...
entries.us: Those strange machines don't seem to be appearing anymore.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D902}{ctl.FA:B602}{ctl.FA:C001}ナルヤの先のアイードの街ってさ、でーっかいんだろ？{ctl.FD}いっぺん行ってみたいなぁ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D902}{ctl.FA:B602}{ctl.FA:C001}Aiedo, out past Nalya -- it's a{BR}great big place, isn't it?{ctl.FD}I'd love to go there just once.
entries.us: That city, Aiedo, beyond Nalya, is a real big city, isn't it? I'd like to go there someday.

entries.jp: かあちゃんが おんもに出ちゃ{BR}ダメ、っていうんだ…ちぇ。
entries.en: Mama says I'm not to go outside......{BR}tch.
entries.us: Mommy says I can't go outside...that's no fun.

entries.jp: もう おんもへ行っても{BR}いいってさ。 へへ！
entries.en: I'm allowed outside now.{BR}Hehe!
entries.us: She says I can go outside now. Whee!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D907}{ctl.FA:B806}{ctl.FA:B705}{ctl.FA:B604}{ctl.FA:B303}{ctl.FA:B202}{ctl.FA:C001}「生命の聖域」か…。{ctl.FD}なぜ そのように呼ばれ、なぜ{BR}あのように祭られているのか…{ctl.FD}この おいぼれにも{BR}わからんのじゃよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D907}{ctl.FA:B806}{ctl.FA:B705}{ctl.FA:B604}{ctl.FA:B303}{ctl.FA:B202}{ctl.FA:C001}The Sanctuary of Life... Why it bears{BR}that name, why it is venerated so...{ctl.FD}even this old man doesn't know.
entries.us: Hmm, 'The Sacred Area of Life'... Why is it called that, and why is it worshipped in that way? I'm such a feeble-minded old man, I don't understand.

entries.jp: 謎のマシンに村人も戦々恐々じゃ…どうにかしないとのぉ…。
entries.en: The villagers dread these machines...{BR}something must be done...
entries.us: These strange machines are making the villagers tremble with fear. We've got to do something.

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ゥ
村のみなにも話を聞けば、マシンの手がかりがつかめるじゃろうて。{ctl.FD}頼みましたぞ。
entries.en: Ask around the village for a lead on the{BR}machines. I'm counting on you.
entries.us: You should be able to get clues about the machines by talking to the villagers. Good luck, we're counting on you.

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ェ
さすが腕は確かじゃの。報酬は{BR}ギルドで受け取っておくれ。
entries.en: Your skills are truly undeniable.{BR}Go collect your reward at the guild.
entries.us: Good job. No doubt of your skills. You'll find your compensation at the guild.

entries.jp: 世話になりましたな。
entries.en: You have my thanks.
entries.us: Thank you for your assistance.

entries.jp: ヘンなマシンも、{BR}最近とんと見かけなくなったのぉ。
entries.en: Those odd machines are hardly seen at all{BR}now.
entries.us: We haven't spotted anymore of those strange machines recently.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D904}{ctl.FA:B603}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:3301}黒い服を着た男が{BR}おそってきたんだよう。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D904}{ctl.FA:B603}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:3301}A man in black clothes attacked us.
entries.us: I saw a mean man wearing black clothes.

entries.jp: よかった よかったよー。
entries.en: Thank goodness! Oh, thank goodness!
entries.us: I'm glad, I'm glad.

entries.jp: また何か{BR}こわいことがおきるの？？
entries.en: Will something scary happen again??
entries.us: Is something frightening going to happen again?

entries.jp: もう こわいコト{BR}ないんだよねっ！
entries.en: No more scary things, right?
entries.us: There won't be anymore scary stuff, right?

entries.jp: もう こわいコト{BR}ないんだろ？
entries.en: No more scary things... right?
entries.us: There won't be anymore frightening things, will there?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D903}{ctl.FA:B603}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:3301}ママがここにかくれてなさいって…ねぇ、外はどうなっているの？{ctl.FD}ママ……パパ……うぇぇえ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D903}{ctl.FA:B603}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:3301}Mama told me to hide in here......{BR}Hey, what's happening outside?{ctl.FD}Mama...... Papa...... waaah.
entries.us: Mommy said to hide here... What's going on outside? Mommy...Daddy....Waaaaa!

entries.jp: ママもパパも元気でよかったわ！
entries.en: I'm glad Mama and Papa are safe!
entries.us: I'm glad both Mommy and Daddy are OK!

entries.jp: ママ…パパぁ…。
entries.en: Mama... Papa...
entries.us: Mommy...Daddy...

entries.jp: ママ！ パパ！ うふふっ。
entries.en: Mama! Papa! Hehe.
entries.us: Mommy! Daddy! Hee, hee.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D904}{ctl.FA:B604}{ctl.FA:B303}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:140A}元通りになったのはいいけど、またジオが襲ってくるんじゃないかしらこの子たちだけは{BR}なんとしても守らないと…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D904}{ctl.FA:B604}{ctl.FA:B303}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:140A}I'm relieved things are back to normal,{BR}but what if Zio attacks again?{ctl.FD}I have to protect these children,{BR}no matter what......
entries.us: I'm glad that everything is back to normal, but I'm afraid that Zio is going to come back and attack us. We have to defend the village, and protect these children...

entries.jp: ジオは死んだ…本当ですか？{BR}ああっ、これで安心…！
entries.en: Zio is dead... really?{BR}Ah, at last we're safe...!
entries.us: Zio is dead...is that true? Oh, finally, I'm so relieved!

entries.jp: ジオは死んだと聞いたのに…{BR}まだ世の中は治まらないのですか？
entries.en: I heard Zio is dead... but is the world{BR}still in turmoil?
entries.us: I've heard that Zio is dead, but then why aren't things under control?

entries.jp: わたし、見ました…！{BR}あの機械人間たち、空を飛ぶの！{ctl.FD}…北東の方からやってきたの！{BR}本当よ！！
entries.en: I, I saw it...!{BR}Those mechanical humans -- they fly!{ctl.FD}...They came from away to the{BR}northeast! It's true, I tell you!!
entries.us: I saw them! I saw those mechanical humans fly! They came from the northeast! It's true!

entries.jp: 安心していいのでしょうか…？
entries.en: Is it safe to relax...?
entries.us: I wonder, can we feel safe now?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D902}{ctl.FA:B602}{ctl.FA:C001}{ctl.FA:1405}ジオが手をふり上げた瞬間、{BR}目の前がまっくらになったんだ。{ctl.FD}気がついたら あんたらがそこに{BR}立っていたというわけさ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D902}{ctl.FA:B602}{ctl.FA:C001}{ctl.FA:1405}The moment Zio raised his hand,{BR}everything before my eyes went black.{ctl.FD}The next thing I knew, there{BR}you all were, standing over me.
entries.us: The moment Zio raised his hand, all I saw was blackness. Then, when I came to, you guys were standing right there.

entries.jp: あのキカイたち、{BR}人は襲わないっていうじゃないか！そんなにコワがること{BR}ないんじゃないか？？
entries.en: They say those machines don't attack{BR}people, don't they!{ctl.FD}So there's no reason to be so{BR}frightened of them, surely??
entries.us: They say those machines don't assault humans! So there shouldn't be any need to be afraid, right?

entries.jp: この世は なべて{BR}コトも無し、だといいな！
entries.en: All's right with the world - if only!
entries.us: If only this world was free of problems!

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}うう…奥からモンスターが…
entries.en: {ctl.F3}Ugh... monsters, from deeper in...

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}ホルト教授は奥へ行ったっきりだ…おそらく…もう…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}そんな…！
entries.en: {ctl.F3}Professor Holt went in and never came{BR}back... He's probably... already...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}No...!
entries.us: They've been turned into stone!

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}石になってる…
entries.en: {ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}He's turned to stone...
entries.us: They've been turned into stone!

entries.jp: {ctl.F2:039F}{ctl.F2:00000A}{ctl.F9:13}{ctl.F2:00000B}{ctl.F9:13}{ctl.F2:00000C}{ctl.F4:03}ああっ！ ホルト教授！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00000D}{ctl.F4:01}これはいったい…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}…古代の呪法！？ 今、こんな事{BR}できるヤツがいるなんて…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}元に戻す方法はないんですか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}「アルシュリン」って薬なら石化をとけるって聞いた事あるけど…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}それは どこにあるんですかっ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}前にモタビアンの村で聞いたんだ…でも、ずいぶん昔の話だよ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}モタビアンの村っていうと…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}ここから ずーっと南に行った{BR}モルカムの村さ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:03}よし！ じゃあ さっそく{BR}行きましょう！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00000E}{ctl.F4:02}えっとモルカムまでだったら…と。おおまけにまけて500メセタね{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}{ctl.F2:00000F}……………オニ。{ctl.F9:3B}
entries.en: {ctl.F2:039F}{ctl.F2:00000A}{ctl.F9:13}{ctl.F2:00000B}{ctl.F9:13}{ctl.F2:00000C}{ctl.F4:03}Ah! Professor Holt!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00000D}{ctl.F4:01}What in the world happened here...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}...An ancient curse?! To think there's{BR}someone capable of this nowadays...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Is there no way to reverse this?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}I've heard of a medicine called Alshlin{BR}that can undo petrification, but...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Where can we find it?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}I heard of it in a Motavian village{BR}once... though that was a long while back.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}A Motavian village, you say?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}The village of Molcum, a good long{BR}way south of here.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:03}Right! Then let's go right away!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00000E}{ctl.F4:02}To Molcum... let's see. I'll give you a huge{BR}discount: 500 meseta.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}{ctl.F2:00000F}............Monster.{ctl.F9:3B}

entries.jp: {ctl.F2:000023}{ctl.F4:0D}おお？ や、ハーンではないか！{BR}イヤここはスゴい所だぞ！！{ctl.FD}先文明の遺産がゴロゴロしとる！{BR}ちょうどいい、おまえも…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}ホルト教授！ 何言ってんです！{ctl.FD}あなたは 今の今まで{BR}ジオに石にされてたんですよ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}ああん？ そーなの？{ctl.FD}まぁ 今こうしてピンピン{BR}しとるんだから気にするな！{ctl.FD}よぉし！ すぐに調査再開じゃ！{BR}ハーン！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}はい！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}おまえはな、アカデミーに戻って{BR}事の次第を報告しとくれ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}……はぁ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}よぉし！{BR}バースバレーの奥に出発じゃあ！！{ctl.F2:000024}{ctl.F4:02}ヘンなじいさんだねぇ…！{BR}でもまぁ、一件落着ってところね。{ctl.F4:03}どうもすみません、ロクにお礼も{BR}言わず…あんな人ですので…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}気にしないでよ、ハーン！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}さて、ひと仕事終わって疲れたわ。今日はゆっくり休もう、ルディ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}うん！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F2:000027}{ctl.F4:03}ぼくは アカデミーに戻るよ。{BR}今までのことを報告しとかなきゃ。{ctl.F4:01}うん…パイクは？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}オレか？ オレは…ジオを倒しに{BR}行くさ。…たとえひとりででもな！{ctl.F4:01}そんなムチャな！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}ムチャでも何でも かまうもんか！もう…決めたんだ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000028}{ctl.F9:4F}{ctl.F2:000029}{ctl.F4:02}…仕事もひとくぎりついたし…{ctl.FD}本来なら ハンターギルドのある{BR}アイードの街に帰るところよね…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:03FE}{ctl.F4:00}うわぁぁあ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00002A}{ctl.F2:03A9}{ctl.F4:02}何っ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}悲鳴だ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F2:000023}{ctl.F4:0D}Oh? Why, if it isn't Hahn!{BR}What a marvelous place this is!!{ctl.FD}Relics of the earlier civilization are lying{BR}around everywhere!{ctl.FD}Perfect timing -- you others can also...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Professor Holt! What are you saying!{ctl.FD}Until a moment ago, Zio had you{BR}turned to stone!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}Eh? Did he now?{ctl.FD}Well, I'm hale and hearty as you see,{BR}so never mind that!{ctl.FD}Right! We resume the survey at once!{BR}Hahn!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Yes!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}You are to go back to the Academy and{BR}report what has happened.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}......Ugh, okay.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}All right then! Into the depths of{BR}Birth Valley!!{ctl.F2:000024}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}What an odd old man...!{BR}But anyway, that settles that.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}I'm sorry, he hardly even thanked{BR}you. He's always been like that.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Don't worry about that, Hahn!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Well, the job's done and I'm tired.{BR}Let's take a load off today. Rudy?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Yeah!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F7}{ctl.F2:000027}{ctl.F4:03}I'll go back to the Academy.{BR}I must report all of this.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Right... and you, Pyke?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Me? I'm... I'm going to bring Zio down.{BR}Even if it means doing it alone!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}That's crazy!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Crazy or not, what do I care!{BR}I've... I've made up my mind!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000028}{ctl.F9:4F}{ctl.F2:000029}{ctl.F4:02}...And the job comes to an end...{ctl.FD}Normally we'd be going home to Aiedo,{BR}where the Hunters Guild is...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:03FE}{ctl.F4:00}Aaaaaah!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00002A}{ctl.F2:03A9}{ctl.F4:02}What was that?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}A scream!!

entries.jp: {ctl.F2:00002B}{ctl.F4:03}こ、こんな…き、教授は！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}行くよ、ルディ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}はいっ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F2:00002B}{ctl.F4:03}Wh-what is this...{BR}Oh no... Professor?!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Let's go, Rudy!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Right!!

entries.jp: {ctl.F2:00002C}{ctl.F4:01}ふうっ…今のはどう、ライラ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}そうね、少しは{BR}ましになってきたわね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00002D}{ctl.F4:00}たたりじゃ！ 聖域をおかすから{BR}こんなことになるのじゃ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00002E}{ctl.F4:01}…たたりか…この奥、いったい{BR}何があるっていうんだろう…！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00002F}{ctl.F4:03}なんてこった！ 教授はまだ中だ！{ctl.FD}…………{ctl.FD}あの……ライラさん？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}1000メセタにしとくわよん。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}……け、結婚資金が……
entries.en: {ctl.F2:00002C}{ctl.F4:01}Phew... how was it this time, Laila?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Not bad. You're getting a little{BR}better at it.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00002D}{ctl.F4:00}A curse! This is what comes of{BR}defiling the sanctuary!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00002E}{ctl.F4:01}A curse... What in the world is in there...!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00002F}{ctl.F4:03}Oh no! The Professor is still inside!{ctl.FD}..........{ctl.FD}Um...... Miss Laila?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Let's say 1000 meseta.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}......M-my wedding fund......

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:1004}{ctl.F6}ヨい
{ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}岩で塞がってしまった。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}シード…。
entries.en: {ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}It's been blocked by rocks.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Seed...
entries.us: It's sealed off by a rock... Seed...

entries.jp: おお、ギルドから来なさったか。{BR}よろしくお願いしますぞ。{ctl.FD}実は一週間ほど前から村のまわりを正体不明のマシンがうろついての…どうも、バースバレーの奥を{BR}調べようとしとるらしいんじゃ。{ctl.FD}村人に危害を加えようとはしないのじゃが…村のみなが不安がっての。できれば、{BR}追っぱらってほしいんじゃよ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ふーん…おかしいな。オレたちは{BR}村に入るとき、襲われたぜ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}いえ ルディ、あれは私だけを{BR}ねらっているようでした。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…？？？
entries.en: Ah, you've come from the guild.{BR}I'm counting on you.{ctl.FD}The truth is, about a week ago machines{BR}of some unknown kind began prowling{ctl.FD}around the village...{ctl.FD}They seem to be trying to get into the{BR}depths of Birth Valley.{ctl.FD}They haven't tried to harm the villagers,{BR}but everyone is uneasy.{ctl.FD}If possible, I'd like to have you drive{BR}them off...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Hm... that's odd. They attacked us as we{BR}were coming into the village.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}No, Rudy. They appeared to be after{BR}me alone.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...???
entries.us: Ah, you've come from the guild. Thank goodness for your help. You see, since about a week ago, unidentified machines have been roaming this village. It looks like they're trying to inspect Birth Valley. They're not doing any harm to the villagers, but it's making us all uneasy. If you could, we'd like you to drive them away. Hmm...that's strange. When we entered the village didn't they attack us? No, Chaz, it seems that I was their only target. Oh?

entries.jp: おお、マシンの元締めを{BR}たたいたというのか…！{ctl.FD}確かに、マシンの姿は{BR}見当たらなくなったようじゃ。{ctl.FD}さすが腕は確かじゃの。報酬は{BR}ギルドで受け取っておくれ。
entries.en: Oho, so you struck down the one behind{BR}the machines...!{ctl.FD}True enough, there's no sign of them{BR}to be seen anymore.{ctl.FD}Your skills are surely impressive.{BR}Please collect your reward at the guild.
entries.us: Oh, you've beaten the controller of those machines! It must be true. We don't see those machines anymore. Good job. There's no doubt of your skills. You'll find your compensation at the guild.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:03}ホルト教授…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}ったく、うじうじしてんじゃないよモルカムへ行くよ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:03}Professor Holt......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Honestly, that's enough moping.{BR}We're going to Molcum!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}ここはクルップの村だよ。{ctl.FD}ハーン！ ハーンじゃないか！{BR}帰ってきたのかい！？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:4201}This is the village of Krupp.{ctl.FD}Hahn! Hahn, is that you?!{BR}You've come home!?
entries.us: This is the village of Krup. Hahn! It's Hahn! You've come home!?

entries.jp: ここはクルップの村だよ。
entries.en: This is the village of Krupp.
entries.us: This is the village of Krup.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4202}{ctl.FA:1201}ハーン、よく帰ってきたね！{ctl.FD}サーヤがよろこぶよ！{BR}はやく会っておやりよ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}サーヤ…って？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}えっ！ いやっ、その……。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:4202}{ctl.FA:1201}Hahn, welcome home!{ctl.FD}Saya will be overjoyed!{BR}Go see her right away!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}"Saya''...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Wha--! U-uh, that is......
entries.us: It's good to see you home, Hahn! Saya will be overjoyed to see you! Go see her! Who's Saya? Oh! Er, well...

entries.jp: ハーン、よく帰ってきたね！
entries.en: Hahn, welcome home!
entries.us: It's good to see you home, Hahn!

entries.jp: ハーンがお世話になりました。
entries.en: Thank you for looking after Hahn.
entries.us: Thank you for everything you've done for Hahn.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:1301}トノエなら北の方だけど、{BR}途中の道が迷路になってんだぜ。{ctl.FD}しかも その入口が大きな岩で{BR}ふさがれてるときてる。{ctl.FD}このあいだまで{BR}開いてたのにな。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:1301}Tonoe's north of here, but the road{BR}there turns into a maze.{ctl.FD}And the way in is blocked by{BR}giant rocks, no less.{ctl.FD}It was open until just the other day.
entries.us: Well, Tonoe is north of here but the road to Tonoe is like a maze. Moreover, the entrance to Tonoe is blocked by a large rock. That's what I heard recently.

entries.jp: トノエなら 北の方だけど、{BR}途中の道が迷路になってんだぜ。{ctl.FD}そんなとこに行くなんて{BR}物好きだな。
entries.en: Tonoe's north of here, but the road{BR}there turns into a maze.{ctl.FD}You must be a real weirdo,{BR}wanting to go to a place like that.
entries.us: Well, Tonoe is north of here but the road to Tonoe is like a maze. What a curiosity seeker you must be to want to go to a place like that.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}この村の出世頭は 防具屋の{BR}ひとり息子、ハーンだよ。{ctl.FD}モタビア・アカデミーの{BR}学者なんだ。村の誇りだねぇ。{ctl.FD}え？ なんだハーンじゃないの！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:4201}This village's greatest success is the{BR}armorer's only son, Hahn.{ctl.FD}A scholar at Motavia Academy.{BR}The pride of the village.{ctl.FD}Eh? Why, if it isn't Hahn himself!
entries.us: This village's most successful citizen is Hahn, the armorer's only son. He's a professor at Motavia Academy. We're really proud of him. What! Well, if it isn't Hahn!

entries.jp: この村の出世頭は 防具屋の{BR}ひとり息子、ハーンだよ。{ctl.FD}モタビア・アカデミーの{BR}学者なんだ。村の誇りだねぇ。
entries.en: This village's greatest success is the{BR}armorer's only son, Hahn.{ctl.FD}A scholar at Motavia Academy.{BR}The pride of the village.
entries.us: This village's most successful citizen is Hahn, the armorer's only son. He's a professor at at Motavia Academy. We're really proud of him.

entries.jp: そこの湖はな、昔 大きな{BR}隕石が落ちてできたあとに、{ctl.FD}水がたまったものなんだってよ。{BR}本当かね！？
entries.en: That lake? They say a huge meteorite{BR}crashed there in the distant past...{ctl.FD}and the crater it left filled up{BR}with water. Is that for real?!
entries.us: That lake there? It was created by a meteor that struck the planet. The crater filled with water long ago. Unbelievable, huh?

entries.jp: 近くの大きな湖に{BR}小島が見えるじゃろ？{ctl.FD}その上に見える建物な、昔から{BR}「戦士の神殿」と言われとるんじゃわしは昔泳いで行ったことがあるが神殿へ通ずる道は怪物がうようよ！危うく逃げ帰ってきたんじゃ。{BR}そのときの傷がこれじゃよ。ほほ！
entries.en: Y'see the little island in the big{BR}lake nearby?{ctl.FD}That building on it has long been called{BR}the Warriors' Temple since olden times.{ctl.FD}I swam out there once, but the path{BR}to it was crawling with monsters!{ctl.FD}Barely made it home with my life.{BR}Got this here scar from that day. Hah!
entries.us: See that little island in the big lake near here? The building on that island has been called Soldiers' Temple since long ago. Once, I swam over there, but there were monsters all over the island! It was frightening and I came rushing home.

entries.jp: うちの子も サーヤに{BR}あずけておけば安心だわ！
entries.en: I can rest easy leaving our child{BR}in Saya's care!
entries.us: I'm confident our child  will be safe with Saya.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:1101}こうして空を見て{BR}明日の天気を占うのよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:1101}We read the sky like this to tell{BR}what tomorrow's weather will be.
entries.us: We look up to the sky in this manner to predict tomorrow's weather.

entries.jp: このあいだ 西の方で{BR}ものすごい煙が あがってたの！{ctl.FD}どこかで大きな火事でも{BR}あったのかしら？ 気になるわぁ。
entries.en: The other day there was a lot of{BR}smoke rising in the west!{ctl.FD}Was there a huge fire somewhere?{BR}It does worry me.
entries.us: The other day, there was a tremendous amount of smoke coming from the west! I wonder if there was a big fire somewhere?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:03}サーヤっ！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0C}ハーン！ 帰ってきてくれたのね！うれしい！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}サーヤ！ 会いたかったよ！{ctl.FD}…みなさん、ご紹介します。{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}ぼくの、…ゴホン！{BR}こ、婚約者のサーヤです。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}婚約者ぁあ！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0C}初めまして。{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0C}サーヤともうします。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}サーヤは自分の家で 子供たちに{BR}勉強を教えてるんですよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}へぇ…えらいですね！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0C}いいえ…こんなことくらいしか{BR}できませんから、わたくし…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}こちらは仕事を手伝ってもらってるハンターのライラさんとルディくん{ctl.F4:0C}初めまして。{BR}…大変なお仕事ですのね、ハーン？ライラさん、ルディさん、{BR}ハーンをよろしくお願いしますね。{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}そんなに心配しなくても{BR}だいじょうぶだよぅ。{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0C}いいえ！ あなたにもしものことがあったら わたくし……{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}サーヤ……{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0C}ハーン……{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:02}……勝手にやってて…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:03}Saya!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0C}Hahn! You came back to me!{BR}I'm so happy!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Saya! I've missed you!{ctl.FD}...Everyone, let me introduce you.{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03} This is{BR}my... ahem! My f-fiancee, Saya.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Fiancee?!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0C}How do you do? {ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0C}My name is Saya.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Saya teaches the village children{BR}out of her own home.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Oh... that's admirable!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0C}Oh, no... it is really the only way I can{BR}be of any use...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}These are the hunters helping me{BR}with my work, Laila and Rudy.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0C}How do you do.{BR}...It's difficult work, isn't it, Hahn?{ctl.FD}Miss Laila, Mister Rudy, please look{BR}after Hahn for me.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}There's no need to worry so much about{BR}me, I'll be okay.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0C}But, if anything were to happen to you,{BR}I......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Saya......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0C}Hahn......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:02}......Don't mind me...!
entries.us: Saya! Hahn! You've come home! I'm so happy! Saya! I've missed you! Let me introduce you to everyone. This is my...ahem... fi..fiancee, Saya. Fiancee!? It's a pleasure to meet you. My name is Saya. Saya teaches children here in her home. Wow...I'm impressed! Oh, no, it's about the only thing I'm capable of doing... Alys and Chaz are hunters. They are assisting me in my task. It's a difficult job, isn't it? Thank you for taking care of Hahn. Now, don't you worry. Everything will be okay. But, if anything were to happen to you, I... Saya... Hahn... ...Oh, you two...!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6301}{ctl.F4:0C}ライラさん、ルディさん、{BR}ハーンをよろしくお願いしますね。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6301}{ctl.F4:0C}Miss Laila, Mister Rudy, please look{BR}after Hahn for me.
entries.us: Thank you, again, for taking care of Hahn.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:0C}ライラさんが こんなことに{BR}なってしまうなんて……{ctl.FD}ルディさん、気を落とさずに{BR}がんばってくださいね。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:0C}That such a thing should happen{BR}to Miss Laila......{ctl.FD}Mister Rudy, don't let it break you.{BR}Keep your spirits up, and do your best.
entries.us: Oh, that such a thing has happened to Alys... Keep your spirits up Chaz and best of luck.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}サーヤ先生はやさしくってきれいであたし、大好きよ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}Miss Saya is kind and beautiful,{BR}and I love her!
entries.us: My teacher Saya is kind and beautiful. I love her!

entries.jp: 先生が しばらく自習して{BR}なさいって。…さびしいなぁ。
entries.en: Teacher said to study on our own{BR}for a while. ...It's pretty lonely.
entries.us: Teacher says to study on our own for a while. It's lonely without her.

entries.jp: あれ、赤い服のおねえちゃんは{BR}どこへ行ったの？
entries.en: Hey, where did the lady in the red{BR}dress go?
entries.us: Hey, where did that lady in the red dress go?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}ぼく、大きくなったらサーヤ先生をお嫁さんにもらうんだ！{ctl.FD}約束したんだ！ 本当だぞ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}When I grow up, I'm going to marry{BR}Miss Saya!{ctl.FD}I promised! It's true!
entries.us: When I grow up, I'm going to ask my teacher, Saya, to marry me! I made a promise to her! It's true!

entries.jp: 先生が しばらく自習して{BR}なさいって。…さびしいなぁ。
entries.en: Teacher said to study on our own{BR}for a while. ...It's pretty lonely.
entries.us: Teacher says to study on our own for a while. It's lonely without her.

entries.jp: おかあさんたちが悲しそうな顔して集まってたけど、何かあったの？
entries.en: All the mothers gathered together{BR}looking sad. Did something happen?
entries.us: Everybody's mothers are congregating and looking sad. Did something happen?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}最近の破滅的環境破壊には何者かの作為が感じられるんだけど……。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}か、かわいくない…
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}I detect a deliberate hand behind the{BR}recent ruin of our environment......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}N-not cute at all...
entries.us: I think the recent environmental disaster was deliberately caused by someone... What a smart aleck kid...

entries.jp: いくらけがしたからってさ、{ctl.FD}婚約者のやとったハンターに{BR}一日中 つきそってやるなんて…{ctl.FD}サーヤ先生も お人好しだよな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}………
entries.en: Sitting with the hunter her fiance hired{BR}all day long, just because she's injured...{ctl.FD}Miss Saya is so kind-hearted!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}.........
entries.us: Yeah, so she's hurt, but Saya is one good-natured person to stay by the side of a hunter that her fiancee hired! Oh.

entries.jp: 年なんか とらなくたって{BR}時が来れば人は死ぬんだよな。{ctl.FD}こないだは ひどいこと言って{BR}悪かったよ…。
entries.en: Regardless of age, when the time comes,{BR}people will just die.{ctl.FD}I'm sorry for the awful thing{BR}I said the other day...
entries.us: When the time comes, humans die no matter how old they are. I'm sorry I said such a terrible thing the other day.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}あたし、サーヤ先生みたいな{BR}大人になりたいわ！{ctl.FD}でもハーンみたいなカレはイヤね。もっとしっかりした人でなくちゃ！{ctl.F4:03}………
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}I want to grow up to be like Miss Saya!{ctl.FD}But I wouldn't want a guy like Hahn.{BR}He'd have to be someone more reliable!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}.........
entries.us: I want to grow up to be like my teacher Saya! But I wouldn't like a guy like Hahn. He's got to be more reliable! Ahem.

entries.jp: 赤い服のおねえちゃん、病気なの？はやく なおるといいね！
entries.en: Is the lady in the red dress sick? I hope{BR}she gets better soon!
entries.us: Is that lady in the red dress sick? Hope she gets better soon!

entries.jp: 赤い服のおねえちゃん、{BR}もういないって本当なの？
entries.en: Is it true the lady in the red dress{BR}isn't here anymore?
entries.us: Is it true that the lady in the red dress isn't here anymore?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}ぼ、ぼく トイレに行きたいけど{BR}授業が終わるまではガマンしなきゃからかわれて ヘンなあだなを{BR}つけられるのはまっぴらだからね！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}I-I need the bathroom, but I have to hold{BR}on until class ends.{ctl.FD}I'd hate to be teased and given some{BR}weird nickname for it!
entries.us: I...I want to use the bathroom, but I'll have to hold it 'til class is over. I don't want to miss a thing Saya is teaching.

entries.jp: 先生がいなくなったから 今のうちトイレに行ってきちゃおうかな？
entries.en: Teacher's gone, so maybe I should{BR}run to the bathroom while I can?
entries.us: Since the teacher is gone, maybe I should go to the bathroom now.

entries.jp: あれ？ 目の下が赤いよ？{BR}わかった、いじめられたんだ。
entries.en: Oh? It's all red beneath your eyes.{BR}I know, you got picked on.
entries.us: Oh dear! Your eyelids are red! You were teased, weren't you?

entries.jp: あーあ。うちの息子も となりの{BR}ハーンくらい頭がよきゃあねぇ。
entries.en: Ah, me. If only our boy had half{BR}the brains of Hahn next door.
entries.us: Oh yes. If only our son was as bright as Hahn.

entries.jp: しかたないよな。{BR}あの母親の子供なんだからよ。
entries.en: It can't be helped, can it.{BR}With a mother like that.
entries.us: It can't be helped, don't you think? After all, being a child of that mother...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}ハーン！{ctl.FD}勘当された身で よくもこの家の{BR}じゅうたんをふめたものだな！？{ctl.FD}店もつがず 勉強ばかりして！{BR}そんなものが何の役に立つんだ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}とうさん、今はこの星自体が{BR}危ない状態なんだ。{ctl.FD}それをぼくは科学の力で助けたい！そのために勉強しているんだよ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}Hahn!{ctl.FD}Disinherited, and still you'd tread{BR}on this family's carpet?!{ctl.FD}You won't take the shop, you only{BR}study! What good is that to anyone?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Father, the whole planet itself{BR}is in danger now.{ctl.FD}I want to save it with the power{BR}of science! That's why I study!
entries.us: Hahn! Considering that you are disinherited, you sure have some gall to step into this house!? You don't help in the family business, you just study! What use is that? Pa, right now, the whole planet is in serious danger! I want to help with the power of science! That's why I'm studying!

entries.jp: ハーンも生意気なことを{BR}言うようになったものじゃ…。{ctl.FD}このあいだまで ヨチヨチ{BR}歩いていたと思ったがの。
entries.en: To think Hahn has started speaking{BR}so boldly...{ctl.FD}It seems like just yesterday he was{BR}taking baby steps.
entries.us: So Hahn, he has learnt to say some mighty cheeky things. It seems like just yesterday that he was taking his first baby steps.

entries.jp: 祖父の代からの防具屋も終わり…{BR}それもいいかもしれませんな！
entries.en: This armor shop has been in the family{BR}since my grandfather's time...{ctl.FD}And now it's coming to an end.{BR}But, maybe that's for the best!
entries.us: This armor shop was started in my grandfather's generation. And now it's all over, maybe it's for the best!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}ハーン！ よく帰って……。{ctl.FD}とうさんは ああ言うけど、本当はおまえのことを心配してるんだよ？{ctl.F4:03}わかってるよ、かあさん。…でも{BR}ぼくの気持ちは変わらないよ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6302}{ctl.FA:4201}Hahn! It's good to have you......{ctl.FD}Your father talks that way, but the{BR}truth is he worries about you.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}I know, Mother. ...But it doesn't{BR}change how I feel!
entries.us: Hahn! It's good to see you home! Your Pa goes on like that, but really he's very proud of you. I know, Ma... But my feelings won't change!

entries.jp: おとうさん、ハーンも{BR}もう りっぱな大人ですよ。
entries.en: Dear, Hahn is a grown man now.
entries.us: Dear, Hahn is an adult now.

entries.jp: ハーン…また行ってしまって…{BR}たまには顔を見せにきておくれよ…
entries.en: Hahn... off again already...{BR}Show your face here from time to time...
entries.us: Hahn...so you're leaving again... Come back and show your face once in a while.

entries.jp: だんなさまは ハーンぼっちゃん{BR}のこと、ああ言いますけど…{ctl.FD}ぼっちゃんが 研究済みの資料を{BR}ほんの少し流してくれるからこそ、{ctl.FD}こんないなかでも りっぱな{BR}防具を売ることができるんです。
entries.en: The master speaks of young Hahn{BR}that way, but...{ctl.FD}it's only because the young master{BR}passes us a little of his research{ctl.FD}that a backwater like this can{BR}sell such fine armor at all.
entries.us: Hahn's Pa talks like that, but... It's thanks to Hahn sending us the scientific literature that he has completed that a rural place like this is able to sell such splendid weapons.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:03}ライラさん！{BR}しっかりしてください！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:03}Laila! Please, hold on!!
entries.us: Alys! You've got to make it!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:0C}これはいったい どんな病気！？{BR}こんな苦しそうなの見たことないわまだ意識があるのが不思議なくらい…本当に意志の強い方ですのね…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:0C}What manner of illness is this?!{BR}I've never seen such suffering.{ctl.FD}It's a wonder she's conscious at{BR}all... What a strong will she has!
entries.us: What on earth is this illness she has?! I've never seen anyone seem to be in so much pain. It's almost amazing she's still conscious. She really is strong-willed!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:22}うっ…ルディ…そんな情けない顔{BR}するんじゃないよ…フフ…くうっ！{ctl.F4:01}ライラ…しっかり…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:22}Ngh... Rudy... don't make such a{BR}pathetic face... heh... aagh!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Laila... hold on...!
entries.us: Oooo...Chaz...don't look so miserable...ow...ooo! Alys...don't give up...!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:0C}ハーン！ 帰ってきてくれたのね！…でも、どうかなさったの！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ハーン、このひとは？{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}ぼくの婚約者のサーヤです。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0C}初めまして。サーヤともうします。{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}サーヤ、あいさつは後だ！{BR}今はライラさんを…！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0C}たいへん！ 早くベッドに！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:0C}Hahn! You've come home!{BR}...But what has happened!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Hahn, who is this?{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}This is Saya, my fiancee.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0C}How do you do.{BR}My name is Saya.{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}Saya, greetings can wait!{BR}Right now, Laila...!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0C}Oh no! Get her to a bed, quickly!!
entries.us: Hahn! You've come home! ...but, has something happened!? Hahn, who is this person? This is my fiancee, Saya. Nice to meet you. I'm Saya. Don't worry about greetings now, Saya! At this point, we've got to take care of Alys! Oh dear! We've got to get her to bed immediately!!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ライラ…。{ctl.F7}{ctl.F2:00004B}{ctl.F4:03}これは…わからないよ、{BR}どういう症状なのか…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}いっこうに良くならないな…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ジオ…あいつは今までに戦ってきた相手とは 何か違っていた…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}何物をも受けつけない{BR}悪しき力に守られていたような…{ctl.FD}そんな気がしました…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}くそォ！ ジオのヤロウ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}でも、フレナは助けだせたんだからナルバスを止めてしまえば…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}それはダメですわ！{ctl.FD}だってナルバスはジオスフォートの地下にあるんですもの！{ctl.FD}というより、ナルバスの上にジオが城を建てた、ということですけれど{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}あの結界の下か！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}やはりジオを倒さねば…！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:22}ス…レイなら…{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}ライラ！ しゃべっちゃダメだよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:22}スレイなら…何か…{BR}手を知っているはずだよ…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ライラさん、あたしたちでジオは{BR}やっつけるから…いいのよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:22}いいかい…今のあたしらじゃ…{BR}どうあがいても勝てない…！{ctl.FD}ジオの…マジックバリアを…{BR}何とかしないと…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}マジックバリア！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}「マジック」！ そんなもの、{BR}千年以上前に絶えて久しいはず…！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}あ！ スレイ、確か「マジック」を使ってたよ！ フレエリとか…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:22}そう…だから…スレイに協力して…もらえば…ううっ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ライラさん！{BR}ルディ、スレイ…さん、って？{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}ああ、いけすかないキザ野郎だよ！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}でも…確かに…くやしいけど、{BR}あいつに頼むしかないみたいだな…{ctl.F4:03}スレイって確か、ドリンじいさんとどっか行っちゃったんじゃないか？{ctl.F4:05}ドリンじいさんなら…{BR}{ctl.F2:00004C}「ラデアの塔」かもしれない。{ctl.FD}再び ラデアの塔の門を開けねば{BR}ならんか…と言っていたからな。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ラデアの塔って…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}オレも よくは知らないんだがな、東の流砂の先の半島にあるらしい。ドリンじいさんは あそこに大事な物が眠っていると言っていたよ…。{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:01}流砂なんてどうやってこえるんだ？スレイやドリンじいさんは…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}そこまでは知らないよ！{BR}それこそマジックでも使うんだろ？{ctl.F4:07}だいじょうぶ、おまかせください！{ctl.F2:00004D}「ランドマスター」がありますわ！{ctl.F4:01}ランドマスター？{BR}何それ？{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}ランドマスターが まだ{BR}残っているっていうの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}ええ、その通り。旧文明の{BR}万能装甲車、ランドマスター！{ctl.FD}あれなら 流砂なんか{BR}物の数ではありませんわ！{ctl.FD}そう…ちょうどここから南の、{BR}マシンセンターに行けばあるはず。{ctl.F4:01}マシンセンター…{BR}そんなのあったっけ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}わたしと来てくだされば{BR}わかりますわよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:03}よし！ じゃあ 急いで{BR}また出発しましょう！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}…ハーンは、{BR}ここに残ってくれないか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}え？ そ、そんな…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}残って、ライラを{BR}みていてほしいんだ。{ctl.FD}それに、ハーンには{BR}そこの かわいい彼女もいるしね！{ctl.F4:03}う…しかし…。{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}ライラ、きっとスレイを{BR}見つけてくるからね！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:22}ルディ…！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}ハーン…ライラを頼むよ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Laila...{ctl.F7}{ctl.F2:00004B}{ctl.F4:03}I... I don't understand this.{BR}What kind of affliction is this...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}She's not getting better at all...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Zio... he was different{BR}from anyone we've ever fought...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}As though he were shielded by an{BR}evil power that repelled everything...{ctl.FD}That is how it felt to me...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Damn it! That bastard Zio!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}But we got Frena out, so if we{BR}shut Nurvus down...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}That will not work!{ctl.FD}Nurvus lies beneath{BR}Zio's Fort!{ctl.FD}Or rather, Zio built his castle{BR}on top of Nurvus.{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}Under that barrier!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}So Zio has to be beaten first...!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:22}Th... ray would...{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}Laila! You shouldn't be{BR}talking!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:22}Thray would... know some...{BR}way of dealing with it...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Laila, we'll handle Zio{BR}ourselves... it's all right!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:22}Listen... as things are now...{BR}it's impossible, there's no way to win...{ctl.FD}Zio's... magic barrier...{BR}something must be done about it...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Magic barrier!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Magic! That supposedly died out more{BR}than a thousand years ago...!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}Ah! Thray was using magic,{BR}I'm sure of it! Like that Flaeli thing...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:22}Yes... so... if you can get Thray{BR}to help you... uugh!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Laila!{BR}Rudy, who is this Thray?{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}Oh, he's an insufferable smug jerk!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}But... it's true... and I hate to admit it,{BR}but it seems we have to ask him...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Didn't Thray go off somewhere{BR}with Elder Dorin?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}If Elder Dorin is involved...{BR}{ctl.F2:00004C}it may be Ladea Tower.{ctl.FD}He was saying he would have to{BR}open its gates once more.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Ladea Tower...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}I don't know it well myself, but it's{BR}on the cape past the eastern quicksand.{ctl.FD}Elder Dorin said something important{BR}rests in that place...{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}How do you even cross quicksand?{BR}How did Thray and Elder Dorin...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}That I couldn't tell you!{BR}Probably magic, I'd assume?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Never fear, leave it to me!{ctl.F2:00004D}{BR}We have the Land Master!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Land Master?{BR}What's that?{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}You mean the Land Master{BR}is still around?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Yes, exactly. The all-purpose{BR}armored car of the old civilization!{ctl.FD}For that, quicksand is{BR}nothing at all!{ctl.FD}Yes... there should be one just{BR}south of here, at the Machine Center.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Machine Center...{BR}Was there such a place?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}If you will come with me,{BR}you shall see.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:03}Right! Then let's hurry{BR}and get moving!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}...Hahn, would you{BR}stay here?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Eh?
