B-but...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Stay, and watch over{BR}Laila for me.{ctl.FD}Besides, you have that{BR}lovely lady of yours here!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Uh... but...{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}Laila, I'll find Thray,{BR}and bring him back, I swear it!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:22}Rudy...!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}Hahn... look after Laila!
entries.us: Alys... I have no idea what these symptoms are... It appears she isn't getting any better. That Zio...there was something different about him from other enemies I've fought! She refuses everything. It's as if she's... possessed by some evil power. Damn you! Zio you devil! Can we save her if we shut down Nurvus? No, that won't work. Nurvus is located in the basement of Zio's Fort! Actually, Zio has erected his fort on top of Nurvus. Oh, below that invisible barrier!! So we'll have to defeat Zio after all! I...if only Rune were... Alys! Don't talk! Rune should know... some way to do it. Alys, don't worry. We'll defeat Zio somehow! Now, listen. With what we have right now...  there's no way we can win. We've got to do something about Zio's magic barrier. Magic barrier? 'Magic'! That sort of thing should have ceased to exist a thousand years ago! Come to think of it, Rune was indeed using some kind of magic! Something called Flaeli. That's right...so if you can get the cooperation of... Rune...ooo! Alys! Chaz, who is Rune? Oh, he's a disgusting, conceited jerk! I hate to admit it, but we may have no choice but to ask for his help. Didn't Rune go off somewhere with Grandfather Dorin? If he's with Grandfather Dorin... Perhaps he's gone to the 'Ladea Tower.' Because he was saying something about opening the gates to the Ladea Tower. What's the Ladea Tower? I'm not quite sure myself, but I hear it's located on a small island beyond the quicksand in the east. Grandfather Dorin said that something important is there. How are we going to get across the quicksand? How did Rune and Grandfather Dorin do it? That's beyond me. Probably that's where magic comes into play. Don't worry. Leave it up to me! There's the 'Land Rover'! The Land Rover? What's that? Do you mean to say there's still a Land Rover in existence? Yes, absolutely. The Land Rover, is an all-purpose armor-plated car of an ancient civilization! With a Land Rover, crossing quicksand is nothing! If we go to the Machine Center directly south of here, I'm sure we'll find one. A Machine Center? Is there such a place? If you come with me, you'll see. OK! In that case, let's hurry and get going! Will you stay here, Hahn? What? Ah, but... We want you to remain here and look after Alys. Also, you have a cute girlfriend here! Er...but... Alys, I'm sure we'll find Rune! Chaz... Hahn, take good care of Alys!

オレたちも行くぞ！

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:2403}{ctl.FA:2102}{ctl.FA:2201}{ctl.FA:1F01}食いしん坊な犬だよなぁ！{BR}エサをやると、食うわ食うわ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:2403}{ctl.FA:2102}{ctl.FA:2201}{ctl.FA:1F01}What a glutton this dog is!{BR}Feed him and he eats and eats!
entries.us: What a pig this dog is! It never stops eating!

entries.jp: 犬？{ctl.FD}エサをしばらくやらなかったら{BR}どっか行っちまったぜ。{ctl.FD}確か、北の方にいったなぁ。
entries.en: The dog?{ctl.FD}We didn't feed him for a while and{BR}off he went somewhere.{ctl.FD}North, I'm fairly sure.
entries.us: Dog? We haven't fed him for a while. He left not long ago. I think he went north.

entries.jp: この犬、どこからともなく{BR}舞い戻ってきたけど…{ctl.FD}食いしん坊は{BR}相変わらずだなぁ！
entries.en: This dog wandered back from{BR}wherever he'd gone...{ctl.FD}Still the same glutton{BR}he always was!
entries.us: This dog came back from wherever he went, but he hasn't changed. He's still a pig!

entries.jp: あの犬、あんたらの{BR}だったのかい？
entries.en: That dog, was he yours, then?
entries.us: That dog belongs to you?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:2101}ばう わう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}うわー。小汚い犬！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:2101}Bow wow!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Ahh! You scruffy little mutt!
entries.us: Bow wow! Gee, what a fat little mutt!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ハ
ばう わう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}さぁ、こっちへおいで！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}あっ！ こら待て！{ctl.FD}何かで つらなきゃダメか？
entries.en: Bow wow!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Come on, over here!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}Hey! Wait, you!{ctl.FD}We'll need something to tempt him.
entries.us: Bow wow! Hey, come over here! Hey! Over here!

entries.jp: くぅーん。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}よしよし、おまえの好物の{BR}ショートケーキだぞぉ。{ctl.FD}今のうちだ。とっとと{BR}アイードに連れて帰ろう！！
entries.en: Whine.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}There, there. Shortcake, your favorite.{ctl.FD}Now's our chance. Let's get him{BR}back to Aiedo, quick!!
entries.us: Whimper. All right, here's your favorite food, shortcake. Now's our opportunity. Let's hurry and take him back with us to Aiedo!!

entries.jp: ここはモタビアンの村、{BR}モルカムだが…{ctl.FD}パルマ人は帰れ！{BR}中には いれないぞ！！
entries.en: This is the Motavian village{BR}of Molcum, but...{ctl.FD}Palmans, go home!{BR}You aren't getting in!!
entries.us: This is the Motavian village of Molcum. Parmanians are not allowed in our village.

entries.jp: おまえら ジオってやつの{BR}手先じゃないのか？
entries.en: Aren't you two agents of that{BR}guy Zio?
entries.us: Aren't you guys agents of that guy Zio?

entries.jp: {ctl.F6}ヨう

{ctl.F2:000010}{ctl.F4:02}スレイ！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000011}{ctl.F4:04}よう、ライラ！{BR}久しぶりだな…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ライラ、知りあい？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}………昔の、ね…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000012}{ctl.F4:04}ほぉ、そのチビが今の連れなのか？まだ ガキじゃねえか…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}なんだって！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}やめな、ルディ！！{BR}スレイ、それよりこれは…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ジオのしわざさ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ジオ！ もしかして{BR}ゼマの人たちを石にしたのも…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ほぅ？{BR}少しは頭が回るみたいだな。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}こっ、このやろう！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}よしなって！ …しかし、{BR}どこへ行ってもジオ、ジオだね。{ctl.FD}いったい何者だっていうの…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}…さあな！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:03}そ、それより アルシュリンは{BR}どうなるんですよぉ！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}アルシュリンを探してるのか？{BR}じゃあ トノエに行くといい。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}トノエ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}こっからだと ちょっと遠いな。{BR}まず東のクルップの村に行って…{ctl.FD}そこから 北に行けば{BR}トノエに通ずる谷があるぜ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}ク、クルップぅ…は…{BR}寄らなくていいですよぉ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}？？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}と、とにかくトノエに{BR}向かいましょう！ ライラさん？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}ああ…しょうがないね。行くか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}オレも まぜてもらおうかな？{ctl.F9:13}{BR}{ctl.F2:000013}{ctl.F9:13}ちょいと ついでもあるんでね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000014}{ctl.F4:02}！ ……そう？ 助かるわ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ライラッ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}よし、決まったぁ！ そこのチビ、足手まといになるなよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}チビチビいうな！ おれは…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ルディといったっけ？{BR}フフ…ちんけな名前だな！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}くっ！ …おまえ！ ちゃんと{BR}ついてこないと おいてくからな！{ctl.F4:04}フッ…迷惑はかけんさ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}………。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}…先行き不安だな…ハハ…
entries.en: {ctl.F2:000010}{ctl.F4:02}Thray?!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000011}{ctl.F4:04}Hey, Laila!{BR}It's been a while...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}You know him, Laila?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}......From long ago, yeah...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000012}{ctl.F4:04}So this little runt is your new partner?{BR}But isn't he still just a kid...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What did you say?!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Enough, Rudy! More importantly,{BR}Thray, what happened here?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Zio did this.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Zio! Then was he the one who turned{BR}everyone in Zema to stone...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Oh? Maybe you're sharper than you look.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Y-you jerk!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Knock it off! Still, everywhere we go,{BR}it's Zio this, Zio that.{ctl.FD}Who is he, anyway...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}...Who knows?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:03}W-well anyway, what about the{BR}Alshlin?!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}You're looking for Alshlin?{BR}Then you should go to Tonoe.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Tonoe?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}It's a fair distance from here.{BR}First, head east to the village of Krupp.{ctl.FD}North of there is a valley that leads{BR}to Tonoe.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}K-Krupp... We don't need to stop there,{BR}you know...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}??{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}A-anyway, let's head for Tonoe!{BR}All right, Laila?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Yeah... Guess we have no choice. Let's go!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Mind if I come along?{ctl.F9:13}{BR}{ctl.F2:000013}{ctl.F9:13}I've got an errand that way myself.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000014}{ctl.F4:02}! ...Really? That'd be a big help.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Laila!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Then it's settled! Don't slow us down,{BR}runt!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Quit calling me that! My name is...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Rudy, wasn't it?{BR}Heh... What a pathetic name.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Grr... You'd better keep up, or we'll{BR}leave you behind!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Hmph. I won't be a burden.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}.........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}This does not bode well... Ha ha...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6502}{ctl.FA:3001}ここはトノエ…。{ctl.FD}うわっ！ おまえたち！{BR}どうやって入ってきたんだ！？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6502}{ctl.FA:3001}This is Tonoe...{ctl.FD}Whoa! You people!{BR}How did you get in here?!
entries.us: This is Tonoe... Hey! How did you get in here?

entries.jp: ここはトノエ…。{ctl.FD}うわっ！ おまえたち！{BR}どうやって入ってきたんだ！？{ctl.FD}なんだ、パイクの友だちか…。{BR}びっくりさせるなよ！
entries.en: This is Tonoe...{ctl.FD}Whoa! You people!{BR}How did you get in here?!{ctl.FD}Oh, friends of Pyke's, huh...{BR}Don't startle me like that!
entries.us: This is Tonoe... Wow! You guys! How did you get in here? Oh I see, you're friends of Gryz. You sure gave me a scare!

entries.jp: ここはトノエ…{BR}おお、あんたらかい。
entries.en: This is Tonoe...{BR}Oh, it's you.
entries.us: This is Tonoe... Hey, it's you guys.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:3201}アルシュリン？{BR}そんなもの 知らないよ！ けど…何か聞きたいことがあるなら、{BR}ドリンじいさんの所に行ってみな！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:3201}Alshlin? Never heard of {BR}such a thing! But...{ctl.FD}if you have questions to ask, go{BR}and see Elder Dorin!
entries.us: Alshline? I know nothing about it! But... if you have questions, you should go to Grandfather Dorin!

entries.jp: やぁ、さがし物は見つかった？{ctl.FD}情報屋のドリンじいさんに聞けば{BR}たいがいのことは わかるもんね！
entries.en: Well, did you find what you{BR}were after?{ctl.FD}Ask Elder Dorin the information dealer{BR}and you'll learn near anything!
entries.us: So, did you find what you were looking for? You should be able to find answers to pretty much anything if you ask Grandfather Dorin!

entries.jp: ああ、モルカムの件は聞いている！ジオのやつめ……！！
entries.en: Yes, I've heard about what happened to{BR}Molcum! That devil Zio......!!
entries.us: Yeh, I've heard about what's going on in Molcum! That darn Zio!

entries.jp: パルマ人は 戦争好き。{ctl.FD}そんな人たちが起こした いくさに巻き込まれるのは まっぴらだわ！
entries.en: Palmans love their wars.{ctl.FD}I won't be dragged into a fight{BR}started by the likes of them!
entries.us: Parmanians like to go to war. I refuse to get embroiled in battles started by people like that!

entries.jp: 我らの自慢はチタンの精製技術だ。{ctl.FD}パルマ人の街では チタンの{BR}武器なんて見たことないだろ？
entries.en: Our pride is our titanium refining.{ctl.FD}Bet you've never seen a titanium{BR}weapon in a Palman town, huh?
entries.us: Our pride and joy is the refined art of Titanium. I bet you've never seen a weapon of Titanium in any of your towns, have you?

entries.jp: じゃま、じゃま！ あんたたち、{BR}ボーッと歩いてんじゃないわよ！
entries.en: Out of the way, out of the way!{BR}Don't just wander around aimlessly!
entries.us: Outta my way! And, stop roaming around aimlessly!

entries.jp: いろんな物を作ってれば、{BR}そりゃあ失敗したものも多いよ。{ctl.FD}成功なんてものは、この幾多の{BR}失敗の上に成り立っているのさ…！
entries.en: Make as many things as we do and{BR}inevitably you'll have plenty of failures.{ctl.FD}Success is built on the back of{BR}every one of those failures...!
entries.us: Oh sure, if you make the best you're bound to have many failures too. Success is arrived at through numerous failures!

entries.jp: あん？ パルマ人じゃねぇか。{BR}あんたらに売るもんなぞ 無いよ！
entries.en: Eh? Palmans, huh.{BR}We've got nothing to sell to you!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ここは 今日は{BR}お休みみたいだな…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Looks like this place is{BR}closed for the day...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}うひゃー。ガラクタばっかり。{BR}これ売り物のつもりなのかね？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Yikes. Nothing but junk.{BR}Is this meant to be for sale?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ここの店の人 寝てらぁ。{BR}かわいそうだから起こさないどこ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}The shopkeeper here is asleep.{BR}Seems a shame to wake him.

entries.jp: パルマ人が 何しにきた！？{BR}でてけ でてけ！
entries.en: What do Palmans want here?!{BR}Out! Get out!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}これ…食べ物みたいだけど…。{BR}やめとこ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}This... looks like food, but...{BR}Better not.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}こわそうな目して にらんでるよ…近寄らない方がいいかな。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}He's glaring at me with such{BR}hard eyes... better keep away.

entries.jp: うわーっ。パルマ人だ！{BR}お、お助け！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}別に とって食やしないよぅ。
entries.en: Aaah! A Palman!{BR}H-help!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I'm not going to eat you.

entries.jp: ………。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}無視するなよなー。
entries.en: .........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Don't just ignore me.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6505}{ctl.F6} ぇ
{ctl.F4:0F}わしが情報屋のドリンさまじゃ。{BR}いったい 何が聞きたいのかの？{ctl.FD}チタン精製の秘密か？{ctl.F5:0001}うむ。しかしそれは「秘密」というだけあって本当に秘密なのじゃよ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:0F}I am Dorin, the information dealer.{BR}What is it you wish to know?{ctl.FD}Is it about the secret of refining{BR}titanium?{ctl.F5:0001}Mm-hmm. But it wouldn't really be a{BR}secret if I told you that!
entries.us: I'm the information monger, Grandfather Dorin. What exactly do you want to ask? Is it about the secret of refining Titanium? I see. It is referred to as a 'secret' and it really is a secret!

entries.jp: この村への通路が岩でふさがれて{BR}おったのはなぜか、か？{ctl.F5:0001}うむ。ジオの襲来にそなえて{BR}あらかじめ閉ざしておいたんじゃよ
entries.en: You want to know why the way into{BR}this village was blocked by rocks?{ctl.F5:0001}Mm-hmm. We closed it in advance,{BR}anticipating an attack from Zio.
entries.us: You want to know why the path to this village is blocked by a rock? In preparation of a possible assault by Zio we've closed ourselves off.

entries.jp: では「八ッ裂きのライラ」と{BR}異名をとる名うての美人女ハンターライラ・ブラングウェンの{BR}スリーサイズか？？{ctl.F5:0001}うむ。上から88・ろくじゅ…{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0F}うわっ！{BR}痛いっ！！{ctl.FD}な、何をするんじゃ！{BR}いきなりなぐるとは失敬な！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0F}ああ？ うわあっ！{BR}ライラ・ブラングウェン！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}あんた！ それを人が来るたび{BR}ペラペラしゃべくってんの！？{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0F}ひっ、ひえええっ！ お助け！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0F}おっ、おお、スレイ！{BR}スレイではないか？ 助けてくれ！{ctl.F4:04}変わらねえな、じいさん！{ctl.F7}
entries.en: Then, how about the measurements of the{BR}renowned beauty and hunter,{ctl.FD}Laila Brangwen, also known as{BR}"Laila the Dismemberer''?{ctl.F5:0001}Ahem. From the top, eighty-eight, sixty...{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0F}Whoa!{BR}Ouch!{ctl.FD}W-what are you doing?{BR}How rude, punching me out of nowhere!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0F}Huh? Whoa!{BR}Laila Brangwen!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}You! Are you blabbing that to everyone{BR}who happens by?!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0F}Y-yikes! Help me!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0F}O-oh, Thray!{BR}Is that you, Thray? Help me out!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}You haven't changed a bit, old man!{ctl.F7}

entries.jp: なんじゃ、用がないなら話かけんでくれんか。わしゃ忙しいんじゃから
entries.en: Well, if you have no business with me,{BR}don't come around. I'm busy.
entries.us: Then if you don't have any business here, stop talking to me. I'm real busy.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:0F}おお、パイクが世話になった{BR}ようじゃな。ありがとうよ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:0F}Ah, you've been good to Pyke,{BR}I hear. My thanks to you.
entries.us: Ah, I believe you've been good to Gryz. Thank you.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6502}{ctl.FA:3001}{ctl.F4:10}あたし、モルカムに住んでたのよ。{ctl.FD}でもある日、ジオが攻めてきて…{BR}兄ちゃんが懸命に戦ったんだけど…かなわなくて……{BR}父ちゃんも…母ちゃんも死んで…{ctl.FD}兄ちゃんと 命からがら{BR}逃げてきたの……うっうっ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6502}{ctl.FA:3001}{ctl.F4:10}I used to live in Molcum, you know.{ctl.FD}But one day Zio came... my big{BR}brother fought with all he had...{ctl.FD}but it wasn't enough......{BR}Father died... Mother too...{ctl.FD}My brother and I barely escaped{BR}with our lives...... sniff.
entries.us: You know, I lived in Molcum. But, Zio attacked Molcum. My brother fought valiantly. He just wasn't a match for Zio. My Mom and Dad both died. My brother and I barely escaped with our lives...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:10}あたし、モルカムに住んでたのよ。{ctl.FD}でもある日、ジオが攻めてきて…{BR}兄ちゃんが懸命に戦ったんだけど…かなわなくて……{BR}父ちゃんも…母ちゃんも死んで…{ctl.FD}兄ちゃんと 命からがら{BR}逃げてきたの……うっうっ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}パナ…いつか必ず お兄ちゃんが{BR}仇をとってきてやるからな…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:10}I used to live in Molcum, you know.{ctl.FD}But one day Zio came... my big{BR}brother fought with all he had...{ctl.FD}but it wasn't enough......{BR}Father died... Mother too...{ctl.FD}My brother and I barely escaped{BR}with our lives...... sniff.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Pana... one day your brother will{BR}avenge them, I swear...!
entries.us: You know, I lived in Molcum. But one day, Zio attacked Molcum. My brother fought valiantly, but... he just wasn't any match for Zio. Both my parents died. My brother and I barely escaped with our lives... Pana...I promise you that one day I will exact revenge!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:10}お兄ちゃん……
entries.en: {ctl.F4:10}Big brother......
entries.us: Oh, big brother...
Argh!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:05}オレは このパナをおいていく{BR}わけにはいかん…許してくれ…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:05}I can't leave Pana here on her{BR}own... Forgive me.
entries.us: I just can't leave Pana here by herself. Forgive me...

entries.jp: 機械を作るのって我ながらうまいと思うんだけど 料理はダメなんだ。こんどケーキを焼いてみようと{BR}思うんだけど、うまくいくかなぁ。
entries.en: I'm pretty good at building machines{BR}if I say so myself, but cooking...{ctl.FD}I thought I'd try baking a cake{BR}next. I wonder how it'll turn out.
entries.us: If I may say so myself, I'm pretty good at making machines, but I'm no good at cooking. I'd like to bake a cake.

entries.jp: ウチの人は{BR}物思いにふけるのが好きで…{ctl.FD}今もどこかで 何やら{BR}考えているのでしょう。
entries.en: My husband is fond of losing{BR}himself in thought...{ctl.FD}No doubt he's off somewhere{BR}pondering something even now.
entries.us: My husband likes to sit lost in thought. He's probably somewhere thinking about something right now.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}くっ…サビついていて開かない！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:05}ああ、これを開けるのは{BR}ちょっとコツがいるんだよ。{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:05}ここを…こう持って…せえの、{BR}そぉれっ！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}開いた！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}よし、じゃあ行こうか。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Ngh... it's rusted shut!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:05}Ah, there's a knack to getting{BR}that one open.{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:05}Take hold here... like so...{BR}ready now, heave!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}It's open!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Right. Shall we go in?
entries.us: Oof...it's rusted shut! Oh, there's a little trick to opening this door. Just hold here...like so... and then one, two, three, lift! It opened! Great, let's go in.

entries.jp: {ctl.F2:000015}{ctl.F2:000016}{ctl.F4:04}ライラ、まぁかんべんして{BR}やってくれないか？{ctl.FD}このじいさんも 悪気がある{BR}わけじゃないんだからさ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}悪気があってやられちゃ{BR}たまんないわよ！！！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ドリンじいさん、あずけてあった{BR}ものを返してもらいにきたぜ。{ctl.FD}あとな、こいつらがアルシュリンをほしいと言っている…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0F}ああ、アルシュリンでよければ{BR}好きに もっていってくれ！{ctl.FD}裏の地下倉庫の奥じゃ。{BR}勝手に取りに行くがいい。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:03}あ、ありがとうございます！{BR}ライラさん、ではさっそく！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000017}{ctl.F4:0F}ああ待て！{ctl.FD}あすこは今 使っとらんでな。{BR}ちぃと物騒になっとるかもしれん。パイクよ！ この人たちの{BR}案内役、やってくれんかの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}はい。{ctl.FD}…パイクという。よろしくな。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}じゃオレは このドリンじいさんに用があるから ここでな！{ctl.FD}おぅそうそう そこのチビガキ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}なんだよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ジオを なんとかしてやろうなんて変な気 おこすんじゃねぇぞ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:03FE}{ctl.F2:03F4}{ctl.F2:000018}{ctl.F4:01}え……？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}………{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}まだ 今のおまえじゃ{BR}役者が違いすぎるからな！{ctl.FD}じゃ…縁があったらまたあおう。{ctl.FD}ライラ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}え…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}達者で、な。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}オレが…ジオを……？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}………
entries.en: {ctl.F2:000015}{ctl.F2:000016}{ctl.F4:04}Come now, Laila. Can't you let it go?{ctl.FD}The old man meant no harm by it.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}He had better not have meant any!!!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Elder Dorin, I've come to take back what{BR}I left in your care.{ctl.FD}And these people are after some{BR}Alshlin, as well......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0F}Ah, if it's Alshlin you want, take as{BR}much of it as you please!{ctl.FD}It's deep inside the underground{BR}storehouse out back. Help yourselves.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:03}Th-thank you very much!{BR}Laila, let's go right away!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000017}{ctl.F4:0F}Ah, wait!{ctl.FD}We haven't used that place in a while.{BR}It may have become a little dangerous.{ctl.FD}Pyke! Will you go along and guide{BR}these people?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Yes.{ctl.FD}...Pyke's the name. Good to meet you.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}I've got some business with Elder Dorin{BR}here, so this is where I leave you!{ctl.FD}Oh -- and one more thing, runt!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What is it now!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Don't go getting any crazy ideas, like{BR}trying to handle Zio!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:03FE}{ctl.F2:03F4}{ctl.F2:000018}{ctl.F4:01}What......?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}.........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}For the time being, the two of you are in{BR}altogether different leagues!{ctl.FD}Well... if fortune wills it,{BR}we'll meet again.{ctl.FD}Laila......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}What...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Stay well.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Me...... take on Zio......?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}.........
entries.us: Please excuse him, will you, Alys? The old man doesn't have any bad intentions. That's why I put up with it. Grandfather Dorin, I came to retrieve the item I entrusted in your care. Also, these people are looking for Alshline. Ah, if what you want is Alshline, feel free to take whatever you need. It's in the back of the basement warehouse out back. Go help yourselves. Thank you! Alys, let's go! Oh, wait! That place is unused right now. So it may be a teensy bit dangerous. Gryz! Will you guide these people? My pleasure. My name is Gryz. Nice to meet you. Well, I have some business with Grandfather Dorin here, so I'll say so long here! Oh yeah, pip squeak... I've had enough of you! Don't get any silly thoughts, like taking on Zio, into that little head! Huh? Guys... At this stage of the game, you're no match for him! Maybe our paths will cross again. Alys... Yeah. Take care. Me...taking on Zio? Thanks Rune.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}トノエは この先か？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}フン、こんなもの！{BR}みんな！ さがっていろ！！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:04}フレエリ！！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}す、すげ……{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}さ、行こうぜ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}今のは…見たことない技だけど…？テクニックとも違う…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ふふん…見たことないのも{BR}無理はないか…。{ctl.FD}これはな、{BR}「マジック」っていうモノさ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}マジック…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Tonoe is beyond here?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Hmph, this is nothing!{BR}Everyone, stand back!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:04}Flaeli!!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}Whoa...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Come on. Let's go.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}What was that...? I've never seen a Skill{BR}like it. It wasn't a Technique, either.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Heh... No wonder you've never seen it.{ctl.FD}That was something called...{BR}Magic.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Magic...!

entries.jp: {ctl.F2:000019}{ctl.F4:02}これがアルシュリン…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}さぁ！ はやくゼマに戻って{BR}みんなを助けましょう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:05}なぁ…{BR}オレもつきあわせてくれないかな？オレは自分の村をジオにやられた…父も…母も…守りきれなかった…！どうしても{BR}仇（かたき）がうちたいんだ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ちょっと待ってよ、パイク！{ctl.FD}ぼくら、別にジオを倒すために{BR}旅してるんじゃないんだよ…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}最初あんたらといた 背の高いのが何やら言っていたじゃないか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}あれは…あいつが勝手に…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}どの道 この村でいつまでも{BR}クサっているわけにはいかない！{ctl.FD}ダメだと言っても ついて行く！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}パイク…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}まぁいいじゃない、ルディ。{BR}パイクがいてくれて助かってるし…この先どうなるかなんて、{BR}だれも わかりゃしないんだし…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}よし、じゃ改めて…よろしくな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}…いいから早く行きましょうよぅ。
entries.en: {ctl.F2:000019}{ctl.F4:02}So this is Alshlin...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Come on! Let's hurry back to Zema and{BR}save everyone!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:05}Listen...{BR}Would you let me come with you?{ctl.FD}Zio destroyed my village.{BR}My father... my mother... I saved neither.{ctl.FD}I have to avenge them!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Wait a minute, Pyke!{ctl.FD}We aren't exactly traveling just to{BR}defeat Zio, you know.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Didn't that tall man who was with you say{BR}something about that?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}That was... He came up with that all{BR}on his own!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Either way, I can't stay here forever and{BR}rot in this village!{ctl.FD}Even if you say no, I'm coming!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Pyke...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Why not, Rudy? Pyke's been a big help.{ctl.FD}Besides, none of us knows what lies{BR}ahead, do we?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}All right. Then once again...{BR}I'm glad to be working with you!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Yes, yes. Now can we please get going?
entries.us: So this is Alshline! OK! Let's hurry and return to Zema and help those people out! Umm... Do you think I can go along? My own town was destroyed by Zio. I couldn't save my father or my mother! One way or another  I need to get my revenge! Hey, Gryz! We're not necessarily making this journey for the purpose of defeating Zio. But didn't that tall guy who was with you say something like that? Oh, that...he was just arbitrarily saying stuff. Either way, I can't stay in this town forever! I'm coming along even if you refuse to take me! Gryz! C'mon, Chaz, there's nothing wrong with that. Gryz could be quite a help and, after all, no one knows what's going to happen from here on out. Great. Once again... good to be working with you! Yeah, whatever. Let's get going!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6}
{ctl.F6} ぉ
{ctl.F4:01}うっひゃー、ハデな いす！{BR}趣味悪いなぁ…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Yeesh, what a gaudy chair!{BR}Terrible taste...!
entries.us: Wow, what a gaudy chair! What awful taste!

entries.jp: カウンターのウラをのぞいても{BR}何もありやせんぜ、お客さん？
entries.en: You'll find nothing behind the{BR}counter, sir.
entries.us: Sir, you won't find anything behind the counter.

entries.note: trailing bytes, no terminator

entries.jp: ここはナルヤの街ですけど、{BR}もうこんな所 住めないかも…。
entries.en: This is the town of Nalya, but...{BR}we may not be able to stay here.

entries.jp: 3ケ月前のことじゃったかのう…。{ctl.FD}街のすぐそばに 大きな隕石が{BR}落ちて…このありさまじゃよ。{ctl.FD}いったい わしらが{BR}何をしたというんじゃ……。
entries.en: It was three months ago now...{ctl.FD}A huge meteorite fell just outside{BR}the town, and left us like this.{ctl.FD}What in the world did we ever{BR}do to deserve it......

entries.jp: この街は もうダメかもな。{ctl.FD}早いとこ 西のアイードあたりに{BR}引っ越した方が かしこいぜ！
entries.en: This town may be finished.{ctl.FD}Wiser to move west to Aiedo{BR}while you still can!

entries.jp: こ、ここ…オレんちだったんだぜ。{ctl.FD}まぁ、生きているだけでも{BR}めっけもんなのかもしれないけど…
entries.en: Th-this... this was my house.{ctl.FD}Still, being alive at all might{BR}count as a stroke of luck...

entries.jp: なんかさ、大穴の真ん中に機械{BR}みたいなのが見えないか？{ctl.FD}何だか気になるけど、{BR}こわくて だれも近づかないのさ。
entries.en: Can you see some machine-looking thing in{BR}the middle of that giant crater?{ctl.FD}It kind of intriguing, but no one{BR}dares go near it.

entries.jp: となりの部屋は 雨が入ってきますから、この部屋で寝てるんですのよ
entries.en: The rain gets into the next room,{BR}so we sleep in this one.

entries.jp: かあちゃん、風が冷たいよう！
entries.en: Mama, the wind is cold!

entries.jp: 家を直す金なんて、あるわけない{BR}じゃないか…。どうしよう…。
entries.en: We have no money to repair the house...{BR}What do we do...

entries.jp: この家が奇跡的に無事だったのは{BR}うれしいんですが…{ctl.FD}毎日いやがらせが続いて…こんな{BR}ことなら壊れればよかったのに！
entries.en: I'm glad our house survived{BR}by some miracle, but...{ctl.FD}the harassment never stops. I'd almost{BR}wish it had fallen down!

entries.jp: 親切だった向かいの奥さんが{BR}いじわるばかり……。{ctl.FD}もう人間が信じられないわ！
entries.en: The woman across the way was so kind,{BR}and now she's nothing but cruel......{ctl.FD}I can't believe in people anymore!

entries.jp: 友だちから仲間外れにされてるの…さびしいよぅ…うぇえええ。
entries.en: My friends have shut me out...{BR}I'm so lonely... waaaah.

entries.jp: 家は無事だったけど、だ。{ctl.FD}先々のことを考えると、引っ越した方がいいという気がするよなぁ…。
entries.en: The house survived, sure, but...{ctl.FD}Thinking ahead, I have a feeling{BR}we'd be better off moving away...

entries.jp: 行くあてなんか無いんですよ。{BR}長年住んだ土地は離れがたいしね。
entries.en: We have nowhere to go, you see.{ctl.FD}And it's hard to leave land you've{BR}lived on all these years.

entries.jp: なんであたしの家が壊れて{BR}向かいの家は壊れないのよ！{ctl.FD}不公平じゃないの！{BR}ね、そう思わない！？ キーッ！！
entries.en: Why is it that my house collapsed and{BR}the one opposite me still standing?!{ctl.FD}It isn't fair!{BR}Don't you think so?! Aaargh!!

entries.jp: おい、もう あきらめろよ…。{ctl.FD}妻も こんな人間じゃ{BR}なかったんですがねぇ…。
entries.en: Come now, let it go...{ctl.FD}My wife was never this sort{BR}of person before, you know...

entries.jp: ねぇ、もう仲間はずれにすんの、{BR}やめてもいいだろう？{ctl.FD}仲良く遊びたいよう！
entries.en: Come on, can't you stop leaving{BR}me out now?{ctl.FD}I just want us to play together!

entries.jp: 隕石が落ちてすぐ後さぁ、{ctl.FD}なんだか すごい軍隊みたいなのが西から来て 橋を渡って行ったぜ。{ctl.FD}で、また西に戻っていったと{BR}思ったら、橋が壊されてたんだ。{ctl.FD}アイードから来たのかね？{BR}いったい何なんだろうな！
entries.en: Just after the meteorite fell...{ctl.FD}some huge army came from the west{BR}and crossed over the bridge.{ctl.FD}Then, just when I thought they'd headed{BR}back west, the bridge was destroyed.{ctl.FD}Did they come from Aiedo?{BR}What was that all about!

entries.jp: また おかしな事言って！{BR}隕石のおかげでボケたんじゃない？
entries.en: You're talking nonsense again!{BR}Did the meteorite scramble your brain?

entries.jp: いやぁ、早めに商品を逃がしといたおかげでこうして商売できるんでさ
entries.en: Well, thanks to getting rid of my goods{BR}early, I can still do business now.

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}もう オレのことなんか{BR}ほっといてくれよぅ。
entries.en: {ctl.F3}Just leave me alone,{BR}would you.
entries.us: Cool!

entries.jp: 西にアイードって大きな街があってあたしの実家がそこにあるんだよ。だから お世話になろうって{BR}言ってるのに……
entries.en: There's a big town west called Aiedo,{BR}and my family home is there.{ctl.FD}So I keep saying we should go and{BR}stay there......

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}ここ？ カダリ…って街だぜ。{ctl.FD}あんたたちも ジオの教会を{BR}訪ねて来たのかい？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}Here? This is Kadary.{ctl.FD}Have you come to visit Zio's{BR}church as well?
entries.us: This place? This is the town of Kadary. Have you come to visit Zio's church as well?

entries.jp: ここ？ カダリ…って街だぜ。{ctl.FD}もうジオの教会を訪ねてくるヤツはいないよ。あんたたちも違うだろ？
entries.en: Here? This is Kadary.{ctl.FD}Nobody visits Zio's church any{BR}more. You either, I presume?
entries.us: This place? This is the town of Kadary. Nobody comes to visit Zio's church any more. You didn't, did you?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}この街に ジオって男の教えを{BR}広める教会が建ってさ…。{ctl.FD}信者たちが あちこちから{BR}集まって来るんだよ。{ctl.FD}大きい声じゃ言えないけど、{BR}…迷惑だよなぁ…！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}They built a church here to spread{BR}the teachings of a man named Zio...{ctl.FD}Believers come flocking in from{BR}all over the place.{ctl.FD}I shouldn't say it too loudly, but...{BR}...it's a real nuisance!
entries.us: A church that spreads the teachings of a man named Zio was erected in this town. Devotees come here from all over the place. I don't want to say it in a loud voice, but... it sure is a big bother!

entries.jp: いやぁ、ジオって もう{BR}いなくなったんだってねぇ？{ctl.FD}これで この街も{BR}ちょっとはまともになるよ。
entries.en: Ah, they say Zio's gone now?{ctl.FD}Then, this town might actually become{BR}a decent place.
entries.us: Ah, I hear that Zio is gone now. Well, finally this town should get back to normal now.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}北の通路を抜けてきたのかい？{ctl.FD}じゃあ 来る途中、焼かれて{BR}廃虚になった街を見たろう？{ctl.FD}あれ、ジオがやったって話なのよ！もう あたしゃコワくって！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}Did you come via the northern path?{ctl.FD}Then you must have seen the town{BR}burned to ruins along the way?{ctl.FD}They say Zio did that!{BR}It scares me to death thinking about it!
entries.us: Did you come by the path to the north? In that case, you must have seen the town burnt to ruins on your way here? It's been said that was all due to Zio! I'm so afraid!

entries.jp: 北の通路を抜けてきたのかい？{ctl.FD}じゃあ 来る途中、焼かれて{BR}廃虚になった街を見たろう？{ctl.FD}あれ、ジオがやったって話なのよ！やっぱり バチがあたったのかね？
entries.en: Did you come via the northern path?{ctl.FD}Then you must have seen the town{BR}burned to ruins along the way?{ctl.FD}They say Zio did that!{BR}I guess he got what was coming to him?
entries.us: Did you come by the path to the north? In that case, you must have seen that town burnt to ruins on your way here. It's been said that was all due to Zio! Perhaps they were being punished.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6502}ちょっと いいですか？{ctl.FD}あなたはジオを信じますか？{ctl.F5:0001}おお、同志よ！ ジオさまに{BR}栄光を！ 愚者どもに粛正を！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6502}May I trouble you a moment?{ctl.FD}Are you a believer of Zio?{ctl.F5:0001}Ah, a comrade! Glory to{BR}Lord Zio! Purging to the fools!
entries.us: Excuse me, can I ask you something? Do you believe in Zio's teachings? Ah, a kindred spirit! Glory be to the great Zio! Purge the souls of the fools!

entries.jp: では すぐに同志になりなさい。{BR}さもなくば我らの粛正を受けますぞ
entries.en: Then become one of us at once.{BR}Or else face our purging.
entries.us: In that case, become one of us at once. Otherwise, you will be purged by us.

entries.jp: ちょっと いいですか？{ctl.FD}あなたはジオを信じますか？{ctl.F5:0001}君、まわりが見えなくなってるね？もうぼちぼち頭を冷やした方が。
entries.en: May I trouble you a moment?{ctl.FD}Are you a believer of Zio?{ctl.F5:0001}You've quite lost sight of the{BR}world, haven't you? Cool your head.
entries.us: Excuse me, can I ask you something? Do you believe in Zio's teachings? Are you blind to your surroundings? Maybe it's time you cooled off.

entries.jp: そうですよね！{BR}わたしゃどうかしてたんですよ！
entries.en: You're right, of course!{BR}What could have come over me!
entries.us: I'm glad that you see the truth! Something must have happened to me!

entries.jp: ああ……ジオさまァー……。
entries.en: Ah...... Lord Ziooo......
entries.us: Oh...Zio, the holy one...

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ぅ
{ctl.FA:6501}ジオはもうすぐ この世の終わりが来ると説いているらしいが…{ctl.FD}本当かね？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}Zio preaches that the end of the{BR}world is coming soon, they say...{ctl.FD}Can it be true?
entries.us: Zio says that the end of this world is coming soon. I wonder if that's true?

entries.jp: ジオの言っていた{BR}この世の終わり、って…{ctl.FD}てめえの終わりのこと{BR}だったんじゃねぇか？
entries.en: That end of the world Zio kept{BR}preaching about...{ctl.FD}Turned out to be the end of him,{BR}didn't it?
entries.us: The end of the world that Zio was talking about... Perhaps he was talking about the end of himself?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}街の裏手にある酒場…。{ctl.FD}行きつけの店だったのに、{BR}最近は 入るに入れないよ…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}The tavern at the back of town...{ctl.FD}It was my regular haunt, and now{BR}I can't set foot in it...
entries.us: That inn in the back of the town... I used to frequent that place, but recently, I can't go in even if I wanted to...

entries.jp: やぁ、やっとまた裏の店で{BR}酒を飲むことができるぜ！
entries.en: Ha! At last I can drink at the{BR}place out back again!
entries.us: Ah, finally we can drink in the inn!

entries.jp: ジオ？ な、何の事かしら？{ctl.FD}別に教会になんか行っていません{BR}でしたわよ、わたし。おほほほほ。
entries.en: Zio? Wh-whatever do you mean?{ctl.FD}I never went near that church,{BR}no way. Oh ho ho ho ho.
entries.us: Zio? I...I wonder what it's all about? I hadn't really been going to church, hee, hee.

entries.jp: 大のオトナが ジオさまジオさまと情けねぇ！{ctl.FD}他人をあがめる前に 自分があがめられるようになろうと思わんのか！
entries.en: Grown adults bleating Lord Zio,{BR}Lord Zio. Pathetic!{ctl.FD}Instead of worshipping someone else, try{BR}becoming worthy of worship yourself!
entries.us: How pathetic, a full-grown adult like you crying for Zio! You have to be able to respect yourself before you can respect others, so grow up!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}なんだなんだ、あの{BR}ジオとかってのにかぶれた連中は！{ctl.FD}う、薄気味悪いったら{BR}ありゃしねぇよ、ちくしょう！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}What the hell is the deal with that crowd{BR}obsessed over this Zio nonsense!{ctl.FD}Gives me the creeps like you wouldn't{BR}believe, damn it all!
entries.us: What is going on with those guys going overboard with this Zio thing? It just makes my skin crawl!

entries.jp: やれやれ。みんな正気に{BR}戻ったみたいで ひと安心だよ。
entries.en: Well, well. Everyone seems to have{BR}their senses back. What a relief.
entries.us: Thank goodness. It's quite a relief that everyone is getting back their senses.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}ウチの娘が ジオの信者になって{BR}しまって家に帰ってこないんですぅ
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}Our daughter has become one of{BR}Zio's followers and won't come home.
entries.us: Our daughter has become a follower of Zio and won't come home.

entries.jp: ようやく娘も正気に戻りました！
entries.en: Our daughter has come to her{BR}senses at last!
entries.us: At last, our daughter has come to her senses, too!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}死にゆく運命の星ならば、ひとりの男に賭けてみるのも一興というもの……そうではなくて？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}If this world is fated to perish,{BR}there's a certain charm in staking hope{ctl.FD}all on one man...... don't you think?
entries.us: If it is the fate of this planet to die anyway, we might as well pin all our hopes on this one man. Don't you agree?

entries.jp: 運命を あるがままに受け入れろ{BR}ということなの…それとも…？
entries.en: Are you saying to accept fate as{BR}it comes... or something else...?
entries.us: Are you saying just accept your fate...or...what?

entries.jp: ジーオ！ ジーオ！
entries.en: Zi-o! Zi-o!
entries.us: Ziiio! Ziiiio!

entries.jp: ここは ジオさまを{BR}あがめたてまつる教会。{ctl.FD}この汚れた地を{BR}破壊の業火で清め…{ctl.FD}そこに優良な民だけの理想国家を{BR}建設するんですって！{ctl.FD}なんて すてきなんでしょう！{BR}シビレるわ！
entries.en: This is the church where we worship{BR}Lord Zio.{ctl.FD}He will cleanse this soiled land{BR}with the fires of destruction...{ctl.FD}and build there an ideal nation{BR}of none but the worthy!{ctl.FD}How wonderful it will be!{BR}It gives me goosebumps!
entries.us: This is a church where we worship the great Zio. Zio says he's going to cleanse this soiled land with the fires of destruction... And then, he's going to build a utopian society populated with only the finest citizens! How wonderful! The thought makes me tingle!

entries.jp: 怠惰に生きる愚民どもなど…！{ctl.FD}まさしく ジオさまの手で{BR}粛正されてしかるべきですな！
entries.en: Those foolish masses, living in indolence...!{ctl.FD}It is only right that they be purged{BR}by Lord Zio's own hand!
entries.us: Those ignorant masses living in idleness! These are exactly the people that should be purged at the hands of Zio!

entries.jp: あたしたち信者だけは ジオさまが新しい世界へと導いてくれるのよ！
entries.en: Only we believers will be led into{BR}the new world by Lord Zio!
entries.us: It's only we believers that Zio will lead to the new world!

entries.jp: 破壊のあとにこそ 新たなる世界を創ることができるのじゃよ！！
entries.en: It is only after destruction that{BR}a new world can be made!!
entries.us: Only after the destruction can we create a new world!

entries.jp: 我々、ジオさまの信者は{BR}選ばれた民なのじゃー！
entries.en: We, the believers of Lord Zio,{BR}are the chosen people!
entries.us: We, the believers of Zio, are the chosen people!

entries.jp: ここカダリのすぐ東にそびえるのがジオスフォート！！{ctl.FD}我らの象徴！ 希望の城だ！！
entries.en: Towering just to the east of Kadary{BR}is Zio's Fort!!{ctl.FD}Our symbol! Our castle of hope!!
entries.us: That's Zio's fort which soars just east of Kadary! It is our symbol! It's our castle of hope!

entries.jp: ジオさまはジオスフォートにあって我らを教え導いてくれるのじゃ。{ctl.FD}あなありがたや かたじけなや。
entries.en: Lord Zio is in Zio's Fort, teaching{BR}and guiding us.{ctl.FD}How thankful and humbled we are.
entries.us: Zio is at his Fort where he teaches and guides us. How thankful we are to him.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6502}{ctl.F6} や
{ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:06}失神しちゃってるから{BR}話はできないわ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}こわいよー。
entries.en: {ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:06}They've fainted,{BR}so they can't talk.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}How scary!
entries.us: Just a little lower! Er... Chaz, let's get going!

entries.jp: わ、わたしは いったい{BR}何をしていたのでしょうか…？
entries.en: Wh-what on earth have I{BR}been doing...?
entries.us: Wh...what on earth have I done?

entries.jp: ほほぅ？ こんな所に女連れたぁ{BR}いい度胸してるぜ、ボウズ？
entries.en: Oho? Bringing a woman to a place{BR}like this... quite bold of you, kid.
entries.us: Huh? You've got some guts to bring a woman to a place like this, eh, Boys?

entries.jp: 何だ、てめぇ その目は！{ctl.FD}オレたちを ジオさまの部下と{BR}知ってのことか、ん？
entries.en: What's that look for, eh?{ctl.FD}Don't you realize you're speaking to{BR}Lord Zio's men?
entries.us: What's with you? How dare you eye me like that! Don't you know that we are Zio's subordinates?

entries.jp: ジオさまについてりゃ こうして{BR}イイめをみることができるぜ！
entries.en: Stick with Lord Zio and you can{BR}have a good time like this!
entries.us: If you follow Zio we can show you a good time, just like this!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}…確かに食いぶちには困らねぇが、オレの手は確実に汚れていく…。{ctl.FD}…これでいいのかな…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}...True, I never want for a meal,{BR}but my hands get dirtier by the day.{ctl.FD}...Is this really all right...?
entries.us: It's true that I don't have to worry about money to feed myself, but my hands are definitely becoming soiled... I wonder if I'm doing the right thing?

entries.jp: 今までの飲み代を オレはここで{BR}はたらいて返すことにしたんだ！
entries.en: I've decided to work here to pay them{BR}back for all the drinks I had!
entries.us: I've decided to work here so I can repay my tab, at the inn, I've accumulated!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}普通に酒場をやっていたんですが、あるときジオの兵士がやってきて…代金はツケにしとけと言ってますが払っちゃくれないでしょ…トホホ…
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}I ran an ordinary tavern, and then{BR}one day Zio's soldiers came in...{ctl.FD}Put it on the tab, they say, but{BR}they'll never pay, will they...
entries.us: I've just been running this place like a regular inn, but one day, Zio's soldiers came... They said to just put everything on a running tab, but they never pay up ...boo hoo...

entries.jp: ジオ倒さる！ の知らせとともに、みんな逃げて行っちゃいましたよ。やはり代金はふみ倒されましたけどホッとしました。{ctl.FD}…ひとり感心なのもいたしね。
entries.en: Word came that Zio had fallen, and{BR}that entire crew ran off.{ctl.FD}Skipped out on the bill, of course,{BR}but I'm relieved nonetheless.{ctl.FD}...There was one person who actually{BR}did the right thing, though.
entries.us: Zio will be defeated! With that pronouncement, everyone ran way. They ran out on their tabs, but I'm relieved. There was one person I was impressed with though.

entries.jp: あら？{BR}こんなボウヤがお客さんなの？{ctl.FD}かわいいわね。{BR}はりきっちゃおうかしら？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}え…な、何のこと？
entries.en: Oh? A little boy like you for a customer?{ctl.FD}How adorable.{BR}Maybe I should really give it my all?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Huh... wh-what do you mean?
entries.us: Oh my? Such a little boy as a customer? How adorable. I'm going to give you some great service. Huh? Wh... What are you talking about?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}ひ、ひどいと思いませんか？{ctl.FD}教会に来ている連中、夜は{BR}ここに寝泊まりしてるんですよ？{ctl.FD}ジオの兵士がこわくて 宿代なんか取れないし…あんまりだ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}I-isn't it dreadful?{ctl.FD}That group from the church, they{BR}sleep here every night.{ctl.FD}I'm too afraid of Zio's soldiers{BR}to charge them... it's too much!
entries.us: I don't like that new church. Zio's soldier stay the night here, but I'm too afraid to collect room charges from them. It's just too much!

entries.jp: 教会にいた連中、やっと{BR}出て行ってくれましたよ！
entries.en: That church crowd has finally{BR}cleared out of here!
entries.us: All those people who came to the church have finally left!

entries.jp: ジオさまの信者の間ではね…{ctl.FD}「カダリを見ずして したり顔を{BR}するなかれ」という言葉があるのよカダリは あこがれの聖地なの！
entries.en: Among Lord Zio's believers there's{BR}a saying...{ctl.FD}"Wear no smug face until you have{BR}seen Kadary.''{ctl.FD}Kadary is a holy place they all yearn{BR}to visit!
entries.us: Among the believers of Zio, there's a saying that goes 'The righteous do not ignore Kadary.' Kadary is a sacred area!

entries.jp: このモタビアの不浄を救えるのは{BR}ジオさまをおいて他にはいない！{ctl.FD}ああっ！{BR}ジオさまに栄光あれーーーっ！！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}失神しちゃった…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}こ、こわい……。
entries.en: None but Lord Zio can save Motavia{BR}from its impurity!{ctl.FD}Aaah!{BR}Glory be to Lord Ziooooo!!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}He's fainted...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Th-that's frightening......
entries.us: No one other than Zio can save us from the uncleanliness of Motavia! Ahhh! Glory be to you, Zio! He's fainted...  How...how frightening.

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} る

{ctl.F4:01}これ…なんか光ってるけど？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あたし、わかるわ。{BR}かわって、ルディ！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:00}へぇ…やるもんだ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}けっこう キツいプロテクト{BR}ですけど…なんとか…よし！{ctl.FD}いけます！ メインコンピュータのメモリーにアクセス！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F2:00003E}{ctl.F4:01}…何これ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}これ！ 千年前にパルマから{BR}脱出した宇宙船ですって！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}えっ！ 本当！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}パルマって…千年前に{BR}爆発、消滅したっていう…！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あら…知ってるのね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ああ…アカデミーで聞いたんだ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}アルゴル星系 第一惑星パルマ…{ctl.FD}AW1284、人工衛星ガイラの{BR}衝突により爆発、消滅……{ctl.FD}今は、アステロイドベルトに{BR}その名残を残すのみ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}脱出した人たちがいたんだ…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}メモリーによると…爆発寸前の{BR}パルマから かろうじて脱出…。{ctl.FD}しかし…爆発の衝撃波で{BR}宇宙船は半壊……！{ctl.FD}その後 モタビアの衛星軌道に{BR}つかまり、宇宙をただよう…{ctl.FD}中の人間は みな死亡したが、{BR}コンピュータブロックだけは…{ctl.FD}自己修復機能により維持されてきた……ということらしいです。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}みんな…死んだ…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}航路の記録を見ると…千年の間に{BR}少しずつ軌道が下がってきて…{ctl.FD}そして、ついに墜落…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}じゃ…パルマの人って…{BR}やっぱり全滅してしまったのか！？{ctl.F4:06}いいえ…パルマから脱出した船は{BR}これだけじゃないわ！{ctl.FD}他にも同じタイプの船が{BR}脱出に成功しているみたい。{ctl.FD}ほとんどは モタビアか{BR}デゾリスに降りたんだけど、{ctl.FD}…そのままアルゴル星系外へ{BR}出て行ったものもあるわ。{ctl.FD}正確な数は…メモリーが壊れていてわからないけれど…数十隻ってとこ{ctl.F4:01}…この宇宙のどこかに…{BR}まだ航海を続けているのか…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}This... it's glowing somehow?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}I can manage this.{BR}Let me take over, Rudy!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:00}Well... not bad at all.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}The security is fairly tight,{BR}but... somehow... there!{ctl.FD}I'm in! Accessing the main{BR}computer's memory!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F2:00003E}{ctl.F4:01}...What is this?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}This! It says it's a ship that fled{BR}Palma a thousand years ago!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}What! Really!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Palma... the planet that exploded{BR}and vanished a thousand years ago!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Oh... you know of it.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Yes... I heard of it at the academy.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Palma, first planet of the{BR}Algol system...{ctl.FD}AW 1284. Destroyed by the impact{BR}of the satellite Gaira......{ctl.FD}Now only an asteroid belt{BR}remains of it...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}And there were people who escaped...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}According to the memory... they barely{BR}got clear of Palma before it blew...{ctl.FD}But the blast wave left the{BR}ship half-wrecked......!{ctl.FD}After that it was caught in{BR}Motavia's orbit, adrift...{ctl.FD}Everyone aboard perished, but the{BR}computer block alone...{ctl.FD}was maintained by its own self-repair{BR}function...... so it seems.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Everyone... died...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Per the flight logs... over a{BR}thousand years the orbit decayed...{ctl.FD}and at last it fell...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Then... the people of Palma...{BR}were they all wiped out after all!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}No... this was not the only ship{BR}to escape from Palma!{ctl.FD}Others of the same type seem{BR}to have gotten away as well.{ctl.FD}Most of them came down on{BR}Motavia or on Dezolis,{ctl.FD}...but some continued on, leaving the{BR}Algol system altogether.{ctl.FD}The exact number... the memory is{BR}corrupted... some tens of ships.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...Somewhere out in the cosmos...{BR}they're still continuing their voyage...?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}パルマから脱出した宇宙船が{BR}墜落したものだ……。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A spaceship that fled Palma{BR}crashed here......

entries.jp: みんな いいかげんよね！{ctl.FD}あたしは たとえジオさまが{BR}亡くなっても彼を信じ続けるわよ！
entries.en: You're all so unreliable!{ctl.FD}Even if Lord Zio is dead, I will{BR}keep on believing in him!
entries.us: Oh, you guys, stop! Even if Zio is defeated, I'll keep on believing in him! Oh...Zio, the holy one...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:2701}{ctl.FA:6501}あたし、モタビア・アカデミーからここへやってきたの！{ctl.FD}学校の勉強なんて{BR}バカらしくって！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:2701}{ctl.FA:6501}I came here from Motavia Academy!{ctl.FD}Schoolwork is so utterly ridiculous!
entries.us: I came here from the Motavia Academy. School work is so stupid!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ヘ
{ctl.F4:24}ああーん。ここはどこ？{BR}ピアタに帰りたいよぅ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}うん、ピアタに帰ろう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:24}連れて帰ってくれるの？{BR}ありが…と…
entries.en: {ctl.F4:24}Waaah. Where is this?{BR}I want to go home to Piata.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Right, let's get you to Piata!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:24}You'll take me home?{BR}Thank... you...
entries.us: Waaaa. Where is this? I want to go back to Piata. Yes, let's go back to Piata! You'll take me back? Th...thank...you

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}きみっ！ だいじょうぶ！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:24}おなか…すい…た…
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Hey! Are you all right?!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:24}I'm... so... hungry...
entries.us: Hey, you! Are you all right!? I...am...hungry...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:2907}{ctl.F6} ホ
おお！ そなたが持っているのは{BR}「ペロリーメイト」ではないか！{ctl.FD}懐かしいのぅ！{BR}これがもう栄養満点での！{ctl.FD}わしも昔、よく食うたものじゃ！{BR}どれ、この娘に与えてみよう！
entries.en: Oho! Is that a PelorieMate you're{BR}carrying?{ctl.FD}That brings back memories!{BR}Packed full of nourishment!{ctl.FD}I ate them all the time in my day!{BR}Here, let's give one to this girl!
entries.us: Hey! You're holding a Perolymate! Does that bring back memories! That has high nutritional value! I used to eat those back in the old days! Lemme see, let's give it to this girl!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:24}うーん。うーん。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:24}Mmh. Mmh.
entries.us: groan, groan

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} マ
{ctl.F4:24}あらら？ あたし、どうして{BR}こんなところにいるのかしら？{ctl.FD}ここはどこ？{BR}うわーん。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:24}Oh dear? However did I come to{BR}be in a place like this?{ctl.FD}Where is this?{BR}Waaaah.
entries.us: Oh dear? How did I get here? Where is this place? Waaa.

entries.jp: しばらく食うや食わずの生活だったようじゃの。だいぶ衰弱しておる。なにか栄養のあるものでも食わせてやればいいんじゃがのぅ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}栄養のあるものか…。
entries.en: It seems she's gone without food for{BR}quite a while. She's quite emaciated.{ctl.FD}If only we could feed her{BR}something nutritious......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Something nutritious...
entries.us: Looks like she has been eating irregularly. She is pretty weak. She should be given something nutritious to eat. Hmm, something nutritious...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:24}あら。{BR}あたし、どうしたのかしら？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}よかった！ 元気になったね！{BR}さあ、ピアタに帰ろう？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:24}Oh. What happened to me?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Thank goodness, you're better!{BR}Now, let's get you to Piata.
entries.us: Oh. What has happened to me? Thank goodness you've revived! Now, let's go back to Piata.

entries.jp: どうかな？？
entries.en: How about it??
entries.us: How is it?

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}バカやろう！ かけおちしといて{BR}今さら そんな事ができるか！！
entries.en: {ctl.F3}You idiot! You ran off to elope,{BR}and now you ask that of me!!
entries.us: Cool!

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}ねぇあんたぁ、もう{BR}この街から出て行かないかい？
entries.en: {ctl.F3}Hey...{BR}Why don't you leave this town already?
entries.us: Cool!

entries.jp: ほんと、やれやれね。
entries.en: Honestly. Good grief.
entries.us: Yeh, you're right.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}ここ アイードは流通の街。{ctl.FD}いろんな物が いろんな所から{BR}集まり、そして出ていくのさ。{ctl.FD}なんだ、ライラさんじゃないスか。おかえりなさい！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:4201}This is Aiedo, a hub of commerce.{ctl.FD}All manner of goods gather here{BR}from all over, and move on again.{ctl.FD}Why, if it isn't Laila.{BR}Welcome home!

entries.en: {ctl.FA:4201}The most skilled around here would be{BR}"Laila the Dismemberer'', I would say.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}I told you to drop that name!{BR}It's got no style to it!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Mm, true enough. ...Ow!{ctl.FD}Laila, what did you hit me for?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Hmph!
entries.us: I'd say that 'Alys the Eight Stroke Sword' is the most skilled fighter in these parts. Didn't I tell you to quit calling me that? It's totally ridiculous! Yeah, it certainly is! Ooops! Alys, why are you hitting me?! Hmmph!

entries.jp: この辺で一番の腕利きといったら{BR}「八ッ裂きのライラ」だろうな。{ctl.FD}そういえば 最近見かけないけど、どうしちゃったのかねぇ？

entries.us: I'd say that 'Alys the Eight Stroke Sword' is the most skilled fighter in these parts. Come to think of it, I haven't seen her around lately. I wonder what happened to her?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}この街には 武器・防具屋は{BR}2軒あるんですけどね、{ctl.FD}いいモノ欲しいんだったら{BR}ハンターギルドそばの店よ！{ctl.FD}あら、ライラさんにこんなこと{BR}言っても しょうがないわね。

entries.jp: この街には 武器・防具屋は{BR}2軒あるんですけどね、{ctl.FD}いいモノ欲しいんだったら{BR}ハンターギルドそばの店よ！
entries.en: There are two weapon and armor{BR}shops in this town,{ctl.FD}but if you want the good stuff,{BR}it's the one by the Hunters Guild!
entries.us: There are two weapons and armor stores in this town. If you want good quality stuff you'd better go to the store near the Hunter's Guild.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}{ctl.F6} せ
やぁルディ。今日はライラさんは{BR}いっしょじゃないのかい？

entries.us: Hi Chaz. Isn't Alys with you today?

entries.us: This is the prison. You'd better not get too close.

entries.en: {ctl.FA:4201}I'm a hunter, but I've had no work{BR}lately...{ctl.FD}That's because some woman called{BR}Laila snaps up every single gig.{ctl.FD}Why, if it isn't Laila herself.{BR}Send a job my way every now and then!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Don't talk nonsense!{ctl.FD}Work isn't something sent your way.{BR}You have to go take it yourself!!
entries.us: I'm a hunter, but I haven't been able to find work lately. That's because there's some woman called Alys who's getting all the work. Hey, well if it isn't Alys. Why don't you send some work my way once in a while? Don't talk rubbish! Work is not something that gets sent to you. You have to go out and get it!

entries.jp: オレはハンターだが、{BR}最近仕事にありつけなくてな…。{ctl.FD}それというのもライラとかって女が仕事をみんなかたづけちまうからだ
entries.en: I'm a hunter, but I've had no work{BR}lately...{ctl.FD}That's because some woman called{BR}Laila snaps up every single gig.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}おうおう！ オレさまにぶつかってあいさつ無しに行こうってのかい？あ！ ライラさんじゃねぇですか！こりゃどーも…失礼しました…へい

entries.en: Hey now! You bump into yours truly and{BR}walk along without so much as a word?{ctl.FD}Oh, it's Rudy.{BR}Give my regards to Laila, won't you?
entries.us: Hey there! How dare you bump into me and pass on without a word? Oh, it's you, Chaz. Give my regards to Alys, will you?

entries.jp: この街は ハンターがごろごろ{BR}してて 物騒ではあるけれどさ、{ctl.FD}モンスターが来ても安心とか、{BR}いいコトも結構あるよな！

entries.us: There are a lot of hunters in this town so it's kind of dangerous, but, on the other hand, we're safe if any monsters appear. There are some benefits to having all these hunters here!

entries.jp: この「みと」っていう占い屋さん、本当によく当たるのよ。{ctl.FD}こないだなんか、ウチのだんなの{BR}ヘソクリの隠し場所をズバリよ！
entries.en: This fortune-teller, Mito,{BR}she really does get it right.{ctl.FD}Last time she pinned down exactly{BR}where my husband hid his secret savings!
entries.us: The fortune-teller named Mito is one of the best. Like last time, she was right on the money about where my husband was stashing his secret savings!

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}………{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ルディ、お墓参りの{BR}ジャマしちゃいけないと思う。
entries.en: {ctl.F3}.........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy, we shouldn't get in the way{BR}of her visiting the grave.
entries.us: Hmph... Chaz, I don't think you should get in her way when she is paying her respects at the grave.

entries.jp: こっちは ぶっそうなヒトは{BR}あんまり来ないから安心だわ！

entries.jp: うちの娘をかどわかした{BR}あのヤサ男め！{ctl.FD}今 思い出しても腹が立つわい！
entries.en: That smooth-faced devil who led my{BR}daughter astray!{ctl.FD}It makes my blood boil even now!

entries.en: They say things are bad over in{BR}Nalya...?{ctl.FD}I wonder if our daughter is well...{BR}I worry and worry.{ctl.FD}Come, dear. Don't stay angry forever.{BR}Let's go pay her a visit, okay?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}ああ ライラさん、こないだは{BR}おすそわけをもらって悪かったわねあのお料理、おいしかったわよ。{BR}お皿は洗って返しますからね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}ラ、ライラさんって料理するのか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}わからんもんだなー。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}いいでしょ別にどうだってぇ！！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:4201}Ah, Laila, thanks again for sharing that{BR}food with me the other day.{ctl.FD}That dish was delicious. I'll wash{BR}the plate and bring it back.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}W-wait, Laila cooks?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}You never know with people.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}So what! What business{BR}is it of yours!!
entries.us: I'd say that 'Alys the Eight Stroke Sword' is the most skilled fighter in these parts. Didn't I tell you to quit calling me that? It's totally ridiculous! Yeah, it certainly is! Ooops! Alys, why are you hitting me?! Hmmph!

entries.jp: 裏に住んでるライラさんね、{BR}ありゃ いいコだねぇ！{ctl.FD}今は なんだか物騒な仕事{BR}してるみたいだけどさ、{ctl.FD}子供にゃやさしいしその気になりゃ料理洗濯お裁縫、何でも来いだよ！今度帰ってきたら、見合いの相手をあたしが世話してやろうかねぇ！
entries.en: That Laila who lives out back,{BR}now there's a sweetheart!{ctl.FD}She seems to do some rough work these{BR}days, by the look of it,{ctl.FD}but she's kind to children, and when{BR}she puts her mind to it, she can{ctl.FD}cook, wash, sew, anything!{BR}Next time she's home, perhaps I'll{ctl.FD}find her a match!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} め
大きい街に住んでるといえば{BR}聞こえはいいけれどね、{ctl.FD}ギルドなんかが あるもんだから{BR}ガラの悪いハンターが集まるんだよ子供の教育上、{BR}よくないんじゃないかねぇ…。
entries.en: Living in a big city might sound nice, but...{ctl.FD}with the Guild here you get{BR}an unsavory crowd of hunters.{ctl.FD}Not exactly what you'd want for a child's{BR}upbringing...

entries.jp: 待てコラァ！
entries.en: Stop right there!

entries.jp: いやーん。
entries.en: Oh nooo.

entries.jp: 最近、ナルヤから{BR}ひっこしてきたんですけどね。{ctl.FD}家内が マーケットに行ったきり{BR}戻らんのですよ。何やってんだか。

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6502}{ctl.FA:4202}{ctl.FA:4501}{ctl.F4:20}{ctl.F2:0B45}おお、ライラかえ、{BR}この間は世話になったねぇ。{ctl.FD}あんただったら ただで{BR}占ってやるぞえ……フムフム……{ctl.FD}…………{ctl.FD}…あ…いや………{ctl.FD}…ち、ちと今日は調子が{BR}悪いようじゃ。また来ておくれ。

Thanks for your help{BR}the other day.{ctl.FD}For you I'll read the cards for{BR}free... mm-hm... mm-hm...{ctl.FD}............{ctl.FD}...ah... no.........{ctl.FD}...I-I'm afraid I'm not quite feeling up to it{BR}today. Come back another time.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:20}悪いが今日はもう店じまいじゃよ。

entries.jp: ここは モタビアで{BR}一番大きいマーケットさ！
entries.en: This is the biggest market{BR}on Motavia!

entries.jp: さすがは 音に聞こえた{BR}アイードのマーケットよね！{ctl.FD}めずらしい物もたくさん！{BR}何時間いても あきないわぁ！

entries.jp: かあちゃん、もう帰ろうよぅ…。
entries.en: Mommy, can we go home now...

entries.jp: わざわざ あちこち行かなくても{BR}ここに来りゃたいがいの物はあるぜ

entries.jp: うんせ、うんせ。{ctl.FD}いっぱい買いすぎちゃって、{BR}運ぶのがたいへんだわ。

entries.en: We traveled all this way to shop{BR}at the market, but...{ctl.FD}the costs to even get here have left us{BR}completely broke.{ctl.FD}Actually, we can't even afford our room,{BR}so we've just been staying without{ctl.FD}saying anything... Wh-what do we do!

entries.jp: ねぇ、夜になったら{BR}あの窓から逃げましょうよ！

entries.jp: こないだはコワかったなぁ。{ctl.FD}すっげぇ軍隊が わーっと{BR}アイードの近くを通り抜けてよ。{ctl.FD}ぶるるるる。{BR}飲まずにはいられねぇぜ。
entries.en: That sure was scary, the other day.{ctl.FD}A huge army came sweeping past{BR}right by Aiedo.{ctl.FD}Brrrr.{BR}A man needs a drink after that.

entries.jp: ごほん！{ctl.FD}セキをしてもセキにひとり。{ctl.FD}さびしいなぁ…。
entries.en: Cough!{ctl.FD}Even when I cough, there is{BR}only one person in this seat.{ctl.FD}How lonely...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}やぁ、ライラさんがこちらに{BR}見えるなんて おめずらしい。{ctl.FD}わたしの顔を見に来てくれたのなら歓迎しますよ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}ウフフ、じゃあ 今度また{BR}ごちそうになろうかしらね。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:4201}Ah, Laila. Here of all places,{BR}what a rare treat.{ctl.FD}If you came just to see my face,{BR}then you are very welcome.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Heh heh. Then perhaps I'll let{BR}you treat me sometime.
entries.us: I'm a hunter, but I haven't been able to find work lately. That's because there's some woman called Alys who's getting all the work. Hey, well if it isn't Alys. Why don't you send some work my way once in a while? Don't talk rubbish! Work is not something that gets sent to you. You have to go out and get it!

entries.jp: ルディ、子供はこんなとこ{BR}来るもんじゃないぜ？
entries.en: Rudy, this is no place{BR}for a child, you know?

entries.jp: こんなところにケーキ屋があって{BR}ごめんなさい！
entries.en: Sorry there's a cake shop{BR}in a place like this!

entries.jp: わが家は 昔から代々{BR}ケーキ屋を営んでいます。{ctl.FD}温度、湿度の関係で地下の方が{BR}よく生地が ネれるんですな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ふーん。でも、店まで地下に{BR}なくてもよさそうだけどなぁ。
entries.en: My family has run a cake shop{BR}here for generations.{ctl.FD}With its temperature and humidity,{BR}dough kneads better underground!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Huh. Still, the shop itself doesn't{BR}necessarily have to be underground, too.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}ライラじゃないか。やっと{BR}この街に墓を買う気になったかえ？{ctl.F4:02}冗談！ こんなゴミゴミした街に{BR}骨をうずめる気はないわ！{ctl.FD}歳とったら、もっと静かなとこで{BR}のんびり暮らすのよ！！

Why don't you send some work my way once in a while? Don't talk rubbish! Work is not something that gets sent to you. You have to go out and get it!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:02}やっとウチに帰ってきたね！{BR}今日はもう休もうか？{ctl.F5:0001}そうだね。{BR}また明日からがんばろう！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:02}Home at last!{BR}Shall we rest for today?{ctl.F5:0001}Yeah, good idea.{BR}Let's give it our best again tomorrow!

entries.jp: そうだね。{BR}もう少しがんばろうか？
entries.en: Very well then.{BR}Shall we give it a little more effort?

entries.jp: へっ、何がマーケットだよ！{BR}本当に役立つ物はここでないとな！
entries.en: Pah, some market that is!{BR}The truly useful goods are here!

entries.jp: 目移りするけど、いい武器も 腕が良くなきゃ宝の持ちぐされだしな…
entries.en: Tempting, sure, but even a great{BR}weapon is wasted on a lacking wielder...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}あら、ライラさんが来てくれる{BR}なんて光栄だわ。はりきっちゃう！

entries.en: Times being what they are, you'd{BR}think hunting paid well...{ctl.FD}but the monsters have grown so{BR}strong that only the elites thrive.{ctl.FD}You can see it in how few{BR}customers come through!

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}イカすー！
entries.en: {ctl.F3}Nice one!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}{ctl.F3}もうちょっと！ もうちょっと！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}………。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}行くよ、ルディ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:4201}{ctl.F3}Just a bit more! A bit more!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}.........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}We're going, Rudy!

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}もうちょっと！ もうちょっと！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}………。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ルディ、早く行きましょう！
entries.en: {ctl.F3}Just a bit more! A bit more!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}.........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy, let's hurry!

entries.jp: しゃがんでなかったかって？{BR}ばッ、バカいいなさい！ 失礼な！
