entries.jp: あ、ライラさん！{BR}今日もおきれいですねぇ。{ctl.FD}サラサラと髪が風になびいて…{BR}ヨッ、いい女！ にくいよコノ！{ctl.FD}そんじゃあまた…さよならーっ！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}な、なななな何ですか、{BR}あのおべんちゃらヤロウは？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}もしかして 無理矢理{BR}言わせてるんじゃないのか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}そこ！ 何こそこそ言ってんのよ！
entries.en: Ah, Laila!{BR}Looking lovely again today.{ctl.FD}Your hair flowing smoothly in the wind...{BR}Hey, gorgeous! You can really turn heads!{ctl.FD}Well then, until next time...{BR}farewell!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}Wh-wh-what on earth was that{BR}smooth-talking creep all about?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}You don't suppose she makes him{BR}say that stuff, do you?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}You two! What are you muttering about{BR}over there!
entries.us: Hey, Alys! You look just as beautiful as usual. With your hair fluttering in the wind... You're one attractive woman! Well, see you later! Wh...what was that all about? What a geek! Maybe he's being forced to say those things. Hey, you guys over there! What are you talking about?

entries.jp: あっれー？ 確かに ここに{BR}しまったと思ったんだけどなぁ…{ctl.FD}おーい。でておいでー！{BR}オレのヘソク…{ctl.F7}わぁっ！ なんだい、あんたたち！ノックくらい しなさいよ！
entries.en: That's odd... I could have sworn{BR}I put it in here...{ctl.FD}Heyyy. Come out, come out!{BR}My secret sav--{ctl.F7}Waah! What are you people doing!{BR}Knock, why don't you!
entries.us: That's strange... I could have sworn that I put it away in here... Hey! My secret sav... Yikes! What the heck are you guys doing here?! Don't you have the decency to at least knock?!

entries.jp: ほら、急ぎなさい！{BR}静かに！ 静かに！{ctl.FD}あぁん、待ってぇ、お姉さま！{BR}おいてかないで！ キャッいやん！なんだなんだ今のは、ああん？{ctl.FD}あっ、こいつら！{ctl.FD}待てコラ！ 逃げるな！{ctl.FD}ああーん。みのがしてくださぁい。{ctl.FD}そうはいくかコノヤロ！{BR}ふてぇヤツらだ！ つれてけ！{ctl.FD}ああーん。
entries.en: Come on, hurry!{BR}Quietly! Quietly!{ctl.FD}Ohhh, wait for me, miss!{BR}Don't leave me! Eek, no!{ctl.FD}What's all this about, huh?{ctl.FD}Hold it, you two!{ctl.FD}Stop right there! Don't run!{ctl.FD}Ohhh. Please let us go.{ctl.FD}Not likely, you bastards!{BR}Take them away!{ctl.FD}Ohhhh.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:2402}{ctl.FA:1F01}ウチの飼い犬が、この間から{BR}姿が見えないんですよ。{ctl.FD}この街の中は、すみからすみまで{BR}探したんですけどね。{ctl.FD}子供がしょげてるのが{BR}かわいそうで…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:2402}{ctl.FA:1F01}Our pet dog has been missing{BR}for a while now.{ctl.FD}We've searched this town from{BR}one end to the other.{ctl.FD}It's pitiful, seeing my child{BR}so crestfallen...
entries.us: Our pet dog is missing. We've searched this town from one end to the other. It pains me to see the children so crestfallen.

entries.jp: 「ろっきい」は、その…ものすごく意地汚くて、ふとっちょなんです。甘いものが大好きなんですもの…{BR}ふとるわけですわよね。{ctl.FD}…こんなのじゃ{BR}手がかりになりませんか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}いえ、どんなに関係ないと思われるささいな事でも話してください。
entries.en: Rocky is, well... terribly greedy,{BR}and rather chubby.{ctl.FD}He does love sweets...{BR}no wonder he put on weight.{ctl.FD}...Is that any use to you as a clue?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Oh, please tell me every detail,{BR}however unrelated it may seem.
entries.us: Rocky is, well...tremendously stubborn and kind of fat. That's because he loves sweet things... No wonder he gets fat. ...Would this constitute some kind of clue? No, no, please tell me every detail even if it may seem irrelevant.

entries.jp: ありがとうございました。{BR}娘があんなに喜んで……。
entries.en: Thank you so much.{BR}My daughter is so happy......
entries.us: Thank you very much. See, my daughter is so happy.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:2506}{ctl.FA:2405}{ctl.FA:1F03}{ctl.FA:1E02}{ctl.FA:4401}街の外は怪物が出るから、{BR}おいそれと探しには行けないし…。{ctl.FD}ハンターギルドに{BR}頼んでみるっていう手もあるけど、{ctl.FD}犬を探してくれる{BR}ハンターなんて、いるのかね？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:2506}{ctl.FA:2405}{ctl.FA:1F03}{ctl.FA:1E02}{ctl.FA:4401}Monsters roam outside the town, so{BR}we can't simply go look...{ctl.FD}We could ask at the{BR}Hunters Guild, I suppose,{ctl.FD}but would any hunter really go{BR}looking for a dog?
entries.us: I can't even go looking for him, I'm so afraid. There are monsters roaming outside the town. There's the option of asking for help at the Hunters' Guild, but would there be a hunter who would go find a dog?

entries.jp: しかたないから、ハンターギルドに依頼を出したよ。{ctl.FD}しかし犬探しなんて、よほどヒマなハンターじゃないとなァ…。
entries.en: I had no choice but to submit a{BR}request to the Hunters Guild.{ctl.FD}Though looking for a dog would certainly{BR}require a hunter with a lot of free time...
entries.us: I had no choice. I went to the Hunters' Guild and asked fortheirr help. I'm sure only a hunter who is really bored and has too much spare time would undertake dog searching.

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ヒ
どうか、{BR}よろしくお願いします。
entries.en: Please. We're counting on you.
entries.us: I beseech you, help us!

entries.jp: いやぁ、{BR}ありがとうございました！{ctl.FD}さすがはギルドのハンターさんだ！娘も喜んでおりますよ。{ctl.FD}報酬は決まり通り、ギルドに{BR}お支払いしておきますね。
entries.en: Well! Thank you very much!{ctl.FD}Just what one expects of a Guild{BR}hunter! My daughter is overjoyed.{ctl.FD}I'll pay the fee to the Guild,{BR}as agreed.
entries.us: Oh, thank you! Great job! Only to be expected from a hunter! My daughter is overjoyed! I'll send the agreed upon commission to the guild.

entries.jp: ありがとうございました。
entries.en: Thank you very much.
entries.us: Thank you very much.

entries.jp: や、いつぞやは{BR}世話になりました。
entries.en: Ah, thanks for the help back then.
entries.us: Thank you for what you did the other day.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:2402}{ctl.FA:1F01}「ろっきい」……{ctl.FD}あたしの犬の名前なの。{BR}どこへ行っちゃったのかしら…？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:2402}{ctl.FA:1F01}Rocky......{ctl.FD}That's my dog's name.{BR}Where could he have gone...?
entries.us: 'Rocky'... That's my dog's name. I wonder where he could have gone off to?

entries.jp: えっとね、「ろっきい」はァ、品が良くってェ、すっごくかわいいの！おじさんたち、早く「ろっきい」を連れて帰ってきてね！ お願い！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}お、おじさん……かぁ。{BR}因果はめぐるなァ…。
entries.en: Well, Rocky is so very well-behaved{BR}and so very cute!{ctl.FD}Mister, bring Rocky home soon,{BR}won't you! Please!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}M-mister...... When I was her age, did I{BR}really call people my age "Mister''...?
entries.us: Let me see, 'Rocky' has good manners and is really cute! Mister, please bring back 'Rocky' as soon as possible! Please! She, she called me mister... It's like some bad luck is destined to occur...

entries.jp: わぁい わぁい！ 「ろっきい」が帰ってきた！ わぁい わぁい！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…なんか いじめてない？
entries.en: Yaaay! Yaaay! Rocky's back!{BR}Yaaay! Yaaay!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...She isn't bullying him, is she?
entries.us: Yahoo! Yahoo! Rocky's back! Hooray, Hooray! No wonder he ran away.

entries.jp: きゃいん きゃいん！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…なんか いじめられてない？
entries.en: Yelp! Yelp!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...He isn't being bullied, is he?
entries.us: Woof Woof! Do you like that kind of treatment?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:7D08}{ctl.FA:7C07}{ctl.FA:7B13}{ctl.FA:7A02}{ctl.FA:7901}牢の見張りも楽じゃないよ。{BR}退屈で退屈で……。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:7D08}{ctl.FA:7C07}{ctl.FA:7B13}{ctl.FA:7A02}{ctl.FA:7901}Guarding a jail is not easy work.{BR}But the sheer boredom of it......
entries.us: Guarding a prison is no easy job. It's so boring.

entries.jp: 二人組の女？{BR}そこに入ってるのと違うのか？
entries.en: A pair of girls?{BR}Would they be those two in there?
entries.us: A pair of girls? Are you talking about those two?

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ラ
あの姉妹？{BR}実刑10年だとさ。{ctl.FD}出してやれ？{BR}ダメだダメだ！{ctl.FD}……まぁ、保釈金を払えば{BR}開放してやれんこともないぞ。{ctl.FD}金額？{ctl.FD}保釈金は50000メセタだ。
entries.en: Those sisters?{BR}They got a ten-year sentence.{ctl.FD}Let them out?{BR}Not a chance!{ctl.FD}......Though if you paid the bail,{BR}I suppose I couldn't refuse.{ctl.FD}How much?{ctl.FD}Bail is 50000 meseta.
entries.us: Those sisters? They've got a ten-year sentence, so they say. Let them out? No way! Well, if you post their bail I don't see why I can't let them out. The amount? Their bail is at 50,000 meseta.

entries.jp: 保釈金は50000メセタだ。{BR}あんた、払うのかい？？{ctl.F5:0100}そりゃそうだよな！{BR}そりゃそうだもん。
entries.en: Bail is 50000 meseta.{BR}Are you going to pay it?{ctl.F5:0100}Well, of course you won't!{BR}Course you won't.
entries.us: Their bail is at 50,000 meseta. Are you going to pay? I'm not surprised! That's to be expected.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:7F01}えっ！？{ctl.FD}あんたが？ 保釈金を？{BR}うひょー。{ctl.FD}太っ腹だね！！{ctl.FD}と思ったら、何だい{BR}金が無いんじゃないか。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:7F01}Huh!?{ctl.FD}You? Paying their bail?{BR}Well I never.{ctl.FD}How very generous of you!!{ctl.FD}...Or so I thought. You haven't{BR}got the money, have you.
entries.us: What!? You'll post their bail? Wow! Pretty magnanimous of you! But look at you, you ain't got the money.

entries.jp: えっ！？{ctl.FD}あんたが？ 保釈金を？{BR}うひょー。{ctl.FD}太っ腹だね！！{ctl.FD}確かに！ 鍵は開けとくから{BR}連れてっていいぜ！
entries.en: Huh!?{ctl.FD}You? Paying their bail?{BR}Well I never.{ctl.FD}How very generous of you!!{ctl.FD}All right then! I'll leave it unlocked,{BR}so go ahead and take them!
entries.us: What!? You'll post their bail? Wow! How magnanimous of you! Yep, payment received in full! I'll leave it unlocked so go ahead and take them away!

entries.jp: 鍵は開いてるよ。{BR}とっとと連れていけよ。
entries.en: It's unlocked.{BR}Take them and be off.
entries.us: It's unlocked. Go ahead and take them away.

entries.jp: やれやれ。{BR}また退屈な日々がやってきたか…。前に女の子が二人入っていた頃は、結構退屈しなかったんだがなぁ！
entries.en: Well, well.{BR}Back to the dull days again...{ctl.FD}It wasn't half as dull when those{BR}two girls were in here!
entries.us: Ho hum. Boring days are here again. I wasn't as bored when those two girls where in here!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}あ、てめぇライラ！{ctl.FD}きさまのおかげで{BR}オレはこんなところに！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:4201}Ah, curse you, Laila!{ctl.FD}It's your fault I'm stuck in here!
entries.us: Hey, Alys, you rotten...! Thanks to you I've ended up in here!

entries.jp: くっそぉー！{BR}床に穴ほってやるぅ！
entries.en: Damn it!{BR}I'm gonna dig through the floor!
entries.us: Blast! I'll dig a hole in the floor!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:7C03}{ctl.FA:7A02}{ctl.FA:7901}夜中に抜け出そうとしたんですけど見つかっちゃって……。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:7C03}{ctl.FA:7A02}{ctl.FA:7901}We tried to slip out during the night{BR}and got caught......
entries.us: We tried to escape during the night, but we got caught.

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ヨ
刑期が終わるまで、牢の中で貴重な青春を過ごすなんてイヤよー！
entries.en: I don't want to spend my precious{BR}youth in a cell until my sentence is up!
entries.us: I don't want to spend my precious youth in this prison!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ル
{ctl.FA:7901}あたしたち前科者になっちゃった…もう お嫁にいけないわー！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:7901}We're convicts now...{BR}No one will marry us!
entries.us: We're ex-convicts now. No one will marry us now!

entries.jp: あーん。助けてよぅ。{BR}おかあさーん。
entries.en: Ohhh. Help us.{BR}Mommyyy.
entries.us: Aaah. Help. Mommy.

entries.jp: えっ？{BR}ギルドからきたハンター！？{ctl.FD}なんとヒマな…あ、いえいえ{BR}ありがたいことです！{ctl.FD}実は娘のかわいがっていた、犬の{BR}「ろっきい」が行方不明でして。{ctl.FD}街中を探しても見つかりません。{BR}かといって街の外は怪物が…。{ctl.FD}それでハンターギルドに{BR}お願いしたというわけなのです。{ctl.FD}どうか、{BR}よろしくお願いしますよ！
entries.en: What? A hunter from the Guild!?{ctl.FD}You must have time to sp-- no, no,{BR}I'm most grateful!{ctl.FD}The truth is, Rocky, our daughter's{BR}beloved dog, has gone missing.{ctl.FD}We searched the town and found{BR}nothing, and outside there are{ctl.FD}monsters... So we sent a request{BR}to the Hunters Guild.{ctl.FD}Please. We're counting on you!
entries.us: What? You're a hunter from the guild!? You sure must have a lot of spare...no, no -- I'm so very thankful! The fact of the matter is that Rocky, our daughter's dog, is missing. We searched the town, but couldn't find him. And outside the town with all those monsters... That's why we went to the Hunters' Guild. I beseech you, help us!

entries.jp: わたしたち、遠くから買い物に{BR}来たはいいけど調子に乗りすぎて…宿代が払えなくなって{BR}つかまっちゃったんですぅ。{ctl.FD}えっ！ ウーゾの両親から依頼を？そうですか…。{ctl.FD}でも、番人がずっと見張っていて…帰ることなんてできないわ。
entries.en: We came a long way to shop, and{BR}kinda got carried away...{ctl.FD}Then we couldn't pay for the room,{BR}and they arrested us.{ctl.FD}What! A request from my parents{BR}in Uzo? I see......{ctl.FD}But the guard watches us all the time...{BR}There's no going home.
entries.us: We came from far away to do some shopping, but we got a little carried away. So much so that we couldn't pay for our rooms and we got caught. What? You have a request from my parents in Uzo? Is that right? But there's a watchman standing guard all the time... there's no way I can go home.

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} リ
えっ？ 保釈金を{BR}払ってくださったの？？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}さ、ご両親が心配してるから{BR}急いでウーゾに帰ろう？
entries.en: What? You've paid our bail??{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Come on, your parents are{BR}worried. Hurry home to Uzo.
entries.us: What? You posted my bail? Let's go. Your parents are real worried. We'd better hurry back to Uzo.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}牢獄だ。{BR}誰もいないよ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A jail.{BR}Nobody is in it, you know.
entries.us: It's a prison...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}牢獄だ。{BR}落ちつきがないなぁ…
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A jail.{BR}They seem restless...
entries.us: It's a prison...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}せっかくだから{BR}壁にはっておこう！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Seems like a waste not to{BR}put it up on the wall!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}テルミの村で買ったペナントだ。{ctl.FD}海を向こうに 丘の上の勇者の像、それに「テルミ」と入っている。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}無駄使いなんだから！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}旅の記念なんだから{BR}いいじゃないかぁ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}The pennant I bought in Termi.{ctl.FD}The hero's statue on the hill with{BR}the sea beyond, and "Termi'' on it.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Such a waste of money!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}It's a souvenir of the journey.{BR}Where's the harm in that?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}せっかくだから{BR}かざっておこう！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Seems like a waste not to{BR}put it on display!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}テルミの村で買った{BR}木彫りのサンドワームだ。{ctl.FD}見事なできばえ！{BR}職人の技を感じさせるよな。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ほんっとに、無駄使いよね！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}旅のロマンってものを{BR}理解してくれよぉ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}The carved wooden sand worm{BR}I bought in Termi.{ctl.FD}Splendid work! You can feel the{BR}craftsman's hand in it.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Honestly, what a waste of money!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Try to understand the romance{BR}of travel, would you.

entries.note: trailing bytes, no terminator

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}ありゃ？ あんたら、よそ者だね？{ctl.FD}よくもまぁ 好きこのんで{BR}このモンセンなんかに来るもんだ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}Oh? Strangers, are you?{ctl.FD}Imagine coming to Monsen of all{BR}places, and by choice.
entries.us: Huh? You're strangers? You must have a strange sense of fun, to visit Monsen.

entries.jp: ああ、このモンセンも{BR}静かな街になったもんだよ。
entries.en: Ah, Monsen's turned into a peaceful{BR}town after all.
entries.us: Ah, this town of Monsen has become a peaceful town.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}ここのところの地震続きは{BR}いったい どうしたもんだろう。{ctl.FD}何か よくないことでも{BR}おきるんじゃないかねぇ…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}What's behind all these earthquakes{BR}lately, I wonder.{ctl.FD}Something bad's going to happen,{BR}isn't it...
entries.us: I wonder what was behind those earthquakes recently? Maybe something bad is going to happen...

entries.jp: 地震が続いたこの街も なんだか{BR}ようやく落ち着いてきましたよ。
entries.en: The town's had quake after quake,{BR}but it seems to be settling at last.
entries.us: Ah, this town of Monsen has become a peaceful town.

entries.jp: あの流砂も昔は小さいものだったが年々 大きくなってのう。{ctl.FD}今では ここモンセンは、どことも交流の無い 陸の孤島じゃよ。
entries.en: That quicksand was a small thing{BR}once, but it grows year on year.{ctl.FD}Now Monsen's an island on dry land,{BR}cut off from everywhere.
entries.us: That quicksand was just a small area, but now it's growing year by year. Presently, Monsen is a deserted island on land, with no interaction with any other community.

entries.jp: ラデアの塔だって？{ctl.FD}ああ、東の半島の先にある、{BR}あれをラデアの塔というのかな？
entries.en: The Ladea Tower, you say?{ctl.FD}Ah, that thing out on the eastern{BR}peninsula, is that the Ladea Tower?
entries.us: Have you seen the Ladea Tower? It stands on the peninsula to the east.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}半島にいくの？ あそこには{BR}テルミという村があるけど…{ctl.FD}流砂で行き来がなくなった上に{BR}この地震でしょ？{ctl.FD}みんな元気でいるか 心配だわね。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}Going to the peninsula? There's a{BR}village called Termi out there...{ctl.FD}Already cut off by the quicksand, and{BR}now these earthquakes on top of it?{ctl.FD}I worry whether they're all safe.
entries.us: You're going to the peninsula? There's a village called Termi there, but... Because of the quicksand we haven't been able to get there. I wonder if they're OK?

entries.jp: 地震もおさまったし、{BR}流砂も小さくなってるみたい！
entries.en: The quakes have stopped, and the{BR}quicksand looks to be shrinking!
entries.us: The earthquakes have subsided and it looks like the quicksand is getting smaller!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}この道具屋だけは 地震のおかげで大はやりしていやがる！{ctl.FD}それが足元を見やがってさ、{BR}値段をつり上げてるんだ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}This tool shop is the only one making a{BR}killing off the earthquakes!{ctl.FD}They're taking advantage of the{BR}disaster, and jacking up their prices!
entries.us: This store's business is booming due to the earthquakes! They're taking unfair advantage of the situation and raising their prices!

entries.jp: 地震がおさまれば、こんな店で{BR}二度と買い物なんかするもんか！
entries.en: Now that the quakes have stopped, see{BR}if I ever buy from that shop again!
entries.us: Now that the earthquakes have subsided, I'll never again buy anything from this store!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6502}{ctl.FA:6102}{ctl.FA:6001}{ctl.F6} わ
やぁ、あなたがたが 何とか{BR}してくれるのか。すまないねぇ。
entries.en: Oh, you'll do something about it?{BR}That's kind of you.
entries.us: Oh great, you guys will do something about the quakes? I appreciate it.

entries.jp: 地震で心の休まるヒマもなかったが最近のこの静かなこと！{ctl.FD}かえって気味が悪いくらいだよ。
entries.en: The quakes gave me no peace of mind, and{BR}now look how quiet it is!{ctl.FD}It's almost unnerving, actually.
entries.us: I wasn't able to get any peace of mind with all the earthquakes, but how quiet it is now! It's so quiet, it's almost eerie.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}こう地震が多くちゃ お客なんて{BR}来やしませんよ。トホホ…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}With quakes like these, no customers{BR}will come. Oh dear, oh dear...
entries.us: With all these earthquakes, we won't get any customers. sigh.

entries.jp: これで少しは お客さんが{BR}来てくれるかしらん。
entries.en: Perhaps we'll get a customer or{BR}two now.
entries.us: Maybe we'll finally get some customers now.

entries.jp: オレは旅から旅のハンター。{ctl.FD}この辺は サンドワームが多くて{BR}かなわねぇな！{ctl.FD}逃げれば追いかけてこないから、{BR}間違っても戦おうなんて思うなよ！
entries.en: I'm a hunter, traveling town to town.{ctl.FD}Sand worms are everywhere around here,{BR}more than a man can handle!{ctl.FD}They won't chase you if you run,{BR}so don't go thinking of fighting!
entries.us: I'm a traveling hunter. What a mess with all the sand worms around here! Just because they don't chase you if you run away from them, don't get any ideas about trying to battle them!

entries.jp: サンドワームはな…{ctl.FD}子供のケンカに親が出てくんだよ…シャレになんないよなぁ！
entries.en: Sand worms, now...{ctl.FD}Pick a fight with the child and out{BR}comes the parent...{ctl.FD}That's no laughing matter!
entries.us: With all these sand worms... The parents will not let their children play outside... I guess they're just being careful.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}あなた となりのうち見た？{ctl.FD}ここも いつああなるか、{BR}地震のたびにビクビクよ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}Did you see the house next door?{ctl.FD}Every quake I'm terrified ours will{BR}go the same way!
entries.us: Hey, did you see the house next door? I'm scared to death every time an earthquake occurs, thinking when this house is going to be like that one!

entries.jp: もう地震はおきないんですか？{BR}
entries.en: You mean there'll be no more{BR}earthquakes?
entries.us: You say there'll be no more earthquakes? I wonder if that's true?

entries.jp: となりの部屋は 息子夫婦が{BR}住んでおったんじゃが…{ctl.FD}わしらをおいて この村を{BR}出ていってしまったんじゃよ。
entries.en: My son and his wife lived in the{BR}next room, but...{ctl.FD}they've gone and left the village,{BR}abandoning us.
entries.us: My son and his wife used to live next door, but... They've up and left this town, just abandoning us.

entries.jp: ここだけの話ですけどね。{ctl.FD}息子の嫁というのが{BR}これがもう性悪でねぇ！{ctl.FD}出てってくれて{BR}ホッとしてるんですよ。
entries.en: Just between you and me....{ctl.FD}That wife of my son's...{BR}she's a nasty piece of work!{ctl.FD}I'm actually quietly relieved she's gone.
entries.us: This is just between you and me. My son's wife, she's one depraved person! Actually, I'm quite relieved that she's gone.

entries.jp: 半島にあるテルミって村は 何か{BR}昔の勇者とやらを祭ってたっけ。{ctl.FD}ええっとぉ…ア…アリ…アリ…{BR}アリスとかいったかしら？
entries.en: That village Termi on the peninsula{BR}honors some hero of old, I think.{ctl.FD}Now what was it... A... Ali... Ali...{BR}Alice, was it?
entries.us: At that village Termi on the peninsula there, I believe they've enshrined some heroine of yore. Lemme see...A...Ali...Ali... I think they said her name was Alis?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}いやぁはっはっは。地震で 物が{BR}こわれたなら、当店でお買い物を！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}Ha ha ha! If the quake broke your{BR}things, buy new ones here!
entries.us: Ha, ha, ha. If the earthquake has broken your goods,  buy your replacements at this store!

entries.jp: 地震が起きなくなったとたん、誰も買い物に来てくれなくなりました…
entries.en: The moment the quakes stopped, not{BR}a soul comes in to buy anything...
entries.us: Now that the earthquakes have stopped, no one shops here anymore.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}うちのひと、こわれやすいように{BR}売り物にヒビを入れてるんですよ！あたしは ご近所さまに{BR}合わせる顔がありません！！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.FA:6101}My husband cracks the merchandise so{BR}they'll break faster!{ctl.FD}I can't even look our neighbors{BR}in the eye anymore!!
entries.us: I can't believe my husband is taking advantage of our friends!

entries.jp: …バチがあたったのよ…！{BR}ほんとに…バカなんだから…。
entries.en: ...It's just karma...!{BR}Really... the fool...
entries.us: This must be divine punishment!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:3D06}{ctl.FA:3C05}{ctl.FA:2F04}{ctl.FA:2D03}{ctl.FA:2C02}{ctl.FA:6501}ウチの目の前に{BR}地割れができちゃって…{ctl.FD}子供が落ちないかと{BR}心配ですわ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:3D06}{ctl.FA:3C05}{ctl.FA:2F04}{ctl.FA:2D03}{ctl.FA:2C02}{ctl.FA:6501}A ravine has opened in the ground{BR}right outside our house...{ctl.FD}I do worry the children will fall in.
entries.us: There's a crack in the ground right in front of our house. I'm afraid that the children will fall into it.

entries.jp: たいへん！ ウチの子、遊んでて{BR}前の地割れに入ってっちゃったの！助けに行きたいけど、地割れから{BR}最近恐ろしいうなり声がして…！{ctl.FD}ギルドにお願いしたのに…ハンターさん、まだ来てくれないのよ…！
entries.en: Help! My child was playing and went{BR}down into the crack out front!{ctl.FD}I want to go after him, but lately{BR}there's a dreadful groaning from inside!{ctl.FD}I asked the Guild for help, but still no{BR}hunter has come...!
entries.us: Oh no! My child was playing outside and fell into the crack! Ther've been some eerie groaning sounds coming from the crack recently! So I went to the Guild for assistance, but the hunter hasn't come yet!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ミ
お願いです！ 早く地割れから{BR}息子を助け出してください！！
entries.en: Please! Get my son out of{BR}that crack, quickly!!
entries.us: Please! Rescue my son! Please!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ム
報酬はギルドにお送りしました。{BR}どうぞ受け取ってくださいね！
entries.en: I've sent the fee to the Guild.{BR}Please go and collect it!
entries.us: I've sent your commission fee to the Guild. Please pick it up there!

entries.jp: お世話になりました。あれ以来、{BR}子供はいつもそばに置いてますの。{ctl.F4:01}それもどうかと思うけどなぁ。
entries.en: Thank you for your help. Ever since,{BR}I keep my child right by my side.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I'm not sure that's the best answer,{BR}either.
entries.us: Thank you for your help. Since that incident, I always keep my child close at hand. It's debatable if that's a good solution.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:3D02}{ctl.FA:2F01}あの地割れに落ちると{BR}星の反対側に行けるのかな？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:3D02}{ctl.FA:2F01}If I fell down that crack, would I come{BR}out on the other side of the planet?
entries.us: I wonder if you can get to the other side of the planet if you fall into that crack?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:25}星の向こう側を見に行きたくて{BR}谷間に入っていってみたんだ。{ctl.FD}やっぱ、星の向こうには行けないのかなぁ！ つまんないなぁ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:25}I wanted to see the other side of{BR}the world, so I went into the ravine.{ctl.FD}You can't get to the other side{BR}after all! What a bummer!!
entries.us: I wanted to go and see the other side of the planet, so I went into the valley. But it didn't take me to the other side! No fun!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:25}ママが、あんまり外に出ちゃダメ！って言うんだ！ つまんないよぅ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:25}Mommy says I shouldn't go outside{BR}so much! That's no fun.
entries.us: Mommy says I'm not to go outside too much! This is not fun.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}こ、これは…？{BR}モンセンの地下にこんな洞窟が！？{ctl.F4:06}タラスくんは いったい{BR}どこに行ったのかしら！？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Wh-what's this...?{BR}A cave, under Monsen!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Where on earth did{BR}Tallas go!?
entries.us: Wh...what's this? There's an underground cave like this in Monsen? I wonder where on earth Tallas has gotten to?

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}子供の靴だ…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}タ、タラスくんのかしら…！？
entries.en: {ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}A child's shoes...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}I-is it Tallas'...!?
entries.us: A child's shoes! I wonder if they're Tallas'?

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} モ

{ctl.F2:039E}{ctl.F4:25}ふわーぁ。…あれ？ ここは？{BR}星の向こう側かな？？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}うわっ！{BR}ほんとに食われてたのか！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}良かった！ 無事みたい。もう少し遅かったら消化されてたかも…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:25}あ、そうか。{BR}ヘンななめくじに襲われて…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}おにいちゃんたちが{BR}助けてあげたんだよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:25}ありがとう、{BR}おじちゃん！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}………。
entries.en: {ctl.F2:039E}{ctl.F4:25}Yaawn. ...Huh? Where's this?{BR}The other side of the world??{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Yikes!{BR}You really had been eaten!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Thank goodness, he seems unhurt.{BR}A little later and he'd be digested.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:25}Oh, that's right.{BR}A weird slug got me...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}And we came and pulled you out.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:25}Thank you, mister!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}.........
entries.us: Yawn...Huh? Where is this? Is this the other side of the planet? Yikes! Were you really eaten? Thank goodness! You seem to be all right. You would've been digested had we not come along in time. Oh yeah, that's right. I was attacked by some weird slug. You know, we saved your life. Oh. Thanks, mister! Anytime.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:2201}{ctl.FA:2001}{ctl.F6} ノ
{ctl.F6} ハ
ばう わう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そーっと、そーっと…！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}あっ！{BR}こら待て！！
entries.en: Bow wow!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Gently, gently...!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}Hey!{BR}Wait, you!!
entries.us: Woof woof! Here boy! Ah! Wait!

entries.jp: くぅーん。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}よしよし、おまえの好物の{BR}ショートケーキだぞぉ。{ctl.FD}今のうちだ。とっとと{BR}アイードに連れて帰ろう！！
entries.en: Whine.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}There, there. Shortcake,{BR}your favorite.{ctl.FD}Now's our chance. Let's get him{BR}back to Aiedo, quick!!
entries.us: whimper. Good boy, good boy. Here's your favorite food, a piece of shortcake. Here's our chance. Let's take him back to Aiedo!

entries.jp: ばう わう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}……この小汚い犬が、きっと{BR}「ろっきい」に違いない！
entries.en: Bow wow!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}......This filthy little dog{BR}has to be Rocky!
entries.us: Woof woof! This scraggly little dog must be Rocky!

entries.jp: ハンターさんですか？{BR}お待ちしていましたわ！{ctl.FD}実は…ウチの息子のタラスが、外で遊ばせてる間に姿が見えなくなって人に聞いたところ、ウチの前にある地割れに入っていったとか！{ctl.FD}もうそれ以来、夜も眠れなくて…{BR}すぐにも助けに行きたいけれど、{ctl.FD}地割れから最近、地をはうような{BR}恐ろしいうなり声がするんです…！お願いです！ 立て看ははずして{BR}おきますから、息子を助け出して！
entries.en: Are you the hunter?{BR}I've been waiting for you!{ctl.FD}You see, my son Tallas was playing{BR}outside and then he was gone.{ctl.FD}I asked around, and they say he went{BR}into the fissure in front of our house!{ctl.FD}I haven't slept since. I'd go after{BR}him myself this instant, but...{ctl.FD}there's a dreadful rumbling growl coming{BR}out of that fissure...!{ctl.FD}Please! I'll take the warning sign down.{BR}Please bring my son back!
entries.us: Are you a hunter?  Oh, I've been waiting for you! You see, I let my son, Tallas, play outside, but he simply disappeared. I've asked around, and I've been told that he fell into the crack in front of our house! Since then, I haven't been able to do anything. Of course I want to rescue him, but creepy groaning sounds have been coming out of the crack! Oh please! Rescue my son!

entries.jp: ありがとうございました！ 本当は半分あきらめていたんですが…。{ctl.FD}無事でほんとに良かった！ 子供はあんまり手離しでもいけませんわね報酬は規定通り、ギルドの方に{BR}お送りしておきますから。
entries.en: Thank you, thank you! Truth be told,{BR}I'd half given up hope...{ctl.FD}I'm so glad he's safe! One mustn't{BR}let a child too far out of sight.{ctl.FD}I'll send the agreed fee to the Guild.
entries.us: Thank you so much! To tell you the truth, I had lost hope. I'm so glad he's safe! I mustn't let him out of my sight again. I shall send the agreed upon commission fee to the Guild.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}うわー、何だこいつ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ルディ、まさか…{BR}タラスくん、このばけものに…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}よせやい、{BR}縁起でもない…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}襲ってくるわ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Ugh, what is this thing?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy, surely not...{BR}Tallas, and this monster...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Don't, don't say such unlucky things...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}It's attacking!
entries.us: Arrgh! What on earth is this? Oh no, Chaz, Tallas... This monster couldn't have... Cut it out, it's bad luck to even think such a thing! It's coming for us!

entries.jp: あら、見かけない方々。{ctl.FD}ここはテルミ。{BR}いにしえの勇者を祭る村ですわ。
entries.en: Oh my, unfamiliar faces!{ctl.FD}This is Termi.{BR}The village honors the hero of old.

entries.jp: 勇者の像は あの丘の上じゃ。{ctl.FD}どんなに石工が技をつくしても…{ctl.FD}本物の美しさには遠く及ばなかったといわれておるよ。
entries.en: The hero's statue is up on that hill.{ctl.FD}However the masons labored at it...{ctl.FD}they say it came nowhere near{BR}the beauty of the real thing.

entries.jp: 勇者さまを知らないだと！？{BR}…このばちあたりめが！{ctl.FD}はるか昔、悪の魔王に立ち向かい、そして討ち果たした偉大な方じゃよ
entries.en: You don't know of the hero!?{BR}...You blasphemer!{ctl.FD}Long ago, she stood against the evil{BR}Demon King, and vanquished him.

entries.jp: 女の人だったんだぜ、{BR}勇者さまってさ。{ctl.FD}さぞかし美人だったんだろうなぁ。あこがれちゃうよなぁ！
entries.en: Turns out the hero was a woman, you{BR}know!{ctl.FD}She must have been a real beauty.{BR}I really admire her!

entries.jp: ここは歴史のある街よ。{ctl.FD}なんでも大昔に 勇者さまが訪れ、いたく気に入られたんですって！
entries.en: This town has a long history to it.{ctl.FD}Long ago the hero came here, and{BR}took a great liking to the place!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6201}ラデアの塔か。それなら{BR}村を南に下ったところだ。{ctl.FD}そういえば、塔に向かうってやつがこの間も来ていたなぁ。{ctl.FD}背の高いやつでさ、勇者さまの像をしばらく ながめていたっけ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6201}Ladea Tower? That would be south{BR}of the village.{ctl.FD}Come to think of it, someone else{BR}came through bound for the tower.{ctl.FD}A tall fellow. He stood a good{BR}while looking at the hero's statue.
entries.us: Oh, the Ladea Tower? That's located south of this village. Come to think of it, there was some other person the other day who said he was heading for the tower too. He was tall and gazed at the statue of the heroine for quite a while.

entries.jp: あれ？ その兄ちゃん、{BR}あんたらの仲間だったのかい？
entries.en: Oh? That young fellow,{BR}he's one of yours, is he?

entries.jp: ここは勇者の丘。ロマンティックで若い二人にぴったりだろう？
entries.en: This is the Hero's Hill. Perfect for a{BR}young, romantic couple, wouldn't you say?

entries.jp: 緑も多いし、潮の香りもたっぷり！勇者さまの像もあるっていうのに…あんなに流砂が{BR}大きくなっちゃあねぇ…。
entries.en: Green everywhere, and the smell of{BR}the sea! And the hero's statue too...{ctl.FD}And then the quicksand had to go{BR}and grow like that...

entries.jp: 確かに地震もありましたけどね！{ctl.FD}あたしはあの意地悪ババアがイヤで家を出てきたんですからね！{ctl.FD}誰がモンセンになんか{BR}帰るもんですか！
entries.en: Sure, there were earthquakes here, too!{ctl.FD}But I left that house because of{BR}that spiteful old woman!{ctl.FD}No way am I ever going back{BR}to Monsen!

entries.jp: 最初は軽い気持ちで テルミに{BR}引っ越して来たんですが…{ctl.FD}流砂のおかげで帰るに帰れなく{BR}なってしまいました。{ctl.FD}ウチのかみさんも{BR}ああ言ってるしね…。
entries.en: We moved to Termi on a bit of a whim{BR}at first, but...{ctl.FD}thanks to the quicksand, we couldn't{BR}go home even if we wanted to.{ctl.FD}Plus, the way my wife talks like that...

entries.jp: 昔の勇者といっても、力で相手を{BR}ねじふせた人なのでしょう？{ctl.FD}そんなの野蛮人のすることですわ。
entries.en: The hero of old was someone who simply{BR}subdued others by force, then?{ctl.FD}That's something a barbarian would do.

entries.jp: …あなたたちからは{BR}戦いのにおいがするわ…！{ctl.FD}生きていくためには仕方のないことかもしれないけど、あたしはイヤ！あたし、あなたたちがキライよ！{BR}出ていってください！！
entries.en: ...There's the smell of battle on you...!{ctl.FD}Perhaps it's necessary to stay alive,{BR}but I hate it!{ctl.FD}I don't like you at all!{BR}Please, go away!!

entries.jp: 昔、この村に術者がやってきて、{BR}金属に念を込める術を教えていったそれを今に受け継ぐのがこの店だ。
entries.en: Long ago, a practitioner came to this{BR}village and taught the art of imbuing{ctl.FD}metal with spiritual energy. This shop{BR}carries on that tradition today.

entries.jp: ラデアの塔も、昔来たという術者が作った物だって話だぜ。{ctl.FD}まぁこれは話に尾ひれがついてるんだろうな。昔の話だからな。
entries.en: The Ladea Tower was built by that{BR}same practitioner, they say.{ctl.FD}Though a tale grows in the telling,{BR}and it was such a long while ago.

entries.jp: あんたら、観光客？{ctl.FD}「アリサの剣」買っていかないか？安くしとくよ！
entries.en: You folks tourists?{ctl.FD}Why not buy an "Alisa's Sword''?{BR}I'll give you a good price!

entries.jp: じし、じし、地震が最近多くて…{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:05}ひゃーーーっ！！{BR}助けて！！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}わわわわわっ！{BR}ど、どーしたの パイク！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あーっ！ わかった！{BR}パイク、地震がこわいんでしょ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}え…そ、そぉなの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}こわいもんは こわいんだから{BR}しょうがないだろう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あはははは！{BR}パイク、いくじなしィー！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:05}うっ、うるさぁい！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}しかし、しょっちゅうこんな地震がおきるんじゃホントたいへんだなぁ{ctl.F4:07}これは…プレートシステムが{BR}原因に違いありませんわ！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}プレートシステムぅ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}ここからすぐ北にある、モタビアの地殻を制御するシステムです。{ctl.FD}それが暴走しているのに{BR}間違いありません！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:05}そ、そんなもの！{BR}さっさと止めに行こうぜ！{ctl.F7}えっ！？ この地震、{BR}止めてくださるのですか？{ctl.F7}お、お願いしますよ！！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}えっ？ で、でも…{BR}オレたち忙しいんだけど…{ctl.F7}おお、やってくださると！？{ctl.FD}うおおおおーーー！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}………{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}じゃよろしくたのみます！
entries.en: Q-q-quakes, so many of them{BR}lately...{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:05}Yaaaagh!!{BR}Help!!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}Whoawhoawhoa!{BR}Wh-what's wrong, Pyke!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Ah! I know!{BR}Pyke's scared of earthquakes!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Huh... i-is that it?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}If something frightens you, then it{BR}frightens you! Can't be helped!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Ahahahaha!{BR}Pyke, you big scaredy cat!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:05}Oh, shut up!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Still, quakes this often really{BR}poses a serious problem...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}This must be due to the Plate System.{BR}I am certain of it!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}The Plate System?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Just north of here. It governs{BR}the crust of Motavia.{ctl.FD}And it has run wild.{BR}There is no doubt of it!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:05}Then let's go and shut the{BR}thing off, quick!{ctl.F7}What!? You'll stop the{BR}earthquakes for us?{ctl.F7}P-please! I beg you!!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}Huh? B-but...{BR}we're a little busy...{ctl.F7}Oh, you'll really do it!?{ctl.FD}Whooooaaaa!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}.........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}We're counting on you!
entries.us: Th...there've been earthquakes recently... Ahhhhh! Help! Yikes! Wh...what's wrong, Gryz! Oh, I get it! Gryz's afraid of earthquakes, aren't you, Gryz? Huh? Is that true? What if I am afraid? I can't help it! Ha, ha, ha! What a coward! Oh, shut up! At any rate, with earthquakes happening so often like this, it's a real problem. I'm sure that the Plate System is the cause of all this! Plate System? It's a system located just north of here which controls the tectonic plates of Motavia's surface. I'm sure that system is malfunctioning! Well, if that's the case, let's shut it down! What? You're going to stop these earthquakes? Oh, thank you very much! What? Er... we're kind of busy... Please. You must stop these quakes. Please. But... Thanks!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:07}ここが プレートシステムの{BR}コントロールブロックですわ！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F2:000050}{ctl.F4:05}止まった！ これで地震は もう{BR}起きないんだ！ ばんざーーい！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}ええ、これでとりあえずは大丈夫！{ctl.FD}でも…根本的な解決には{BR}なりませんことよ。{ctl.FD}ナルバス、ひいてはゼランを{BR}止めない限り異変は絶えませんわ！{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:06}そうよね…。{BR}そのためには…まず、ジオを！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}うん！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:07}This is the control block for the{BR}Plate System!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F2:000050}{ctl.F4:05}It's stopped! No more earthquakes{BR}now! Hooray!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Yes, we are safe for the moment!{ctl.FD}But... it does not solve the{BR}root of the problem.{ctl.FD}Until Nurvus, and Zelan beyond it,{BR}are stopped, the anomalies will go on!{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}You're right...{BR}And for that... Zio, first!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Yes!
entries.us: This is the control center of the Plate System! The system is down! Now there won't be any more earthquakes! Hooray! Yes, we'll be all right for the time being. But this doesn't solve the problem, you know. The abnormalities will not end unless we shut down Nurvus -  and maybe even Zelan! Yes, you're right... And, in order to do so...first, we must get to Zio! Right!

entries.jp: {ctl.F2:00003F}{ctl.F4:05}あれは！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}だれか捕らわれてる…{BR}フレナだわ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}助けるんだ！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F2:0392}{ctl.F4:07}あ…あなたがたは？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}ライラ・ブラングウェンと{BR}その一行だよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}ありがとうございます！{ctl.FD}あなたがたも けがをなさって{BR}おいでですわね？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:04BD}{ctl.F2:000043}わたしのせめてものお礼です。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:04CC}{ctl.F4:01}あ…？ 力がわいてくる！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}「メディカルパワー」ですわ。{ctl.FD}わたしは「ナルバス」の管理を{BR}つかさどる、フレナと申します。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}ヒュー！ アンドロイドとは{BR}聞いていたが、これほどとはな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}人間とかわらないじゃないか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}それはそうと、フレナ？{ctl.FD}暴走したシステムへエネルギーを{BR}送るの、すぐに止めてくれない？{ctl.FD}できるの、あんただけなんだろ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}ええ、わたしも全システムを{BR}凍結しようとしたんですけれど…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:03FE}{ctl.F4:00}そこまでだ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}だれだ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}あの声…！ ジオ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:03A8}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F2:000044}{ctl.F9:09}{ctl.F2:000045}{ctl.F4:06}な…なにこれ！？{BR}すごい…殺気…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}ジオ！ きっさまァー…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:13}主のいないスキにあがりこむか、{BR}どろぼう猫ども。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}自分のことを たなに上げて{BR}よく言うな！{ctl.FD}きさまがしてきたことを考えろ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:13}フ…モタビアに害をなす{BR}虫けらどもを排除して何が悪い。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}虫けら、だと…！{BR}おまえ！ おまえだけは許さん！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000046}{ctl.F4:13}クククク…それそれ。{BR}その顔だよ、私が見たいものは。{ctl.FD}苦しみにもだえる顔、助けをこうておびえる顔、怒りにふるえる顔…！いい。いいぞ！ もっと怒れ！{BR}苦しめ！ 悲しめ！{ctl.FD}それこそは 我と{BR}我が大いなる神への最高の供物！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}神だって…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}な、何だ、こいつ！？{BR}…くそっ！ 行くぞ、みんな！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}待ってルディ！{ctl.FD}ジオ！ わかってんの？{BR}暴走したシステムを止めないと、{ctl.FD}モタビア自体が 人の住める星じゃなくなるんだよ？ フレナを…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:13}生きとし生けるものの絶滅、{BR}けっこうではないか？{ctl.FD}生命あるものに死を！{BR}形ある物に破壊を！{ctl.FD}それこそが 我が望み！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}めちゃくちゃだよ、そんなの！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:13}我が神は このアルゴルに{BR}いかなる生命の存在をも許さない！すべては無に帰するのだよ。{BR}わたしが、この手で、それを成す！{ctl.F4:01}それじゃ おまえ自身も{BR}いなくなっちゃうじゃないか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:13}我が神が それを望むのなら、{BR}それは我が望みでもあるのだよ…。{ctl.F4:03}く、狂ってる…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:13}戯れ事は終わりだ。{ctl.F2:07}わたしの{BR}ジャマをする者には消えてもらう。わが神の意志に背いた{BR}おのが愚かさを呪うがいい。{ctl.FD}わが 唯一にして絶対なる神、{BR}「ダーク・ファルス」さまのな…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}「ダーク・ファルス」！？
entries.en: {ctl.F2:00003F}{ctl.F4:05}What's that!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Someone's been captured...{BR}It's Frena!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}We have to save her!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F2:0392}{ctl.F4:07}Wh... who are you?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Laila Brangwen{BR}and company.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Thank you so much!{ctl.FD}You are injured,{BR}are you not?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:04BD}{ctl.F2:000043}This is the least I can offer in thanks.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:04CC}{ctl.F4:01}Ah...? Strength is welling up in me!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}That is my Medical Power.{ctl.FD}I am Frena, and I oversee the{BR}management of Nurvus.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Whew! I heard she was an android,{BR}but I never expected this!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}She's no different from a human!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}By the way, Frena...{ctl.FD}could you stop the energy being{BR}fed to the runaway system?{ctl.FD}You're the only one who can,{BR}aren't you?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Yes, and I tried to freeze every{BR}system myself, but...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:03FE}{ctl.F4:00}That will do.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Who's there!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}That voice...! Zio!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:03A8}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F2:000044}{ctl.F9:09}{ctl.F2:000045}{ctl.F4:06}Wh... what is this!?{BR}Such intense bloodlust...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Zio! You bastard...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:13}Creeping in while the master is{BR}away, are we, you thieving cats.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}That is rich, coming from you!{ctl.FD}Think about what you have done!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:13}Hmph. What harm is there in{BR}clearing away Motavia's vermin?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Vermin, you say...!{BR}You! I will never forgive you!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000046}{ctl.F4:13}Heh heh heh... there it is.{BR}That face is what I wish to see.{ctl.FD}A face writhing in pain, begging for help{BR}in terror, shaking with rage...!{ctl.FD}Good. Very good! Get angrier!{BR}Suffer! Grieve!{ctl.FD}That is the finest offering to{BR}me and to my great god!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Your god...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Wh-what is with this guy!?{BR}...Damn it! Come on, everyone!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Wait, Rudy!{ctl.FD}Zio! Don't you get it? If the{BR}runaway system is not stopped,{ctl.FD}Motavia itself will be a world no{BR}one can live on. Let Frena...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:13}The extinction of every living{BR}thing. Is that not splendid?{ctl.FD}Death to all that lives!{BR}Destruction to all that has form!{ctl.FD}That is my heart's desire!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}That's insane!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:13}My god will permit no life{BR}whatever to exist in Algol!{ctl.FD}All shall return to nothingness. And I,{BR}with my own hands, shall deliver it!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Then you would cease to exist{BR}as well, wouldn't you!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:13}If that is what my god desires,{BR}then that is my desire as well...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}H-he's mad...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:13}Enough of this nonsense.{ctl.F2:07} Those who{BR}stand in my way must be eliminated.{ctl.FD}Curse your own folly for defying{BR}the will of my god.{ctl.FD}My one and only, absolute god,{BR}Lord Dark Falz...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}"Dark Falz''!?
entries.us: What's that? Somebody's been captured... it's Demi! We've got to rescue her! Who...who are you? Alys Brangwin and company. Thank you very much! You are all injured, are you not? Allow me, it's the least I can do to show my gratitude. Huh...? I feel strength welling inside me!? It's my Medical Power. My name is Demi, and I am in charge of controlling Nurvus. Whew! I heard she was supposed to be an Android, but this is beyond my expectations! She's no different than a human being! Be that as it may. Demi, can you stop the transmission of energy to the system that's malfunctioning? You're the only one who can do it, right? Yes. I, too, have tried to freeze the entire system, but... Go no further. Who's that! That voice! It's Zio! Wh...what is this?  I feel...this incredible menace! Zio! You son of a...! Watch your tongue son. So you thought you would sneak in while the owner's out, eh, you little sneak thief? Take a look at your own evil self before you dare put us down! Think about all you've done! Hmmph. So I've wrought damage to Motavia. What's wrong with eliminating worms? Worms? You dare call us worms?! You...you... I cannot forgive you! Heh, heh, heh. Now, now. That's the expression I want to see! A face filled with pain and anguish, begging fearfully for help, a face quivering with anger! Go, on! Get angry! Suffer! Be sad! That would truly be the ultimate offering to me and my great god! Your god? Son of a...! Blast! Come on! Let's go everyone! Wait, Chaz! Zio! Do you understand what's going on? If we don't stop the systems that are running out of control, Motavia itself is going to become uninhabitable. You must let Demi... Total annihilation of life, What a fine thing! Death to all that lives! Destruction to all that has form! That is indeed my desire! That's crazy! My god will not tolerate any life forms in Algo! Everything must be wiped out. And I, with these very hands, will do just that! That means you yourself will be gone too! If my god wishes that to be so, that is also my wish. You...you're out of your mind! Fun and games are over with. Anyone who dares get in my way shall perish. My humble self, who has taken it upon myself to do the wish of my god, shall destroy thee. Oh, the greatest, my one and only ultimate god, Dark Force! 'Dark Force'?

entries.jp: {ctl.F2:000047}{ctl.F2:04CE}{ctl.F4:02}ルディ！ 危な…あああっ……！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:04CE}{ctl.F2:000048}{ctl.F9:13}{ctl.F4:01}ライラっ！？{ctl.F9:31}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000049}{ctl.F4:03}これは…マズイですよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ここはいったん退きましょう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}く…くそぉ！！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}ま、負けた…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}く、くっそぉおおおお！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:04BD}{ctl.F2:000041}{ctl.F4:06}ルディ！ ダメよ！！ レスタでもライラさんの傷が治らない！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そんな！ ライラ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}ルディ、一度{BR}どこかの村にもどった方がいい！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…ちくしょう！

Look ou... aaahh......!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:04CE}{ctl.F2:000048}{ctl.F9:13}{ctl.F4:01}Laila!?{ctl.F9:31}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000049}{ctl.F4:03}This... this is bad!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Let's pull back for now!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}D... damn it!!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}W-we lost...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}D-daaaaamn it!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:04BD}{ctl.F2:000041}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy! It's no use!! Even Resta{BR}will not close Laila's wound!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}No! Laila!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Rudy, we should get back{BR}to a village for now!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...Damn it!
entries.us: Chaz! Careful! Ahhhh! Alys? We're in trouble! We'd better make a temporary retreat! I think you're right. We...we've lost! Blast it! Chaz! It's no good! Even Gires won't repair Alys's wounds! No! Alys! We'd better return to my village, Chaz! Alys... sniff

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}みんな、さがっていろ！{BR}…それっ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}Everyone, stand back!{BR}...There!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:07}この下が すべてのコントロール{BR}システムの中枢、ナルバスですわ！{ctl.F4:01}ジオは…ジオはそこにいるのか！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ルディ、気持ちはわかるが…{BR}今はナルバスを止めなければ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}時間がありませんのよ！{BR}急ぎましょう！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:07}Below this is Nurvus, the heart{BR}of every control system!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Is Zio... is Zio down there!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Rudy, I know how you feel, but{BR}Nurvus must be stopped right now!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}We're running out of time!{BR}Let us hurry!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}あれ？{BR}なんかヘンな機械が入ってるぞ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}変とは失礼ですわね！ これは、{BR}アンドロイド用の追加パーツですわ{ctl.F4:06}追加パーツ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}ええ、体内に内蔵するタイプの{BR}武器ユニットみたいですけど…。{ctl.FD}えっと……大丈夫みたいですね。{BR}私のボディにも合いますわ。{ctl.FD}すぐ組み込みますから、後ろ向いて目閉じてて下さいません？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}はぁ？ なんで？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}いいから！ ルディ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}う…うん…わかった。{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:07}ふう…。{BR}みなさん、もうよろしいですわよ。これで私、48％ほど{BR}パワーアップしましたわ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}どこも変わったようには{BR}見えないけど…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}見た目はそうでしょうけど…{BR}まぁ、すぐにわかりますわ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ふーん…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}新兵器「フォノンメーザー」！{BR}早く試してみたいですわ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Hm?{BR}There's some strange machine in here.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Strange! How rude! These are add-on{BR}parts for androids.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Add-on parts?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Yes, it appears to be a weapon unit{BR}designed for internal installation...{ctl.FD}Let me see...... it seems compatible.{BR}It will fit my body, too.{ctl.FD}I will install it at once, so would you{BR}please turn around and shut your eyes?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Huh? Why?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Just do it, Rudy!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}A-all right.{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:07}Phew...{BR}You may all look now.{ctl.FD}With this I am some 48 percent{BR}more powerful!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}You don't look any different{BR}to me...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}I may not look different...{BR}But you shall see soon enough.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Hmm...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}My new weapon, the Phonon Maser!{BR}I can't wait to try it out!
entries.us: What? There're some weird machines here. Weird! Don't be so rude. These are spare parts for androids. Spare parts? Yes, they look like internal weapon units. Let's see...they seem to be in working order. And they look like they will fit. I will install them right away. Will you close your eyes and turn your back? Huh?  Why? Just do it,  Chaz! Oh... Hmmm... OK everybody, I'm done. Now I'm powered up! I don't see that anything has changed. It looks that way doesn't it? Well, soon you shall see. Huh? It's the new weapon 'Phononmezer!' I can't wait to try it out!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}あれ？{BR}なんか変な機械が入ってるぞ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ちょっと見せて！{ctl.FD}………。{ctl.FD}だめだわ…{BR}私にもわからない…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}しょうがない、{BR}置いて行こう。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Hm?{BR}There's some strange machine in here.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Let me see!{ctl.FD}.........{ctl.FD}No good...{BR}I don't know what it is either.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Oh well.{BR}We'll just leave it here.
entries.us: What? There's some weird machines here. Hey, let me see! Ah... Hmmm, nope. I don't know what this is either. Oh well, we'll just leave it here.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}なんだ？ この光…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}対物シールドですわ。{BR}うかつに触ると危ないですわよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ここも、{BR}環境維持システムの一つなの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}ええ。モタビアの地殻を制御する{BR}プレートシステムですわ。{ctl.FD}その重要さゆえ、原住民が勝手に{BR}入らないよう封鎖してあるんですの原{ctl.F4:05}住民ねぇ…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}What's this? This light...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}A containment shield. It is dangerous{BR}to touch it carelessly.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Is this another part of the{BR}environmental maintenance system?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Yes. The Plate System, which{BR}controls Motavia's crust.{ctl.FD}Due to its importance, it's been sealed{BR}to prevent natives from wandering in.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}The natives, huh...
entries.us: What's this? What's this light. It's a force field. It could be dangerous if you touch it. Is this another one of the environmental control systems? Yes. It is the Plate System which controls Motavia's planet surface. Because of its crucial nature, it is blocked off so that the natives will not just wander in. Hmm, natives...

entries.en: {ctl.FA:DE02}{ctl.FA:9401}Will you really be all right{BR}without us?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Hoho. It gets boring staring at{BR}the same faces day in, day out.

entries.en: That silly-looking figure must be Master{BR}Raja! Safe and sound, heaven be praised!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Why, you......
entries.us: What a bonehead! It's a miracle you're safe! You...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}うわッ！{BR}すごい雪嵐だ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}これが もう{BR}3カ月も続いとるんじゃ。{ctl.FD}もともと寒い星ではあったがな、{BR}ここまでひどい嵐はワシも知らん。{ctl.F4:08}デゾリスでも 気象システムに{BR}異常が発生しているのでしょう。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}いや、これは「ガルベルクの塔」が原因に決まっとる！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ガルベルクの塔…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ラジャ、{BR}なんで そんなコトわかるの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}カンじゃ！！{ctl.FD}…ちなみに病気の人は{BR}カンジャ！{ctl.F2:08}{ctl.F9:59}{ctl.F2:09}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あはははははは！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…………。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Whoa! What a snowstorm!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}And it's been like this three months now.{ctl.FD}It was always a cold planet, but I've{BR}never seen a storm this bad.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}The weather system on Dezolis must{BR}be malfunctioning.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}No, the Gallberg Tower is behind{BR}this, definitely!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}The Gallberg Tower...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Raja, how could you know that?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}A hunch!!{ctl.FD}...I get those in my back as{BR}well. Hoho!{ctl.F2:08}{ctl.F9:59}{ctl.F2:09}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Ahahahahaha!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}.............
entries.us: Wow! What a heavy snow storm! This has been going on for three months now. This planet has always had a cold climate, but even I have never seen anything like this! There must be a malfunction in the Dezolisian climate control system. No, I bet the cause of all this lies in the Garuberk Tower! The Garuberk Tower? Raja, what makes you think that? It's a feeling I have. And my feelings are always good -- get it? Ha, ha, ha! Ouch...

entries.jp: アルゴル太陽系{BR}第三惑星 デゾリス{ctl.FD}雪と氷におおわれた{BR}極寒の地である…
entries.en: The third planet of the Algol{BR}system: Dezolis.{ctl.FD}A land of bitter cold, buried{BR}under snow and ice...
entries.us: The third planet in the Algo solar system. It's an extremely cold planet covered in snow and ice.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ふぅ…{BR}なんとか無事だったけど…{ctl.FD}うわぁー…{BR}ハデにやっちゃったな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000089}{ctl.F4:09}キカイが降ってくるとは{BR}なんとキカイな！！{ctl.F2:08}{ctl.F9:59}{ctl.F2:09}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}はぁ…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}おぬし…何者じゃ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}うわぁー、デゾリアンだ。{BR}初めて見た！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}質問に答えんか、すかたん！{BR}大事な寺院を壊しおって！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ああっ、そ、そりゃどうも！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00008A}{ctl.F4:06}ルディー？ どうかしたのー？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}どうやら 人家に{BR}落ちてしまったようですね…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}おお？{BR}本当におぬしら何者なんじゃ？{ctl.FD}角の生えた女に{BR}からくり人形。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}これは耳よ！！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}アンドロイドと{BR}言ってもらいましょう。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}きざな男。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}だまれじじい！！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:09}ふーん、なるほど…。{BR}モタビアから ソラ飛ぶ船での。{ctl.FD}ソラぁトんでもない！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あははははは！{BR}おもしろい おじいさん！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…………。{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:08}ルディ、このシャトルは{BR}もうダメですね。修復不能です。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}えーっ？ ど、どうしよう！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}…ね、おじいさん？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}わしゃ ラジャ、っちゅーんじゃ！覚えといた方がいいぞ、嬢ちゃん。{ctl.F4:06}あ、はい…じゃラジャ…さん？{BR}この船が直せるような施設って……{ctl.F4:09}…………{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ご存知ないですよね…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}…直せるところは知らんがの、{BR}ホッホ、耳寄りな情報があるぞ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}なになになになに？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}別の空ゆく船がある、{BR}という情報じゃ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}デゾリスに他の宇宙船が！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}教えてよ、じいさん！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}ホホ、教えてもいいがの、{BR}ひとつ条件がある。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}条件だぁ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}面白そうだから{BR}わしもつれてけ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}え………。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}寺院を壊したのも、{BR}不問にしとくぞ？{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}……こんなじーさん 連れて{BR}歩きたくないなぁ……どうする？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}別に？{BR}あたしは 面白くって好きよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ま、しゃあないんじゃないの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}合理的な選択です。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…………{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}ぜひ{BR}{ctl.F9:1D}ごいっしょしましょう！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}うむ！{BR}では教えてしんぜよう。{ctl.FD}聞くがよい！！{ctl.FD}はるか大昔、このデゾリスに空ゆく船でやってきたパルマ人があった。その子孫らの住む街には、今でも{BR}かの船が隠されているという！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…ホントかよ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}ホントじゃ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}ルディ、こうなった以上 それを{BR}頼りに行くしかないでしょう。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}で、その街って{BR}どこの、なんて街なの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}ここより わずか北西にいった所のパルマ人の街、「タイラー」じゃ！さぁ、みなのもの！{BR}さっそく 行くとしようぞ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…はいはい。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Phew... we made it out in one piece,{BR}more or less...{ctl.FD}Whoa... what a mess we made{BR}of that landing!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000089}{ctl.F4:09}Nuts and BOLTS falling from the sky!{BR}Now there's a BOLT from the blue!!{ctl.F2:08}{ctl.F9:59}{ctl.F2:09}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Huh...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}You there... what are you?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Whoa, a Dezolian!{BR}I've never seen one before!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Answer the question, you nitwit!{BR}Smashing up an important temple!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Ah, sorry about that!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00008A}{ctl.F4:06}Ruuudy? Is something wrong?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}It appears we have crashed{BR}into somebody's house...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Oho?{BR}What are you people, really?{ctl.FD}A woman with horns growing out{BR}of her head, and a clockwork doll.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}These are EARS!!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Android, if you would.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}And a smug one, at that.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Quiet, you old geezer!!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:09}Hmm, I see...{BR}From Motavia, in a ship that flies.{ctl.FD}Quite a FLIGHT!{BR}And quite a FLIGHT of fancy!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Ahahahaha!{BR}What a funny old man!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}............{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:08}Rudy, this shuttle is finished.{BR}It cannot be repaired.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What!? W-what do we do now!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}...Say, old man?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}I am called Raja!{BR}Best you remember it, missy.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Ah, yes... Raja, then, sir?{BR}Is there anywhere that could fix...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}............{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}You wouldn't know, would you...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}...I know of nowhere to fix it,{BR}but hoho, I have news worth hearing.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What what what what?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}News of another ship{BR}that goes through the sky!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Another spaceship, on Dezolis!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Tell us, old man!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Hoho, I'll gladly tell you,{BR}but there is one condition.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}A condition?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}It sounds like fun.{BR}Take me with you.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Eh......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}And I'll say nothing more{BR}about my temple, fair?{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}...I don't want to drag this old{BR}man around with us... do you?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}I don't mind.{BR}I like him, he's funny.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Well, I guess we have no choice.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}It is the rational choice.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}............{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}By all means,{BR}{ctl.F9:1D}do come along with us!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Mm! Then I shall tell you.{ctl.FD}Hear me well!!{ctl.FD}Long, long ago, Palmans came to{BR}Dezolis in a ship that flew the sky.{ctl.FD}In the town where their descendants{BR}live, it is said that ship lies hidden still!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...Is that true?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}It is true!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Rudy, as things stand, we have{BR}no choice but to rely on this lead.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}So this town, where is it?{BR}What is it called?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}A Palman town a little way{BR}northwest of here: Tyler!{ctl.FD}Now then, everyone!{BR}Let us be off at once!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...Yeah, yeah.
entries.us: Hmmm... We're safe but... Wow! What a flamboyant landing! How strange. It's raining machines! Huh? You...what on earth are you? Ahhh, it's a Dezolisian. It's the first one I've ever seen! Answer me, you bonehead! You've destroyed an important temple! Oh, er, sorry, about that! Chaz? Is anything wrong? It looks like we've crushed someone's house... Who are you people? A girl with horns, and a mechanical doll! These are ears, I tell you!!! Please use the word android, will you? An droid, the droid -- whatever. Quiet, you old fart! Hmm, I see... From Motavia... on a ship that flies. Or flew, anyway, before it fell. That's extraordinary... Four Motavians flee, fly -- and fall, right on my Temple hall. Ha, ha, ha! What a funny old man! Ah... Chaz, this shuttle is done for. It's beyond repair. What shall we do? Hey, old man. My name is Raja! You'd better remember that, little girl. Ah, yes...Raja. Are there any facilities where we can fix this ship? None that I know of. Then how are you going to fix our ship? I'm not. But...hee, hee... I do have some welcome news for you. What, what, what, what? There is another ship that can travel the skies! There are other spaceships on Dezolis?! Tell us where, old man! Hee, hee, okay I'll tell, but on one condition. A condition? This sounds interesting. Take me along. What?! If you do I'll overlook the destruction of the temple. I don't want to drag this old man around with us... what shall we do? I don't mind. I like him. He's kind of interesting. I don't think we have much choice. It seems a very practical choice. Oh? Then, let's go! Great! Now listen carefully! A long, long time ago, Parmanians came here to Dezolis on a ship that traveled the skies. It is said that the ship still exists in the town of their descendants! Is this true? Of course it's true! Chaz, under the circumstances, we have no choice but to rely on this information and go there. And where is this town? It's a Parmanian town called 'Tyler' a short distance northwest of here! Everyone, let's get going! All right, all right.

entries.jp: ここはタイラー。{BR}パルマ人の街だよ。
entries.en: This is Tyler.{BR}A Palman town.
entries.us: This is Tyler. It's a Parmanian town.

entries.jp: ありゃ？{BR}よそのパルマ人だよ。{ctl.FD}いったい どうやって{BR}氷の壁を越えてきたんだい？
entries.en: Oh my? A Palman from elsewhere.{ctl.FD}How in the world did you manage to get{BR}past the walls of ice?
entries.us: Oh my! It's another Parmanian. How on earth were you able to get through the walls of ice?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A001}この雪嵐でしょ？ 帽子が{BR}飛んでいきそうで困っちゃうわ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A001}I hate this snowstorm. My hat is{BR}forever about to blow away!
entries.us: I hate this snow storm. I feel like my hat is going to be blown away. Such a nuisance!

entries.jp: 嵐がやんで、これで安心して{BR}とっておきの帽子がかぶれるわね！
entries.en: The storm's over, so now I can wear{BR}my best hat without a worry!
entries.us: Now that the storm has subsided, I can wear my favorite hat without any worry!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A001}ぶるるるる。{BR}何だい最近のこの天気は。{ctl.FD}もともと住みよい星でもなかったがここんとこ ことさらひどいね！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A001}Brrrrrr. What is this weather{BR}we've been having?{ctl.FD}It was never a comfortable world,{BR}but lately it's been dreadful!
entries.us: Brrrrrr. What's with the climate recently? This was never a comfortable planet to begin with, but nowadays it's even worse!

entries.jp: やっと風がなくなったよ。{BR}少しはマシな陽気になったね。{ctl.FD}
entries.en: The wind's died down at last.{BR}The weather's slightly kinder now.
entries.us: The winds have finally died down. The weather is a little better now.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:8201}街のはずれには{BR}でっかい墓があるよ。{ctl.FD}なんでも、この村の{BR}最初の長（おさ）の墓だとか。{ctl.FD}長老なら、くわしい事{BR}知ってるんじゃないか？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:8201}There's a large grave out on the{BR}edge of town.{ctl.FD}The grave of this village's first{BR}chief, so they say.{ctl.FD}The village elder would know more{BR}about it, wouldn't he?
entries.us: There's a large grave on the outskirts of town. They say it's the grave of the first chief of this village. I'm sure the old man would know more about it.

entries.jp: 何だ何だ、街のとなりに出てきた{BR}でっかい広場は！{ctl.FD}色々とヘンなことあるなぁ！
entries.en: What in the world is that huge open space{BR}that has appeared next to town!{ctl.FD}All kinds of strange things are{BR}going on!
entries.us: What's going on, with this big open area that just appeared next to town? There's been such strange things going on!

entries.jp: けっ。女房のヤツ、てめえだけ{BR}家でヌクヌクしてやがって！{ctl.FD}狩りに行く方の身に{BR}なってみろってんだ！
entries.en: Feh. My wife gets to sit at home all warm{BR}and cozy!{ctl.FD}Let her see  what it's like going out to{BR}hunt in this weather!
entries.us: Hmmph, my wife, she gets to stay home nice and warm! She should see what it's like to have to go out hunting in this weather!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A001}みんなのんきにしてるけど…{BR}このままじゃ凍え死んでしまうよ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A001}Everyone's acting so carefree...{BR}But we'll freeze to death at this rate!
entries.us: Everyone seems so unconcerned, but we'll freeze to death if we don't do something!

entries.jp: よかった、嵐が止まったよ。{BR}これで一安心だね。
entries.en: Thank goodness, the storm's stopped.{BR}We can breathe a sigh of relief now.
entries.us: Thank goodness the storm is over. Now we can relax.

entries.jp: パルマ人の街は ここの他にもあるのですが、行った事ありませんの。だって寒いの{BR}ダメなんですものー。{ctl.FD}家の外にもめったに出ないのに、{BR}まして街の外なんて！
entries.en: There are other Palman towns besides{BR}this one, but I've never been.{ctl.FD}I simply cannot bear the cold.{ctl.FD}I rarely even leave my own house,{BR}let alone the town!
entries.us: There are other Parmanian towns besides this one, but I've never been to one. You see, I just can't stand cold weather. I don't get out of the house too often, much less go traipsing out of town!

entries.jp: ウチの母ちゃんは情けないよな！{BR}そこいくと父ちゃんは立派だぜ！
entries.en: Our mom is hopeless!{BR}Our dad, though, he's splendid!
entries.us: Our mom is pathetic! On the other hand, our dad is wonderful!

entries.jp: 家を守るのも大事な仕事。{BR}わたしは父も母も尊敬しているわ。
entries.en: Protecting the home is important{BR}work too.{ctl.FD}I respect Father and Mother both.
entries.us: Protecting the household is an important job too! I respect both my father and mother.

entries.jp: 「ラコニア」って金属、{BR}知ってるか？{ctl.FD}それを使えば、世にも素晴らしい{BR}武器や防具が作れるんだけどな。{ctl.FD}ここじゃ精製技術が追いつかなくて純度の低い「シルバー」が限界さ。
entries.en: Do you know the metal they{BR}call Laconia?{ctl.FD}With it you could make peerless weapons{BR}and armor.{ctl.FD}Our refining can't manage it, so{BR}low-grade silver is our limit.
entries.us: Do you know of a metal called 'Laconia?' With Laconia you can make weapons and armor that is out of this world! We haven't caught up with refining techniques here so the best we can do is make the low grade 'silver.'

entries.jp: はァ、いかにも わしが{BR}長老と呼ばれとる者ですじゃ。{ctl.FD}ここは 昔デゾリスに移住してきた最初のパルマ人が降り立った場所。街の名前は、その時の宇宙船の{BR}船長の名をとってつけたそうな。{ctl.FD}その船長をまつって 街はずれに{BR}墓を建てたという話ですじゃ。
entries.en: Yes, I am the one they call the elder.{ctl.FD}This is where the first Palmans to{BR}settle Dezolis landed.{ctl.FD}The town took its name from the{BR}captain of the ship that bore them.{ctl.FD}And they raised a grave on the{BR}town's outskirts in his honor, they say.
entries.us: Ha, yes, I am he whom everybody calls the Old Man. This is the place where the Parmanians first landed when they moved to Dezolis a long time ago. It's been said that they named this town after the captain of the space ship they came on. And the story goes that they built a grave on the outskirts of the town in memory of the captain.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A001}パルマ人は他にも街を作ってるわ。「ミース」とか「リシェル」とか。あんまり交流はないけど、元気で{BR}やってくれているといいわね！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A001}Palmans have built other towns --{BR}Meese, and Richelle.{ctl.FD}We've had little contact with them, but{BR}I hope they're faring well!
entries.us: The Parmanians have built other towns too, like Meese and Reshel. We don't trade much with them, but I hope they are doing well!

entries.jp: 雪嵐がやんだわ。他のパルマ人の街とも連絡がつくようになるかしら？
entries.en: The snowstorm's over. I wonder if{BR}we'll reach the other Palman towns?
entries.us: The snow storm has subsided. I wonder if we'll be able to communicate with the other Parmanian towns?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A001}嵐で燃料の調達もままなりません。今に本当に凍えてしまうかも…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A001}With this storm we can't even get{BR}fuel in effectively.{ctl.FD}We may truly freeze before long...
entries.us: What with the storm, our fuel supply is sporadic. We might really freeze to death.

entries.jp: 嵐がやみましたが、{BR}その前に地震がありましたね。
entries.en: The storm has passed, but before{BR}it came, there were earthquakes.
entries.us: The storm has subsided, but before the storm we had earthquakes.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:8106}{ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}「偉大なる指導者、{BR} タイラー ここに眠る」…{ctl.FD}「我に触れよ…我が声を聞け…{BR} その身をゆだねよ…」？？{ctl.FD}…何だ、このプレート？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:8106}{ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}"Here lies Tyler, our great{BR}leader''...{ctl.FD}"Touch me... hear my voice...{BR}yield thy body unto me...''??{ctl.FD}...What is this plate?
entries.us: 'Here lies the great leader Tyler... Touch us... Listen to our voice... Entrust that body to us...' ...What is this inscription?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「偉大なる指導者、{BR} タイラー ここに眠る」…{ctl.FD}「我に触れよ…我が声を聞け…{BR} その身をゆだねよ…」？？{ctl.FD}これがタイラーの墓か…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}ほっタイラーかしにされとるの。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ギュナは この墓をよく調べれば、って言うけど…何もないなぁ…。{ctl.FD}こんなプレートがあるだけで…{BR}うわっ！？{ctl.FD}プレートが引っ込んだ！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}そうか！ ルディ、{BR}プレートを もっと押し込め！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}よしっ！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}うわぁー！ すごーい！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}この下に宇宙船が…？{BR}行ってみよう！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"Here lies Tyler, our great{BR}leader''...{ctl.FD}"Touch me... hear my voice...{BR}yield thy body unto me...''??{ctl.FD}So this is Tyler's grave...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}He's been left en-TYLER-ly alone.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Gyuna said to look this grave over{BR}closely, but there's nothing...{ctl.FD}Only this plate, and-- whoa!?{ctl.FD}The plate sank in!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}I get it! Rudy, push the plate{BR}in further!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Right!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}Whoaa! Amazing!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Is there a spaceship under here...?{BR}Let's go see!!
entries.us: 'Here lies the great leader Tyler... Touch us... Listen to our voice... Entrust that body to us...' So this is Tyler's grave... Lying alone...what a horrible fate. Gyuna said to inspect this grave closely, but I don't see anything... There's just this inscription... Ahh!? The plate just moved! It moved? Chaz, push it again! OK! Wow! Incredible! Maybe there's a space ship down there? Let's go see!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:8402}{ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}でっかい お墓だなぁ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:8402}{ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}What an enormous grave.
entries.us: What a big crypt.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:8401}{ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}真ん中にプレートが…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:8401}{ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}There's a plate in the middle...
entries.us: There's a plate here...

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}こんな大きな墓が動くなんて…。
entries.en: {ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}To think a grave this big{BR}could move...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}こんな大きな墓が動くなんて…。

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} づ

{ctl.F4:01}これか！ す、すごいな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}これが はるか昔、{BR}パルマ人が乗ってきた宇宙船ね！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ここにエンブレムがあるぞ。ラ…ン…ディール……「ランディール」！{ctl.F4:06}ランディールっていうの？{BR}かっこいい！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00008C}{ctl.F4:09}そラをとンディーく船じゃの！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}………。で、どうなの？{BR}フォーレン！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}こりゃ！{BR}ムシするでない！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00008D}{ctl.F4:08}…保存状態は{BR}ベストに近いですね。{ctl.FD}若干のメインテナンスで{BR}充分 使えるようになりますよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ヒュー！{BR}ツキは我にあり、だな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}フォーレン、{BR}発進準備を頼むよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}了解！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}This is it! It's incredible!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}So this is the ship the Palmans{BR}came in, all that time ago!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}There's an emblem here.{BR}L... a... n... LANDEEL!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Landeel? What a great name!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00008C}{ctl.F4:09}Well! We've LANDed ourselves{BR}a fine DEAL there! Hoho!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}.......... So, what do you think,{BR}Forren?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Hey now! Don't ignore me!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00008D}{ctl.F4:08}...The state of preservation is{BR}close to ideal.{ctl.FD}A little maintenance and it will{BR}serve perfectly well.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Whew! Fortune's on our side!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Forren, prepare it for launch!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Understood!
entries.us: So this is it! Amazing! So this is the space ship the Parmanians used in coming here so long ago! Here's an emblem. L-a-n-d-a-l-e... 'Landale!' It's called a Landale. What a cool name! An air-going barge. A space sled! So, how is it? Hey Wren! Hey! Don't ignore me! It's been preserved almost perfectly. With a little maintenance, it could be perfectly useful. Whew! We sure are in luck! Wren, Make preparations for takeoff! Roger!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DE02}{ctl.FA:9401}南の寺院には ラジャという{BR}徳の高い立派な僧がおられます。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}徳が高いィ？ 立派ァ？{BR}このじいさんが？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}底が浅くてヨッパらい、の{BR}間違いじゃないのか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}…なかなかやるの。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DE02}{ctl.FA:9401}At the temple to the south is Raja,{BR}a priest of virtue and high standing.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Virtue? High standing? This old man?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}High STANDING? The way he drinks, by{BR}nightfall he can't STAND up straight!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}...Not bad, you two.
entries.us: In the temple to the south, there's a highly virtuous and wonderful priest named Raja. Highly virtuous? Wonderful? Yeah, right. I don't think they know you very well Raja. What? I'm virtous and wonderful, right?

entries.jp: 南の寺院には ラジャという{BR}徳の高い立派な僧がおられます。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}悪いけど、やっぱり{BR}徳が高いとは思えないなぁ…。
entries.en: At the temple to the south there is{BR}a priest of great virtue, Raja.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Sorry, but I still can't see{BR}the great virtue...
entries.us: In the temple to the south, there's a highly virtuous and wonderful priest named Raja. Excuse me, but I just can't see him as being highly virtuous...

entries.jp: 南の寺院には ラジャという{BR}徳の高い立派な僧がおられます。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}デゾリアンはウソつきだって{BR}聞いてたけど…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}そんなのは昔のたわごとじゃ！
entries.en: At the temple to the south there is{BR}a priest of great virtue, Raja.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I'd heard Dezolians were liars,{BR}but...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}That's just old nonsense!
entries.us: In the temple to the south, there's a highly virtuous and wonderful priest named Raja. I have heard that Dezolisians are liars but... That's just old nonsense!

entries.en: {ctl.FA:DE02}{ctl.FA:9401}Master Raja!{ctl.FD}Your sidekicks this time{BR}are a strange bunch!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Raja's the sidekick here!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Saying such a thing! Like a KICK in{BR}my SIDE!
entries.us: Oh, Raja the great one! You are certainly with some strange traveling companions this time! Raja is our strange traveling companion! How could you say something like that? I thought we were friends.

entries.jp: ありゃ？ おともの方たち、{BR}ラジャ大人はどうされました？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}おともはラジャの方なんだってば！
entries.en: Oh? You there, his sidekicks --{BR}where did Master Raja go?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Raja is OUR sidekick, I tell you!
entries.us: Oh? Ah, you're Raja's traveling companions. Where is the great Raja? I tell you, Raja is our traveling companion!
