entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}この雪嵐、{BR}何とかならないのかしら？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}This snowstorm...{BR}can nothing be done about it?
entries.us: Can't something be done about this snow storm?

entries.jp: 雪嵐がやんだわ！{BR}よかったぁ！
entries.en: The snowstorm's stopped!{BR}Thank goodness!
entries.us: The snow storm has subsided! Thank goodness!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DC02}{ctl.FA:9401}あら、パルマ人ね？{BR}タイラーの街から来たのかしら？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}モタビアから{BR}空を飛んできたみタイラー。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}だーっ！{BR}いいかげんにしろ じじい！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DC02}{ctl.FA:9401}Oh, a Palman? Have you come from{BR}the town of Tyler?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}From Motavia, by air. A trip{BR}TAILOR-made -- TYLER-made! Hoho!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Gaah! Give it a rest, old man!
entries.us: Oh, you're a Parmanian. Are you from the town of Tyler? It looks like they've flapped all the way here from Motavia. Arrgh! Will you cut it out, you old fart?!

entries.jp: あら、パルマ人ね？{BR}タイラーの街から来たのかしら？
entries.en: Oh, a Palman? Have you come from{BR}the town of Tyler?
entries.us: Oh, you're a Parmanian. Are you from the town of Tyler?

entries.jp: あら、パルマ人ね？{BR}タイラーの街から来たのかしら？{ctl.FD}…みなれない方も{BR}いらっしゃるみたいだけど…。
entries.en: Oh, a Palman? Have you come from{BR}the town of Tyler?{ctl.FD}...Though there seem to be some{BR}unfamiliar faces with you...
entries.us: Oh, you're a Parmanian. Are you from the town of Tyler? It looks like there are some unfamiliar types with you, too...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}デゾリスのどこかにあるという{BR}ガルベルクの塔…。{ctl.FD}なんでも一夜にして建ったとか。{BR}……ギュナから聞いたんだけどね。{ctl.F4:01}一夜にして…{BR}どっかで聞いたような話だ…！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}The Gallberg Tower, said to stand{BR}somewhere in Dezolis...{ctl.FD}Built in a single night, they say.{BR}......Gyuna told me that.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}In a single night...{BR}I've heard that somewhere before...!
entries.us: The Garuberk Tower is supposed to exist somewhere in Dezolis...  It is said that it was built overnight. Built overnight... I seem to have heard this story before!

entries.jp: 口に出すのもはばかられるような{BR}ウワサを耳にしたんですがね…。{ctl.FD}ま、まさか{BR}本当じゃありませんよね！
entries.en: I've heard a rumor I hardly dare{BR}say aloud...{ctl.FD}It couldn't possibly be{BR}true, could it!
entries.us: I just heard a rumor that I even hesitate to say aloud... It couldn't possibly be true, could it!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9D02}{ctl.FA:9401}北西のタイラーって街もそうだが、デゾリスにはパルマ人の街も多い。最近の寒さは我々でもつらいのに、パルマ人にゃ こたえるだろうな。{ctl.F4:09}こタエルけど、タエル！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9D02}{ctl.FA:9401}Tyler in the northwest is one, but{BR}Dezolis has many Palman towns.{ctl.FD}This cold is hard even on us --{BR}it must be worse for them.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Very TRYING... but they keep{BR}TRYING!
entries.us: There are many Parmanian towns in Dezolis and the town of Tyler to the northwest is one of them. This cold weather we're having now is hard even for us. I hate to think how horrible it is for the Parmanians. It's hard for them, but they'll survive!

entries.jp: 北西のタイラーって街もそうだが、デゾリスにはパルマ人の街も多い。最近の寒さは我々でもつらいのに、パルマ人にゃ こたえるだろうな。
entries.en: Tyler in the northwest is one, but{BR}Dezolis has many Palman towns.{ctl.FD}This cold is hard even on us --{BR}it must be worse for them.
entries.us: There are many Parmanian towns in Dezolis and the town of Tyler to the northwest is one of them. This cold weather we're having now is hard even for us. I hate to think how horrible it is for the Parmanians.

entries.jp: なんか暖かくなってきたよな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…まだ寒いと思うけどなぁ。
entries.en: It's warming up a bit, isn't it!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...I still think it's cold.
entries.us: It seems like it's getting warmer! I still think it's cold.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9D01}我らデゾリアンのほこりは{BR}「ガンビアス大寺院」。{ctl.FD}デゾリスの中心にして、すべての{BR}デゾリアンの心のよりどころです！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9D01}The pride of us Dezolians is the{BR}Gungbius Grand Temple.{ctl.FD}The heart of Dezolis, and the{BR}support of every Dezolian soul!
entries.us: Gumbious Temple is Dezolisians' source of pride. It's the center of Dezolis, and it's the pillar of support for the hearts of Dezolisians!

entries.jp: やっと雪嵐が晴れましたか。{ctl.FD}これで大寺院にもまた、{BR}参拝ができますな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}あの…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ルディ、黙ってたほうがいい。
entries.en: The snowstorm's cleared at last.{ctl.FD}Now we can make our pilgrimage to{BR}the Grand Temple again!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Um...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy. Better to say nothing.
entries.us: Ah, the snow storm is finally over. Now we can visit the great temple to pray again! Umm...  Don't say anything, Chaz.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9D01}ふぅ。やっと雪かきが{BR}終わったところなんだ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9D01}Phew. Just finished clearing{BR}the snow.
entries.us: Hmm. I've just finished shoveling away the snow.

entries.jp: ふぅ。やっと雪かきが{BR}終わったところだ。{ctl.FD}毎日の雪かきが{BR}オレの仕事なのさ！
entries.en: Phew. Just finished clearing{BR}the snow.{ctl.FD}Shoveling it every day{BR}is my job!
entries.us: Hmm. I've just finished shoveling away the snow. Shoveling snow every day is my job!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9402}突然始まった この雪嵐で、{BR}街から街の行き来も途切れがち。{ctl.FD}道が 氷でふさがっちゃった所も{BR}多いみたいですよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}雪嵐はもうコオリゴリじゃの！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}あ、それ いつ出るかいつ出るかと思ってたんだ！！ ありがちー！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}くっ……{BR}お、おのれぇー！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9402}With this snowstorm out of nowhere,{BR}travel between towns keeps failing.{ctl.FD}Plenty of roads are blocked solid{BR}with ice, or so they say!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}These storms? I've had ICY-nough{BR}of them!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Ah, I've been waiting and waiting{BR}for that one!! Thanks so much!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Grr......{BR}C-curse you!
entries.us: What with this snow storm, the ability to travel in and out of town is unreliable. There are many places where the roads are obstructed by ice! On winter nights, we huddle so tight, saying ice is really nice... How's that!? I give up! Hah!

entries.jp: 突然始まった この雪嵐で、{BR}街から街の行き来も途切れがち。{ctl.FD}道が 氷でふさがっちゃった所も{BR}多いみたいですよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}雪嵐よりも君をアイス！{BR}どうじゃ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}……はいはい。
entries.en: With this snowstorm out of nowhere,{BR}travel between towns keeps failing.{ctl.FD}Plenty of roads are blocked solid{BR}with ice, or so they say!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Never mind the snowstorm, I've{BR}ICE only for you! How's that!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}......Yeah, yeah.
entries.us: What with this snow storm, the ability to travel in and out of town is unreliable. There are many places where the roads are blocked by ice! Snow is the best Blow, for then affections grow. Then we huddle so tight, on long winter nights, saying Ice Is Really Quite Nice... How's that!? ...all right, all right! I give up. I give up!

entries.jp: 突然始まった この雪嵐で、{BR}街から街の行き来も途切れがち。{ctl.FD}道が 氷でふさがっちゃった所も{BR}多いみたいですよ！
entries.en: With this snowstorm out of nowhere,{BR}travel between towns keeps failing.{ctl.FD}Plenty of roads are blocked solid{BR}with ice, or so they say!
entries.us: What with this sudden snow storm, the ability to travel in and out of town tends to be unreliable. There seems to be many places where the roads are obstructed by ice!

entries.jp: 雪嵐はやみました。よその街との{BR}交流も じきに始まるでしょう。
entries.en: The snowstorm has stopped. We'll be{BR}trading with other towns again soon.
entries.us: The snow storm has stopped. Now we should be able to travel to and from other towns again.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DE01}{ctl.FA:9401}ああ、ラジャさま！{ctl.FD}いつも 面白いシャレを聞かせて{BR}くださってありがとうございます！{ctl.F4:01}…どぉもデゾリアンのセンスには{BR}ついていけない物を感じるなぁ…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DE01}{ctl.FA:9401}Ah, Master Raja!{ctl.FD}Thank you for always treating us{BR}to your splendid wordplay!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...I get the feeling I'll never{BR}keep up with Dezolian humor...
entries.us: Oh, great Raja! Thank you for amusing us with your funny wit. ...I just feel that I can't keep up with the Dezolisian sense of humor...

entries.jp: ラジャさまは 立派な高僧なのに、こんな辺境の地に追いやられて…{ctl.FD}もったいないことです…。
entries.en: That such a fine high priest like Master{BR}Raja should be driven out to this place...{ctl.FD}Such a waste of his talents.
entries.us: Oh, great Raja, that such a wonderful high priest would travel to such a remote region... It seems like such as waste.

entries.jp: ああ、ラジャさま！{ctl.FD}いつも 面白いシャレを聞かせて{BR}くださってありがとうございます！{ctl.F4:01}…どぉもデゾリアンのセンスには{BR}ついていけない物を感じるなぁ…。
entries.en: Ah, Master Raja!{ctl.FD}Thank you for always treating us{BR}to your splendid wordplay!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...I get the feeling I'll never{BR}keep up with Dezolian humor...
entries.us: Oh, great Raja! Thank you for amusing us with your funny whit. ...I just feel that I can't keep up with the Dezolisian sense of humor...

entries.jp: ギュナの話に耳をかたむけながら{BR}地酒をかっくらう…{ctl.FD}酒場は われわれの{BR}魂のよりどころですよ。
entries.en: Tipping back the local brew while{BR}Gyuna talks...{ctl.FD}The tavern is where our souls{BR}find their rest.
entries.us: It's so nice to sit by the fire and listen to Gyuna's stories... The inn is our source of relaxation.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:09}酒じゃ酒じゃ！{BR}ホッホッホ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:09}Drink, drink!{BR}Ho ho ho!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:09}うむ。うまい酒とうまい食い物。{BR}しゃーわせじゃのー。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:09}Mmm. Fine drink and fine food.{BR}Thisss is happiness, it really is.

entries.jp: デゾリス中から酒飲みがやってきてよもやま話をして帰る…。{ctl.FD}そして それをギュナが聞き、{BR}後に伝え広める…。{ctl.FD}ここは人々の想いが集い、{BR}そして出ていく場所じゃ。
entries.en: Drinkers come from all over Dezolis,{BR}swap their idle talk, and go home...{ctl.FD}And Gyuna hears every word of it,{BR}and passes it on down the line...{ctl.FD}This is where folk's thoughts{BR}gather, and where they set out from.

entries.jp: ここの主人のギュナは物知りだが、昔なまりがひどいんだ！
entries.en: The master here, Gyuna, knows a lot,{BR}but that old country accent is thick!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}すっごくンまい地酒があると聞いて遠くからやってきたんだが…{ctl.FD}雪嵐で道が氷でうまっちゃってよ、帰るに帰れねェや。ういっく。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Heard there was a local brew that{BR}was mighty fine, came a long way...{ctl.FD}Now the snowstorm's buried the road{BR}in ice and I can't get home. Hic.

entries.jp: すっごくンまい地酒があると聞いて遠くからやってきたんだが…{ctl.FD}雪嵐がやんでも氷の壁はとけなくて帰るに帰れねェや。うぃっく。
entries.en: Heard there was a local brew that{BR}was mighty fine, came a long way...{ctl.FD}Storm's stopped, but the ice walls{BR}won't melt. Can't get home. Hic.

entries.jp: わぁ！ なんだよ、{BR}うさんくさい連中だなぁ。{ctl.FD}酒がまずくなる。{BR}近づかんでくれんか。
entries.en: Whoa! What's all this, then?{BR}A shady-looking bunch if ever I saw.{ctl.FD}You're spoiling my drink.{BR}Keep your distance, would you?

entries.jp: うわええええぇえ。オレが、オレが悪かったよ。帰ってきてくれよぅ。{ctl.F4:01}泣きじょうごだよ…{BR}始末におえないなァ。
entries.en: Waaaaahhh. It was me, it was all{BR}my fault. Please come back...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}A weepy drunk...{BR}There's no dealing with him.

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} イ
{ctl.FA:8101}{ctl.F4:15}おんや、初めてのお客さんズラ。{BR}ほぉ、ラジャのともだちズラか。{ctl.FD}んじゃあ何だって話してやるズラ。何の話が聞きたいんズラ？{ctl.FD}雪嵐の被害のことズラか？{ctl.F5:0204}
entries.en: {ctl.FA:8101}{ctl.F4:15}Well, a first-time customer,{BR}I reckon. Ho, a friend of Raja's?{ctl.FD}Then I'll tell ya whatever ya like.{BR}Whatcha'll wanna hear, man?{ctl.FD}The damage from that ol' snowstorm,{BR}I reckon?{ctl.F5:0204}

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:15}おお、ラジャのともだちズラ。{BR}また何か聞きたいズラか？{ctl.FD}雪嵐の被害のことズラか？{ctl.F5:0103}
entries.en: {ctl.F4:15}Ah, Raja's friend, I reckon.{BR}What else y'all wanna know?{ctl.FD}The damage from that ol' snowstorm,{BR}I reckon?{ctl.F5:0103}

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}この雪嵐は 3カ月前に始まって、いまだに続いてるズラ。{ctl.FD}あちこちで 帽子が飛ばされたり{BR}おハダが荒れたり 大被害ズラ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…………。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}ウホン！ しかしズラ、{BR}一番問題になるのは 氷の壁ズラ！いたるところ 嵐が雪を集め、{BR}氷の壁を作ってしまったズラ。{ctl.FD}おかげでデゾリス各地は分断ズラ。行き来ができなくなったズラ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Ol' snowstorm started three months{BR}back and it'll be going still, I reckon.{ctl.FD}Hats blown off, skin done gone rough{BR}all over. Terrible disaster, man!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}Ahem! Tell ya the real trouble,{BR}I reckon, is them walls of ice!{ctl.FD}Storm's done heaped the snow up{BR}everywhere and frozen it into dang walls.{ctl.FD}Dezolis's all cut into pieces, I tell ya.{BR}No getting around at all, man!
entries.us: This snow storm started three months ago, and hasn't stopped since. It's been a terrible disaster, hats being blown off all over the place and lips getting chapped! Hats? Lips? Ahem! But, the biggest problem is the wall of ice! The storm has left snow drifts all over the place, and has created walls of ice. This has divided Dezolis up into parts. We can't get anywhere!

entries.jp: 天が呼んだか 地が叫んだか、{BR}突然 雪嵐は止まったズラ。{ctl.FD}でも、聞くところによると{BR}ガンビアス大寺院が…。{ctl.FD}いやいや。{BR}そんなの信じられないズラ。
entries.en: Heaven called or the earth cried out,{BR}man, but that ol' storm plumb stopped.{ctl.FD}'Cept, from what I hear, man, that{BR}Gungbius Grand ol' Temple has uhh...{ctl.FD}No, no. Can't believe it, man.{BR}I won't.

entries.jp: ガルベルクの塔のことズラか？{ctl.F5:0003}{ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9401}このデゾリスのどこぞにあるという悪魔の棲むといわれる塔ズラ。{ctl.FD}何でも一夜にして こつぜんと{BR}現れたという話ズラ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}それじゃ！ その悪魔が{BR}この世を滅ぼすのじゃ！{ctl.FD}アルゴルは呪われているのじゃー！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ラジャの言うこと…{BR}本当なのかしら？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}そこまではわからないズラ。{ctl.FD}でも、こいつのことだから 何かを感じているのかもしれないズラ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そのガルベルクの塔のある所って、全然わからないのかい？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}見た人によって言う事が違うズラ。…北の方としかわからんズラ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…なるほどね。
entries.en: Dang ol' Gallberg Tower, I reckon?{ctl.F5:0003}{ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9401}Some dang tower somewhere in Dezolis{BR}where devils are said to dwell, man.{ctl.FD}Tell ya what, man, heard it rose up out of{BR}nowhere in a single night!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}That's it! Those devils will{BR}be the ruin of this world!{ctl.FD}Algol lies under a curse!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}What Raja says... could it be true?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}Couldn't tell ya, man.{ctl.FD}But him being what he is, might be he{BR}has one o' them feelings, I reckon.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}And you've got no idea at all where{BR}this Gallberg Tower stands?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}Every man who's come here'n seen it says{BR}different. North, s'all I know, man.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...I see.
entries.us: Do you want to know about the Garuberk Tower? It's said there's a tower somewhere in Dezolis where the demons live. As the story goes, the tower suddenly appeared overnight! That's it! It's those demons who are destroying the universe! Algo is under a curse! Could what Raja says be true? That I don't know. But, Raja being what he is, he may be sensing something. And you have no idea at all where the Garuberk Tower is? All who've seen it say something different. ...All I can say is that it's up north somewhere.  I see...

entries.jp: このデゾリスのどこぞにあるという悪魔の棲むといわれる塔ズラ。{ctl.FD}何でも一夜にして こつぜんと{BR}現れたという話ズラ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そのガルベルクの塔のある所って、全然わからないのかい？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}だんだんしぼれてきたズラ！{BR}ミースの北がアヤしいズラ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…なるほどね。
entries.en: Some ol' tower somewhere in Dezolis{BR}where devils are said to dwell, man.{ctl.FD}Tell ya what, man, heard it rose up out of{BR}nowhere in a single night!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}And you've got no idea at all where{BR}this Gallberg Tower stands?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}Narrowing down, I reckon!{BR}North of Meese looks likely to me, man.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...I see.
entries.us: It's said there's a tower somewhere in Dezolis where the demons live. As the story goes, the tower suddenly appeared overnight! And you have no idea at all where the Garuberk Tower is? I didn't say that. I have a feeling it's north of Meese. I see.

entries.jp: それが、なんとガルベルクの塔は{BR}消えてなくなったらしいズラ。{ctl.FD}雪嵐がやんだのもそのおかげズラ。なんでも筋骨隆々の英雄が、{ctl.FD}そのとりまきを引き連れて{BR}邪悪な塔を滅ぼしたらしいズラ。{ctl.FD}いったい誰ズラ？ それらしい{BR}やつは思い当たらないズラ。
entries.en: Tell ya what, man, the Gallberg Tower has{BR}up and vanished, I reckon.{ctl.FD}That's why that ol' storm stopped. Some{BR}great strapping hero, they say,{ctl.FD}with his hangers-on behind him,{BR}brought that wicked ol' tower down.{ctl.FD}Now, who the heck could it be, I reckon?{BR}Tell ya, nobody comes to mind, man.

entries.jp: ラジャのことズラか？{ctl.F5:0004}{ctl.FA:DE03}{ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9401}こいつとは長いつきあいズラ。{BR}ヘンなやつズラー。…けんども、{ctl.FD}術者としては優秀で、「ガンビアス大寺院」でも信望は厚かったズラ。{ctl.F4:01}へぇー。{BR}このじーさんがねぇ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}それをうとましく思った{BR}連中にハメられて、{ctl.FD}ラジャは{BR}こんなイナカに飛ばされたんズラ。{ctl.F4:01}そんなことが…{BR}そうは見えないけどなぁ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}それが本人はきゅうくつな寺院から離れられて、逆に喜んでるズラ！{ctl.FD}イイやつズラー！{BR}ワシらは親友ズラ！
entries.en: About Raja, I reckon?{ctl.F5:0004}{ctl.FA:DE03}{ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9401}Known him a long time, man.{BR}Weird dude. ...Tell ya what, though, man,{ctl.FD}got a dang fine hand at the arts, and{BR}mighty well respected at Gungbius.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Really. That old man?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}Some jealous types resented him for it,{BR}set a dang ol' trap for him or whatever,{ctl.FD}and Raja got sent off to this here{BR}backwater, I reckon.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}That happened...?{BR}You'd never know it to look at him.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}And he's happy as can be, too, man! Free{BR}of that stuffy ol' temple, I reckon!{ctl.FD}Man's a good egg, tell ya what!{BR}Dang ol' best of friends!
entries.us: You want to know about Raja? I've known him a long time. He's a weird one...but, he's a skilled magician, and he was well liked at Gumbious Temple. Wow. I can't believe it. That old freak!? But, he was tricked by those who were jealous of him, and was banished to this rural place. Really...  It doesn't seem possible. Actually Raja himself is quite happy that he was able to get away from that constrained temple! He's a good guy! He's a good friend of mine!

entries.jp: ラジャが倒れたズラか？ 殺しても死なないようなやつなのにズラー。……心配ズラー……。
entries.en: Raja's fallen, I reckon? Man's the{BR}sort ya couldn't kill with an axe.{ctl.FD}......Kinda dang ol' worried, man......

entries.jp: ラジャ倒れ、ウワサでは{BR}ガンビアス大寺院が…。{ctl.FD}そんなのウソズラ。なんで{BR}イヤなことばかり起こるズラ？
entries.en: Raja's down, and dang ol' rumors say{BR}the Gungbius Grand ol' Temple has...{ctl.FD}It's a lie, I reckon. Why we gotta get{BR}nothing but bad news, man?

entries.jp: こいつとは長いつきあいズラ。{BR}ヘンなやつズラー。…けんども、{ctl.FD}術者としては優秀で、ガンビアス{BR}大寺院でも信望は厚かったズラ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}へぇー。{BR}このじーさんがねぇ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}それをうとましく思った{BR}連中にハメられて、{ctl.FD}ラジャは{BR}こんなイナカに飛ばされたんズラ。{ctl.F4:01}そんなことが…{BR}そうは見えないけどなぁ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}でも、こんなことになって、{BR}かえってラジャは助かったズラ！{ctl.FD}イイやつズラー！{BR}ワシらは親友ズラ！
entries.en: Known him a long time, man.{BR}Weird dude. ...Tell ya what, though, man,{ctl.FD}got a dang fine hand at the arts, and{BR}mighty well respected at Gungbius.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Really. That old man?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}Some jealous types resented him for it,{BR}set a dang ol' trap for him or whatever,{ctl.FD}and Raja got sent off to this here{BR}backwater, I reckon.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}That happened...?{BR}You'd never know it to look at him.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:15}And he's happy as can be, too, man! Free{BR}of that stuffy ol' temple, I reckon!{ctl.FD}Man's a good egg, tell ya what!{BR}Dang ol' best of friends!
entries.us: I've known him a long time. He's a weird one...but, he's a skilled magician, and he was well liked at 'Gumbious Temple.' Wow. I can't believe it. That old man! But, he was tricked by those who were jealous of him, and was banished into a rural place like this. Really... it just doesn't possible. But actually it turned out better for him this way! He's a real good guy! He's a good friend of mine!

entries.jp: 宇宙船のありかズラか？{ctl.F5:0002}{ctl.FA:8201}宇宙船というと、タイラーの街の{BR}地下にあるといわれるやつズラか？くわしくは知らんズラが、墓をよくしらべると道が開けるらしいズラ。{ctl.F4:01}墓…？
entries.en: Where the spaceship lies, I reckon?{ctl.F5:0002}{ctl.FA:8201}Dang ol' spaceship, would that be the one{BR}I heard's under the town of Tyler?{ctl.FD}I dunno the details, but search{BR}them graves well and a way opens, man.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Graves...?

entries.jp: …今さら何言ってるズラ。
entries.en: ...What are y'all on about now, I reckon.

entries.jp: また来るズラ。
entries.en: Come on back again, man.

entries.jp: ここはゾーサの街だよ。{BR}デゾリスペンギンの卵が特産さ！
entries.en: This is Zosa. Dezolis Penguin eggs are our{BR}specialty!
entries.us: This is the town of Zosa. The egg of the Dezolis Penguin is our special product!

entries.jp: デゾリスペンギンは{BR}かわいいよな！{ctl.FD}アウルデゾリアを品種改良して、{BR}放し飼いできるようにしたのさ。
entries.en: Dezolis Penguins are adorable!{ctl.FD}We selectively bred the Owl Dezoria so{BR}they could roam freely.
entries.us: The Dezolis Penguin  is really cute! We made improvements to the Dezo Owl species so that they can be bred in captivity.

entries.jp: デゾリスペンギンを{BR}食べたりはしないよ！{ctl.FD}卵を食用には{BR}しているけれどね。
entries.en: We would never eat Dezolis Penguins!{ctl.FD}We do eat their eggs, though.
entries.us: We would never eat the Dezolis Penguin! We do use their eggs for food though.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}ガルベルクの塔ねえ。…そういや{BR}東の方で気味悪い塔を見たなぁ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Gallberg Tower? Come to think of it, I{BR}saw an eerie tower to the east.
entries.us: Ah, the Garuberk Tower. Come to think of it, I've seen a creepy tower east of here.

entries.jp: ガルベルクの塔なら、消えて{BR}無くなったってウワサだが…{ctl.FD}ガンビアス大寺院まで{BR}無くなったってのはホントなのか？
entries.en: They say Gallberg Tower vanished without{BR}a trace...{ctl.FD}Is it true that even the Great Temple of{BR}Gungbius is gone?
entries.us: The Garuberk Tower? I've heard rumors that it has disappeared. Is it true that even  Gumbious Temple is gone?

entries.jp: キュー！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}きゃーっ！{BR}かわいいーっ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}スレイ………かわいい？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}……いや。
entries.en: Chirp!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Eeee! Isn't it so cute!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Thray...... do you think it's cute?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}......No.
entries.us: Chirp! Oh! It's so cute! Rune, do you think it's cute? Not really.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:8A01}デゾリスペンギンといっしょに{BR}歩きたくなぁい？{ctl.FD}街の西に看板立ててる人がいるから話を聞いてみたら？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:8A01}Don't you want to take a walk with a{BR}Dezolis Penguin?{ctl.FD}Talk to the man with the sign on the west{BR}side of town.
entries.us: Wouldn't you like to walk along with the Dezolis Penguin? There's a person putting up a signboard to the west of town. Why don't you ask him?

entries.jp: あら、「連れデゾリスペンギン」をやってるのね？{ctl.FD}まるで意味無いんだけど、{BR}そこがまた いいのよね！
entries.en: Oh, you're doing the Dezolis Penguin{BR}Walk?{ctl.FD}It's completely pointless, but that's what{BR}makes it fun!
entries.us: Oh, you're doing the Walk with the Dezolis Penguin! Actually it's pretty senseless, but that's what's so neat!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:C502}{ctl.FA:A101}ねぇねぇ知ってる？{ctl.FD}どっかのパルマ人の街が全滅したんですって！ 何があったのかしら？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:C502}{ctl.FA:A101}Hey, did you hear? They say some{BR}Palman town was completely wiped out!{ctl.FD}What could have happened?
entries.us: Hey, know what? Some Parmanian town has been completely destroyed! I wonder what happened?

entries.jp: ねぇねぇ知ってる？{ctl.FD}とある全滅したパルマ人の街、{BR}立て直しを始めたんですってよ！
entries.en: Hey, did you hear?{ctl.FD}They've started rebuilding that{BR}destroyed Palman town!
entries.us: Hey, know what? They've started to rebuild the Parmanian town that was completely destroyed!

entries.jp: ねぇねぇ知ってる？{ctl.FD}リシェルってパルマ人の街、{BR}すっかり復興したんですってよ！
entries.en: Hey, did you hear? The Palman town of{BR}Richelle has been completely rebuilt!
entries.us: Hey, know what? The Parmanian town called Reshel is apparently completely rebuilt!

entries.jp: わたしの仕事は 卵ひろい。{ctl.FD}いつ卵を産んでもいいよう、一日中こうして後をついて歩いてるのさ。
entries.en: My job is gathering eggs.{ctl.FD}I follow them around all day, ready{BR}whenever they lay one.
entries.us: My job is to collect eggs. I walk behind them all day long so that they can lay their eggs any time.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:8A01}人間、生きていれば 独り物思いにふけりたい時もあるじゃないか。{ctl.FD}だから じゃましないでくれよ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:8A01}A man who's alive is bound to want to{BR}sit alone with his thoughts sometimes.{ctl.FD}So don't go disturbing me!
entries.us: Being human, don't you sometimes find yourself lost in thought? So don't bother me!

entries.jp: お、「連れデゾリスペンギン」！{BR}では いいコトを教えてやろう。{ctl.FD}北西に行くとな、黄色い動物が{BR}たくさん住んでる谷があるぞ。{ctl.FD}で北東にいくとな、何だかわからんミョーな建物があるんだ、これが。まぁ、気が向いたら{BR}行ってみるんだな！
entries.en: Oh, the Dezolis Penguin Walk! Then I'll let{BR}you in on something.{ctl.FD}Head northwest and you'll find a valley{BR}full of yellow animals.{ctl.FD}Head northeast and you'll find a strange{BR}building no one can make sense of.{ctl.FD}Well, visit them if you feel like it!
entries.us: Oh,'Walk with the Dezolis Penguin!' In that case let me tell you something. If you go to the northwest, there's a valley where a lot of yellow animals live. And then, if you go to the northeast, there's a strange building we can't figure out. You should go if you feel like it!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}非科学的なコト{BR}言っちゃいけませんぜ！{ctl.FD}塔が嵐をおこしたり、人を病気に{BR}したりなぞ するもんですかい。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Don't go saying such unscientific things!{ctl.FD}A tower can't cause storms or make{BR}people sick.
entries.us: You shouldn't say such unscientific things! How can a tower cause storms and make people sick?

entries.jp: 非科学的なコト{BR}言っちゃいけませんぜ！{ctl.FD}塔が消えたからって 嵐がやんだり病気が治ったりするもんですかい。
entries.en: Don't go saying such unscientific things!{ctl.FD}Storms won't stop or the sick recover{BR}just because a tower vanished.
entries.us: You shouldn't say such a unscientific thing! How could a storm subside, or sick people recover, just because a tower has disappeared?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}うわっ！{BR}ペンギンのえさが なくなってるぞ
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Whoa!{BR}The penguin food is gone!
entries.us: Oh! Penguin-feed is stolen!!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ぼ
なんと！ あのデゾリスペンギンが今日だけ あなたの仲間に！！{ctl.FD}デゾリスペンギンが あなたと{BR}いっしょに町内を歩いてくれるよ！この夢のような ひとときが{BR}今なら たったの500メセタだ！当然やってみるよね？{ctl.F5:0002}{ctl.FA:8C01}じゃあ ごゆっくり！{ctl.FD}街を出たり、家に入ったりしたら{BR}終わりだから 気をつけてくれよ！
entries.en: Would you believe it! The famous{BR}Dezolis Penguin, yours for a day!{ctl.FD}It will walk the town at your side!{ctl.FD}This momentous dream, just{BR}500 meseta if you take it now!{ctl.FD}You'll try it, of course?{ctl.F5:0002}{ctl.FA:8C01}Enjoy yourselves!{ctl.FD}Just remember: leave town or step into{BR}a house and it's over!
entries.us: Make that Dezolis Penguin a part of your group for today! The Dezolis Penguin will walk around town with you! This dream-like experience is yours for only 500 meseta! Of course you'll try it, won't you? Well then, enjoy! Be careful because the Penguin will leave if you exit town or go inside a house!

entries.jp: じゃあ ごゆっくり！{ctl.FD}と思ったら、何だい{BR}金が無いんじゃないか。
entries.en: Enjoy yourselves!{ctl.FD}...Or so I would say, but you{BR}don't have the money, do you.
entries.us: Wait. You don't have enough money.

entries.jp: こんな楽しいことやらないなんて！心のゆとりがないね、あんたたち。
entries.en: Passing up a treat like that!{BR}No room in your souls, you people.
entries.us: I can't believe you would skip such an enjoyable experience! You guys certainly aren't very broad-minded.

entries.jp: 街を出たり、家に入ったりしたら{BR}終わりだから 気をつけてくれよ！
entries.en: Just remember: leave town or step into{BR}a house and it's over!
entries.us: Be careful because the Penguin will leave if you leave town or go inside a house!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}最新情報！{ctl.FD}ガルベルクの塔は{BR}人食い樹の森の奥にあって、{ctl.FD}とても人間のたどりつける所では{BR}ないらしいぞ！！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Latest news!{ctl.FD}The Gallberg Tower stands deep beyond{BR}the forest of man-eating trees...{ctl.FD}Apparently, it's a place no human could{BR}ever hope to reach!
entries.us: Breaking news! The Garuberk Tower is located beyond the forest of carnivorous trees. Apparently it's not a place that you can get to!

entries.jp: 最新情報！{ctl.FD}ガルベルクの塔は{BR}人食い樹の森の奥にあって、{ctl.FD}とても人間のたどりつける所では{BR}ないらしいぞ！！{ctl.FD}…え？ 行ってきたの？{BR}………あ、そう。
entries.en: Latest news!{ctl.FD}The Gallberg Tower stands deep beyond{BR}the forest of man-eating trees...{ctl.FD}Apparently, it's a place no human could{BR}ever hope to reach!{ctl.FD}...Eh? You've been?{BR}......Oh. I see.
entries.us: Breaking news! The Garuberk Tower is located beyond the forest of carnivorous trees. Apparently it's not a place that you can humanly get to! Oh? You've been there? Oh, well.

entries.jp: よその街では みんな{BR}狩りをして生計を立てていますが…デゾリスペンギンのおかげで{BR}この街は牧畜生活ですわ。
entries.en: In other towns everyone lives by{BR}hunting, but...{ctl.FD}thanks to the Dezolis Penguin, this{BR}town lives by herding.
entries.us: In other towns, everybody makes a living by hunting, but... Thanks to the Dezolis Penguin, we lead a breeder's life in this town.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}この雪嵐のおかげで{BR}我らの心のよりどころ、{ctl.FD}ガンビアス大寺院への参拝も{BR}かなわぬものとなってしまった…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Thanks to this snowstorm, even the{BR}pilgrimage to Gungbius Grand Temple,{ctl.FD}where our hearts find their rest,{BR}is beyond us now...
entries.us: Because of this snow storm, we can't even get to Gumbious Temple, where we find peace of mind and pray.

entries.jp: せっかく雪嵐が晴れたと思ったのに変なウワサが…じょ、冗談だよな！
entries.en: Right when the snowstorm cleared, now{BR}there's this strange rumor circulating...{ctl.FD}It's a joke. Surely it's a joke!
entries.us: Just as I thought, the snow storm cleared up. Now there's this rumor...it, it's a joke, right?

entries.jp: ミース？ リシェル？{BR}…ああパルマ人の街か。{ctl.FD}それなら ちょっと東に行きゃあ{BR}見えてくるだろうよ。
entries.en: Meese? Richelle?{BR}...Ah, the Palman towns.{ctl.FD}Go a little ways east and you'll{BR}see them soon enough.
entries.us: Meese? Reshel?  ...Oh, those Parmanian towns. If you just go east a little you'll probably see them.

entries.jp: ここは不思議の谷だミャウ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}うわぁっ！ ネコが！{BR}ネコがしゃべった！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}わたしたちはジャコウネコ。{BR}しゃべれるネコだミャウ。{ctl.FD}…あなたたちには{BR}何かを感じるミャウ。{ctl.FD}中に入って{BR}長老に会うミャウ。
entries.en: This is the Valley of Mystery, meow.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Whoa! A cat!{BR}The cat talked!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}We are musk cats.{BR}Cats that talk, meow.{ctl.FD}...We feel something{BR}from you, meow.{ctl.FD}Go inside and meet{BR}the elder, meow.
entries.us: This is the mysterious valley, meow. Wow! It's a cat! And the cat talked! We are musk cats. We can talk, meow. We get some kind of a feeling from you, meow. Go in and meet the old man, meow.

entries.jp: あなたたちは 特別ミャウ。
entries.en: You are special, meow.
entries.us: You guys are special, meow.

entries.jp: ふだんはパルマ人もデゾリアンも{BR}谷の中には入れないミャウ。
entries.en: Normally no Palman or Dezolian may{BR}enter the valley, meow.
entries.us: Normally, neither Parmanians nor Dezolisians can enter this valley, meow.

entries.jp: …あなたたちは なんだか{BR}なつかしい感じがするミャウ。
entries.en: ...Somehow you feel dear{BR}to us, meow.
entries.us: Somehow, we get a feeling of fond remembrance from you, meow.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}デゾリスの天気は{BR}最近おかしいミャウ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}The weather in Dezolis has been{BR}strange lately, meow.
entries.us: The weather in Dezolis is rather strange these days, meow.

entries.jp: 天気がようやく{BR}よくなったミャウ。
entries.en: The weather has got better{BR}at last, meow.
entries.us: The weather has finally improved, meow.

entries.jp: ミュー。{ctl.FD}このビンのフタ、{BR}開けられないミャウ。
entries.en: Mew.{ctl.FD}I can't get the lid off{BR}this bottle, meow.
entries.us: Meow. I can get the top off of this bottle, meow.

entries.jp: この谷の中だけは{BR}デゾリスでも あたたかいミャウ。
entries.en: Only inside this valley is it warm,{BR}even on Dezolis, meow.
entries.us: In all of Dezolis, only this valley is warm, meow.

entries.jp: 人間がここに入ってくるとは{BR}めずらしいミャウ。
entries.en: It is rare for humans to come{BR}in here, meow.
entries.us: Very seldom do humans enter this place, meow.

entries.jp: ジャコウネコも今や ここにいる{BR}だけになってしまったミャウ。
entries.en: All the musk cats there are left{BR}are here now, meow.
entries.us: All that is left of the musk cats are here, meow.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9101}長老は宝物を持っているミャウ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9101}The elder has a treasure, meow.
entries.us: The old man has a treasure, meow.

entries.jp: 長老の宝を{BR}役立ててほしいミャウ。
entries.en: Please put the elder's treasure{BR}to good use, meow.
entries.us: Please put the old man's treasure to good use, meow.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9101}長老の宝物は わたしたちも{BR}見たことがないミャウ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9101}Even we have never seen the{BR}elder's treasure, meow.
entries.us: We haven't even seen the old man's treasure, meow.

entries.jp: 長老の宝を{BR}役立ててほしいミャウ。
entries.en: Please put the elder's treasure{BR}to good use, meow.
entries.us: Please put the old man's treasure to good use, meow.

entries.jp: 長老の羽根は この世に並ぶ物が{BR}無いほど 美しいミャウ。
entries.en: Nothing in this world is as{BR}beautiful as the elder's plumage, meow.
entries.us: The beauty of the old man's shuttlecock is unparalleled in this world, meow.

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}長老のマネだミャウ。
entries.en: {ctl.F3}I'm doing my impression of{BR}the elder, meow.
entries.us: I'm imitating the old man, meow.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9103}{ctl.F6} べ
よく来たな、客人よ。{BR}わしが この谷の長（おさ）じゃ。…ふむ、ここに通されるだけあってよい目をしておるわ。{ctl.FD}それに…不思議じゃ…{BR}初めて会ったという気がせん…！{ctl.FD}おぬしらならば{BR}これをたくしても よかろう。{ctl.FD}この谷に代々伝わる宝じゃ。{BR}持ってゆくがよいぞ。{ctl.FD}「シルバータスク」じゃ！
entries.en: Welcome, guests.{BR}I am the chief of this valley.{ctl.FD}...Hm. I sense a fierce look in your eyes,{BR}as befits those who are brought to me.{ctl.FD}And... how strange... it does not{BR}feel like our first meeting...!{ctl.FD}To you I may safely entrust it.{ctl.FD}A treasure passed down in this valley{BR}for generations. Take it with you.{ctl.FD}The Silver Tusk!
entries.us: Good of you to come, visitors. I'm the chief of this valley. Hmm, there is good in your eyes. No wonder you were let through. It's really strange... I have a feeling that this is not the first time we've met. I feel good about putting this in your care. This is a treasure that has been passed on generation after generation. Take it with you. It's the Silver Tusk!

entries.jp: よく来たな、客人よ。{BR}わしが この谷の長（おさ）じゃ。…ふむ、ここに通されるだけあってよい目をしておるわ。{ctl.FD}それに…不思議じゃ…{BR}初めて会ったという気がせん…！{ctl.FD}おぬしらならば{BR}これをたくしても よかろう。{ctl.FD}この谷に代々伝わる宝じゃ。{BR}持ってゆくがよいぞ。{ctl.FD}「シルバータスク」じゃ！{ctl.FD}なんだ、{BR}もう持てんではないか。{ctl.FD}しばらく あずかっておくから{BR}また来るがよい。
entries.en: Welcome, guests.{BR}I am the chief of this valley.{ctl.FD}...Hm. Good eyes, as befits those{BR}who are let through to me.{ctl.FD}And... how strange... it does not{BR}feel like our first meeting...!{ctl.FD}To you I may safely entrust it.{ctl.FD}A treasure passed down this valley{BR}for generations. Take it with you.{ctl.FD}The Silver Tusk!{ctl.FD}What's this, you can't carry{BR}anymore.{ctl.FD}I'll keep it a while.{BR}Come again.
entries.us: Good of you to come, visitors. I'm the chief of this valley. Hmm, there is good in your eyes. No wonder you were let through. It's really strange... I have a feeling that this is not the first time we've met. I feel good about putting this in your care. This is a treasure that has been passed on generation after generation. Take it with you. It's the Silver Tusk! Oh, you can't carry anything else. Well, you know where to find me.

entries.jp: シルバータスク、{BR}役立ててくれい。
entries.en: Please put the Silver Tusk to good use.
entries.us: Here's the Silver Tusk. Please make good use of it.

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ぶ

{ctl.FA:9401}{ctl.F4:08}これが どうやらデゾリスの気象{BR}コントロールシステムのようですね{ctl.F4:01}モンスターが{BR}巣くっていやがった！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}やはり ここが{BR}異常気象の原因のようですね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}調べてみましょう！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}んんん 無駄無駄！ 雪嵐の原因はガルベルクの塔じゃというのに！！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9401}{ctl.F4:08}This appears to be Dezolis's{BR}weather control system.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Monsters have infested the place!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}So this is the source of the{BR}abnormal weather after all.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Let's investigate!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Nnno, no, waste of time! The storm{BR}comes from the Gallberg Tower!!
entries.us: This seems to be the control system for the Dezolisian climate. The monsters have been making a nest! As we suspected, this must be the cause of the abnormal weather. Let's investigate! It's no use! I've been telling you, the cause of the snow storm lies in the Garuberk Tower!!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:08}これが どうやらデゾリスの気象{BR}コントロールシステムのようですね{ctl.F4:01}モンスターが{BR}巣くっていやがった！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}やはり ここが{BR}異常気象の原因のようですね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}調べてみましょう！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:08}This appears to be Dezolis's{BR}weather control system.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Monsters had made a nest{BR}of the place!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}So this is the source of the{BR}abnormal weather after all.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Let's investigate!!
entries.us: This seems to be the control system for the Dezolisian climate. The monsters have been making a nest! As we suspected, this must be the cause of the abnormal weather. Let's investigate!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:21}ぶわぁーはははは！ バァカめぇ！まんまとここまでやってくるとは！マヌケども！{BR}この気象システムはワナよ！{ctl.FD}ふ、キサマらごときアホウどもに、この手を汚すも もったいないが…命令を受けた身とあっては{BR}いたしかたない！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}待て！ …命令だと！？{ctl.FD}ジオも…{BR}ダーク・ファルスも倒したはずだ！おまえはいったい だれの命令を{BR}受けてきたっていうんだ！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:21}倒した？ ダーク・ファルス様を？はーはははははははは！ 笑止！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:21}Bwahahahaha! Fools!{BR}Walking right into a trap!{ctl.FD}Idiots! This weather system{BR}was a ruse!{ctl.FD}Heh. A waste to dirty my hands on{BR}dolts like you...{ctl.FD}but I am under orders, and I{BR}have no choice!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Wait! ...Orders, you said?{ctl.FD}Zio is dead...{BR}and Dark Falz with him!{ctl.FD}Whose orders are you acting on?!{BR}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:21}Defeated? Lord Dark Falz?{BR}Hahahahahaha! Absurd!!
entries.us: Ha, ha, ha! You dolts! How foolhardy you are to come here! Morons! This was just a trap! Hmmph. It seems like a waste to dirty our hands with stupid people like you, but... Being just a vessel that takes orders, I'll just have to do it! Wait! You said orders? But we've beaten Zio...and Dark Force! Whose orders are you acting on? You defeated him? The great Dark Force? Ha, ha, ha, ha! Ridiculous!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9401}{ctl.F4:01}ちくしょう！{BR}なんか気になるな！{ctl.FD}あいつ…ダーク・ファルスが まだ生きてるような口ぶりだった…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}………。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}ルディ、{BR}気象システムに異常無し。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}本当にワナだったの…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}ほぉれ、やっぱりガルベルクの塔に行けばいいんじゃよ！！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9401}{ctl.F4:01}Damn it! Something's not right!{ctl.FD}That thing... it talked as if Dark{BR}Falz were still alive...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}.........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Rudy, no fault exists in the{BR}weather system.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}So it really was a trap...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}There now! I said all along we{BR}should go to the Gallberg Tower!!
entries.us: Blast! This bothers me! It was talking like that creep Dark Force is still alive! Yeah... Chaz, there is nothing wrong with the climate control system. So, it really was a snare. See. Just like I said. We have to go to the Garuberk Tower!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ちくしょう！{BR}なんか気になるな！{ctl.FD}あいつ…ダーク・ファルスが まだ生きてるような口ぶりだった…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}………。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}ルディ、{BR}気象システムに異常無し。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}本当にワナだったの…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Damn it! Something's not right!{ctl.FD}That thing... it talked as if Dark{BR}Falz were still alive...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}.........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Rudy, no fault exists in the{BR}weather system.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}So it really was a trap...
entries.us: Blast! This bothers me! It was talking like that creep Dark Force is still alive! Yeah... Chaz, there is nothing wrong with the climate control system. So, it really was a snare.

entries.jp: ルディ、仕事だよ！{BR}さっさと支度しな！
entries.en: Rudy, we got a job!{BR}Hurry up and get ready!
entries.us: Chaz, we have work to do! Hurry up and get ready!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:02}あんた、これがハンター登録されて初仕事なんだ。気合い入れなよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そうか、{BR}もう「見習い」じゃないんだ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}あんたは今日からこのライラさんの正式なパートナーなんだからね！{ctl.FD}さ、行くよ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:02}This is your first job as a registered{BR}hunter. You'd better give it your all!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Right... I'm no longer an apprentice.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}From today onward, you're the official{BR}partner of Laila herself! Well, let's go!!
entries.us: This is your first job since you joined the Hunters Guild. You'd better put your heart into it! So... I'm not a trainee anymore. From this day on, you are a full-fledged partner! Now come on! Let's go!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}で、今回はどこへ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}ちょっと遠いね。ピアタの街の{BR}モタビア・アカデミーだよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}へー。あの学問の街！{BR}いったい何があったんだろ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}さあね。「とにかく来てくれ」の{BR}一点張りでね。{ctl.FD}くわしい事は{BR}向こうに行ってからだよ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}So where to this time?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}It's a bit of a trip.{BR}Motavia Academy, in the town of Piata.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Oh! That college town.{BR}I wonder what's happened there?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}No idea. All they'd say was "just come''.{BR}We'll get the details when we arrive.
entries.us: Where are we off to this time? It's a bit far. We're going to Motavia Academy in the town of Piata. Wow! So we're going to the Town of Learning! I wonder what's happened there? Who knows? The message said 'Just come.' We'll get the details once we're there.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}せっかくだから{BR}アカデミーを見物したいなぁ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}何のんきなこと言ってんだい！{BR}ボヤボヤしてると おいてくよ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}While we're there, I'd like to tour{BR}the Academy.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Don't get comfortable!{BR}You dawdle, and I'll ditch you!
entries.us: Since we're going to be there anyway, I'd sure like to tour the Academy. Is that all you can think about? Get moving or I'll leave you behind!

entries.jp: これで一安心。リシェルを元通り、いえそれ以上に再建してみせます！
entries.en: That's a relief. We'll see{BR}Richelle rebuilt as it was --{ctl.FD}no, better than it was!

entries.jp: 防具屋が 早くも店を開けている{BR}らしいぜ。オレもがんばらなきゃ！
entries.en: The armorer has his doors open already,{BR}they say. I'd best get moving, too!

entries.jp: いい思い出も、イヤな思い出も{BR}尽きないけれど…{ctl.FD}やっぱり 生まれ育った街は{BR}なかなか捨てられないわ。
entries.en: Good memories and bad, more than{BR}I can count...{ctl.FD}but the town you were born and{BR}raised in is hard to give up.

entries.jp: 本当に もう{BR}だいじょうぶなのか？{ctl.FD}また そこらへんから ゾンビが{BR}出てきたりしないだろうな！
entries.en: Is it really safe now?{ctl.FD}No zombies coming up out of the{BR}ground again, I hope!

entries.jp: 我々ががんばれば、街を捨ててった人たちも 今に戻ってくるさ！
entries.en: If we put our backs into it, the{BR}ones who left may yet come home!

entries.jp: 新装開店には やはり新しい{BR}目玉商品が必要ですわなぁ。
entries.en: A grand reopening wants a grand new{BR}line to draw the eye, of course.

entries.jp: おとうちゃんは おとなりの{BR}お手伝いに行ってるの。{ctl.FD}おまえは おとなしく{BR}待ってなさいって言われてるの。
entries.en: Daddy's gone next door to help out.{ctl.FD}He told me to wait here{BR}and be good.

entries.jp: ここはリシェルの街だ。{BR}パルマ人の同胞よ、ようこそ！
entries.en: This is the town of Richelle.{BR}Fellow Palmans, welcome!

entries.jp: オレの道具屋も新装開店だ。{BR}ぜひ、のぞいてみてくれよ！
entries.en: My tool shop's reopened too.{BR}Do come and have a look!

entries.jp: 新しいリシェルは いい思い出で{BR}いっぱいにしてみせるわよ！
entries.en: I'll fill the new Richelle with{BR}good memories, see if I don't!

entries.jp: どうやら もう本当に何事も{BR}なくなったみたいだな！
entries.en: Looks like it's truly all over{BR}and done with!

entries.jp: 街を離れた人たちも 少しずつ{BR}帰ってきてくれていますよ。
entries.en: The ones who left the town are{BR}coming back, a few at a time.

entries.jp: あの廃虚だったリシェルが{BR}よくぞ こんな短い間に！
entries.en: Richelle was in ruins, but look at{BR}it now, in such a short time!

entries.jp: あたしは この間引っ越して来たんだけど…昔この街 何かあったの？
entries.en: I only moved here the other day...{BR}Did something happen here once?

entries.jp: 天気といい 街並といい、ようやく以前の生活が戻ってきましたよ。
entries.en: The weather, the streets... our old{BR}life has come back to us at last.

entries.jp: ようやっと 商売も{BR}調子に乗ってきましたわなぁ。
entries.en: Trade's picking up nicely{BR}at long last.

entries.jp: おとうちゃんは お手伝いが{BR}終わっても まだ油を売ってるの。{ctl.FD}大人の言う事は だまって{BR}聞くもんだ、って言われてるの。
entries.en: Daddy finished helping and he's{BR}still out gossiping.{ctl.FD}I'm told to hold my tongue and do{BR}as the grown-ups say.

entries.jp: ちょっと あんたたち汚いなぁ。{BR}くつがドロだらけじゃないか？{ctl.FD}新しくなったばかりの店なんだからむやみに汚さないでくれよ！
entries.en: Hey now, you're filthy.{BR}Your boots are caked in mud!{ctl.FD}The shop's only just been rebuilt.{BR}Don't go dirtying it for nothing!

entries.jp: やっぱり{BR}新しい家はいいわね！{ctl.FD}ヘンな虫が住みつかないように{BR}今の内に殺虫剤まいとかなきゃ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}うわあっ！ こっちにむけて{BR}殺虫剤をまかないでよ。
entries.en: A new house really is lovely!{ctl.FD}I must spray some insecticide now,{BR}before any weird bugs get in!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Whoa! Don't spray that{BR}in my direction!

entries.jp: せっかく引っ越した先でも 友達ができたところだったのになァ…。
entries.en: And I'd only just made friends{BR}where we moved to, as well...

entries.jp: やれやれ、引っ越しを 2回も{BR}したおかげで、もう破産だよ。{ctl.FD}でも未来は輝きに満ちているよ！{BR}今に見てろ！{ctl.FD}金なんか これから{BR}いくらでも稼いでやるさ！
entries.en: Good grief. Moving twice has{BR}bankrupted me.{ctl.FD}But the future's still bright!{BR}You just watch!{ctl.FD}I'll earn all the money I please{BR}from here on!

entries.jp: この人が こんなコト言うなんて{BR}そりゃあ たまげたわよ。{ctl.FD}とんだ食わせ者だと思ってたけど、見直しちゃうわね！
entries.en: I was absolutely floored to hear him talk{BR}like that.{ctl.FD}I figured he was a real piece of work,{BR}but he's really changed my mind!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}ここはミースの街。{ctl.FD}今、ヘンな病気で{BR}たいへんなんだ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}This is the town of Meese.{ctl.FD}Right now we're in a bad way{BR}with a strange sickness.

entries.jp: ここはミースの街。{ctl.FD}病気だった人も{BR}よくなってきたよ。
entries.en: This is the town of Meese.{ctl.FD}The ones who were ill are getting better.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}ヘンな病気が はやっちゃって…{ctl.FD}すごい熱を出して、ひと月ともたず死んでしまうんだ。おまけに…{ctl.FD}その死体はゾンビとなって復活するっていうんだから…コワいよー。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}A strange sickness is going around...{ctl.FD}It causes a raging fever, and within a{BR}month they are dead. And worse yet...{ctl.FD}They say the bodies rise again{BR}as zombies... it's so terrifying...

entries.jp: 突然、病気の人の熱が{BR}ひきはじめたんだ。
entries.en: All of a sudden the sick people's fevers{BR}started going down.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}西の方にリシェルという街が{BR}あったんだけど…{ctl.FD}はやりの病気で全滅ですって！{BR}今ではゾンビの街らしいわよ。{ctl.FD}この街も他人事じゃないわ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}There used to be a town called Richelle{BR}over to the west...{ctl.FD}But apparently, a rampant disease wiped{BR}everyone out! A town of zombies now...{ctl.FD}It could happen to this town, too!

entries.jp: ゾンビは土にかえったんだって！{BR}リシェルも再建が始まってるわよ。
entries.en: The zombies are back in the ground!{BR}Richelle's being rebuilt, too.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}リシェルから逃げてきた人たちも{BR}いるけど、ここも安心できないね！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Some fled here from Richelle,{BR}but this place isn't safe either!

entries.jp: リシェルから逃げてきた人たち、{BR}帰っていったぜ。{ctl.FD}もう一度 やり直すんだとさ。
entries.en: The ones who fled Richelle have{BR}gone home.{ctl.FD}Apparently, they're going to start over{BR}from scratch.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}ゾゾゾゾンビって、{BR}火に弱いんだろ？{ctl.FD}こうして街の真ん中に 火をたいていれば、襲ってこないよね？ ね！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Z-z-z-zombies are weak{BR}against fire, aren't they?{ctl.FD}So if we keep a fire burning in the{BR}square they won't come? Right? Right?

entries.jp: もうゾンビは出ないんだろ？{BR}火なんて 消し！ 消し！
entries.en: No more zombies, right?{BR}Out with the fire! Out, out!

entries.jp: ここは病人の収容所。{ctl.FD}元は宿屋だったんですが、ご主人の好意で開放してもらっています。
entries.en: This is a shelter for the sick.{ctl.FD}It used to be an inn, but the owner has{BR}kindly opened it up for us to use.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}この街も半分以上の人が{BR}病に倒れているんです。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}More than half this town has fallen ill.

entries.jp: みんな よくなってきて{BR}よかったよかった。
entries.en: Everyone's getting better.{BR}It's such a big relief.

entries.jp: あの墓地を見たかね…？{ctl.FD}かわいそうじゃが、ゾンビになった人は火で焼いてうめたんじゃよ…。
entries.en: Did you see that graveyard...?{ctl.FD}It's a horrible thing, but the ones who{BR}became zombies were burned and buried.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9501}「エスパー」ってのが来てるって？何だか うさんくさいなァ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9501}An Esper has come, they say?{BR}Sounds dubious to me!

entries.jp: 「エスパー」ってのが来てるって？何だか うさんくさいなァ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}うさんくさいとは何よ、{BR}失礼ね！
entries.en: An Esper has come, they say?{BR}Sounds dubious to me!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Dubious indeed!{BR}How rude!

entries.jp: 病気の人が治ってきたよ。エスパーとかって人たちの おかげなのか？
entries.en: The sick are getting better. Is it{BR}thanks to those Espers, I wonder?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9501}この道具屋さん、ご主人が{BR}はやり病にかかって お休みよ。{ctl.FD}何とかっていう 不思議な香りの{BR}香水を売ってたんだけどね。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9501}This tool shop is closed. The owner{BR}has caught the sickness.{ctl.FD}He used to sell some perfume or{BR}other with a curious scent.

entries.jp: この道具屋さん、ご主人が{BR}はやり病にかかって お休みよ。{ctl.FD}何とかっていう 不思議な香りの{BR}香水を売ってたんだけどね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}香水ですって！ いいなァ…。
entries.en: This tool shop is closed. The owner{BR}has caught the sickness.{ctl.FD}He used to sell some perfume or{BR}other with a curious scent.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Perfume! Oh, lovely...

entries.jp: この道具屋さん、店が開いたのは{BR}いいけれど…高いわね、あの香水！
entries.en: I'm glad this tool shop is open again,{BR}but that perfume! What a high price!

entries.jp: わーい！ わーい！
entries.en: Yaaay! Yaaay!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}あたしはともかく、この子だけは{BR}病気にさせられませんわ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Never mind me, I won't have{BR}this child fall ill!
entries.us: Never mind me, I just won't let this child become ill!

entries.jp: ウチの子のつまらなさそうな姿は{BR}見てても つらかったんですけど…でも、もう{BR}だいじょうぶですよね！
entries.en: It was hard to watch my child look{BR}so bored and forlorn...{ctl.FD}But it's all right now, isn't it!
entries.us: It was heart-breaking to see my child looking so bored... But now, it's all OK, right?

entries.jp: ねー、なんで{BR}外に出ちゃいけないのー？
entries.en: Heyyy, why can't I go outside?
entries.us: Hey, why can't I go outside?

entries.jp: いやー、あの病気！ 今度こそ{BR}本当に死ぬかと思いましたよ。
entries.en: Ugh, that illness! This time I{BR}truly thought I was going to die.
entries.us: Oh, what an illness it was! I thought for sure I was going to die.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}宿屋さんが あんなことになってるもんでね。今ウチが仮の宿屋でさ。リシェルから逃げてきた人たちで{BR}今は にぎわっていますよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}What with the inn being as it is,{BR}our place is the inn for now.{ctl.FD}We're full up with folk who have fled{BR}from Richelle.
entries.us: With the inn being  the clinic right now, our place is the temporary inn. Right now, we've got a lot of people who have escaped from Reshel.

entries.jp: やれやれ、やっとナれない仕事からおさらばできそうでさぁね。
entries.en: Well, well. Looks like I can wave{BR}goodbye to work I'm no good at.
entries.us: Ah, finally, I can quit this work I'm so unused to.

entries.jp: わたしは リシェルを{BR}逃げ出してきた者ですがね。{ctl.FD}あの人があんな…{BR}ああ恐ろしい！！
entries.en: I'm one of those who fled Richelle.{ctl.FD}That someone could turn like{BR}that... Oh, it was dreadful!!
entries.us: I'm a refugee from Reshel. That person became... Oh, it was scary!

entries.jp: もうイヤだよ、こんな怖いところ。もっと遠くに逃げなきゃあ。
entries.en: I'm so sick of scary places.{BR}I need to run even further away.
entries.us: I'm fed up with scary places. I've got to run even farther.

entries.jp: 生まれ育ったリシェルの街をすてるなんて できないわ！{ctl.FD}きっと病気によくきく薬ができて、街を元に戻せるようになるわ！！
entries.en: I could never abandon Richelle,{BR}where I was born and raised!{ctl.FD}They'll find a medicine that works,{BR}and the town will be itself again!!
entries.us: I just can't abandon Reshel, the town I was born in and grew up in! I'm sure they'll find some medicine for the illness and the town will be back to normal!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}ここはホントはデゾリスに名だたる大きな宿屋なんだけどね。{ctl.FD}病人があんまり多いんで ご主人が使わせてくれているんだよ。{ctl.FD}いやぁ、情のある素晴らしい方だ！フツウできることじゃないねぇ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}This is really a great inn, renowned{BR}throughout Dezolis.{ctl.FD}But there are so many sick that the{BR}innkeeper lets us use it.{ctl.FD}A fine, warm-hearted man! Not what{BR}you'd expect of most people!
entries.us: This place is actually a large inn renowned throughout Dezolis. But because there are so many ill, the innkeeper is letting us use it. Such a wonderfully warm-hearted person! I'd say it's beyond the call of duty!

entries.jp: どうしたことか みんな{BR}快方に向かっているよ。
entries.en: However it happened, everyone{BR}is on the mend.
entries.us: I don't know what happened, but everyone seems to be on the road to recovery.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}この奇病、{BR}どんな薬も効果無しだ。{ctl.FD}今の所、生命エネルギーを注ぎ、{BR}命をのばすことくらいしか…。{ctl.FD}それで今「エスパー」のみなさんがはるばる来てくれているんだよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}This strange sickness...{BR}no medicine touches it.{ctl.FD}For now, all we can do is pour in{BR}life energy and lengthen their days.{ctl.FD}Which is why the Espers have come{BR}all this way to us.
entries.us: No medicine seems to cure this strange illness. At this point, the only thing to do is inject life energy into them to prolong their lives a little... That's why all these people from Esper have come.

entries.jp: 薬の完成を待たずして みんな{BR}よくなってきたよ！ よかったな！
entries.en: Everyone's got better without{BR}waiting for the medicine! Wonderful!
entries.us: Everybody's getting better without waiting for the medicine to be made! I'm so glad!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}我々が みなさんが言うところの{BR}「エスパー」です。{ctl.FD}南東の「エスパーの館」から{BR}やってきました。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}We are the ones you have all been{BR}calling Espers.{ctl.FD}We came from the Esper Mansion,{BR}away to the southeast.
entries.us: We're the 'Espers' that you all have been talking about. We have come from the 'Esper Mansion' southeast of here.

entries.jp: シェスを{BR}助けてやってください！
entries.en: Please, help Shess!
entries.us: Please help Kyra!

entries.jp: シェスじゃないか！{BR}無事だったんだね！
entries.en: Why, it's Shess!{BR}You're safe, then!
entries.us: Oh it's you, Kyra! You're safe!

entries.jp: 病が治ったのは{BR}良かったんですが…
entries.en: It's good that the sickness{BR}has passed, but...
entries.us: It's good that the illness is gone, but...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}ううううう{BR}苦しい…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Uuuuuugh...{BR}it hurts...
entries.us: Oooooo  I'm in pain...

entries.jp: だいぶ 具合が{BR}よくなってきました。
entries.en: I'm feeling a great deal{BR}better now.
entries.us: My condition has improved considerably.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}こんなことくらいしか{BR}力になれませんが…
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}This small way is all the help{BR}we can offer...
entries.us: We could only help  in this small way...

entries.jp: シェスを{BR}助けてやってください！
entries.en: Please, help Shess!
entries.us: Please help  Kyra!

entries.jp: こんな はねっかえりですが、{BR}シェスをよろしく。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}はねっかえりで{BR}悪かったわねっ！
entries.en: She's a bit of a handful, but please{BR}take good care of Shess.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Gee, so sorry for being such a handful!
entries.us: I'm sorry Kyra is so saucy, but...  Well, excuse me!

entries.jp: これは…あの邪悪な塔が{BR}ほろぼされたのですか？
entries.en: This is... has that wicked tower{BR}been destroyed?
entries.us: ...You mean that evil tower has been destroyed?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}生命エネルギーの注入は我々自身の生命をけずる行い……しかし…！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}Giving life energy shaves away our{BR}own lives...... and yet...!
entries.us: To give others life energy means the taking of life energy from ourselves, but...

entries.jp: シェスを{BR}助けてやってください！
entries.en: Please, help Shess!
entries.us: Please help Kyra!

entries.jp: こんな おてんば娘ですが、{BR}シェスをよろしく。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}おてんばで悪かったわね！
entries.en: She's a tomboy, but look{BR}after Shess for me.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Gee, sorry for being such a tomboy, then!
entries.us: I'm sorry Kyra is such a tomboy, but...  And what's wrong with that!

entries.jp: ふぅ。正直 わたしも{BR}ホッとしましたよ。
entries.en: Phew. Truth be told, I'm quite relieved.
entries.us: Whew. To the tell truth, I'm quite relieved.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}我々も苦しいが 患者さんは{BR}もっと苦しい。…がんばらねば。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}We suffer, but the patients suffer{BR}more. ...We must hold on.
entries.us: We're in pain, but the patients are in even more pain. We've got to work harder.

entries.jp: シェスを{BR}助けてやってください！
entries.en: Please, help Shess!
entries.us: Please help Kyra!

entries.jp: こんな じゃじゃ馬娘ですが、{BR}シェスをよろしく。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}じゃじゃ馬で悪かったわね！
entries.en: She's a wild one, but please take good{BR}care of Shess.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Wow, well excuse me for being so wild!
entries.us: I'm sorry Kyra is such an unruly girl, but... And what is that supposed to mean? You twit!

entries.jp: なんにしても{BR}ばんばんざいです。
entries.en: Whatever the reason, it's{BR}cause for cheering.
entries.us: Whatever, it's cause for celebration.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}{ctl.F3}うおおおおおおお！{ctl.FD}生命エネルギーは気合いだ！！{BR}うおおおおおおおおおおお！！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}{ctl.F3}Whoaaaaaaaaa!{ctl.FD}Life energy is all in the spirit!!{BR}Whoaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!
entries.us: Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaam! This patient needs life energy! Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaam!!

entries.jp: シェスを{BR}助けてやってください！
entries.en: Please, help Shess!
entries.us: Please help  Kyra!

entries.jp: こんな 軽はずみな娘ですが、{BR}シェスをよろしく。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}んもー。{BR}いーかげんにしてよぉ！
entries.en: She's a rash one, but please take good{BR}care of Shess.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Ohhh, give it a rest!
entries.us: I'm sorry Kyra is such an imprudent girl, but... Hmmph! Oh, cut it out!

entries.jp: ふにゃふにゃ。{ctl.FD}…気合いがヌけました。
entries.en: All limp.{ctl.FD}...The fighting spirit's gone out of me.
entries.us: ...Ohhh... I'm out of energy...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9401}我々は交代要員。{BR}2交代制でやってます。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9401}We're the relief. We operate{BR}in two shifts.
entries.us: We're the other shift.

entries.jp: やれやれ、休みが{BR}無くなってしまいました。
entries.en: Well, well. There goes my day off.
entries.us: Finally. I'm on break.

entries.jp: シェスも帰ってきたよ。{BR}うれしー！
entries.en: Shess is home too.{BR}I'm so glad!
entries.us: Kyra has come home. Oh joy!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}わたしはこの宿の主人。ホントは{BR}ウチを使わせたくはなかったけど…空き部屋があんなにあるのに、と{BR}街中の人が白い目で見るんです！！だから泣く泣く…{BR}ちっくしょー！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}I'm the owner of this inn. To be honest,{BR}I'd rather not have used it this way...{ctl.FD}but the townsfolk kept giving me dirty{BR}looks, asking about all my empty rooms...!{ctl.FD}And so, with a heavy heart, I gave in...{BR}Damn it all!
entries.us: I'm the innkeeper. To tell the truth I didn't want our place to be used, but... With all those empty rooms, the townspeople would have looked at me reproachfully! How upsetting... Darn!

entries.jp: ホントに病院でも 開こうかなぁ。
entries.en: Maybe I really should open a{BR}hospital or something.
entries.us: Maybe I should seriously consider opening a hospital.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}あんた、いっそのこと{BR}病院にしちまおうかぁ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Dear, why not go the whole way{BR}and make it a hospital?
entries.us: Yes, maybe we should just make it a hospital.

entries.jp: 何をかくそう あたしゃ昔から{BR}看護婦にあこがれてたんだよ！
entries.en: I won't deny it -- I've always{BR}dreamed of being a nurse!
entries.us: I'll admit it, I've always dreamed of being a nurse!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}エスパーの館には、我々のような{BR}力を持った者が まだまだいます。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}There are many more with power like{BR}ours at the Esper Mansion.
entries.us: There are many more who have power like ours in the Esper Mansion.

entries.jp: みなさん、シェスをたのみます！
entries.en: I entrust Shess to all of you!
entries.us: I trust you to save Kyra.

entries.jp: シェス、無茶するんじゃないぞ。
entries.en: Now, Shess. Don't do anything{BR}reckless.
entries.us: Now, Kyra, don't do anything reckless.

entries.jp: シェスが 無事帰ってきました。{BR}あなたがたのおかげですな。
entries.en: Shess has come home safe.{BR}We have you to thank for it.
entries.us: Kyra has come home safe and sound. It's all thanks to you.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}{ctl.F4:17}ガルベルクの塔が出現した直後、{BR}この奇病が発生しました。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}ほぉれ、わしの言った通り。{BR}やはり あの塔が原因なん{ctl.F9:13}…{ctl.F9:27}じゃ{ctl.F9:13}…
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A103}{ctl.FA:9502}{ctl.FA:9401}{ctl.F4:17}This strange sickness broke out{BR}just after Gallberg Tower appeared.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}There now, just as I said.{BR}That tower is the cause of it{ctl.F9:13}...{ctl.F9:27} after all{ctl.F9:13}...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:17}シェスは 無鉄砲だから…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:17}Shess is so reckless...
entries.us: Kyra is such a daredevil...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:17}みなさん、シェスをたのみます。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:17}I entrust Shess to all of you.
entries.us: Everyone, I entrust Kyra to you.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:17}シェスが無事でよかった。あれで{BR}実は みんなのアイドルだからね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:17}I'm glad Shess is safe. For all{BR}her wildness, she's everyone's idol!
entries.us: I'm glad that Kyra is safe and sound. Though she's so wild, she's everyone's idol!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:09}うーん、うーん…。{BR}ウンが悪かったのぉ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}コりないなー！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:09}Augh... augh...{BR}What AUGH-ful luck...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}You never learn!
entries.us: Yes, yes... It was bad luck... But with those nurses there, maybe the worst of times will also be the best of times... You just won't give up, will you!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:09}くくくくくく…。{BR}くく 81…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}コりないなー！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:09}Ohh... an inn for a sickroom...{BR}That makes me an INN-patient --{ctl.FD}and an impatient one at that!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}You never learn!
entries.us: Ooooooo.... Oooo...! You just won't give up, will you?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:09}クルシー…。{BR}ユルシーてくれい…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}コりないなー！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:09}Ohh... the nurse says I'm running{BR}a fever...{ctl.FD}Running! I can't even sit up!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}You never learn!
entries.us: I'm in pain... OK, I give up! You just won't give up, will you!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:09}だいぶいいが マダマダじゃわい。マダるっこしいのぅ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}変わんないなぁ、ラジャ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:09}Much better, but STILL not right...{BR}And lying STILL is the worst of it!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}You never change, Raja!
entries.us: I'm feeling better, but I still need a lot more time in bed... I see you haven't changed, Raja!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:0A}この人、ラジャっていったっけ？{BR}良くなってきたのはいいんだけど…くっだらないシャレがうるさいわ、ヒトのおしりはさわるわ…{ctl.FD}あんたたちの しつけが{BR}なってないのよね！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}オレは保護者じゃなーい！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:0A}This man -- Raja, was it?{BR}I'm glad his condition is improving, but...{ctl.FD}he never stops with the dreadful{BR}puns, and he pinches at people...{ctl.FD}You people have brought him up{BR}shockingly badly!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I'm not his guardian!
entries.us: This person, they say his name is Raja? It's great that he's getting better, but... He keeps telling these stupid jokes. How do you put up with him? I'm not his guardian!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ラジャ…{BR}やめろよ、悪い冗談は…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ルディ！ 冗談じゃないわよ！{BR}すごい熱！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}急いで{BR}ベッドに運ぶんだ！！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}ラジャまで 病気に…。{BR}このままじゃ 死んじゃうわ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ハハハ…信じらんない。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}笑い事じゃないわ、ルディ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ごめん……。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ファル…おまえも{BR}気づいてるんだろ…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}スレイ…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}デゾリスに来てから{BR}ずっと 感じてはいたんだが、{ctl.FD}このあたりにきて{BR}かなり強くなってる！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ええ…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}何だよ、{BR}何言ってんだよ、二人とも！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}…ルディ、よく聞け…。{BR}この感じは、「黒い波動」だ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}おそらく…ガルベルクの塔から{BR}発せられているんだろう。{ctl.FD}しかも…かなり近い！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…くそっ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Raja... cut it out, that's a sick joke...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy! It's no joke!{BR}He's burning up!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Get him to a bed, quickly!!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}Even Raja has fallen ill, now...{BR}He'll die if this goes on!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Haha... I thought he was just{BR}dying to tell more jokes...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}This is no laughing matter, Rudy!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Sorry......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Fal... you feel it too,{BR}don't you...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Thray...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}I've felt it ever since we{BR}came to Dezolis,{ctl.FD}but around here it has grown{BR}a great deal stronger!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Yes...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What? What are you two{BR}talking about!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}...Rudy, listen well...{BR}This feeling is the Black Wave!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}It comes, most likely, from{BR}the Gallberg Tower.{ctl.FD}And it is close! Very close!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...Damn it!!
entries.us: Raja... Quit joking around! Chaz! This is no joke! He's got a tremendous fever! Quickly! We must carry him to a bed! Even Raja has fallen sick... He'll die if we leave him like this! Ha, ha, ha...I don't believe it. This isn't any laughing matter, Chaz! I'm sorry... Rika, you're aware of it too, aren't you? Rune... I've sensed it ever since we came to Dezolis, but it feels particularly strong here! Yes! What is it? What are you two talking about? Chaz, listen carefully... This feeling is the Black Energy Wave! The Black... It's probably...coming from The Garuberk Tower. And it's pretty close! Darn!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:17}たいへんだ たいへんだ！{ctl.FD}シェスが…シェスがひとりで{BR}ガルベルクの塔に向かったぞ！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}シェス？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:17}我々の仲間で、{BR}特に能力の高い少女です！{ctl.FD}しかし…ムチャな！{BR}塔の周りには人食い樹の森が！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ルディ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}うん、ほうってはおけないな！{BR}その森はどこに？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:17}この街の北東です！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}よし、行くぞ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:17}Terrible news! Terrible news!{ctl.FD}Shess... Shess has gone alone{BR}to the Gallberg Tower!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}Shess?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:17}One of our own -- a girl of{BR}exceptional ability, to be sure!{ctl.FD}But this is madness! The tower is{BR}surrounded by man-eating trees!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Right, we can't leave her alone then!{BR}Where is this forest?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:17}Northeast of this town!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Then let's go!!
entries.us: Help! Help! Kyra...Kyra has headed for The Garuberk Tower by herself! Kyra? She's a girl of exceptional courage from our group! But...this is too reckless! There is a forest of carnivorous trees surrounding the tower!! Chaz! Right. We can't let her go alone! Where is this forest? It's northeast of town! OK, let's go!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6}ヨつ
{ctl.F6} ア
{ctl.F6} ギ
何者だ！{BR}怪しい者を通すわけにはいかん！
entries.en: Who goes there!{BR}I'll let no suspicious soul pass!

entries.jp: おお、シェス！{BR}よく帰ってきたな！
entries.en: Oh, Shess!{BR}Good of you to come home!

entries.jp: おお、シェスのご友人ですか。{BR}どうぞ お入りください。
entries.en: Ah, friends of Shess?{BR}Please, come in.

entries.jp: 氷の壁で この館も外界から{BR}閉ざされてしまいました。
entries.en: The wall of ice has shut this{BR}mansion off from the world outside.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DF02}{ctl.FA:A101}シェス、無事だったのか。{BR}よかったな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}ありがと。{BR}この人たちの おかげよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DF02}{ctl.FA:A101}Shess, you're safe.{BR}Thank goodness!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Thank you.{BR}I owe it to these people.

entries.jp: シェスは 頭に血がのぼると、{BR}考えるより先に動いちゃうからな！
entries.en: When Shess loses her temper,{BR}she acts before she even thinks!

entries.jp: シェスは 頭に血がのぼると、{BR}考えるより先に動いちゃうからな！{ctl.F4:0A}わ、悪かったわねっ！
entries.en: When Shess loses her temper,{BR}she acts before she even thinks!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}W-well, excuse me!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:DF02}{ctl.FA:A101}シェス！ また軽はずみなことを！帰ってこられたから よいものの…{ctl.F4:0A}…以後 気をつけます…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:DF02}{ctl.FA:A101}Shess! Rash as ever! It is a{BR}relief that you came back, but...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}...I'll be more careful from now on...

entries.jp: シェスは いい娘なのですが、{BR}思いこんだら一直線なので…。
entries.en: Shess is a fine girl, but once her mind is{BR}made up, she fixates on it really hard...

entries.jp: シェスは いい娘なのですが、{BR}思いこんだら一直線なので…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}えらい言われようだなぁ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}しかたないわ。…それだけのコト{BR}してきてるんだもん。
entries.en: Shess is a fine girl, but once her mind is{BR}made up, she fixates on it really hard...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}That's a harsh thing to say about her.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}It can't be helped. ...I've given{BR}them reason enough.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}シェス、{BR}ミースの街はどうだい？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}うん…仲間たちは{BR}がんばってくれているけど…{ctl.FD}結局、{BR}根本的な解決にはならないわ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Shess,{BR}how fares the town of Meese?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Well... our people are doing{BR}all they can, but...{ctl.FD}In the end it doesn't resolve{BR}the root cause.

entries.jp: 雪嵐は晴れましたが、氷の壁は…。元に戻るには時間がかかりますね。
entries.en: The snowstorm has cleared, but the{BR}wall of ice...{ctl.FD}It will take a long time for things to{BR}return to normal.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}リシェルやミースのことを聞いて{BR}仲間を何人も送ったんですが…{ctl.FD}氷の壁のおかげで{BR}様子もわかりません。{ctl.FD}あれっ？ シェスじゃないの！{BR}帰ってこられたのね！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}I heard about Richelle and Meese,{BR}and sent a number of our people...{ctl.FD}But with the walls of ice we{BR}have had no word from them.{ctl.FD}Wait! Shess, is that you?!{BR}You made it back!

entries.jp: これで少しは 天気も{BR}おだやかになりましょう。
entries.en: The weather should become a little{BR}gentler now.

entries.jp: この辺の部屋は、ミースに行ってる仲間たちのもの。今は空いてます。
entries.en: The rooms around here belong to those{BR}who have gone to Meese. Empty for now.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}わたしも感じます。不可解な波動がこの星をつつんでいるのを…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}ええ…それも あのガルベルクの{BR}塔に 近づけば近づくほど強く…！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}I feel it too. A mysterious wave{BR}enveloping this world...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Yes... and the closer you go to the {BR}Gallberg Tower, the stronger it gets...!

entries.jp: 謎の波動が弱まったと思ったら、{BR}大きな爆発音が…あれはいったい…
entries.en: Just as the strange wave weakened,{BR}a huge explosion happened...{ctl.FD}What in the world was that...

entries.jp: エスパーだって人間です。ごはんも食べればトイレにもいきますよ。{ctl.FD}寝なきゃ{BR}死んじゃいますしね！
entries.en: Espers are people too. We eat, and{BR}we use the restroom, like anyone else.{ctl.FD}And if we don't sleep,{BR}we'll die!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9701}ううう…こわい…！ わたしは{BR}あの黒い波動が こわい…！{ctl.FD}ルツさまが生きてるなら、なぜ{BR}今こそ出てきてくださらないのか！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9701}Ohh... I am afraid...! That Black{BR}Wave frightens me...!{ctl.FD}If Lord Lutz lives, why will he{BR}not come forth now of all times!

entries.jp: ううう…こわい…！ わたしは{BR}あの黒い波動が こわい…！{ctl.FD}ルツさまが生きてるなら、なぜ{BR}今こそ出てきてくださらないのか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}ここにいるのよねー。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}しーっ！
entries.en: Ohh... I am afraid...! That Black{BR}Wave frightens me...!{ctl.FD}If Lord Lutz lives, why will he{BR}not come forth now of all times!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}He's right here, though.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Shh!

entries.jp: わかります…弱くなりこそすれ、{BR}消えてはいませんよ、黒い波動は！
entries.en: I feel it... weakened it may be,{BR}but the Black Wave has not gone!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9D02}{ctl.FA:9701}ここを入れば 奥の院ですが…{ctl.FD}ロイヤルガードが がんばっていて入れてはもらえませんよ？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9D02}{ctl.FA:9701}Through here is the inner sanctum...{ctl.FD}But the Royal Guards are standing firm,{BR}and they will not let you in.

entries.jp: 奥の院に入ってきた？{BR}あなたがたは いったい…？
entries.en: You came into the inner sanctum?{BR}Who on earth are you...?

entries.jp: 何か…何かがおきる…{BR}胸が たかなります…！
entries.en: Something... something is coming...{BR}My heart is racing...!

entries.jp: ここは 我々の心と身体を{BR}きたえる 修行の部屋です。
entries.en: This is the training hall, where we{BR}temper mind and body alike.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9701}一点の くもりもなき清い精神と{BR}はがねのごとき 身体を持ち…{ctl.FD}ルツさまの足元に{BR}一歩でも近づきたいものです！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}良い心がけよね！！ ルツさまは{BR}みんなの あこがれなの！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9701}A spirit pure without a single{BR}shadow, a body strong as steel...{ctl.FD}I want to take one step closer{BR}to where Lord Lutz stands!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}An admirable resolve!! Lord Lutz{BR}is someone all of us aspire to be like!

entries.jp: 一点の くもりもなき清い精神と{BR}はがねのごとき 身体を持ち…{ctl.FD}ルツさまの足元に{BR}一歩でも近づきたいものです！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}…ですって！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}何が言いたいんだ？
entries.en: A spirit pure without a single{BR}shadow, a body strong as steel...{ctl.FD}I want to take one step closer{BR}to where Lord Lutz stands!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}...so he says!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}What are you getting at?

entries.jp: わたしも アルゴルを{BR}救うために 精進せねば！
entries.en: I too must apply myself, if{BR}Algol is to be saved!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}{ctl.F3}………。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}精神統一してるわ。{BR}そっとしておいてあげてね。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}{ctl.F3}.........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}He is centering his mind.{BR}Best leave him be.
entries.us: Ohm...Ohm... He's meditating. Please leave him alone.
Ohm...Ohm...

entries.jp: ここは礼拝堂ですが…なにかと{BR}事件が多いと ここはヒマでね！
entries.en: This is the chapel, though with all{BR}these incidents, it's quiet in here!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D901}聞きましたか！？{ctl.FD}太古よりアルゴルに伝わるという{BR}聖剣のウワサ！{ctl.FD}何でも持つ者のパワーを何倍にも{BR}してくれるとかくれないとか…！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D901}Have you heard!?{ctl.FD}The rumor of the holy sword passed{BR}down in Algol since ancient times!{ctl.FD}They say it supposedly multiplies its{BR}wielder's power many times over...!

entries.jp: おお、それがウワサの！{BR}まさかこの館に…。
entries.en: Oh, so that is the one they speak of{BR}To think it would be in this mansion...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D901}聞きましたか！？{ctl.FD}太古よりアルゴルに伝わるという{BR}聖剣「エルシディオン」のウワサ！このデゾリスのどこかに{BR}あるとかないとか…！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D901}Have you heard!?{ctl.FD}The rumor of the holy sword Elcidion,{BR}passed down in Algol since ancient times!{ctl.FD}They say it might be hidden here on{BR}Dezolis... or maybe not...!

entries.jp: おお、それがウワサの聖剣！{BR}まさかこの館に…。
entries.en: Oh, so that is the one they speak of{BR}To think it would be in this mansion...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:17}失礼をいたしました！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:17}Forgive my discourtesy!!
entries.us: Please excuse me!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A201}{ctl.F6} 0
{ctl.F4:19}すべては 5代様の御意のままに。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:19}All is as the Fifth Lord wills it.
entries.us: All is exactly according to the wishes of the reverent fifth one.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D903}{ctl.FA:A302}{ctl.FA:D701}{ctl.F4:19}御身の無事を{BR}お祈り申し上げております。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D903}{ctl.FA:A302}{ctl.FA:D701}{ctl.F4:19}I pray for your safe return.
entries.us: I pray for your safety.

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} 1
{ctl.F4:19}5代様、信じておりますぞ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:19}Fifth Lord, I have faith in you.
entries.us: I believe in you, reverent fifth one.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:19}おおお、本当にそれを{BR}手にされるとは…{ctl.FD}さすがは{BR}5代様の見込んだ方じゃ…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:19}Ohh, to think that you'd actually hold{BR}it in your hands...{ctl.FD}As expected of someone whom the Fifth{BR}Lord held in such high regard...!
entries.us: Oh my, you were actually able to get your hands on that... Trust the reverent fifth one  to be able to pick the one with ability!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}ここが奥の院の さらに奥の部屋…ルツの間、と呼ばれている…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}えっ…じゃあ、いよいよなのね…。いよいよルツ様に会えるのね！{ctl.FD}あっ！ あたし、{BR}服 汚れてないかしら？ 髪は？{ctl.FD}ああーんどうしよ。{BR}緊張しちゃう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}どんな人なのかしら…。{BR}ね、ルディ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ルツ…{BR}伝説の魔法使い、か…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}Beyond the inner sanctum lies one more{BR}room: the Chamber of Lutz.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Then... it's really happening...{BR}We're finally going to meet Lord Lutz!{ctl.FD}Oh! Are my clothes clean?{BR}How's my hair?{ctl.FD}Oh, what do I do.{BR}I'm so nervous!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}I wonder what kind of person he is...{BR}Rudy, what do you think?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Lutz...{BR}The legendary mage...
entries.us: This is the inner sanctuary and further beyond... there is a room called Lutz's room. That's right. So now, the time has finally come... At last we're going to meet Lutz! Oh dear! Are my clothes clean? How's my hair? Oh, what shall I do. I'm so nervous! I wonder what kind of person he is? What do you think, Chaz? Hmm, Lutz..  The legendary magician...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}ほら、回復してやる…{BR}はやく行ってこい。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}Here, I'll heal you...{BR}Now go on, hurry up.
entries.us: Here, let me heal you. Then get going!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:06}ルディ…しっかりね！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}人間とは 複雑なものですね…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:06}Rudy... be strong!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Humans are such complex beings, aren't{BR}they...
entries.us: Chaz...pull yourself together! Human beings are so complicated.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:17}シェス！ 許可無く ここを{BR}通ることは まかりならんぞ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}ワケありなのよ！？ 取り次いで{BR}くれたっていいじゃない！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:17}そうはいかん！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}わからずや！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}通してやれ…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:17}なんだおまえ！{BR}とにかく、ダメなものはダメ……{ctl.FD}あっ！？？{ctl.FD}あ…あなたさまは………！！{ctl.FD}し、失礼いたしました！{BR}どうぞお通りを！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}スレイ…？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:17}Shess! You may not pass here{BR}without permission!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}There's a special reason for it! You could{BR}at least announce our arrival!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:17}That will not do!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}You're so stubborn!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Let her through...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:17}And who are you--!{BR}A refusal is a refusal, no matter h......{ctl.FD}Ah!??{ctl.FD}Y-you are............!!{ctl.FD}F-forgive me!{BR}Please, go right ahead!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Thray...?
entries.us: Kyra! You may not pass here without permission! Since when do I need permission!? Open the door for us! That I cannot do! You pigheaded oaf! Let her enter! How dare you! I cannot... Hey! Oh, it's...it's you! Forgive my rudeness! Please enter! Rune...?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:0A}え…あれ？{BR}だれもいないわ…？{ctl.FD}ルツさま！{BR}お姿を お見せください！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:04}ここにはいないよ、ルツは…。{BR}とうの昔に この世を去った…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}えっ…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}{ctl.F2:00009F}やはり、二千年も人が生きて{BR}いられるはずはなかったのですね。{ctl.F4:0A}そんな！ あたし、見たのに…！{ctl.FD}それに…それに…{BR}みんな信じているのよ！？{ctl.FD}伝説のエスパー、ルツが今も生きて我々を導いているんだって！！{ctl.FD}だから…だから みんな{BR}がんばっているのに…そんな！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}シェス！ 落ちつけ…。{ctl.FD}確かに…ルツは すでに{BR}この世を去っている。{ctl.FD}しかし、身体は滅びても{BR}その精神は 今も生きているのだ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}？？？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}彼は死ぬ直前、自分の意志と記憶を{ctl.F2:000100}このテレパシーボールに残した…。{ctl.F4:06}じゃあ…{BR}この玉が 今のルツだっていうの？{ctl.F4:04}いや…。今はここにはない…。{ctl.FD}心身ともに 彼の遺志を{BR}継ぐにふさわしい者があれば、{ctl.FD}その者に…ルツの意志と記憶は{BR}受け継がれることになっている…。{ctl.F4:0A}………{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}そして、今は…{ctl.F2:02}{ctl.F9:B3}{ctl.F2:000101}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}！！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}スレイが……ルツ……！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:19}さようでございます。{ctl.FD}スレイ・ウォルシュ…{BR}5代目のルツさまでございます。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}{ctl.F2:000102}あ…あなたが…{BR}ルツ、さま…？ そんな…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ルディ 聞け！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000103}アルゴルには、太古より 千年を{BR}周期に 災いがふりかかっている。ダーク・ファルスという悪の化身が千年ごとに復活を果たすからだ！{ctl.FD}今までは その時々の{BR}勇気ある者が 悪を打ち倒し、{ctl.FD}かりそめの平和を{BR}かちえてきた…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}でも、クランであたしたち 確かにダーク・ファルスを倒したのに…{ctl.FD}まだ アルゴルの異常は{BR}おさまる気配がないわ…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}どういうことなんだ！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}千年前のパルマ爆発で、{BR}アルゴルはゆれた…！{ctl.FD}今まで保っていた 微妙なバランスが大きく崩れたのだ。{ctl.FD}それによる影響なのかもしれん。{BR}まだ「黒い波動」を感じる…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ダーク・ファルスは{BR}生きているっていうのか！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}さあな…{BR}オレにも わからん。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:02}{ctl.F2:000104}ただ一つ言えるのは、諸悪の根源は未だ滅びていない、ということだ！滅びていないのならば{BR}倒すのみ！{ctl.FD}そのために…ルディ、{BR}オレはおまえを選んだのだから。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}おまえこそ、来るべき決戦のためにオレが選んだ戦士なのだ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}え？{ctl.FD}選んだ…？ オレを…？？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}そうだ。{BR}おまえはオレの見込んだ男だ。{ctl.FD}オレの目に狂いが{BR}あるか、ないか…{ctl.FD}いずれわかる…ルディ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}？？？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}{ctl.F2:000105}まぁ、そんなわけだ。{BR}今まで 隠していて悪かったな。{ctl.FD}これからも{BR}よろしくたのむぜ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}？？？？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}とにかく！{BR}ガルベルクの塔だ！{ctl.FD}答は そこにある！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:19}{ctl.F2:000106}道をはばむ人食い樹でしたれば、{BR}デゾリアンの信奉する聖なる炎…{ctl.FD}「イクリプストーチ」を用いれば、必ずや滅ぼすことができましょう。{ctl.F4:04}よし、行き先は決まった！{BR}ガンビアス大寺院だ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:19}ここより西の山あいにある、{BR}デゾリアンの寺院ですじゃ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}行くぞ！ ルディ、いつまでも{BR}ボケッとしてんじゃねえよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}あーん。ルツさまが{BR}こんな言葉使いをなさるなんてー！{ctl.F4:04}わりぃな。{BR}オレは昔からこうなんだ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}あーん。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:0A}Eh...? There's no one here...?{ctl.FD}Lord Lutz!{BR}Please, show yourself!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:04}Lutz is not here...{BR}He departed this world long ago...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}What...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}{ctl.F2:00009F}As I thought. No one could have gone on{BR}living for two thousand years.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}That can't be! But I saw him...!{ctl.FD}And besides... besides...{BR}everyone believes in him!{ctl.FD}That Lutz, the legendary Esper, lives{BR}even now and guides us!!{ctl.FD}That is why... that is why everyone{BR}keeps going... it can't be true!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Shess! Calm down...{ctl.FD}It is true... Lutz has already{BR}left this world.{ctl.FD}But though his body perished,{BR}his spirit still lives on.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}???{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}{ctl.F2:000100}Just before he died, he left his will{BR}and his memory in this telepathy ball...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Then... you're saying that orb{BR}is Lutz now?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}No... He is not here now...{ctl.FD}If one is found fit in mind and body{BR}to carry on what he left behind,{ctl.FD}then to that person... Lutz's will and{BR}memory shall pass...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}.........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}And at present...{ctl.F2:02}{ctl.F9:B3}{ctl.F2:000101}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}!!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Thray is...... Lutz......!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:19}That is so.{ctl.FD}Thray Walsh...{BR}the fifth Lord Lutz.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}{ctl.F2:000102}Y-you are...{BR}Lord... Lutz...? It can't be...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Rudy, listen!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000103}Since ancient times, calamity has come{BR}to Algol in a thousand-year cycle.{ctl.FD}The incarnation of evil called Dark{BR}Falz returns every thousand years!{ctl.FD}Each time, the brave souls of that age{BR}struck the evil down,{ctl.FD}and secured a fleeting peace...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}But we beat Dark Falz on Kuran,{BR}we know we did...{ctl.FD}and still there's no sign of Algol's{BR}anomalies subsiding...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What does that mean!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}When Palma was destroyed a thousand{BR}years ago, it shook Algol...!{ctl.FD}The delicate balance it had held{BR}until then shattered.{ctl.FD}This may be a result of that.{BR}I feel the Black Wave still...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Are you saying Dark Falz{BR}is alive!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Who knows...{BR}Even I can't be certain.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:02}{ctl.F2:000104}But one thing is certain: the root of{BR}all evil has not perished yet!{ctl.FD}And if it still lives,{BR}then it must be destroyed!{ctl.FD}For that reason... Rudy,{BR}I chose you.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}You are the warrior I chose for the{BR}final decisive battle!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Eh?{ctl.FD}Chose...? Me...??{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}That's right.{BR}You're the man I set my hopes on.{ctl.FD}Whether my judgment is wrong{BR}or not...{ctl.FD}we'll know in time... Rudy.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}???{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}{ctl.F2:000105}Well, that's how it is.
