Sorry for{BR}keeping it from you until now.{ctl.FD}I'm counting on you{BR}from here on, all right?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}????{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}In any case!{BR}The Gallberg Tower!{ctl.FD}The answer is there!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:19}{ctl.F2:000106}As for the man-eating trees that bar{BR}the way, the sacred flame the{ctl.FD}Dezolians revere, the Eclipse Torch,{BR}will surely destroy them.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Right, our path is decided!{BR}The Gungbius Grand Temple.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:19}It's a Dezolian temple which lies{BR}in the mountains west of here.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Let's go! Rudy, quit standing{BR}there in a daze!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Oh my! To think that Lord Lutz should{BR}speak so callously!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Sorry about that.{BR}I've always been this way!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Oh my...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}ルディ、聖剣「エルシディオン」がこの奥で おまえを待っている！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}{ctl.F2:000128}聖剣「エルシディオン」！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}そうだ。「深遠なる闇」を滅する力を持った、おそらく唯一の武器だ！行け、ルディ…ひとりで！ そしてエルシディオンに会ってこい…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}エルシディオンに…会う…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}そうだ。そのとき…おまえの{BR}求める答が見つかるだろう…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}Rudy, the holy sword Elcidion{BR}is waiting for you within!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}{ctl.F2:000128}Holy sword Elcidion!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}That's right. Probably the one weapon{BR}with the power to destroy the{ctl.FD}Profound Darkness!{ctl.FD}Go, Rudy... and go alone!{BR}Go and meet Elcidion...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Meet... Elcidion...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}That's right. And then...{BR}you will find the answer you seek...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}これが、{BR}聖剣「エルシディオン」…{ctl.FD}…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F9:77}{ctl.F2:00012A}どこからか声がする…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}よく来ましたね、{BR}ルディ・アシュレ…。{ctl.FD}ここは、アルゴルを護って{BR}戦った者たちの魂が還る場所…。{ctl.FD}そして「エルシディオン」こそ、{BR}その魂の宿りし剣…！{ctl.FD}さあルディ…「エルシディオン」を手に取るのです…。{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}！！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}！！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:00}ルディ…スレイが認めたひと…{BR}わかってくれたのですね…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ああ…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}{ctl.F2:000137}ルディ…{BR}「エルシディオン」を頼みます…！わたしたちの想いが みんな、{BR}その剣には こめられている…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000138}わたしたちはいつも あなたと{BR}共にいるわ…お願い、ルディ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ああ！{BR}まかせてくれ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}So this is the holy sword,{BR}Elcidion...{ctl.FD}...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F9:77}{ctl.F2:00012A}A voice, from somewhere...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}Welcome, Rudy Ashley...{ctl.FD}This is where the souls of those{BR}who fought to guard Algol return...{ctl.FD}And Elcidion is the sword in which{BR}those souls are lodged...!{ctl.FD}Now, Rudy... take Elcidion{BR}into your hands...{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}!!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}!!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:00}Rudy... whom Thray selected...{BR}You understand, do you not...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Aah...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}{ctl.F2:000137}Rudy...{BR}Elcidion is in your care now...!{ctl.FD}All of our feelings{BR}are imbued within that sword...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000138}We are with you always...{BR}We beg you, Rudy...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Yes!{BR}Leave it to me!!
entries.us: So this is the sacred sword, Elsydeon... What? I hear a voice from somewhere! Ah, you have made it, Chaz Ashley... This is the place where the spirits of those who fought to protect Algo return to... Elsydeon is the sword sheltered by those spirits! Now Chaz, you must take Elsydeon in your hands... Hey! Wow! So you are Chaz whom Rune selected... You were able to understand. Aaah...! Chaz... I entrust to you the care of Elsydeon! All of our thoughts are stored within that sword. We will all be with you, Chaz, always, so... Don't worry Leave it to me!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}やはりな。{ctl.FD}エルシディオンも おまえの{BR}力になることを約束してくれた…。オレの目に 狂いはなかったな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}スレイ…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}{ctl.F2:00013C}ルディ、アルゴルを護ろう…！{BR}封印としてのそれではなく…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ああ！ アルゴルに生きる{BR}すべてのもののため…そして…{ctl.FD}過去を断ち、何者にも縛られない{BR}本当の自由な未来を創るため！{ctl.FD}オレは、戦う！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ルディ…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}勝とうぜ、ルディ！{BR}オレたちのアルゴルのために！！{ctl.F9:3B}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:03A9}{ctl.F4:08}たいへんです！ モタビアに異変が発生したと、フレナから連絡が！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ルディ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}うん！{BR}モタビアに急ごう！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}Just as I thought.{ctl.FD}Elcidion has promised to lend you{BR}its strength as well...{ctl.FD}My judgment did not betray me!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Thray...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}{ctl.F2:00013C}Rudy, let us protect Algol...!{BR}Not merely as a seal upon it, but...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Yes! For every living thing in{BR}Algol... and beyond that...{ctl.FD}to sever the past and build a future{BR}that is truly free, unbound by anything!{ctl.FD}That is what I choose to fight for!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Let's win this, Rudy!{BR}For our Algol!!{ctl.F9:3B}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:03A9}{ctl.F4:08}Emergency alert from Frena:{BR}something has happened on Motavia!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Right!{BR}To Motavia, quickly!!
entries.us: I knew it. Elsydeon promised that it would give you power. There was no mistake in my judgment! Rune! Chaz, let's go save Algo! Right! We're doing it for all life in Algo, and to create a future that is truly free of terror! A future unbound at last from the evil of the past! For that, I will fight! Chaz... Let's conquer, Chaz! For Algo! We have an emergency! Demi informs us that disaster has erupted on Motavia! Chaz! All right. Let's hurry to Motavia!!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ぺ
{ctl.F6} で
{ctl.F4:19}おお、スレイさま！{BR}よくぞ ご無事で。このたびは…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}あいさつはいい。{BR}奥に入らせてもらうぞ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:19}は、それはもう…{BR}御意のままに。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:19}Ah, Lord Thray!{BR}I am glad you are safe. And this time...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Never mind the formalities.{BR}I'm going inside.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:19}Y-yes, of course...{BR}As you will it.
entries.us: Ah, Rune! It's good to see you made it back safely. Forget the formalities. I'm going in. Oh, yes, of course... As you wish.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}また奥の部屋をかりるぞ。{BR}ルディに渡すものがある。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:19}ま…まさか、あれを{BR}このような少年に！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}？？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ルディ以外いないんだ。{BR}…オレを信じてくれ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:19}わかりました、5代様。{BR}もう何も言いますまいぞ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}We'll borrow the inner room again.{BR}There's something there for Rudy.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:19}S-surely you don't mean to give{BR}that to a boy like this!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}??{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}There is no one else but Rudy.{BR}...Trust me on this!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:19}Understood, Fifth Lord.{BR}I shall say no more.
entries.us: We're borrowing the inner room again. I've got something to give to Chaz. S...surely, you're not going to give that to a youth like this! Youth! There's no one other than Chaz. ...You've got to believe me! I understand,reverent fifth one. I will say no more.

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ス

entries.note: trailing bytes, no terminator

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}ジュットの街にようこそ。{ctl.FD}…なんてのんきなコト言ってる{BR}場合じゃないよ、この天気は。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Welcome to the town of Jut.{ctl.FD}...Though it's hardly the moment for{BR}pleasantries, in this weather.
entries.us: Welcome to the town of Jut. Actually this is no time for niceties. Look at this weather.

entries.jp: ジュットの街にようこそ。{ctl.FD}…なんてのんきなコト言ってる場合じゃないよ！ 大寺院が…！
entries.en: Welcome to the town of Jut.{ctl.FD}...Though it's hardly the moment{BR}for pleasantries! The Grand Temple...!
entries.us: Welcome to the town of Jut. Actually this is no time for niceties! The temple is...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}みんな元気がないよね！{ctl.FD}これしきの風で{BR}家にこもっちゃうなんてさ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}でも、この地方は特に雪嵐が{BR}激しいわ。無理ないわよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Everyone's in such low spirits!{ctl.FD}Shutting themselves indoors over a{BR}bit of wind like this.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}But the snowstorms are worst of all{BR}in this region. I don't blame them.
entries.us: Everyone seems down-hearted. What wimps to stay indoors just because of a little bit of wind like this. But this region has especially harsh snow storms. I don't blame them.

entries.jp: たっ、たいへんだ！
entries.en: Th-this is terrible!
entries.us: Oh no!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}おおっとっとっと！{ctl.FD}この飛ばされるか飛ばされないかという所がスリル満点でいいよね！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Whoa-oa-oa!{ctl.FD}That moment where you can't tell if{BR}you'll blow away -- that's the thrill!
entries.us: Oops! It's so thrilling when the winds are just right. You don't know whether you'll be blown away or not!

entries.jp: ガンビアス大寺院の方向から{BR}大きな爆発音が！！
entries.en: A great explosion, in the{BR}direction of the Grand Temple!!
entries.us: There was a sound of a big explosion in the direction of Gumbious Temple!!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}このぼうし？{ctl.FD}これは実は中にヒモがついてての。飛ばないようになってるんですじゃ
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}This hat?{ctl.FD}There's a string inside it, see.{BR}That's how it stays on my head.
entries.us: This hat? Actually, there's a string inside it, so it won't get blown away.

entries.jp: 何じゃ 何じゃ！？{ctl.FD}いったい{BR}何があったんじゃ！？
entries.en: What is it? What is it!?{ctl.FD}What in the world{BR}has happened!?
entries.us: What is it? What is it? What the heck  has happened!?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}{ctl.F3}うううう。{ctl.FD}全然前に進まないよう。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}{ctl.F3}Ngggh.{ctl.FD}I'm not moving forward at all.
entries.us: Ooof. I can't move forward at all.

entries.jp: いったい どうなってるんだ、{BR}この星は！？
entries.en: What in the world is happening{BR}to this planet!?
entries.us: What the heck is going on with this planet?

entries.jp: ガンビアス大寺院といえば、消えて無くなったという話は本当ですか？
entries.en: Speaking of the Gungbius Grand{BR}Temple, is it true it just vanished?
entries.us: Is it true that Gumbious Temple just vanished?

entries.jp: この世の終わりだ！{ctl.FD}ああ！ わたしは{BR}どうしたらいいんだ！？
entries.en: It's the end of the world!{ctl.FD}Ahh! What am I{BR}supposed to do!?
entries.us: This is the end of the world! Ahh! What am I to do!?

entries.jp: ガンビアス大寺院が…！{BR}わたしたちの心のささえが…！
entries.en: The Gungbius Grand Temple...!{BR}The pillar of all our hearts...!
entries.us: Oh no, not the Gumbious Temple! It's the source of our strength!

entries.jp: 風がやんだのはいいのですが…{ctl.FD}ガンビアス大寺院の方向で{BR}大きな爆発がしたような…？
entries.en: I'm glad the wind's died down, but...{ctl.FD}wasn't there a great explosion off{BR}towards the Grand Temple...?
entries.us: I'm glad that the winds have died down, but... It sounded like there was a big explosion in the direction of the Gumbious Temple.

entries.jp: 何やら大事がおこっている様子！{BR}この星はいったいどうなるのだ！？
entries.en: Something major is happening!{BR}What will become of this planet!?
entries.us: It seems like some major crisis has occurred! What's going to happen to this planet?

entries.jp: ものすごい地鳴りがしましたよ！？あれは いったい…？？
entries.en: There was a terrible rumbling in the{BR}ground! What was that...??
entries.us: There was a tremendous sound of the earth rumbling! What on earth was it?

entries.jp: ラコニアの武具は{BR}リシェルから仕入れていたの。{ctl.FD}だから品物はここにあるだけなの。在庫限りの早い者勝ちよ！？
entries.en: The Laconia equipment came in from{BR}Richelle.{ctl.FD}So what's on the shelf is all there{BR}is. First come, first served!
entries.us: The Laconia weapons have been purchased from Reshel. So what we have in stock is all that there is. It's first come first served while supplies last!

entries.jp: 狩りをするとはいえ デゾリアンは元来が のんびり屋。{ctl.FD}武器屋なんて はやりませんや。
entries.en: We may hunt, but Dezolians are an{BR}easy-going people at heart.{ctl.FD}A weapon shop isn't exactly{BR}a booming business.
entries.us: We do hunt, but Dezolisians are essentially laid back. Therefore weapon stores don't do a lot of business.

entries.jp: 南西に古い建物が見えるだろう？{BR}大昔の遺跡らしいんだけどさ。{ctl.FD}掘り出しもんが見つかるかもな。{BR}今度 行ってみようかな！
entries.en: See the old building to the{BR}southwest? Ruins from long ago.{ctl.FD}There might be something special in there.{BR}Perhaps I'll go check it out sometime!
entries.us: See that old building to the southwest? Apparently it's some ruin from ages past. I should go there some time. Maybe I'll stumble onto some lucky find!

entries.jp: 南西の建物だって？{ctl.FD}バカだね、氷の壁が切り立ってて{BR}そんなとこ 今は行けませんよ！
entries.en: The building southwest?{ctl.FD}Don't be ridiculous, the ice wall's sheer.{BR}Nobody's getting there now!
entries.us: The building to the southwest? Don't be silly. There's a wall of ice around it and you wouldn't be able to get through!

entries.jp: ありゃ、パルマ人のお客さんだよ、めずらしい。{ctl.FD}デゾリアンの寺院なんか見て{BR}あんたら 面白いかね？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…商売する気あんのか、この人？
entries.en: Well, a Palman customer.{BR}That's a rare thing.{ctl.FD}Is it really that interesting to you,{BR}looking at a Dezolian temple?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...Does this man want any{BR}business at all?
entries.us: Oh my, a Parmanian guest, how rare. So is it that interesting to you to go see a Dezolisian temple? I wonder if this person wants any business?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}ガンビアス大寺院でしたら{BR}もっと北ですよ。{ctl.FD}街の真ん中にあるのはね、{BR}違うんですよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}If it's the Gungbius Grand Temple{BR}you want, that's further north.{ctl.FD}The one in the middle of town,{BR}that's a different thing.
entries.us: If you're talking about the Gumbious Temple, it's further north. The building in the middle of town, now that's different.

entries.jp: ガンビアス大寺院といえば、消えて無くなったという話は本当ですか？
entries.en: Speaking of the Gungbius Grand{BR}Temple, is it true it vanished?
entries.us: Talking about the Gumbious Temple, I hear it vanished. Is that true?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9401}大寺院といえば 昔だじゃればかり言ってたじいさんがいたっけなぁ。最近 見かけないけど、{BR}オレは好きだったな！{ctl.FD}お？ おお！ あんただよあんた！どうしたの、引っ越したのかい？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}うむ。だじゃれがヒットシて{BR}ヒッコシたんじゃ！ ホッホ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ヒッコめー。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ルディ…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9401}Speaking of the Grand Temple, there{BR}was an old man there, all bad puns.{ctl.FD}Haven't seen him lately.{BR}I personally liked him, though!{ctl.FD}Oh? Ohh! It's you, it's you!{BR}What's this, have you moved?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Mm. My jokes were such a HIT{BR}that I HIT the road! Hoho!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...So hit the road, then.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy...
entries.us: Talking about the temple, some time ago there was a man who kept making stupid jokes all the time. I haven't seen him around recently, but I really liked him! Oh? Hey! You, I'm talking to you! What's going on. Did you move? Some of my jokes were such a hit that I had to move on! Ha, ha! And that'll be happening pretty soon here, too. Chaz...

entries.jp: 大寺院といえば 昔だじゃればかり言ってたじいさんがいたっけなぁ。最近 見かけないけど、{BR}オレは好きだったな！
entries.en: Speaking of the Grand Temple, there{BR}was an old man there, all bad puns.{ctl.FD}Haven't seen him lately.{BR}I personally liked him, though!
entries.us: Talking about the temple, some time ago, there was a man who kept making stupid jokes all the time. I haven't seen him around recently, but I really liked him!

entries.jp: ヘンなウワサ、聞きました？{ctl.FD}ガンビアス大寺院がなくなったっていうんですよ。まさかねぇ。
entries.en: Have you heard the strange rumor?{ctl.FD}They say the Gungbius Grand Temple{BR}is gone. Surely not.
entries.us: Have you heard the strange rumor? They say that the Gumbious Temple is gone. That's impossible, don't you think?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}ガンビアス大寺院の奥には、千年の時を越えて生きる大僧正様がおる…会ったことはございませんが、{BR}そういう話らしいですよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}うん…ウワサには{BR}聞いたことがある…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Deep in the Gungbius Grand Temple{BR}lives a High Priest more than a thousand{ctl.FD}years old... I've never met him{BR}myself, but so the story goes.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Mm... I've heard that{BR}rumored too...
entries.us: In the back room of the Gumbious Temple, there's a great Bishop that has lived for over a thousand years... I haven't met him myself, but that's what they say. Uh huh...I have heard that being rumored...

entries.jp: ガンビアス大寺院といえば、消えて無くなったという話は本当ですか？
entries.en: Speaking of the Gungbius Grand{BR}Temple, is it true it vanished?
entries.us: Talking about the Gumbious Temple, I hear it vanished. Is that true?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}ガンビアス大寺院が{BR}近くですからね。{ctl.FD}街の真ん中の寺院なんて、{BR}かわいそうなもんですよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}The Gungbius Grand Temple is{BR}so near, you see.{ctl.FD}You have to pity the little temple{BR}in the middle of town.
entries.us: With the Gumbious Temple being so close by, I feel sorry for the temple in the middle of town.

entries.jp: ガンビアス大寺院が…！{BR}そんな…ウソでしょう！？
entries.en: The Gungbius Grand Temple...!{BR}No... it can't be true!?
entries.us: What! The Gumbious Temple...! You...have got to be kidding?

entries.jp: さすがの我々も、この天気では{BR}おいそれと外に出られませんよ。{ctl.FD}物好きも 中には{BR}いるみたいですけどね！
entries.en: Even we can't step out lightly in{BR}weather like this.{ctl.FD}Though there are one or two{BR}strange folks who do!
entries.us: With weather like this, even we are too afraid to go out. Although there do seem to be some of us who are rather frivolous!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}わが家は この街で{BR}ただ一つの 二階建てが自慢！{ctl.FD}…なんですけど、この嵐では{BR}かえって心配で…折れませんかね？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}Our house is the only two-story in{BR}this town, and we're proud of it!{ctl.FD}...Or we were, rather. In this storm, it{BR}worries me. Will it snap off?
entries.us: It's our pride that our house is the only two-story house in the entire town! On the other hand, with this storm, it's kind of worrisome. I wonder if it will fall?

entries.jp: この家はなんとか{BR}もちましたが…。
entries.en: The house held together,{BR}somehow...
entries.us: This house has  somehow or another survived.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}ゆれるゆれる。{BR}よっちゃうなこりゃ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}It sways and sways.{BR}It's going to give me motion sickness.
entries.us: It's shaking, it's shaking. I'm getting seasick.

entries.jp: 何ですって？{ctl.FD}外が騒がしいみたいだけど、{BR}あたしゃ何にも知らんのですわ。
entries.en: What's that?{ctl.FD}Sounds like a commotion outside,{BR}but I know nothing about it.
entries.us: What? It sounded like there was some commotion outside, but I don't know anything.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}勝手にドアを開けて入ってくるのは百歩ゆずって まぁいいとしよう。だが、いっぺん開けたドアは{BR}閉めてもらえんか、寒いんだから！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}I might be willing to overlook you barging{BR}in uninvited...{ctl.FD}But could you at least close the door{BR}after opening it? It's cold!
entries.us: You think you can just open the door and walk in? Well I'll accept what you say and let you in. But since you've opened the door, could you also close it? It's cold outside!

entries.jp: 百歩もゆずらないぞ！{ctl.FD}勝手にドアを開けて{BR}入ってくるんじゃない！！
entries.en: I won't back down an inch!{ctl.FD}Don't just go opening that door and{BR}barging in like that again!!
entries.us: No way am I going to accept your apology! Don't you dare open that door and come in here again!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}{ctl.F3}おちつきなよ、あんた！{BR}まったく短気なんだからもう！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}{ctl.F3}Calm down, will you!{BR}You really have such a short temper!
entries.us: Now calm down! You're so short-tempered!

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}おちつきなよ、あんた！{BR}まったく短気なんだからもう！{ctl.FD}昨日と今日で言うことの違う人は{BR}信用されないわよ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F3}Calm down, will you!{BR}You really have such a short temper!{ctl.FD}Nobody trusts a man who says one{BR}thing today and another tomorrow!!
entries.us: Now calm down! You're so short-tempered! People won't trust a person who changes what they say from one day to another!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9501}ガンビアス大寺院には 聖なる炎があって、我々を守っているとか。{ctl.FD}千年の間、絶えること無く{BR}燃え続けているそうですよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A102}{ctl.FA:9501}They say the Gungbius Grand Temple{BR}holds a sacred flame that guards us.{ctl.FD}Burning ceaselessly for a{BR}thousand years, so they say.
entries.us: Supposedly there is this holy flame at the Gumbious Temple that protects us. It's said that it has been burning without fail for a thousand years.

entries.jp: ガンビアス大寺院には 聖なる炎があって、我々を守っているとか。{ctl.FD}千年の間、絶えること無く{BR}燃え続けているそうですよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}うわぁ！{BR}ロマンティックねぇ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そおかなぁ。{BR}けっこう気味悪いと思うけどなぁ。
entries.en: They say the Gungbius Grand Temple{BR}holds a sacred flame that guards us.{ctl.FD}Burning ceaselessly for a{BR}thousand years, so they say.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Oooh!{BR}How romantic!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}You think? Seems a little creepy{BR}to me.
entries.us: Supposedly there is this holy flame at the Gumbious Temple that protects us. It's said that it has been burning without fail for a thousand years. Wow! How romantic! I don't know about that. It seems pretty eerie to me.

entries.jp: 聖なる炎は{BR}無事だったのでしょうか…？
entries.en: I wonder if the sacred flame{BR}remained safe...?
entries.us: I wonder if the holy flame is safe?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}千年消えない 聖なる炎？{ctl.FD}…そんなの 本当にあるものか。{BR}うわさを信じちゃいけないよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}A sacred flame unquenched for a{BR}thousand years?{ctl.FD}...No such thing exists.{BR}Don't go believing rumors.
entries.us: A holy flame that's been burning for a thousand years? ...There isn't anything like that. You shouldn't believe rumors.

entries.jp: ガンビアス大寺院が 消滅した？{ctl.FD}だからさ、うわさを信じちゃ{BR}いけないって言ってるだろ、全く。
entries.en: The Gungbius Grand Temple is gone?{ctl.FD}I told you not to believe rumors.{BR}Honestly...
entries.us: The Gumbious Temple has vanished? I told you, you shouldn't believe rumors.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}総本山、ガンビアス大寺院が{BR}すぐ北にあるもんですから…{ctl.FD}ウチに来る者なんて{BR}いやしません。{ctl.FD}しかし それでもいいのです。{BR}信じるこころは ひとつです。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}With our grand headquarters, Gungbius,{BR}being just north of here...{ctl.FD}nobody comes to ours at all.{ctl.FD}But that is quite all right.{BR}Our faith is one and the same.
entries.us: Sir, since the Gumbious Temple is close by to the north... No one comes to this temple. But, that's all right. There's one who has the faith.

entries.jp: ガンビアス大寺院が…{BR}なくなったとな！！？？{ctl.FD}…………。{ctl.FD}あわててはいけません。こんな{BR}時こそ、私がしっかりしなければ！{ctl.F4:06}立派ね、司祭さん！
entries.en: The Gungbius Grand Temple has...{BR}has gone!!??{ctl.FD}..........{ctl.FD}We must not lose our heads. Now of{BR}all times, I must stand firm!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Admirably said, priest!
entries.us: The Gumbious Temple has disappeared?! Dear me... We must not get flustered. It is precisely a time like this that I must be strong and reliable! You must be a wonderful priest.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}総本山もいいが、{BR}鎮守（ちんじゅ）様も大事じゃよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}The grand headquarters is good,{BR}but the local shrine matters too.
entries.us: The head of the temple is wonderful, but the village shrine is also important.

entries.jp: 何としたことじゃ…！
entries.en: What is the meaning of this...!
entries.us: What on earth?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}デゾリアンにとって、{BR}毎日の祈りはかかせません。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}For a Dezolian, the daily prayer{BR}is not to be missed.
entries.us: For us Dezolisians, we cannot fail to do our daily prayers.

entries.jp: ガっ、ガンビアス大寺院が！？{ctl.FD}そんないやしかしまさか。{BR}うわわわわわ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}おちついて！{BR}しっかりしてください！！
entries.en: Th-the Gungbius Grand Temple!?{ctl.FD}No, surely, it can't be.{BR}Waaaaaah.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Calm down! Please,{BR}pull yourself together!!
entries.us: Gumbious Temple? Such a disrespectful thing couldn't have happened. Waaaaa... Calm down! Pull yourself together!

entries.jp: 最近この星はおかしい！{ctl.FD}この先 いったい{BR}どうなることやら…！
entries.en: This planet has been strange lately!{ctl.FD}What will become of us from here...!
entries.us: Things have been strange on this planet recently! What on earth is going to happen in the days to come?

entries.jp: 我々には{BR}祈ることしかできません…！{ctl.FD}自分がいかに無力な存在か…思い{BR}知らされて やるせなくなります…
entries.en: All we can do is pray...!{ctl.FD}It is heartbreaking to be made to realize{BR}how powerless I am...
entries.us: The only thing we can do is to pray. It makes one kind of down-hearted...when you come to the realization of what a powerless existence we lead.

entries.jp: デゾリスに救いが{BR}もたらされんことを…！
entries.en: May salvation come to Dezolis...!
entries.us: Oh, that Dezolis may be saved!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:08}1Gの重力と、呼吸可能な{BR}空気が存在します！{ctl.FD}自然発生の可能性は{BR}きわめてゼロに近いです。{ctl.FD}人為的なものと見た方が{BR}合理的でしょうね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}お招きにあずかり{BR}光栄だね、まったく！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:08}Standard gravity and breathable{BR}air are present!{ctl.FD}The chance of this occurring{BR}naturally is virtually nil.{ctl.FD}It is reasonable to conclude{BR}these conditions are artificial.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I must say, I am truly honored{BR}by the invitation!
entries.us: Supposedly there is this holy flame at the Gumbious Temple that protects us. It's said that it has been burning without fail for a thousand years. Wow! How romantic! I don't know about that. It seems pretty eerie to me.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:1D}ハーッハッハッハ！{BR}来たか！ だが…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1F}ハーッハッハッハ！{BR}ルツ以外の者に用はない！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1D}ハーッハッハッハ！{BR}あの方の手をわずらわせずとも…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1F}我らが手で{BR}なぶり殺してくれる！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:1D}Hah hah hah hah!{BR}So you came! But...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1F}Hah hah hah hah!{BR}We have business only with Lutz!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1D}Hah hah hah hah!{BR}No need to trouble Him...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1F}We shall tear you apart{BR}with our own hands!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:1C}来たな…。ルツ…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}やはり、ラシークか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1C}ふ…待った…{BR}待ったぞ、この時を！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ラシーク！ そんな姿で{BR}よみがえって、おまえはいったい…{ctl.F4:1C}復讐よ！{ctl.FD}ルツ！ きさまと…そして、{BR}あの小娘の意志を継ぐ者たち！{ctl.FD}きさまらに 終わり無き苦しみを！きさまらに 死の洗礼を！！{ctl.FD}そのために わしは帰ってきた！{BR}このような姿になろうとも…！{ctl.FD}我が城から 一歩も外へ{BR}出られぬ身体となろうとも…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}それで オレたちを{BR}わざわざ呼びつけたのか！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1C}ククク…うれしいよ。{BR}我が招きに応えてくれて…。{ctl.FD}きさまらの首を刈るために 今の{BR}わしは存在しているのだからな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}来る！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:1C}So you've come... Lutz...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}LaSheek... as I thought!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1C}Heh... I have waited...{BR}waited for this moment!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}LaSheek! Resurrected in such{BR}a form, what have you become...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1C}Revenge!{ctl.FD}Lutz! You, and those who carry{BR}on the will of that girl!{ctl.FD}Endless suffering to you all!{BR}A baptism of death!!{ctl.FD}That's why I have returned!{BR}Even in this wretched form...!{ctl.FD}With a captive's body unable to take{BR}a single step outside my castle...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}And that's why you went to the{BR}trouble of bringing us here!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1C}Heh heh heh... I am delighted.{BR}That you answered my invitation...{ctl.FD}After all, I exist now for no purpose{BR}but to reap your heads!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Here he comes!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:1C}うぉのぉれぇぇええ！ ルツめ！{BR}かっ、かくなる上は これだけは…{ctl.F4:01}あっ！{BR}イクリプストーチ！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}{ctl.F2:03F5}{ctl.F2:000108}やっ！{ctl.F9:3B}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}やったぁ！{BR}イクリプストーチを取り返したわ！{ctl.F4:1C}朽ちる…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:03ED}{ctl.F2:000109}またしても{BR}我が身体が朽ちてゆく…！！{ctl.FD}…だが、これでも{BR}わしは死ねぬのだ！{ctl.FD}何度でもよみがえり、{BR}「ヤツ」のために働かねばならぬ！{ctl.FD}わしを真に倒したくば、{BR}「ヤツ」を滅ぼせ！{ctl.FD}さもなくば わしは、未来永劫{BR}アルゴルの災いとなろうぞ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:13}{ctl.F4:08}エアキャッスルが{BR}崩れはじめました！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}急いで逃げるんだ！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:08}衝撃波が来ます。{BR}対ショック態勢！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}{ctl.F2:00010B}ラシーク…{BR}思えば哀れなやつ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00010C}あいつは、強大な力に魅せられ…{BR}そして、操られただけなんだ…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}強大な力…？ ラシークの{BR}言ってた 「ヤツ」のことか！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ダーク…ファルスなの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}やはり…{BR}まだ滅んではいないのか？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:1C}Cuuurse youuu! Lutz!{BR}Th-then at the very least...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Ah!{BR}The Eclipse Torch!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}{ctl.F2:03F5}{ctl.F2:000108}Hah!{ctl.F9:3B}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}We did it!{BR}We've got the Eclipse Torch back!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1C}Decaying...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:03ED}{ctl.F2:000109}Once again my body{BR}is withering away...!!{ctl.FD}...But even so,{BR}I cannot die!{ctl.FD}I will rise again and again,{BR}bound to serve Him!{ctl.FD}If you wish to truly defeat me,{BR}you must destroy Him!{ctl.FD}Else I shall remain a scourge{BR}to Algol for all eternity!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:07}{ctl.F2:04DD}{ctl.F9:13}{ctl.F4:08}The Air Castle has begun{BR}to collapse!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Hurry, we need to get out of here!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:08}A shock wave is coming.{BR}Brace for impact!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}{ctl.F2:00010B}LaSheek...{BR}A pitiful soul, in the end...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00010C}He was charmed by an overwhelming{BR}power... and merely used by it...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Overwhelming power...? The "Him''{BR}that LaSheek spoke of!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Dark... Falz?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}So then it's...{BR}not destroyed after all?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:1A}おお、まさしくイクリプストーチ！よくぞ取り戻してくださった。{ctl.FD}あなた方なら これをお貸しするにやぶさかではありません。{ctl.FD}どうぞ 我らが聖なる炎を、{BR}破邪のために役立ててくだされ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}よし！{BR}人食い樹の森へ急ごう！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:1A}Oh, the Eclipse Torch indeed!{BR}You have brought it back to us.{ctl.FD}I have no qualms about entrusting it{BR}to the likes of you.{ctl.FD}Please, put our holy flame to{BR}use in vanquishing evil.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Right!{BR}To the forest of man-eating trees!
entries.us: Supposedly there is this holy flame at the Gumbious Temple that protects us. It's said that it has been burning without fail for a thousand years. Wow! How romantic! I don't know about that. It seems pretty eerie to me.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}あれは！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ダーク・ファルスなの！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}確かに！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}サーチデータを照合…！ クランのものとは異なる個体のようです。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ダーク・ファルスは{BR}二匹いたの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ラジャの言うとおり、こいつが{BR}デゾリスを狂わせているのか…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}いや、デゾリスだけじゃない。{BR}このアルゴル星系全てを、だ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}ダーク・ファルスが こちらに{BR}気づきました。 接近してきます！{ctl.F4:01}望むところだ！{BR}いくぞ、みんな！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}That's...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Is that Dark Falz!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}It is!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Comparing search data...! It seems to be{BR}a different entity from Kuran's.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}There were two of{BR}Dark Falz?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}So Raja was right. This is what{BR}has been destabilizing Dezolis...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}No, not Dezolis alone.{BR}The whole Algol solar system!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Dark Falz has noticed us.{BR}It is approaching!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Bring it on!{BR}Let's go, everyone!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}やったな、ルディ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ああ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}嵐が…やんだわ…！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}空が…！{ctl.F9:77}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}{ctl.F2:02}{ctl.F2:000111}{ctl.F4:01}きれいだ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}黒い波動も止まった…。ミースの{BR}患者たちも回復に向かうだろう。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}終わったのね、これで…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ええ…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}{ctl.F2:000112}ありがとう。これも{BR}みんなの協力あってのことだわ。{ctl.FD}独りでやってみせようなんて、{BR}おこがましかったわよね…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}どういたしまして。{BR}よかったわね、シェス！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}さて！{BR}じゃ あたし、ミースに戻るわ。{ctl.FD}これからが また{BR}たいへんだものね！{ctl.FD}じゃあね、ルディ。あんた、{BR}弟みたいで かわいかったわよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}{ctl.F2:000113}なっ！{BR}バ、バカにすんなっ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}ふふ…そこがかわいいっての。{ctl.FD}さよなら、みんな！{BR}さよなら、ルツ…さま！！{ctl.FD}多少期待とは違ったけど、やっぱりその名に恥じない人だったわ！{ctl.FD}また…お会いできますよね…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}えっ…あ、ああ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}それじゃ！{BR}またね、みんな！！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}…行っちゃった。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}弟、か…。{BR}そんなに頼りないかな？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ああ、だいぶマシにはなったが、{BR}まだまだオレにはおよばんな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}{ctl.F2:000114}そりゃかなわないよ。なんたって{BR}ル・ツ・さ・まァ、だもんな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}{ctl.F2:000115}また なぐられたいのか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}…コりないわねー、もう！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}何っ！？{ctl.FD}ガンビアス大寺院の方だわ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}どういうことなんだ？{BR}ダーク・ファルスは倒したのに！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}とにかく、行ってみよう！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}We did it, Rudy.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Yeah...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}The storm... has stopped...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}The sky...!{ctl.F9:77}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}{ctl.F2:02}{ctl.F2:000111}{ctl.F4:01}It's beautiful...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}The Black Wave has stopped, too.{BR}The patients in Meese should recover.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}So with this, it's finally over...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Yes...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}{ctl.F2:000112}Thank you. This was only possible due to{BR}cooperation with all of you.{ctl.FD}Thinking I could do it alone{BR}was presumptuous of me...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Not at all.{BR}I'm glad for you, Shess!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Well then!{BR}I'll be going back to Meese.{ctl.FD}It's from here on out that the{BR}hard part begins!{ctl.FD}Goodbye, Rudy. You were cute,{BR}like a little brother!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}{ctl.F2:000113}Wha!{BR}D-don't make fun of me!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Heh heh... see, that's exactly why!{ctl.FD}Farewell, everyone!{BR}Farewell, Lord... Lutz!!{ctl.FD}You're a little different from what I{BR}expected, but worthy of the name!{ctl.FD}We'll... meet again, won't we...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Ah... y-yes.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Off I go!{BR}See you, everyone!!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}...She's gone.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}A "little brother'', huh...{BR}Am I really that unreliable?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Well, you've improved a good deal,{BR}but you're still no match for me!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}{ctl.F2:000114}I couldn't hope to be. After all,{BR}you're Lo-o-ord Lu-u-utz!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}{ctl.F2:000115}Do you want to get punched again?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}...You never learn, do you!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:06}What!?{ctl.FD}It came from the Gungbius Temple!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What's going on?{BR}We already beat Dark Falz!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Whatever it is, let's go see!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}しまった！{BR}このトーチは にせものだ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Damn it!{BR}This torch is a fake!

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:0A}イクリプストーチを 持ち去った{BR}やつらだわ！ …幻影…？？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ただの幻影じゃないな…。{BR}結界になっていやがる！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}実体を見つけだして、{BR}倒さなきゃいけないってことか！
entries.en: {ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:0A}It's the ones who took the Eclipse{BR}Torch! ...Phantoms...??{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Not mere phantoms...{BR}They've formed a barrier as well!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}So we have to find the real{BR}ones and bring them down!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:A101}デゾリアンとパルマ人は{BR}仲が悪いわけじゃないのだが…{ctl.FD}宗教上の生活様式の違いから、{BR}共同生活をすることはないよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:A101}It isn't that Dezolians and Palmans{BR}dislike one another...{ctl.FD}but our ways of life differ between{BR}our faiths, so we don't share a town.
entries.us: It's not that Dezolisians and Parmanians don't get along... It's just that they don't co-exist because of their different life styles stemming from religious beliefs.

entries.jp: あんたがたには、我々のショックはわかってもらえないだろうが…！
entries.en: You could never understand what{BR}a blow this is to us...!
entries.us: I'm sure you won't be able to understand the shock we sustained!

entries.jp: ここはモタビア星の{BR}ウーゾという村です。
entries.en: This is the village of Uzo,{BR}on the planet Motavia.

entries.jp: この島は絶海の孤島。{ctl.FD}しばらく前までは、小船を作って{BR}本土に行ったりもしていましたが…こう謎のモンスターが多く現れてはもう海の上は渡れませんや。
entries.en: This island stands alone in the sea.{ctl.FD}Until a while back we'd build a{BR}small boat and cross to the mainland,{ctl.FD}but with these strange monsters{BR}appearing everywhere,{ctl.FD}there's no crossing the water{BR}anymore.

entries.jp: 一度でいいから{BR}本土に行ってみたいわ！{ctl.FD}何でも、教養深い人々であふれた{BR}モタビア・アカデミーや…{ctl.FD}何でも売ってる、マーケットの街{BR}なんてのもあるって話じゃない？
entries.en: Just once, I'd love to see{BR}the mainland!{ctl.FD}They say there's the Motavia Academy,{BR}overflowing with learned people...{ctl.FD}and a market town where they sell{BR}anything you could want, isn't there?

entries.jp: 最近、魚が穫れなくなってのぅ。{BR}土がやせて野菜もできなくなって…謎の怪物も現れるし、{BR}イヤな世の中になってきたのぅ。
entries.en: The fish have stopped coming lately.{BR}The soil's barren, the vegetables die...{ctl.FD}and strange monsters are appearing.{BR}It's turned into such a grim world.

entries.jp: 誰？ あんたたち。{ctl.FD}こんな、観るものも うまいものも穫れるものも無い村によく来るね！
entries.en: Who are you people?{ctl.FD}Imagine coming to a village with{BR}nothing to see, eat or harvest!

entries.jp: 村長さんチの娘さん姉妹、最近{BR}見かけないねぇ。どうしたのやら…
entries.en: The village chief's two daughters... I've{BR}not seen them lately. Where are they...

entries.jp: フラードマントという{BR}マントを知ってるかい？{ctl.FD}軽いけど、{BR}すごい防御力があるそうだよ。
entries.en: Do you know a cloak called the{BR}Frad Mantle?{ctl.FD}It's lightweight, but they say the{BR}defense on it is tremendous.

entries.jp: わが家は代々、{BR}音楽の好きな家系でしてね。{ctl.FD}とあるご先祖様は、何とかフルートって笛を愛用していたらしいよ。
entries.en: Ours has been a musical family for{BR}generations, you know.{ctl.FD}One ancestor of ours was fond of a{BR}some-thing-or-other flute.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:7D03}{ctl.FA:7801}知らん知らん！{ctl.FD}あんな親不孝者ども、{BR}もうウチの娘じゃない！！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:7D03}{ctl.FA:7801}I know nothing, nothing!{ctl.FD}Ungrateful girls like that{BR}are no daughters of mine!!

entries.jp: 知らん知らん！{ctl.FD}ハンターギルドに依頼なぞ{BR}出しておらんおらん！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…え？？
entries.en: I know nothing, nothing!{ctl.FD}I never put in a request to any{BR}Hunters Guild, none at all!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...Eh??

entries.jp: おお、ありがとうございました！{BR}よくぞ無事で送り届けて下さった！感謝の念にたえません。さっそく{BR}報酬はギルドに送っておきます！{ctl.FD}どうぞお納めを！
entries.en: Oh, thank you, thank you!{BR}You brought them home safe and sound!{ctl.FD}I can't thank you enough. I'll send{BR}the fee to the Guild at once!{ctl.FD}Please accept it!

entries.jp: 無事に帰ってきてくれた…。{BR}ありがたいことです…。
entries.en: They came home safe......{BR}I am truly grateful...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:7E04}{ctl.FA:7D03}{ctl.FA:7902}{ctl.FA:7801}よせと言うのにウチの娘たち、{BR}姉妹二人で いかだを作って…{ctl.FD}本土の、大マーケットがあるという街に買い物に出かけたんです…。{ctl.FD}そして、それ以来帰ってきません。今ごろどこでどうしているやら…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:7E04}{ctl.FA:7D03}{ctl.FA:7902}{ctl.FA:7801}I told them not to, but my two{BR}daughters built a raft...{ctl.FD}And off to the mainland they went,{BR}to the town with the big market...{ctl.FD}They have not come home since.{BR}Where can they be now, and how...
entries.us: I told them not to do it, but my two daughters made a raft... And they went to a town on the mainland that is supposed to have this big market to do some shopping. They haven't come home since. I wonder where they are and what they're doing right now...

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ユ
怪物に襲われたんじゃないか、{BR}いかだが嵐で沈んだんじゃないか…悪い方悪い方に考えてしまい、{BR}落ちつくひまがありません。{ctl.FD}どうか娘たちを{BR}探して下さい！
entries.en: I keep fearing the worst, that they were{BR}attacked by monsters, or that their{ctl.FD}raft sank in the storm... My mind always{BR}goes to the worst places.{ctl.FD}Please, find my daughters!

entries.jp: 聞けば 際限無く買い物をしすぎ、果ては無銭飲食に無銭宿泊とか…{ctl.FD}箱入り娘で世間知らずのまま、{BR}甘やかして育てすぎた報いです。{ctl.FD}が、これで娘らもコりたでしょう。本当にありがとうございました。
entries.en: I hear they shopped without end, and{BR}resorted to eating and lodging unpaid...{ctl.FD}That's the price for raising them{BR}soft, sheltered and naive to the world.{ctl.FD}Still, they'll have learned from it.{BR}Truly, thank you.

entries.jp: 娘らも、もうコりたでしょう。{BR}本当にありがとうございました。
entries.en: They'll have learned from it,{BR}I think. Truly, thank you.

entries.jp: とうさん、かあさん、{BR}ごめんなさい…。
entries.en: Father, Mother,{BR}we're sorry...

entries.jp: お世話になりました。{BR}でも、ちょっと楽しかったわ…！
entries.en: Thank you for going to the trouble.{BR}Though it was rather fun...!

entries.jp: よせと言うのにウチの娘たち、{BR}姉妹二人で いかだを作って…{ctl.FD}マーケットで買い物をしようと、{BR}本土に向かったんですが…。{ctl.FD}それが、もうひと月にもなるのに{BR}帰ってくる気配もないんです！{ctl.FD}本土に無事に着いているのか{BR}いないのか、それすら分からず…{ctl.FD}ウチの人はがんこで意地っぱり{BR}だから あんな調子ですが、{ctl.FD}本当は私以上に心配してるんです！どうか娘たちを探してください！
entries.en: I told them not to, but my daughters{BR}built a raft...{ctl.FD}They set off for the mainland to{BR}shop at the market...{ctl.FD}And it's been a month now with no{BR}sign of them coming home!{ctl.FD}Whether they even reached the{BR}mainland safely, we don't know...{ctl.FD}My husband is stubborn and headstrong,{BR}so he carries on the way he does,{ctl.FD}but he frets worse than I do!{BR}Please, please find my daughters!

entries.jp: ここはトリンコの村。{BR}段々畑で有名な、農耕の村よ。
entries.en: This is the village of Torinco.{BR}A farming village, famed for its{ctl.FD}terraced fields.
entries.us: This is the village of Torinco. It's a farming village famous for its terraced fields.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:AF01}自慢の段々畑も、{BR}こんなに荒れちまっちゃあなぁ。{ctl.FD}北東の方から、ヘンな鳥が{BR}飛んできて食い散らかすんだよ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:AF01}Our terraced fields were our pride,{BR}and look how ruined they are...{ctl.FD}Strange birds come flying in from{BR}the northeast and tear them up!
entries.us: Our terraced fields are the pride of this village. Look at what a wasteland it is now. A strange flock of birds flew from the northeast and ate our fields!

entries.jp: 自慢の段々畑も{BR}こんなに荒れちまったが…{ctl.FD}食い荒らしてったヘンな鳥が、{BR}最近はこなくなったなぁ。
entries.en: Our terraced fields were our pride,{BR}and look how ruined they are...{ctl.FD}Though those strange birds that ate{BR}them have stopped coming, lately.
entries.us: Our terraced fields, the pride of this village, have become wasteland. Those birds that ate our fields have stopped coming, though.

entries.jp: オレは、丸太で{BR}いかだを作るのが得意なんだ。{ctl.FD}たまに本土へも行ったもんだけど、最近は怪物が出てコワいんだよな！
entries.en: I have a knack for building rafts{BR}out of logs.{ctl.FD}I'd cross to the mainland now and{BR}then, but the monsters frighten me!
entries.us: I'm good at making rafts out of logs. I used to go to the mainland once in a while, but now I'm too afraid of the monsters!

entries.jp: 地震、異常気象、{BR}モンスターの出現…。{ctl.FD}離れ小島にいる我々には、今世界がどうなっているのか分かりません…
entries.en: Earthquakes, freak weather phenomena,{BR}monsters appearing...{ctl.FD}Out here on a little island, we have{BR}no idea what's become of the world.
entries.us: Earthquakes, abnormal climate, outbreak of monsters... For us here on an isolated island, we can't tell what's going in the world today.

entries.jp: あれ？ 本土から来なさったかい？それはめずらしいのぅ！
entries.en: Oh? You've come from the mainland?{BR}Now that's a rare sight!
entries.us: What? You've come from the mainland? How unusual!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:AF01}畑仕事をやってると、{BR}腰は痛くなるし手は荒れるし…{ctl.FD}でも、作物が青々と育ってゆくのを見れば、疲れなんて吹っ飛ぶわ！{ctl.FD}だけど最近それを食い荒らしていく鳥がいて…やんなっちゃう！！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:AF01}Working the fields aches your back{BR}and roughs up your hands...{ctl.FD}But seeing the crops grow lush and green{BR}makes all that fatigue disappear!{ctl.FD}Trouble is, lately there are birds eating{BR}them all up... it's so frustrating!!
entries.us: Working in the fields gives me backaches and makes my hands rough. But when I watch the crops growing strong and green, all my fatigue disappears! But these days, we have those birds eating up our fields...it's terrible!

entries.jp: 畑仕事をやってると、{BR}腰は痛くなるし手は荒れるし…{ctl.FD}でも、作物が青々と育ってゆくのを見れば、疲れなんて吹っ飛ぶわ！
entries.en: Working the fields aches your back{BR}and roughs up your hands...{ctl.FD}But seeing the crops grow lush and green{BR}makes all that fatigue disappear
entries.us: Working in the fields gives me backaches and makes my hands rough. But when I watch the crops growing strong and green, all my fatigue disappears!

entries.jp: ねぇ、「ほんど」ってなに？{BR}そんなにいいものなの？
entries.en: What's the "mainland''?{BR}Is it really so great?
entries.us: What's the 'mainland?' Is it really such a great thing?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:AA01}そこの家の息子さん、この間から{BR}病気で寝込んでいるんじゃよ…。{ctl.FD}かわいそうにのぅ…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:AA01}The son of that family over there has{BR}been stricken with illness a while now...{ctl.FD}Poor thing...
entries.us: The son of those people in the house over there has been sick in bed. Poor thing.

entries.jp: そこの家の息子さん、{BR}元気になったようじゃよ…。{ctl.FD}よかったのぅ…！
entries.en: The son of that family over there seems{BR}to have his strength back...{ctl.FD}What a relief...!
entries.us: The son of those people in the house over there has apparently recovered. I'm so glad!

entries.jp: ねぇ、今大陸の方では{BR}どんな服がはやってるの？？{ctl.FD}こんな村にいたんじゃ、流行に{BR}遅れちゃう！ 教えてよぅ！
entries.en: Tell me, what clothes are trending on{BR}the mainland these days??{ctl.FD}Stuck in a village like this, we{BR}fall behind in fashion! Please tell us!
entries.us: What kind of clothes are in style over on the mainland? We get behind the times in terms of fashion being cooped up in this village! Tell us!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:AF02}{ctl.FA:AE01}ここの家に住んでる人、{BR}ヘンなんだ。{ctl.FD}畑を荒らす妙な鳥を{BR}かわいがるんだぜ。{ctl.FD}だもんだから村のみんなから{BR}仲間外れにされてるのさ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:AF02}{ctl.FA:AE01}The man who lives in this house{BR}is weird.{ctl.FD}He dotes on the strange birds that{BR}ruin the fields.{ctl.FD}That's why the whole village{BR}has shunned him.
entries.us: The person who lives in this house is kind of strange. He likes those birds that eat our fields. Because of this, he's being ostracized by the other villagers.

entries.jp: そこの家の男が、畑を荒らす鳥の{BR}退治を依頼したって？{ctl.FD}そんなバカな！ あんなに{BR}あの妙な鳥たちをかわいがって、{ctl.FD}ついには村のみんなから{BR}仲間外れにされたほどなのにさ！
entries.en: The man in that house has put in for{BR}the field-birds to be killed?{ctl.FD}Nonsense! He doted on those strange{BR}birds so much{ctl.FD}that the village ended up{BR}shunning him over it!
entries.us: Did you say the guy in the house over there has commissioned the exterminatio of the field-eating birds? That's unbelievable! He cared so much for those strange birds, that it had come to the point where he was ostracized by the other villagers!

entries.jp: 最近、鳥が{BR}畑を荒らしに来なくなったけどさ、それは、そこの家の男が ギルドに鳥の退治を頼んだからなんだって？今まで仲間外れにして{BR}悪いことしたなぁ！
entries.en: The birds have stopped coming to{BR}the fields lately.{ctl.FD}And that's because the man in that{BR}house hired the Guild to deal with{ctl.FD}them, apparently? We've done him{BR}wrong by ostracizing him, then!
entries.us: It looks like those birds have stopped coming to eat our fields. I hear that's because the guy in the house over there commissioned the Guild to exterminate them. I feel bad that we've been ostracizing him all this time!

entries.jp: 我が村は、農作物や海産物の{BR}収穫が豊富でしてな。{ctl.FD}ほとんど食料は自給自足で{BR}まかなってるのが自慢！{ctl.FD}…でしたが、最近は怪物のおかげで漁にも行けず、畑は鳥に荒らされ…今や 毎日の食べ物にも{BR}困る生活です。とほほほほ…。
entries.en: Our village had rich harvests once,{BR}from the fields and from the sea.{ctl.FD}We were proud to be almost entirely{BR}self-sufficient for food!{ctl.FD}...But lately, the monsters keep us{BR}from fishing, birds eat the fields,{ctl.FD}and we're struggling just to put food{BR}on the table. Oh dear, oh dear...
entries.us: Our village used to have abundant harvests of farm crops and marine products. We were proud of the fact that we were pretty much self-sufficient in terms of food supply! But recently, we haven't been able to fish, what with the monsters, and the fields have been eaten up by the birds. Now, we can barely find food for ourselves. Boo hoo...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:AF03}{ctl.FA:AE02}{ctl.FA:AD01}………。{ctl.FD}荒れた畑か…フン…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}？？？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:AF03}{ctl.FA:AE02}{ctl.FA:AD01}.........{ctl.FD}The fields are ruined, then... Hmph...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}???
entries.us: Ohh... The fields are all eaten up! Hmm...

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ヲ
{ctl.F4:27}フッ…せいぜい{BR}がんばってくれよな！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:27}Hmph... Do your best,{BR}for what it's worth!
entries.us: Hmmph...at least do your best!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:27}あんたたちか…{BR}済まないことをしたな…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:27}Ah, it's you people...{BR}I'm sorry for what I did...
entries.us: You guys... I apologize for what I did.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:AC05}{ctl.FA:AB04}{ctl.FA:AA03}{ctl.FA:A902}{ctl.FA:A801}息子が病気にかかって…もう自分は治らない、と思いこんでるんです。本当は身体はもう治ってるはずなんですが…いわゆる心の病気ですな。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:AC05}{ctl.FA:AB04}{ctl.FA:AA03}{ctl.FA:A902}{ctl.FA:A801}My son fell ill... and he is convinced{BR}that he won't recover.{ctl.FD}Physically, he should be healed by now,{BR}but it's a psychological illness, it seems.
entries.us: My son has become ill... he is convinced that he won't be cured. Actually, physically he is cured. It must be one of those so-called psychological illnesses.

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} レ
ハンターさんに失礼とは{BR}重々承知の上でのお願いです！{ctl.FD}テルミゆかりの品を、息子のために買ってきてやってください！
entries.en: I know full well how impertinent{BR}it is to ask this of a hunter!{ctl.FD}Please, buy something from Termi for{BR}my son and bring it back!
entries.us: I ask this of you knowing full well how impertinent it is to ask this of a hunter! Please buy a souvenir from Termi for my son!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ロ
ありがとうございました。報酬は{BR}ギルドにお送りしておきます！
entries.en: Thank you so much. I'll send your{BR}fee to the Guild!
entries.us: Thank you so much. I will remit your commission fee to the Guild!

entries.jp: ありがとうございました。{BR}息子も元気になりました！！
entries.en: Thank you so much.{BR}My son has his strength back!!
entries.us: Thank you so much. My son has recovered!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:AC03}{ctl.FA:AA02}{ctl.FA:A801}まだ怪物もあまり出なかった頃、{BR}家族で出かけた本土の観光地…{ctl.FD}息子はいたく気に入って、{BR}喜んでおりましたわ。{ctl.FD}あの頃の元気を{BR}取り戻してほしいのですけれど…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:AC03}{ctl.FA:AA02}{ctl.FA:A801}Back when there weren't so many{BR}monsters, we took family trips to a{ctl.FD}place on the mainland...{ctl.FD}My son loved it greatly, and was{BR}so happy there.{ctl.FD}I only wish he could get back the{BR}strength he had in those days...
entries.us: Back in the days when there weren't many monsters, there was a tourist town on the mainland... Our family used to visit it. My son took to the place, and was very happy. I wish he would get back the strength he had in those days.

entries.jp: かつて家族で出かけたテルミの村…息子はいたく気に入っていました。とくに、丘の上の勇者の像を見て{BR}たいそう喜んでいましたわ。{ctl.FD}女の人なのにかっこいい、ぼくも{BR}強くなって悪いやつを倒す…って。それがこんなことに…。
entries.en: The village of Termi, where we used{BR}to go as a family...{ctl.FD}My son loved it, especially the statue of{BR}the hero atop the hill. He said, "She's so{ctl.FD}cool, even though she's a woman... I want{BR}to grow strong and beat bad guys, too.''{ctl.FD}And now, to think it has come to this...
entries.us: The village of Termi, where we used to take family trips...my son took to the place greatly. He was especially delighted to see the statue of the heroine on the hill. He said, even though she's a woman, she looks cool, and he wants to be strong and conquer evil people, too. But now this...

entries.jp: 良かった！{BR}息子が元気になってきました！
entries.en: Thank goodness!{BR}My son is getting his strength back!
entries.us: Thank goodness! My son has recovered!

entries.jp: お世話になりました。あれ以来、{BR}息子もたいそう元気になりました！
entries.en: Thank you for your help. Ever since,{BR}my son has been so much better!
entries.us: Thank you for what you did. My son has become quite well!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ワ

{ctl.F4:26}あっ！ これ……！！{ctl.FD}「アリサの剣」だ…。{BR}テルミで見た…勇者の…！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}いいか、見てろよ？{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:26}かっこいい！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}この剣には、勇者アリサの{BR}強さと勇気がこもってるんだ！{ctl.FD}これをあげる。{BR}君も元気を出すんだよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:039E}{ctl.F4:26}…うん！！{BR}ありがとう、お兄ちゃん！{ctl.FD}なんだか ぼく、{BR}元気がでてきたよ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:26}Ah! This......!!{ctl.FD}It's Alisa's Sword...{BR}The hero's, that we saw at Termi...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}All right, watch this.{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:26}That's amazing!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}The strength and courage of Alisa{BR}the hero are in this sword!{ctl.FD}I'm giving it to you.{BR}You get your strength back too!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:039E}{ctl.F4:26}...Yes!!{BR}Thank you, mister!{ctl.FD}Somehow I feel my strength{BR}coming back!
entries.us: Wow! Look at this! It's the Alis-Sword! That heroine...we saw at Termi! Ready? Now watch. Cool! This sword is filled with the strength and courage of the heroine Alis! Here. It's for you. Now, you get better! Oh yes! Thank you! I feel like I'm getting better already!

entries.jp: 勇者アリサも{BR}好きだけどさ、{ctl.FD}あのときのお兄ちゃんも、本物の{BR}勇者みたいにカッコよかったな！{ctl.FD}ぼくも、お兄ちゃんみたいに{BR}強くなりたいな！！
entries.en: I like Alisa the hero,{BR}but...{ctl.FD}back then you looked amazing too,{BR}just like a real hero!{ctl.FD}I want to grow strong{BR}like you!!
entries.us: I like the heroine, Alis, but you looked cool, just like a real hero yourself, when you were doing that! I want to become strong just like you!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ひゃー。{BR}ヘンなでっかい鳥がいるよ！{ctl.FD}危ないから、{BR}近寄らない方がいいな！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Yikes.{BR}There's a strange great bird!{ctl.FD}It looks dangerous.{BR}Better not go near it!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}こいつが、畑を荒らしているという妙な鳥たちのボスか…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}こっちに気づいたわ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}よし、行くぞ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}So this is the boss of those odd{BR}birds that are ruining the fields...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}It's noticed us!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Right, here we go!!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}待て！{ctl.F7}やめてくれ！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}セクレアスさん！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}お願いだ！{BR}見逃してやってくれ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}どうして…あんた、あいつの退治を頼んだ張本人じゃないか！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}そうだ…確かにそうだがよ…{BR}悪かった！ かんべんしてくれ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}いったい{BR}どういうことなの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}わかった、説明する…{BR}説明するから許してくれ！{ctl.FD}オレはよ、昔から動物好きなんだ。それが最近、新種の鳥を発見した…そしてオレは、それをこの洞窟に{BR}集め、育てていたんだよ…。{ctl.FD}しかし、やがて増殖した鳥たちは{BR}エサを求め…{ctl.FD}トリンコにやって来て、畑を{BR}食い荒らすようになったんだ…。{ctl.FD}そしたら村のみんなはよ、怒って{BR}鳥たちを退治しようとするんだよ…ひでぇだろ？ 鳥たちは ただ、{BR}食い物が欲しいだけなのによ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そういうあんたが、なぜ鳥のボスの退治をギルドに依頼したんだ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}怒らねぇで聞いてくれよな…。{ctl.FD}鳥の中にボスができて、そいつが{BR}えらく大きく強いのは知ってたんだいくらギルドのハンターでもよ、{BR}かなうわけがねぇ、と思ったんだ。もしハンターがやられちまえばよ、いい見せしめになるじゃねぇか…。そうすりゃ村のみんなも、もう鳥をいじめなくなると思ったんだよ…。{ctl.F4:01}………。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}だが…あんたらがあそこまで強ぇ{BR}とはな…とんだ誤算だったよ…。{ctl.FD}すまなかったな…。牢屋にでも{BR}何にでも、ぶちこんでくれよ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}行けよ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}？？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}トリンコに帰れって{BR}言ってんだよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}ゆ、許してくれるのか！？{BR}す、すまねぇな！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Hold it!{ctl.F7}Stop, please!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}Mr. Sekreas!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}I beg you!{BR}Let it go!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Why... you're the very person who{BR}asked for it to be put down!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}Well, yes... that's true, but...{BR}I'm sorry! Forgive me!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}What on earth is this about?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}All right, I'll explain...{BR}I'll explain, so forgive me!{ctl.FD}I've loved animals all my life.{BR}Lately I found a new kind of bird...{ctl.FD}And I gathered them here in{BR}this cave, and reared them...{ctl.FD}But in time they multiplied,{BR}and went looking for food...{ctl.FD}They came to Torinco, and began{BR}eating up the fields...{ctl.FD}Then the village got angry and started{BR}killing off the birds...{ctl.FD}Isn't that cruel? All the birds{BR}want is something to eat...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Then why did you ask the Guild{BR}to put down the boss bird?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}Hear me out without getting angry...{ctl.FD}I knew a boss had risen among them,{BR}and that it was huge and strong.{ctl.FD}Even a Guild hunter, I thought,{BR}could never match it.{ctl.FD}And if the hunter were beaten,{BR}wouldn't that be a fine lesson...{ctl.FD}Then the village would leave{BR}the birds alone, I thought...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}.........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}But... I never reckoned you'd be{BR}that strong... I badly misjudged...{ctl.FD}I'm sorry. Throw me in a cell{BR}or wherever you like...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Just go...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}??{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I'm telling you to go home to Torinco!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:27}Y-you'll forgive me!?{BR}I-I'm sorry!!
entries.us: Hey! Stop! Stop that! Sekreas! Please! Let it go! Why? You're the very one who wanted to exterminate it! Yes, that's very true... I'm sorry! Please forgive me! What on earth is going on? OK, OK, let me explain... please forgive me! I've always been an animal lover. Recently, I discovered a new breed of bird. I've been collecting those birds in this cave and rearing them. But eventually, they multiplied and began looking for food. They came to Torinco and started to eat up the fields. That's when the villagers got mad and tried to exterminate the birds. Isn't that cruel? All the birds wanted was to find some food. Then why did you commission the Guild to exterminate the boss bird? Now don't get angry. Hear me out... I knew that a head honcho had started to emerge amongst the birds and that it was very powerful. I thought even a hunter from the Guild would be no match for it. See, I thought it would serve as a good lesson if the hunter got beaten... That way, I figured the villagers would stop being mean to the birds... So, you wanted to use us?! But it was a gross miscalculation on my part. I had no idea you guys would be so strong. I'm really sorry... Just lock me up in prison or wherever you want. Just get out of my sight! What? You heard me... Leave! You, you'll forgive me? Thank you!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:06}ルディ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}気持ちは わからなくもない…。{ctl.FD}鳥のボスもどこかへ飛び去ったし、もう畑が荒らされる事もないだろ。{ctl.F4:04}また どっかで{BR}畑を荒らすかもしれないぜ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そんときはそんときだよ！{BR}さ、みんな！ 行こうぜ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:06}Rudy...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I can't say I don't understand him...{ctl.FD}The boss bird has flown off too,{BR}so the fields should be safe now.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}It might go and wreck fields{BR}somewhere else, you know?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}We'll deal with that when it comes!{BR}Come on, everyone! Let's go!!

entries.jp: ギルドからのハンターさんですか。わたし、カルバースと申します。{ctl.FD}私の息子が病気になりまして…実は身体の方はもう治ってるんですが…自分はもう死ぬ、治らないんだ…と思いこんでしまったのです。{ctl.FD}いわゆる、{BR}心の病気というやつです。{ctl.FD}まだ怪物もあまり出なかった頃、{BR}家族で出かけたテルミの村…{ctl.FD}また、連れて行ってやれればよいのですが、そうもいかず…せめて、{ctl.FD}ゆかりの品でも見せてやれれば{BR}元気を取り戻すやもしれません。{ctl.FD}お願いです。テルミのみやげ物屋で買い物をしてきてください。
entries.en: Are you the hunter from the Guild?{BR}My name is Culvers.{ctl.FD}My son fell ill... and he has got it{BR}into his head that he won't recover.{ctl.FD}His body is mended, in truth...{BR}A sickness of the heart, they call it.{ctl.FD}Back when there weren't so many{BR}monsters, we took family trips to{ctl.FD}the village of Termi...{ctl.FD}If I could take him again I would,{BR}but that's beyond us.{ctl.FD}So perhaps, if he were shown some token{BR}of the place, his strength might{ctl.FD}return. Please. Go to the gift shop{BR}at Termi and buy something for him.
entries.us: Are you the hunters from the Guild? My name is Culvers. My son has become ill...but actually, the doctor said that he has been cured. But my son is convinced that he is going to die, that he can't be cured. It's one of those so-called psychological illnesses. Back in the days when there weren't many monsters, we used to take family trips to Termi. If we could only take him now... but that's not possible. If we showed him something that is connected to Termi it might get his strength back. Please, could you go and buy something from the gift shop at Termi?

entries.jp: おお、奇跡だ！{BR}息子が元気を取り戻した！{ctl.FD}あなたのおかげです！{BR}あなたは勇者の再来だ！！{ctl.FD}ありがとうございました。報酬は{BR}ギルドにお送りしておきます！
entries.en: Oh, a miracle!{BR}My son has his strength back!{ctl.FD}It's all thanks to you!{BR}You are the hero reincarnated!!{ctl.FD}Thank you so much. I'll send your{BR}fee on to the Guild!
entries.us: Oh, it's a miracle! My son has recovered! It's all thanks to you! You are the second hero! Thank you so much. I'll remit your fee to the Guild!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:26}うーん。うーん。{ctl.FD}ぼく、もう死ぬんだ。{BR}どうせ長くないんだ…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:26}Uuuh. Uuuh.{ctl.FD}I'm going to die.{BR}I don't have long anyway...
entries.us: Ohhhh... I'm going to die. I don't have long...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:27}あんたらが、ギルドのハンターさんかい？ オレがセクレアスだよ。{ctl.FD}この段々畑をよ、妙な鳥が{BR}荒らしてるってのは聞いてるだろ？実はよ、その鳥の大親分がいる{BR}ところを知ってんだよ、オレ。{ctl.FD}そこでよ。その鳥の親分を退治してきてくれってのがオレの頼みだ。{ctl.FD}鳥の親分がいるのはよ、{BR}ここから北東の洞窟だぁ。{ctl.FD}畑を守るためだ。{BR}…頼んだぜ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:27}You people are the Guild hunters?{BR}I'm Sekreas.{ctl.FD}You'll have heard the odd birds are{BR}tearing up these terraced fields?{ctl.FD}Well, I happen to know where the{BR}big boss of those birds sits.{ctl.FD}So here's my request: go and put an{BR}end to that boss bird.{ctl.FD}It's in the cave northeast of here.{ctl.FD}It's for the fields.{BR}...I'm counting on you!
entries.us: Are you the hunters from the Guild? I'm Sekreas. You've heard that a strange flock of birds has been eating up these fields, right? Well, the fact is, I know the place where the head honcho bird is. What I want to ask you to do is exterminate the head honcho bird. That head honcho bird can be found in a cave northeast of here. I beg of you, get that bird! Protect our fields!

entries.jp: {ctl.F6} ン
{ctl.F4:26}なんだか ぼく、{BR}元気がでてきたよ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:26}Somehow I feel my strength{BR}coming back!
entries.us: I feel like I'm getting some strength back!
