entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}ジオ？{ctl.FD}誰の依頼だか知らんがやめときな！命がいくつあっても足らないぜ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}Zio?{ctl.FD}I don't know who hired you, but{BR}drop it! You'd need nine lives!
entries.us: This is a request from an old man in Zema. We are having problems with some strange machines that have begun to roam the outskirts of the village. We have not yet been attacked, but we villagers are afraid and would like something to be done about it. That is the message. The fee offered is 80000 meseta! Will you take on this request? I see. That is too bad.

entries.jp: ジオ？{ctl.FD}そういえば 最近聞かないな。
entries.en: Zio?{ctl.FD}Come to think of it, you don't hear{BR}his name lately.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}ここだけの話だがな…。{ctl.FD}アイードの北の洞窟は山の向こうとつながってるっていう話だ。{ctl.FD}だが、そこに入っていった仲間で{BR}生きて帰ってきたヤツがいねぇ！{ctl.FD}あの向こうにいったい何が……！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}Keep this between us...{ctl.FD}They say the cave north of Aiedo{BR}comes out beyond the mountains.{ctl.FD}But not one of the men who went{BR}in there came back alive!{ctl.FD}What in the world is on the{BR}other side......!
entries.us: This is a request from an old man in Zema. We are having problems with some strange machines that have begun to roam the outskirts of the village. We have not yet been attacked, but we villagers are afraid and would like something to be done about it. That is the message. The fee offered is 80000 meseta! Will you take on this request? I see. That is too bad.

entries.jp: ここだけの話だがな…。{ctl.FD}ジオのヤツを どこぞのハンターが倒しちまったらしいぜ！{ctl.FD}すげぇよな。いったい{BR}どこのどいつだろうな！
entries.en: Between you and me...{ctl.FD}Some hunter or other went and{BR}brought Zio down, they say!{ctl.FD}Incredible. Who in the world{BR}could have managed that!

entries.jp: 最近のモンスターは やたら強くてもうオレの手には負えねぇや。{ctl.FD}そろそろ 新しい職を{BR}考えなきゃなぁ！
entries.en: The monsters lately are so strong{BR}I can't handle them anymore.{ctl.FD}Time I thought about a new trade!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}この街は オレらがいるおかげで{BR}比較的 平和だが…{ctl.FD}ヨソの街じゃあ 丸焼けになったり石にされたり たいへんらしいな！{ctl.FD}ときに、それが全部 ジオの{BR}しわざだってのは本当なのか？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}This town stays fairly peaceful,{BR}on account of us being here...{ctl.FD}But elsewhere they're burned to{BR}cinders or turned to stone, I hear!{ctl.FD}Tell me, is it true that all{BR}of it is Zio's doing?
entries.us: This is a request from an old man in Zema. We are having problems with some strange machines that have begun to roam the outskirts of the village. We have not yet been attacked, but we villagers are afraid and would like something to be done about it. That is the message. The fee offered is 80000 meseta! Will you take on this request? I see. That is too bad.

entries.jp: この街は オレらがいるおかげで{BR}比較的 平和だが…{ctl.FD}ヨソの街じゃあ 丸焼けになったり石にされたり たいへんらしいな！
entries.en: This town's peaceful enough,{BR}with us around...{ctl.FD}but other towns get burned to the{BR}ground or turned to stone, they say!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}よぉライラ！ あいかわらずイイ女だなぁ。たまにはつきあわねぇか？{ctl.F4:02}ありがと。あんたが もうちょっと男前になったら 考えたげるわよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:4201}Hey, Laila! Fine-looking woman as{BR}ever. How about a drink sometime?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Thanks. Get a little better looking{BR}and I'll think about it.

entries.jp: ライラは イイ女なんだが、{BR}ちっとも口説かれてくれねーんだ。やっぱオトコがいるのかなー…。{BR}そういや最近姿を見ないけど……。
entries.en: Laila's a fine woman, but she{BR}won't be wooed, not even a little.{ctl.FD}I wonder if there's already a guy in the{BR}picture... Not that I've seen her lately......

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}ものすごい大軍が よく{BR}北の洞窟を出入りしてるんだよ。{ctl.FD}あれが うわさに聞く{BR}ジオの兵団ってヤツだろうな！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}A huge army of people goes in and{BR}out of the north cave all the time.{ctl.FD}That must be Zio's legion that{BR}everybody's talking about!
entries.us: This is a request from an old man in Zema. We are having problems with some strange machines that have begun to roam the outskirts of the village. We have not yet been attacked, but we villagers are afraid and would like something to be done about it. That is the message. The fee offered is 80000 meseta! Will you take on this request? I see. That is too bad.

entries.jp: もう 北の通路を使っても{BR}だいじょうぶなんだってな。
entries.en: They say the northern pass is{BR}safe to use again now.

entries.jp: ほう？ ライラもいいが この{BR}ねえちゃんもかわいいじゃないか？{ctl.F4:06}きゃーーっ！ やだぁ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}やっ、やめろよ！！
entries.en: Oh ho? Laila's fine, but this{BR}young lady's a pretty one too, eh?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Eeek! Stop it!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}C-cut that out!!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4201}よぉ ライラ！{BR}いつものでいいのかい？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}ごめん、今日は{BR}そんな気分じゃないの。またね。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:4201}Hey, Laila!{BR}The usual?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Sorry, I'm not in the mood{BR}today. Another time.

entries.jp: ライラが最近来てくれないんだ。{ctl.FD}長い仕事なのかな。あの飲みっぷりのいいのがいないと寂しいぜ！
entries.en: Laila hasn't come in of late.{ctl.FD}A long job, maybe. It's a duller{BR}room without a drinker like her!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}特に いい仕事を{BR}隠してないかですって？{ctl.FD}失礼しちゃう！ この受付嬢歴{BR}ゥン年のアイリーンの名にかけて、そんなコト 一切ありません！！{BR}さっさと表にまわってください！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Am I holding back the really{BR}good jobs, you ask?{ctl.FD}How rude! On my name of Eileen,{BR}clerk here these many years,{ctl.FD}I do nothing of the sort!!{BR}Now kindly step around to the front!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}いらっしゃいませ！！{ctl.FD}あなたのハンター人生を豊かに彩るハンターギルド！ 受付はこちら！登録されたハンターの方でしたら{BR}仕事をご紹介させていただきます。{ctl.FD}ただいまでしたら……
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Welcome!!{ctl.FD}The Hunters Guild, here to enrich your{BR}life as a hunter! Sign up right here!{ctl.FD}If you are a registered hunter,{BR}we can introduce you to jobs.{ctl.FD}At the moment we have......

entries.jp: これらがご紹介できますが、{BR}いかがですか？
entries.en: These are the listings I can offer you.{BR}What do you say?

entries.jp: ご冗談を。あなたがたに解決していただいた件ですよ。
entries.en: You must be joking. That's a matter{BR}you resolved for us.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}申し訳ありません。{BR}まだ依頼は入っておりません。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}I am very sorry.{BR}No requests have come in yet.

entries.jp: あなたのハンター人生を豊かに彩るハンターギルドにまたどうぞ！！
entries.en: Do come again to the Hunters Guild, {BR}here to enrich your life as a hunter!!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D906}マイルの村の牧場主さんからの{BR}ご依頼です。{ctl.FD}牧場のサンドワームが大きく{BR}育ちすぎてしまい、困っています。どうか何とかしてください……{BR}ということですが。{ctl.FD}報酬は5000メセタ。{BR}この依頼、お受けになりますか？{ctl.F5:0100}そうですか。{BR}それは残念です。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D906}A request from the rancher{BR}of Mile village.{ctl.FD}"The sand worms on the ranch have{BR}grown far too large, and we are{ctl.FD}at a loss. Please do something...''{BR}That is the message.{ctl.FD}The fee is 5000 meseta.{BR}Will you take this request?{ctl.F5:0100}I see.{BR}That is a shame.
entries.us: This is a request from an old man in Zema. We are having problems with some strange machines that have begun to roam the outskirts of the village. We have not yet been attacked, but we villagers are afraid and would like something to be done about it. That is the message. The fee offered is 80000 meseta! Will you take on this request? I see. That is too bad.

entries.jp: では、マイルに行って 依頼主から直接くわしい話を聞いてください。
entries.en: Then please go to Mile and hear the{BR}details from the client directly.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:1A01}{ctl.F4:11}さっさとマイルへ行って依頼主さんから話を聞いてくださいってば！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:1A01}{ctl.F4:11}Please travel to Mile and hear the{BR}story from your client!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}ギルドの規定で、一度に複数の{BR}依頼を受けることはできません。{ctl.FD}あなたはマイルの牧場主さんからの依頼をお受けになっています。{ctl.FD}やることやってから、{BR}また来てくださいね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Guild rules: you may not take more{BR}than one request at a time.{ctl.FD}You have accepted the request from{BR}the rancher of Mile.{ctl.FD}Come back once you have done{BR}what needs doing!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}おつかれさまでした。みごと{BR}サンドワームを処理しましたね！{ctl.FD}報酬は5000メセタです。{BR}どうぞお受け取りください。{ctl.FD}あなたのハンター人生を豊かに彩るハンターギルドに またどうぞ！！{ctl.F4:01}ひとが襲われる前で良かったな。{BR}牧場主さんにはかわいそうだけど。{ctl.F4:06}でも、めげそうもない人だから、{BR}きっと だいじょうぶよね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Well done. You dealt with those{BR}sand worms splendidly!{ctl.FD}The fee is 5000 meseta.{BR}Please take it.{ctl.FD}Do come again to the Hunters Guild,{BR}here to enrich your life as a hunter!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Good thing it was before anyone got{BR}hurt. Hard on the rancher, though.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}He doesn't look the sort to be kept{BR}down. He'll be all right!

entries.jp: 申し訳ありませんが、この件は{BR}登録を抹消させていただきました。
entries.en: My apologies -- this request has{BR}been struck from the register.

entries.jp: アイードのティンカーベル家よりの依頼がきています。{ctl.FD}わが家の飼い犬「ろっきい」が{BR}いなくなってしまいました。{ctl.FD}どうか探してください……{BR}ということですが。{ctl.FD}とてもハンターのする仕事とは{BR}思えませんね。{ctl.FD}報酬は2000メセタです。{BR}この依頼をお受けになりますか？{ctl.F5:0100}そうですか。{BR}それは残念です。
entries.en: A request from the Tinkerbell family{BR}of Aiedo.{ctl.FD}"Our house dog, Rocky, has{BR}gone missing.{ctl.FD}Please find him......''{BR}That is the message.{ctl.FD}It hardly seems like the sort of job{BR}a hunter would take on.{ctl.FD}The fee is 2000 meseta.{BR}Will you take this request?{ctl.F5:0100}Ah, I see.{BR}What a pity.

entries.jp: では、ティンカーベル家に行って{BR}直接くわしい話を聞いてください。ティンカーベル家は、アイードの{BR}東地区にありますからね。
entries.en: Then go to the Tinkerbell house and{BR}hear the details directly.{ctl.FD}The Tinkerbells are in the eastern{BR}quarter of Aiedo.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:1F01}{ctl.F4:11}早くアイードのティンカーベル家へ行って、話を聞いてくださいよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:1F01}{ctl.F4:11}Do hurry to the Tinkerbell house{BR}in Aiedo and hear the story.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}ギルドの規定で、一度に複数の{BR}依頼を受けることはできません。{ctl.FD}アイードのティンカーベル家からの依頼をお受けになっていますよ。{ctl.FD}やることやってから、{BR}また来てくださいね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Guild rules: you may not take more{BR}than one request at a time.{ctl.FD}You have accepted the request from{BR}the Tinkerbell house in Aiedo.{ctl.FD}Come back once you have done{BR}what needs doing!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}おつかれさまでした。{BR}みごと解決ですね！{ctl.FD}報酬は2000メセタです。{BR}どうぞお受け取りください。{ctl.FD}あなたのハンター人生を豊かに彩るハンターギルドに またどうぞ！！{ctl.F4:01}…ヒネた犬だったなぁ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}そういうとこは、{BR}ルディに似てるかもね！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ばっ、バカ言え！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Well done. Neatly settled!{ctl.FD}The fee is 2000 meseta.{BR}Please take it.{ctl.FD}Do come again to the Hunters Guild,{BR}here to enrich your life as a hunter!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...What a surly dog that was!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}In that respect it might be a{BR}bit like you, Rudy!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}D-don't be ridiculous!

entries.jp: ピアタの学生寮の管理人さんから{BR}依頼がきています。{ctl.FD}当寮で預かっている学生がひとり、行方不明になっています。{ctl.FD}どうか探してください……{BR}ということですが。{ctl.FD}とてもハンターのする仕事とは{BR}思えませんね。{ctl.FD}報酬は3000メセタです。{BR}お引き受けになりますか？{ctl.F5:0100}そうですか。{BR}それは残念です。
entries.en: A request from the manager of the{BR}student dormitory in Piata.{ctl.FD}"One of the students in our charge{BR}has gone missing.{ctl.FD}Please find her......''{BR}That is the message.{ctl.FD}It hardly seems like the kind of job a{BR}hunter would take on.{ctl.FD}The fee is 3000 meseta.{BR}Will you accept this request?{ctl.F5:0100}Ah, I see.{BR}What a pity.
entries.us: We have a request from the caretaker of the student dorms in Piata. 'One of the students entrusted to our care has disappeared. Please find her...' That is the message. This certainly doesn't seem to be the caliber of work for a hunter. The fee offered is 3000 meseta. Will you respond to this request? I see. That is too bad.

entries.jp: では、ピアタの学生寮に行って{BR}直接くわしい話を聞いてください。学生寮は、ピアタの{BR}北西地区にありますからね。
entries.en: Then please go to the student dormitory{BR}in Piata and hear the details directly.{ctl.FD}The dorms are in the northwest{BR}quarter of Piata.
entries.us: In that case, please go the student dorms in Piata and get more details directly from the caretaker. The dorms are located in the northwest region of Piata.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:2701}{ctl.F4:11}とっととピアタの学生寮へ行って、管理人さんの話を聞いてください。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:2701}{ctl.F4:11}Off you go to the student dorms in{BR}Piata, to talk to the manager.
entries.us: Just get going, and talk to the caretaker at the student dorms in Piata.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}ギルドの規定で、一度に複数の{BR}依頼を受けることはできません。{ctl.FD}ピアタの学生寮の管理人さんからの依頼をお受けになっていますよ。{ctl.FD}やることやってから、{BR}また来てくださいね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Guild rules: you may not hold more{BR}than one request at a time.{ctl.FD}You are holding the request from the{BR}manager of the Piata student dorms.{ctl.FD}Come back when you've finished{BR}your task!
entries.us: According to the regulations of the guild, you may not take on more than one job at a time. You have already taken on the job from the caretaker of the student dorms of Piata. Come back when you've finished what you need to do!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}おつかれさまでした。{BR}みごと解決ですね！{ctl.FD}報酬は3000メセタです。{BR}どうぞお受け取りください。{ctl.FD}あなたのハンター人生を豊かに彩るハンターギルドに またどうぞ！！{ctl.F4:01}ジオの魔力のせいだったとはいえ、人間 ああも変わるものなのかな…{ctl.F4:06}こわいわね…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Well done.{BR}A splendid resolution!{ctl.FD}The fee is 3000 meseta.{BR}Please take it.{ctl.FD}Do come again to the Hunters Guild,{BR}here to enrich your life as a hunter!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Zio's sorcery or no, I wonder how a{BR}person can really change so much...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}It's frightening, isn't it...!
entries.us: Good job. Congratulations on a successful resolution! Please accept your commission fee of 3000 meseta. Please come again to the Hunters' Guild where we enrich the lives of hunters! Granted it was due to Zio's spell, but how can a human being change so drastically? It sure is scary!

entries.jp: モンセンに住むエティさんから{BR}依頼がまいっております。{ctl.FD}息子が地割れに{BR}落ちてしまいましたっ！{ctl.FD}たっ、助けてくださいっっ！！{BR}……ということですが。{ctl.FD}報酬は5000メセタです。{BR}この依頼を お受けになりますか？{ctl.F5:0100}そうですか。{BR}それは残念です。
entries.en: A request from Ettie, who lives{BR}in Monsen.{ctl.FD}"My son has fallen into a ravine!{BR}P-please, help him!!''{ctl.FD}......That is the message.{ctl.FD}The fee is 5000 meseta.{BR}Will you take this request?{ctl.F5:0100}Ah, I see.{BR}What a pity.
entries.us: This is a request from Eddie who lives in Monsen. 'My son has fallen into a crack in the earth! Please help my son!' That is the message. The fee offered is 5000 meseta. Will you take on this request? I see. That is too bad.

entries.jp: では モンセンへ行って、{BR}直接くわしい話を聞いてください。エティさんの家はモンセンの東、{BR}地震でできた地割れの真ん前です。
entries.en: Then please go to Monsen and hear the{BR}details directly.{ctl.FD}Ettie's house is east in Monsen,{BR}right by the crack the quake opened.
entries.us: In that case, please go to Monsen and get further details directly from Eddie. Eddie's house is located in the east part of Monsen, right in the middle of the cracks from the earthquake.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}ギルドの規定で、一度に複数の{BR}依頼を受けることはできません。{ctl.FD}あなたは、モンセンのエティさん{BR}からの依頼をお受けになっていますやることやってから{BR}またきてくださいね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Guild rules: you may not hold more{BR}than one request at a time.{ctl.FD}You are holding the request from{BR}Ettie of Monsen.{ctl.FD}Come back when you're finished with{BR}your task!
entries.us: According to the regulations of the guild, you may not take on more than one job at a time. You have already taken on the job from Eddie in Monsen. Come back when you've finished what you need to do!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}お疲れさまでした。{BR}子供さん、無事で良かったですね！報酬の5000メセタが{BR}届いています。どうぞ！{ctl.FD}あなたのハンター人生を豊かに彩るハンターギルドに またどうぞ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Well done.{BR}Thank goodness the child is safe!{ctl.FD}The fee of 5000 meseta has arrived.{BR}Please, take it!{ctl.FD}Do come again to the Hunters Guild,{BR}here to enrich your life as a hunter!!
entries.us: Good job. Thank goodness the child was safe! Your commission fee of 5000 meseta has already been remitted. Please accept it! Please come again to the Hunters' Guild where we enrich the lives of hunters!

entries.jp: ウーゾの村の村長さんからの、{BR}伝書による依頼が来ています。{ctl.FD}村を出て行った娘姉妹が、{BR}それっきり帰ってきません。{ctl.FD}どうか行方を探してください……ということですが。{ctl.FD}報酬は…連れて帰って来てくれればなんと大枚50000メセタです。太っ腹ですね！！{ctl.FD}この件は海を渡る必要がありますが…この依頼をお受けになりますか？{ctl.F5:0100}そうですか。{BR}それは残念です。
entries.en: A request by letter from the chief{BR}of Uzo village.{ctl.FD}"My two daughters left the village{BR}and have not come home since.{ctl.FD}Please find where they have gone......''{BR}That is the message.{ctl.FD}The fee, if you bring them home,{BR}is a whopping 50000 meseta.{ctl.FD}How incredibly generous!!{ctl.FD}This job requires crossing the sea...{BR}Will you take this request?{ctl.F5:0100}Ah, I see.{BR}What a pity.
entries.us: There is a request from the village chief of Uzo via letter transmission. 'My two daughters have left the village and have not returned since. Please find out where they are...' That is the message. The fee offered, if you bring them home, is an incredible 50000 meseta. Quite a generous guy! You will need to cross the ocean for this job... will you take on this request? I see. That is too bad.

entries.jp: では、ウーゾの村長宅に行って{BR}直接くわしい話を聞いてください。ウーゾは、ここから南方の{BR}孤島にある村です。
entries.en: Then go to the chief's house in{BR}Uzo and hear the details directly.{ctl.FD}Uzo is a village on a lonely island{BR}to the south of here.
entries.us: In that case, please go to Uzo and get more details at the village chief's house. Uzo is a village on a deserted island south of here.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:7901}{ctl.F4:11}早く ウーゾの村長さんに{BR}話を聞きに行ってください。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:7901}{ctl.F4:11}Do hurry along and hear what the{BR}chief of Uzo village has to say.
entries.us: Do hurry and get more details from the village chief.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}ギルドの規定で、一度に複数の{BR}依頼を受けることはできません。{ctl.FD}ウーゾの村の村長さんからの依頼をお受けになっていますね。{ctl.FD}やることやってから、{BR}また来てくださいね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Guild rules: you may not hold more{BR}than one request at a time.{ctl.FD}You are holding the request from the{BR}chief of Uzo village.{ctl.FD}Come back when you've finished{BR}your task!
entries.us: According to the regulations of the guild, you may not take on more than one job at a time. You have already taken on the job from the village chief of Uzo. Come back when you've finished what you need to do.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}おつかれさまでした。{BR}みごと解決ですね！{ctl.FD}報酬は大枚50000メセタです。{BR}どうぞお受け取りください。{ctl.FD}なんか釈然としない顔してますね。どうかしましたか？？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…いえ、なんでもないです…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:11}そうですよね！ 報酬もらって{BR}文句はないですよね！！{ctl.FD}あなたのハンター人生を豊かに彩るハンターギルドに またどうぞ！！{ctl.F4:01}なんか損した気分！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}プラスマイナスゼロなんだから{BR}いいじゃない、たまには。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Well done.{BR}A splendid resolution!{ctl.FD}The fee is a mighty 50000 meseta.{BR}Please take it.{ctl.FD}You look less than satisfied.{BR}Is something the matter??{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...No, it's nothing...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:11}Of course not! Nobody complains{BR}once their fee is in hand!!{ctl.FD}Do come again to the Hunters Guild,{BR}here to enrich your life as a hunter!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I feel like I got the short end of the{BR}stick, somehow!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}It came out even, so where's the{BR}harm? Just this once.
entries.us: Good job. Congratulations on a successful resolution! Your commission fee is a whopping 50000 meseta! Please accept the money. You look kind of dissatisfied. Is anything wrong? Er, it's nothing... Well, I can't imagine anything can be amiss! After all, you have received your fee! Please come again to the Hunters' Guild where we enrich the lives of hunters! I feel cheated! You didn't win but you didn't lose anything either. Let it be, this once.

entries.jp: トリンコのカルバースさんより、{BR}伝書による依頼がきています。{ctl.FD}わたしの息子が{BR}病気にかかってしまいました。{ctl.FD}ついては、その対処について、{BR}相談したいことがあります。{ctl.FD}くわしくは、直接お会いしてから{BR}ということで…だそうですが。{ctl.FD}報酬は10000メセタです。この件は海を渡る必要がありますが…{ctl.FD}この依頼を{BR}お受けになりますか？{ctl.F5:0100}そうですか。{BR}それは残念です。
entries.en: A request by letter from Mr. Culvers{BR}of Torinco.{ctl.FD}"My son has fallen ill.{ctl.FD}I would like to consult someone about{BR}how to handle the situation.{ctl.FD}I'd prefer to discuss the details in{BR}person.'' That is the message.{ctl.FD}The fee is 10000 meseta. This job requires{BR}crossing the sea, though...{ctl.FD}Will you take this request?{ctl.F5:0100}Ah, I see.{BR}What a pity.
entries.us: There is a request from Mr. Culvers of Torinco via letter transmission. 'My son has fallen ill. I would like to discuss a certain plan I have to deal with this matter. I will go into more detail after we meet.' That is the message. The fee offered is 10000 meseta. There will be a need to cross the ocean for this job... Will you take on this job? I see. That is too bad.

entries.jp: では、トリンコの村に行って{BR}直接くわしい話を聞いてください。トリンコの村はモンセンの南。{BR}カルバース家は その一番奥です。
entries.en: Then go to the village of Torinco{BR}and hear the details directly.{ctl.FD}Torinco is south of Monsen. The{BR}Culvers house is the furthest back.
entries.us: In that case, please go to the village of Torinco and get more details directly from Mr. Culvers. The village of Torinco is south of Monsen. The Culvers residence is the house farthest in the back.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}ギルドの規定で、一度に複数の{BR}依頼を受けることはできません。{ctl.FD}トリンコのカルバースさんからの{BR}依頼を受けていらっしゃいますよ。やることやってから、{BR}また来てくださいね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Guild rules: you may not hold more{BR}than one request at a time.{ctl.FD}You are holding the request from{BR}Mr. Culvers of Torinco.{ctl.FD}Come back when you've finished{BR}your task!
entries.us: According to the regulations of the guild, you may not take on more than one job at a time. You have already taken on the job from Mr. Culvers of Torinco. Come back when you've finished what you need to do!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}おつかれさまでした。報酬は{BR}10000メセタです。どうぞ！{ctl.FD}あなたのハンター人生を豊かに彩るハンターギルドに またどうぞ！！{ctl.F4:01}あんな おもちゃの剣でも、{BR}人を救うことがあるんだなぁ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あれは本物の勇者の剣だったのよ。…あの子にとっては、ね。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Well done. The fee is{BR}10000 meseta. Here you are!{ctl.FD}Do come again to the Hunters Guild,{BR}here to enrich your life as a hunter!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}To think even a toy sword like that can{BR}save someone...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}That was a true hero's sword.{BR}...To that boy, at least.
entries.us: Good job. The commission fee is 10000 meseta. Here it is! Please come again to the Hunters' Guild where we enrich the lives of hunters! It's amazing that even a toy sword like that could save a life. That was a genuine heroine's sword, that is... to that boy.

entries.jp: トリンコのセクレアスさんからの{BR}伝書による依頼が来ています。{ctl.FD}村の段々畑を妙な鳥の集団が{BR}食い荒らすので困っています。{ctl.FD}どうか退治してください……{BR}ということですが。{ctl.FD}報酬は20000メセタです。この件は海を渡る必要がありますが…{ctl.FD}この依頼を{BR}お受けになりますか？{ctl.F5:0100}そうですか。{BR}それは残念です。
entries.en: A request by letter from Mr. Sekreas{BR}of Torinco.{ctl.FD}"A flock of strange birds is eating{BR}the village terraces bare.{ctl.FD}Please get rid of them......''{BR}That is the message.{ctl.FD}The fee is 20000 meseta. This job{BR}requires crossing the sea, though...{ctl.FD}Will you take this request?{ctl.F5:0100}Ah, I see.{BR}What a pity.
entries.us: This is a request from Mr.Sekreas of Torinco. 'We are at our wits' end due to a flock of birds who are eating up our terraced fields. Please exterminate them...' That is the message. The fee offered is 20000 meseta. There will be a need to cross the ocean for this job... Will you take on this job? I see. That is too bad.

entries.jp: では、トリンコへ行って、直接お話をうかがってください。{ctl.FD}トリンコの村はモンセンの南。{BR}セクレアス家はその中程です。
entries.en: Then please go to Torinco and hear the{BR}details in person.{ctl.FD}Torinco is south of Monsen. The{BR}Sekreas house is the middle one.
entries.us: In that case, please go to Torinco and get more details directly from Mr. Sekreas. The village of Torinco is located south of Monsen. The Sekreas residence is in the middle of the village.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}ギルドの規定で、一度に複数の{BR}依頼を受けることはできません。{ctl.FD}トリンコのセクレアスさんからの{BR}依頼をお受けになっていますよ。{ctl.FD}やることやってから{BR}またきてくださいね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Guild rules: you may not hold more{BR}than one request at a time.{ctl.FD}You are holding the request from{BR}Mr. Sekreas of Torinco.{ctl.FD}Come back when you've finished{BR}your task!
entries.us: According to the regulations of the guild, you may not take on more than one job at a time. You have already taken on the job from Mr. Sekreas of Torinco. Come back when you've finished what you need to do!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}え？ 仕事を終わらせてきた？{ctl.FD}おかしいですねー。依頼主からの{BR}報告も報酬の入金もないですよ？{ctl.FD}あ！ さては仕事だけさせといて{BR}報酬を払わない悪質依頼主ではっ？それは一大事！ ギルドのメンツを保つためにも早々に一大捜査網を…{ctl.F4:01}待ってよ！ いいんだ…{BR}今回は もういいんだ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:11}え？？ …そぉですかぁ？{BR}あなたがたがそう言うのなら…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}正しいことは、必ずしも{BR}ひとつじゃないんだ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ルディ……。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}What? You've finished the job?{ctl.FD}How odd. There's been no report from{BR}the client, and no fee remittance?{ctl.FD}Ah! Then this is one of those{BR}wretches who takes the work and{ctl.FD}never pays! A serious matter! For{BR}the Guild's good name we must open{ctl.FD}a full inquiry at once...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Wait! It's all right...{BR}Leave it, this time...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:11}Eh?? ...Are you quite sure?{BR}Well, if you say so...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}There isn't always just one right{BR}answer...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy......
entries.us: What? You've finished the job? That's strange. There's no word nor remittance of the fee from the requestor. Ah-hah! Is this one of those dirty rascals who won't pay up for services rendered? This is a major problem! We must take care of this immediately since it also means saving face for the Guild... Wait! It's all right... What? You really mean it? Well, if you say so... There is not necessarily just one correct answer to everything. Chaz...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D906}ゼマの長老さんより{BR}依頼がきています。{ctl.FD}村のまわりをヘンな機械がうろつくようになり、困っています。{ctl.FD}今のところ、直接 被害を{BR}こうむっているわけではないが、{ctl.FD}村人が不安がって落ちつかないのでなんとかしてください……{ctl.FD}…ということですが。{BR}報酬は80000メセタです。{ctl.FD}この依頼を{BR}お受けになりますか？{ctl.F5:0100}そうですか。{BR}それは残念です。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D906}A request from the elder of Zema.{ctl.FD}"Strange machines have begun to{BR}prowl around the village.{ctl.FD}While there hasn't been any direct{BR}damage yet,{ctl.FD}the villagers are frightened and{BR}unsettled. Please do something......''{ctl.FD}...That is the message.{BR}The fee is 80000 meseta.{ctl.FD}Will you take this request?{ctl.F5:0100}Ah, I see.{BR}What a pity.
entries.us: This is a request from an old man in Zema. We are having problems with some strange machines that have begun to roam the outskirts of the village. We have not yet been attacked, but we villagers are afraid and would like something to be done about it. That is the message. The fee offered is 80000 meseta! Will you take on this request? I see. That is too bad.

entries.jp: では ゼマに行って、長老さんより直接くわしい話を聞いてください。ゼマの一番奥の家が、{BR}長老さんのおすまいです。
entries.en: Then please go to Zema and hear the{BR}details from the elder directly.{ctl.FD}The house furthest back in Zema is{BR}where the elder lives.
entries.us: In that case, please go to Zema and get further details directly from the old man. The house furthest in the back in Zema is the house of the old man in question.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:B301}{ctl.F4:11}早く ゼマの長老さんに{BR}話を聞いてくださいね。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:B301}{ctl.F4:11}Do hurry and hear what the elder{BR}of Zema has to say.
entries.us: Please hurry and get more details from the old man in Zema.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}ギルドの規定で、一度に複数の{BR}依頼を受けることはできません。{ctl.FD}あなたは、ゼマの長老さんからの{BR}依頼をお受けになっています。{ctl.FD}やることやってから{BR}また来てきださいね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Guild rules: you may not hold more{BR}than one request at a time.{ctl.FD}You are holding the request from{BR}the elder of Zema.{ctl.FD}Come back when you've finished{BR}your task!
entries.us: According to the regulations of the guild, you may not take on more than one job at a time. You have already taken on the job from the old man in Zema. Come back when you've finished what you need to do!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:11}お疲れさまでした。{BR}見事マシンを追い払ったそうで。{ctl.FD}報酬の80000メセタ、{BR}届きたてのホヤホヤです。どうぞ！あなたのハンター人生を豊かに彩るハンターギルドに またどうぞ！！{ctl.F4:01}オレたちのやってる事…あちこちに影響を及ぼしているんだな…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}はずかしいコトは{BR}できないわね、ルディ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:11}Well done. I hear you successfully{BR}drove off those machines.{ctl.FD}The fee of 80000 meseta, fresh from{BR}the vault. Here you go!{ctl.FD}Do come again to the Hunters Guild,{BR}here to enrich your life as a hunter!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What we do... it reaches further{BR}than I thought, doesn't it...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}We can't afford to do anything we'd be{BR}ashamed of, then, Rudy!
entries.us: Good job. Congratulations on driving away those machines. The commission fee of 80000 meseta has just arrived. Here it is! Please come again to the Hunters' Guild where we enrich the lives of hunters! The things we do seem to have consequences all over the place. We need to watch what we do, don't we, Chaz!

entries.jp: 申し訳ありません。この件は{BR}依頼が取り下げられました。
entries.en: My apologies. This request has{BR}been withdrawn.
entries.us: I am sorry but this request has been withdrawn.

entries.us: You Parmanians, why are you here? Go away, go away!

entries.us: This looks like food... ...I think.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}こわそうな目して にらんでるよ…近寄らない方がいいかな。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}He's glaring at me with a scary look...{BR}Better keep my distance.
entries.us: He's glaring at me... Let's move on.

entries.jp: うわーっ。パルマ人だ！{BR}お、お助け！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}別に とって食やしないよぅ。

entries.us: Hey. It's a Parmanian! H...help. Don't worry, I'm not going to hurt you.

entries.jp: ………。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}無視するなよなー。
entries.en: .........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Don't just ignore me!
entries.us: Go away! How rude.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.F4:06}フレナ、この端末からナルバスに{BR}強制停止コードを送れない？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}無理ですわ！ ナルバスは今、外部からの入力を完全に遮断していますシステムの中枢に入りこまない限りアクセスさえもできませんわ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6501}{ctl.F4:06}Frena, can't we send Nurvus{BR}a forced shutdown from here?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Impossible! Nurvus has cut off{BR}every outside input entirely.{ctl.FD}Without reaching the heart of the{BR}system we cannot even touch it!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:06}結局 役に立たなかったわね、{BR}この端末…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:06}So this terminal was no use{BR}to us after all...!

entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"This fissure is dangerous.{BR} Entry forbidden,'' it says.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}地震で壊れたのか…{BR}中に入れる状況じゃない。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Wrecked by the quake...{BR}There is no getting inside.

entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"A Baby Diary''...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}もうちょっと きれいに{BR}整理すればいいのに…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}They could stand to keep this{BR}a little tidier...

entries.en: {ctl.FA:D901}{ctl.F4:01}...properly stopped.{BR}Good, good.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}…ちゃんと動いてるな、{BR}よしよし。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}...running properly.{BR}Fine, fine.

entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Well... so many books on the{BR}art of war!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}いわゆる 調度品ってやつだね。

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}食器が並んでるけど、{BR}質素なものだ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Dishes set out in rows,{BR}but plain ones.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}うわっ！{BR}何日皿を洗ってないんだ！？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Ugh! How many days since{BR}these were washed!?

entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Rows of cheap-looking liquor.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}標語が書いてある。{BR}「幸せは歩いていってしまう」…？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A motto is written up.{BR}"Happiness ends up walking away''...?

entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A motto is written up.{BR}"If you're happy, lend a hand''...??

entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A big full-length mirror.

entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Rows of cheap-looking liquor.

entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A pretty tidy kitchen.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}立派な本棚だ。{BR}中はすかすかだけど。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A splendid bookcase.{BR}Empty inside, though.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}動物に関する本が{BR}いっぱいあるぞ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Plenty of books in here{BR}about animals.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}張り紙がしてある。{BR}「トリメイト始めました」…
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A notice is posted.{BR}"Now stocking Trimate''...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ひとんちの たなを{BR}勝手に開けちゃ いけないよな！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}We really shouldn't go through someone{BR}else's shelves without asking!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}農作物の育て方に関する本かなぁ、よくわかんないけど。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Books on raising crops, I think.{BR}Not that I would know.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}うっ…口に出すのも はばかられる内容の本が！ 興味津々………{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ルディっ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Ah... books whose contents I hesitate{BR}to even say aloud! Riveting......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy!!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4401}{ctl.F4:07}すみません。{BR}わたしとしたことが…{ctl.FD}「コントロールキー」がないと{BR}マシンの起動はできませんの。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:4401}{ctl.F4:07}Forgive me.{BR}How careless of me...{ctl.FD}Without the Control Key the{BR}machine cannot be started.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}いまのところ{BR}他のマシンは必要ないかな？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}No need for any of the other{BR}machines just now, I think.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:D903}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:7001}{ctl.F4:07}早くゼランへ…{BR}お願いしますわ、みなさん！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:D903}{ctl.FA:C002}{ctl.FA:7001}{ctl.F4:07}Quickly, to Zelan...{BR}I beg you all!
entries.us: Quickly, to Zelan... I beseech you all!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:07}お久しぶりです。{BR}マスター・フォーレン！{ctl.FD}え…？ ゼランでなくクランが…{BR}そうでしたの…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:07}It has been a long time.{BR}Master Forren!{ctl.FD}What...? Kuran, and not Zelan...{BR}I see...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:07}システムが すっかり安定すれば{BR}みなさんのお手伝いができるのに…
entries.en: {ctl.F4:07}If only the system were fully{BR}stable, I could be of help...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}反応はない…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}No response...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}カギがかかっている…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}「黒い波動」に気がついて、{BR}あわてて戸じまりしたのね…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}でも これしきのドア…{BR}全く無意味だ…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}It is locked...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}They noticed the Black Wave{BR}and barred the door in a hurry...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}But a door like this is of no help at all...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:6502}{ctl.FA:4201}{ctl.F4:01}廃虚と化した街だ！{BR}これはいったい……。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:6502}{ctl.FA:4201}{ctl.F4:01}The town has been reduced to ruins!{BR}What on earth......

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}これも、ジオのしわざなのか…{BR}ジオめ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Was this Zio's doing too, I wonder...{BR}Zio, curse him!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ジオを倒しても、ジオのために{BR}命を落とした人は還ってはこない…
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Beating Zio will not bring back{BR}the lives he took...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}神秘的な女性の像だ。テルミで見た勇者の像の女性に似ているような…
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A mysterious statue of a woman.{BR}Like the heroine's statue in Termi...
entries.us: It's a mystifying statue of a woman. It's similar to the statue of a heroine I saw in Termi.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「生命エネルギーの不思議」…？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"The Mystery of Life Energy''...?
entries.us: 'The Mystery of Life Energy'.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「ESP技能と思想」…？{BR}難しくて よくわかんないや。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"ESP Skills and Ideology''...?{BR}Too difficult. I can't follow it.
entries.us: 'ESP Ability and Ideology.' It's too difficult to understand.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「デゾリス・その光と影」…{BR}ふーん…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"Dezolis: Its Light and Shadow''...{BR}Hmm...
entries.us: 'Dezolis  Its Light and Shadow'  Hmm...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}読みさしの本だ。{BR}「偉大なる先人の記」…だって。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A book left half-read.{BR}"Records of the Great Predecessors''.
entries.us: It's a half-read book. It says 'Records of Great Predecessors'...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「人工冬眠に関する技術資料」…？何だ、こりゃ？？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"Technical Notes on Artificial{BR}Hibernation''... What is this??
entries.us: 'Technical Manual for Artificial Hibernation'... What's this?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「マジックとテクニック・{BR} その効果と相関関係」か…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"Magic and Techniques: Their Effects{BR}and Correlation'', huh...
entries.us: 'Magic and Technique Its Effect and Correlation' Hmm...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「精神と物質」…？{BR}難しくて よくわかんないや。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"Mind and Matter''...?{BR}Too difficult. I can't follow it.
entries.us: 'Spirit and Matter'... It's too difficult to understand.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}……？？？{BR}見たこともない字で書かれている。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}......???{BR}Written in characters I've never seen.
entries.us: What's this? It's written in an alphabet I've never seen before.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}テレパシーボール…{BR}ルツの記憶…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}今はオレが受け継いでいる…{BR}そういうことだ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A telepathy ball...{BR}Lutz's memories...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}I've inherited them now...{BR}That's what it comes to.
entries.us: Telepathy Ball... Lutz's memory... I've inherited it now... That's what it means.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}炎の像…{BR}これ、御神体っていうのかね！？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A statue of flame...{BR}Is this what they call a sacred object?
entries.us: The statue of flames... Are you saying this is an object of worship?

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9801}{ctl.F4:01}これがイクリプストーチか！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9801}{ctl.F4:01}So this is the Eclipse Torch!
entries.us: So this is the Eclipse Torch!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}イクリプストーチは{BR}もう無い……。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}The Eclipse Torch is gone......
entries.us: The Eclipse Torch is gone.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}暖炉だ。この辺は特に寒いから、{BR}ありがたいね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A fireplace. It gets bitterly cold around{BR}here, so this is welcome!
entries.us: It's a fireplace. Around here it gets especially cold, so this is a welcome find!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}デゾリアンの台所だ。{BR}なかなか きれい好きみたいだね。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A Dezolian kitchen.{BR}They do like things clean.
entries.us: It's a Dezolisian kitchen. Appears they like to keep things clean.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ひとんちの たなを{BR}勝手に開けちゃ いけないよな！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}We shouldn't go opening cupboards{BR}in someone else's house!
entries.us: It's not nice to open cabinets in other people's houses without their permission!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}暖炉が二つもあるよ。{BR}相当な寒がり屋さんだな。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Two fireplaces, no less.{BR}Somebody really feels the cold.
entries.us: There are two fireplaces. It must really get cold here.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}空きびんコレクターかな？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}An empty bottle collector, perhaps?
entries.us: I wonder if they collect empty bottles?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}食器が並んでる。意外と{BR}パルマ人と変わらないものだな。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}The dishes are laid out. Not so{BR}different from Palman ones, really.
entries.us: Here are their dishes. They're surprisingly similar to Parmanian dishes.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「火」！{BR}スゴい本があるなぁ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"Fire''!{BR}What a book to have.
entries.us: 'Fire'... What a book!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}大きな鏡だ。デゾリアンも{BR}身だしなみには 気を遣うのかな？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A big mirror. So Dezolians mind{BR}their appearance too, do they?
entries.us: It's a big mirror. I guess Dezolisians are self-conscious about their looks.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「道具屋道」…。{BR}べ、勉強熱心なご主人だ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"The Way of the Tool Merchant''...{BR}A-a keen student, this shopkeeper.
entries.us: 'Equipment Store Management'... Ah, a pretty studious owner.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}……読めない字が書いてある。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}......Written in characters I can't read.
entries.us: ...it's written in an alphabet I can't read.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}炎の像…{BR}これ、御神体っていうのかね！？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A statue of flame...{BR}Is this what they call a sacred object?
entries.us: A statue of flame... You call this an object of worship?

entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"A Psychological Study of Fear of{BR}Heights''... Then why a two-story house??
entries.us: 'Fear of Heights: A Psychological Examination'... Then why build a two-story house?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}これはデゾリアンのかがり火とは{BR}趣が違うね。ただのたいまつだ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}This doesn't have the feel of a Dezolian{BR}watch fire. Just a plain torch.
entries.us: This is different from the elegance of the Dezolisian watch fire. This is merely a torch light.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「デゾリスの気候と健康管理」…{BR}なかなか勉強熱心な奥さんだ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"Dezolian Climate and Health Management''{BR}...A keen student, this lady.
entries.us: 'Dezolisian Climate and Health Maintenance'... A pretty studious lady of the house.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}暖炉だ。{BR}暖かくて しあわせ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A fireplace.{BR}Warm and wonderful!
entries.us: It's a fireplace. It's nice and warm, oh joy!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}台所だ。{BR}なかなか きれいにしてある。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A kitchen.{BR}Kept quite clean.
entries.us: It's the kitchen. They keep it pretty clean.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}出納帳だ。{BR}出しっぱなしは危険だなぁ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}An account book.{BR}Risky, leaving that lying open.
entries.us: It's an account book. It's dangerous to leave this out.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「宿屋の運営と接客サービス」…{BR}なかなか勉強熱心なだんなさんだ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"Running an Inn, and Serving the{BR}Guest''... Quite the studious innkeeper.
entries.us: 'Hotel Management and Customer Service'... A pretty studious husband.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}元宿屋さんだから、{BR}これは いわゆる調度品だ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}He used to keep an inn, so these{BR}would be the furnishings.
entries.us: He's a hotel owner, so these must be his supplies.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}シャトルシップのなれの果てだ。{BR}二度と飛び立つことはないだろう…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ちなみに 悪いのはルディだ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}The sad remains of the shuttle ship.{BR}It'll never fly again...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}For the record, this was Rudy's fault.
entries.us: This is the wreck of the shuttle ship. I guess it'll never fly again. By the way, it's your fault.

entries.us: What is this fire? The Dezolisians believe in fire! This watch fire is an object of their worship.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}デゾリアンの かがり火か…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A Dezolian watch fire, then...
entries.us: Hmm, the watch fire of Dezolisians...

entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A fireplace.{BR}Warm and wonderful!

entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}The tavern's fittings.{BR}Better not touch without asking.
entries.us: It's a blueprint of a bar. You shouldn't indiscriminately touch things!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ひとんちの たなを{BR}勝手に開けちゃ いけないよな！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}We shouldn't go opening cupboards{BR}in someone else's house!
entries.us: It's not nice to open cabinets in other people's house without their permission!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}いわゆる 調度品ってやつかな。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Furnishings, I suppose.
entries.us: These must be supplies.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「アルゴルを護りし者、{BR} 聖剣エルシディオンとともに」…
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"Those Who Guarded Algol, With the{BR}Holy Sword Elcidion''...
entries.us: 'Those Who Protected Algo, Along with the Sacred Sword, Elsydeon'...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}これはデゾリアンのかがり火とは{BR}趣が違うね。ただのたいまつだ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}This doesn't have the feel of a Dezolian{BR}watch fire. Just a plain torch.
entries.us: This is different from the elegance of the Dezolisian watch fire. This is merely a torch light.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}本が出しっぱなしだ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}The books have been left out.
entries.us: They left some books out.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}暖炉だ。{BR}暖かくて しあわせ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A fireplace.{BR}Warm and wonderful!
entries.us: It's a fireplace. It's nice and warm, oh joy!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}へぇ…。{BR}なかなか立派な家具だ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Well...{BR}Rather fine furniture.
entries.us: Wow! Impressive furniture.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}古びた本がある。{BR}「デゾリス開拓史」か…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}An old, worn book.{BR}"A History of Settling Dezolis''...
entries.us: Here's a pretty worn book. Hmm, 'Reclamation of Dezolis'...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ひとんちの たなを{BR}勝手に開けちゃ いけないよな！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}We shouldn't go opening cupboards{BR}in someone else's house!
entries.us: It's not nice to open cabinets in other people's houses without their permission!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}古びた本がある。{BR}「デゾリスに生きる」か…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}An old, worn book.{BR}"Living on Dezolis''...
entries.us: Here's a pretty worn book. Hmm, 'Living in Dezolis'...

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9401}{ctl.F4:01}この火は…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}デゾリアンは、火を信仰しとる！{BR}このかがり火も信仰の対象じゃよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9401}{ctl.F4:01}This fire is...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Dezolians hold fire sacred!{BR}This watch fire is worshipped too.
entries.us: What's this fire? The Dezolians believe in fire! This watch fire is an object of their worship.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}デゾリアンの かがり火か…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A Dezolian watch fire, then...
entries.us: Hmm, the Dezolian's watch fire...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「連れデゾリスペンギン」って{BR}書いてある。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}It says "Your Dezolis Penguin{BR}Companion''.
entries.us: It has 'The Dezolian Penguin Companion' written on it.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ひとんちの たなを{BR}勝手に開けちゃ いけないよな！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}We shouldn't go opening cupboards{BR}in someone else's house!
entries.us: It's not nice to open cabinets in other people's houses without their permission!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}暖炉だ。{BR}暖かくて しあわせ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A fireplace.{BR}Warm and wonderful!
entries.us: It's a fireplace. It's nice and warm, oh joy!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}食器が並んでいる。意外と{BR}パルマ人と変わらないものだな。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}The dishes are laid out. Not so{BR}different from Palman ones, really.
entries.us: Here are their dishes. They're surprisingly similar to Parmanian dishes.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「旅の落書き帳・ご自由に何でも{BR} 書き込んで下さい」…だって。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"Traveler's Scribble Book -- write{BR}whatever you please'', it says.
entries.us: It says 'A Travel Scribble Notebook  Feel Free to Write Whatever You Want'...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}デゾリアンの台所だ。{BR}なかなか きれい好きのようだ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A Dezolian kitchen.{BR}They do like things clean.
entries.us: It's a Dezolian kitchen. Appears they like to keep things clean.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}本に本がはさんである。{BR}昨日の夜の読みさしに違いない。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A book tucked inside another book.{BR}Last night's reading, no doubt.
entries.us: There's a book sandwiched inside another book. Must be a book mark from the previous night.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}本がいっぱいだ。{BR}なかなかの読書家みたい。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Books everywhere.{BR}Quite the reader, it appears.
entries.us: It's a bunch of books. They sure seem to like to read.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:08}チェック完了。クランのシステムはすべて正常に動作しています。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:08}Check complete. Every system on{BR}Kuran is running normally.
entries.us: Check completed. The systems in Kuran are all functioning normally.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9E03}{ctl.FA:8302}{ctl.FA:7001}{ctl.F4:01}これが「ゼラン」の中心部？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}とりたてて{BR}異常は なさそうだけど…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9E03}{ctl.FA:8302}{ctl.FA:7001}{ctl.F4:01}This is the heart of Zelan?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Nothing especially wrong with it,{BR}by the look of things...
entries.us: Is this the central area of Zelan? There don't seem to be any abnormality in particular.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:08}モタビアの異常の原因は{BR}「クラン」にあったのです。{ctl.FD}ゼランのシステムは正常です。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そうだったのか…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:08}The cause of Motavia's troubles{BR}lay in Kuran.{ctl.FD}Zelan's systems are normal.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}So that was it...
entries.us: Kuran caused the disasters on Motavia. Zelan's systems are all functioning normally. So that was it?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}デゾリスの雪嵐は やまない…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}デゾリスの異常気象は、{BR}何か他に原因があると思われます。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}The snowstorm on Dezolis won't{BR}stop...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Something else must be behind the{BR}foul weather on Dezolis.
entries.us: The snowstorm in Dezolis is not abating! I believe there is another cause for the abnormal climate in Dezolis.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:08}チェック完了。ゼランのシステムはすべて正常に動作しています。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:08}Check complete. Every system on{BR}Zelan is running normally.
entries.us: Check completed. The systems in Zelan are all functioning normally.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9E01}{ctl.F4:08}気象システムは{BR}正常に動作しています。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}デゾリスを狂わせているものは{BR}他にあるっていうのか…！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9E01}{ctl.F4:08}The weather system is running{BR}normally.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Then whatever is driving Dezolis{BR}mad is something else...!
entries.us: The climate control system is functioning normally. Are you saying something else is causing the abnormalities in Dezolis?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:08}気象システムは{BR}正常に動作しています。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:08}The weather system is running{BR}normally.
entries.us: The climate control system is functioning normally.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}家は修理の真っ最中だ。{BR}もうすぐ 元に戻りそうだね。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}The house is being repaired.{BR}Nearly back to itself, by the look.
entries.us: The house is in the midst of renovation. It looks like it'll be back to normal soon.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}これは ただのたいまつだ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}This is just a plain torch.
entries.us: This is just a plain old torch light.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}台所だ。新品そのものだ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A kitchen. Brand new, all of it!
entries.us: It's a brand new kitchen!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}暖炉だ。ピカピカの新品だね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A fireplace. Shiny and new!
entries.us: It's a shiny new fireplace!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}台所だ。{BR}…ちょっと汚れてきたかな？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A kitchen.{BR}...Getting a bit dirty already?
entries.us: It's a kitchen. Appears to be getting a little dirty.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}食器も だいぶ増えたね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Quite a few more dishes now!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}暖炉だ。{BR}…ちょっと汚れてきたかな？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A fireplace.{BR}...Getting a bit dirty already?
entries.us: It's a fireplace. Appears to be getting a little dirty.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}いつの間に 本棚が！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A bookshelf, out of nowhere!
entries.us: A large bookshelf!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}食器も ピカピカだね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}The dishes are gleaming too!
entries.us: The dishes are sqeeky clean!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}新しい暖炉は{BR}火の勢いが違うね。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A new fireplace really does burn{BR}differently.
entries.us: The strength of a fire is stronger when it's in a new fireplace.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}「客が集まる店のインテリア」…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}"Interior Designs That Draw a Crowd''...
entries.us: 'Interior Designs to Attract Customers'...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}新品の本棚だ。{BR}まだ本もそんなに入ってない。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A brand-new bookshelf.{BR}Not many books in it yet.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}大きい鏡台だ。これまた新品で{BR}ツルツルのピカピカだ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}A big dressing mirror. New as well,{BR}smooth and gleaming!
entries.us: It's a big mirror. This too is new, smooth, and shiny!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}調度品も新品ばっかりで{BR}気持ちいいね。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}All the furnishings are brand new too.{BR}It does feel good.
entries.us: It feels good, what with the supplies being new.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9E01}{ctl.F4:01}ドアに張り紙がしてある。{BR}「都合によりしばらく休業」か…。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9E01}{ctl.F4:01}A notice on the door. "Temporarily closed{BR}due to unforeseen circumstances''... huh.
entries.us: There's a notice posted on the door. Hmmm... 'Due to circumstances, we will be closed'

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}店が開いている！{BR}ご主人、元気になったのかな？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}The shop's open!{BR}The owner must be better.
entries.us: The store is open! I wonder if the owner feels better?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} ライラはどこかな？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}I wonder where Laila is?
entries.us: I wonder where Alys is?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:02} アカデミーの学長に会って、{BR}くわしい話を聞かなきゃね！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}あこの仕事の依頼主だね？{BR}どこにいるのかな？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:02}We need to meet the principal and hear{BR}the full story!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}He's our client, right?{BR}I wonder where he is.
entries.us: We better see the principal and get more details! So he's the one who requested the commission. I wonder where he is?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}あこのアカデミーの地下室に{BR}モンスターが出るっていうのか…。{ctl.F4:02} ふん…{BR}なんかウラがありそうだね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Monsters, in the basement of this{BR}academy...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Hmph. Feels like there's more to it{BR}than that.
entries.us: Are you saying that there are monsters in the basement of this academy? Hmm... Sounds like there's something behind all this!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:02} 地下室の調査を、学長に続いて{BR}ハーンからも依頼されたわ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}い無理矢理{BR}お金とったんじゃないですかぁ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}あ二兎を追う者は、{BR}二兎を得ちゃうってやつだね！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}いこの人たちについていって{BR}大丈夫なんだろうか…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:02}Both the principal and Hahn have hired us{BR}to investigate the basement.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Didn't you just force me to pay you?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Hey, "he who chases two rabbits catches{BR}both!''{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Will I really be all right tagging along with{BR}these people...?
entries.us: Both the principal and Hahn have asked us to inspect the basement. Are you sure you're not just trying to take my money? Hey, you've already paid, so don't cry over spilt milk. I wonder if I'll be OK going with these people...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} 地下室のカプセルは{BR}いったい何なんだろう…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}あ学長に話をつけるよ！{BR}ホラ、あんたも来な！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}いうわーん。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}What are those capsules downstairs?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}We'll make the principal explain!{BR}Come on, you're coming too!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}M-me...?
entries.us: I wonder what that capsules in the basement are for? I'm going to make the principal tell us! Hey, you! You're coming along too! Who m...me?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:03}あバースバレーはピアタの北東です。早く 教授を助けに行きましょう！{ctl.F4:02} ジオ、か…。{BR}気に入らないねぇ…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:03}Birth Valley is northeast of Piata.{BR}Let's hurry and save the professor!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Zio, huh... I don't like the sound of that.
entries.us: Birth Valley is located northeast of Piata. Let's hurry and go to the professor's rescue! Ah...Zio. I don't like the sound of that!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:03}いうう…ホルト教授が石に…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} モルカムまで行けばアルシュリンが手に入るから大丈夫だよ、ハーン。{ctl.F4:03}いモルカム…ゼマの南にあるという{BR}モタビアンの村ですね？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}あほら、しっかりしなよ！{BR}情けないねぇ、まったく！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:03}Oh dear... Professor Holt, turned to{BR}stone...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}It's all right, Hahn. We can get{BR}Alshlin if we reach Molcum.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Uh, Molcum... the Motavian village{BR}south of Zema, you said?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Chin up, will you? Honestly,{BR}you're hopeless!
entries.us: Oh, no! Professor Holt has been turned to stone! He'll be all right, Hahn. We can go to Molcum and obtain the medecine Alshline. Molcum...you mean that Motavian village south of Zema? Oh, calm down! Really, you're pathetic!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} モルカムは{BR}ジオにやられてしまった…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}あオレが来たときは もう遅かった…すまんな。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02} ………。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}いでも、トノエに行けば{BR}アルシュリンは手に入りますよね！{ctl.F4:01} トノエは…クルップの村から{BR}北へ行ったとこだっけ？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Molcum... Zio destroyed it.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}By the time I got there it was{BR}already too late. I'm sorry.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}.........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}But we can still get Alshlin{BR}in Tonoe, can't we?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Tonoe was... north of the village of{BR}Krupp, wasn't it?
entries.us: Molcum has been done in by Zio... By the time I arrived, it was too late. Sorry. Hmmm... But, once we get to Tonoe, we'll be able to obtain Alshline, right? Tonoe...now that's north of the village of Krup, right?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} トノエの地下倉庫に{BR}アルシュリンがあるのか…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}あパイク、{BR}案内よろしくたのむわよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}いああ、このオレに{BR}どーんと まかせてくれよ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}So the Alshlin is in Tonoe's{BR}underground storehouse...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Pyke, we're counting on you to lead{BR}the way.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Yeah. Leave the whole thing to me.
entries.us: So there's Alshline in the underground warehouse of Tonoe? Thanks for being our guide, Gryz. No problem. You can leave everything to me.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:02} ようやく アルシュリンが{BR}手に入ったわね！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}あ早く ゼマに行って{BR}教授たちを助けましょうよぅ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}いついてく。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}あパイク…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:02}We finally have the Alshlin!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Let's hurry to Zema and save the{BR}professor and the others.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}I'm coming too.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Pyke...
entries.us: We've finally obtained the Alshline! Let's hurry to Zema and rescue the professor and his team. I'll join you. AGryz...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}あホルト教授は、バースバレーの奥に行ったっきりだ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}いせっかく石化はとけたのに…{BR}教授！ 教授はどこに！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02} 世話のかかるおっさんだねぇ、{BR}あんたの先生もさ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Professor Holt went deep into Birth{BR}Valley and never came back...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}After all we did to cure the stone{BR}curse... Professor! Where are you?!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}That teacher of yours is a handful,{BR}isn't he!
entries.us: Professor Holt has gone into the depths of Birth Valley and hasn't come back since. BAfter all we did to obtain the Alshline to turn him from stone back to flesh. This teacher of yours is such a pain in the butt!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:06}あ暴走したシステムを 早く{BR}止めなければ…シードのためにも！{ctl.F4:01} まず、フレナってアンドロイドを{BR}助けるんだったね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}いジオスフォートに行くんだな。{BR}…望むところだ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}あマイルの村から流砂を越えて見える城ですね。北から回っていくしか…
entries.en: {ctl.F4:06}We have to stop the runaway system,{BR}for Seed's sake, too!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}First we need to rescue that android,{BR}Frena.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}To Zio's Fort, then. Suits me fine!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}The castle past the quicksand from{BR}Mile. We'll have to swing north.
entries.us: We've got to hurry and stop the system that's running out of control...for Seed's sake, too! First, we'll have to rescue this android called Demi. We'll have to go to Zio's Fort. Just what we all wanted to do! You're talking about that castle beyond the quicksand that can be seen from the village of Mile. I guess we'll have to go around from the north.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} なんてこった！{BR}ライラが…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あルディ、ライラさんの言う通り、{BR}スレイっていう人を探しましょう？{ctl.F4:07}いそれにはまず、「ランドマスター」ですわ。流砂も平気で渡れますの！「マシンセンター」を探しましょ？クルップの村の南方にありますわ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}No... Laila...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy, let's do as Laila said{BR}and find this Thray.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}For that we'll want the Land Master.{BR}It crosses quicksand with ease!{ctl.FD}The Machine Center lies south{BR}of Krupp. Shall we?
entries.us: Oh no! Alys is... Chaz, let's do as Alys says and find this person called Rune. We'll need the 'Land Rover' to cross the quicksand. Let's find the 'Machine Center.' It's located south of  the village of Krup!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:07} 「ランドマスター」は{BR}「マシンセンター」の中ですわ！{ctl.FD}早く まいりましょ？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:07}The Land Master is inside the{BR}Machine Center!{ctl.FD}Let's hurry over there, shall we?
entries.us: The Land Rover is inside the Machine Center! Let's hurry!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} よし！{BR}ランドマスターが 手に入ったぞ！{ctl.F4:05}いこれで東の流砂をこえて{BR}「ラデアの塔」に行けるな。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あそこに、{BR}スレイっていう人がいるのね…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} あんまり 会いたかないけど、{BR}しょうがないな…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}All right! The Land Master is ours!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Now we can cross the eastern{BR}quicksand to the Ladea Tower.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}And that Thray person is there...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I'd rather not see him, but{BR}we have no choice!
entries.us: OK!  We've got the Land Rover! Now we can cross the quicksand to the east and get to The Ladea Tower. And there's supposed to be a person called Rune there. I don't feel much like seeing him, but I guess we have no choice!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04} ジオのマジックバリアを破るには、「サイコウォンド」が必要だ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}いラデアの塔の{BR}最上階にあるのね？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}あそいつを使って、{BR}さっさとジオを倒しちまおう！{ctl.FD}そして…ライラに{BR}早く良くなってもらわなきゃ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}To break Zio's magic barrier{BR}we need the Psycho Wand.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}And it's on the top floor of{BR}the Ladea Tower?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Then we take it and finish Zio{BR}for good!{ctl.FD}And Laila... she has to get{BR}better, and soon.
entries.us: To break through Zio's magic barrier, we'll need the 'Psycho-wand.' And it's on the topmost floor of The Ladea Tower? Let's defeat Zio with that wand! And...Alys needs to get better quick!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} ジオが手下をよこしたのか…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}あよほど サイコウォンドが{BR}気に障るようだな。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}い次がくる前に、{BR}早く手に入れちまおうぜ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}So Zio sent his underlings...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}The Psycho Wand must trouble him{BR}a great deal.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Let's take it before the next{BR}wave shows up.
entries.us: We've defeated Zio's underlings, but... It seems that the Psycho-wand works well against him. Let's get it quickly before the next ones come.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}あサイコウォンドがあれば、{BR}ジオのパワーも恐れることはない。{ctl.F4:07}いジオスフォートの地下…{BR}ナルバスにまいりましょう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} ちくしょう……ライラ……！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あルディ…
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}With the Psycho Wand, Zio's power{BR}is nothing to fear.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}To Nurvus, then, beneath Zio's Fort!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Damn it... Laila...!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy...
entries.us: As long as we have the Psycho-wand, we needn't be afraid of Zio's power. Let's go to Nurvus in the basement of Zio's Fort...! Blast! Alys...! Chaz...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}あ結界はといた。{BR}あとはナルバスに突入あるのみ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}いジオも放ってはおけませんが、まずナルバスを止めるのが先決ですわ！{ctl.F4:01} ……うん……そうだな……！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あルディ…
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}The barrier is broken. All that's{BR}left is to storm Nurvus!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Zio cannot be left alone either,{BR}but Nurvus must come first!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...Yeah... you're right...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy...
entries.us: We've broken the invisible barrier. Now all we have to do is get to Nurvus! We can't abandon the situation with Zio, but yes, stopping Nurvus is a higher priority! Yes, that's true... Chaz...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} ナルバスは フレナのおかげで{BR}なんとか止まったけど…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あ環境維持システムの機能回復のため人工惑星「ゼラン」に行かないと…そこに、フォーレンがいるのね…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}あいいから はやいとこ{BR}「ゼラン」に向かおうぜ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Nurvus is stopped, thanks to{BR}Frena, but...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}To restore the climate control system{BR}we must reach Zelan.{ctl.FD}Forren is there, isn't he...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Enough talk. Let's get{BR}to Zelan!
entries.us: We've been able to stop Nurvus, thanks to Demi, but... We've got to go to the artificial satellite 'Zelan' to restore the functions of the environmental control system. And Wren is there, right? Whatever. Let's just hurry to 'Zelan!'

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:08} システム異常の原因は、{BR}「クラン」にあったのです。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}い人工惑星「クラン」…そこで{BR}何がおきているというの…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:08}The cause of the system fault{BR}lies in Kuran.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}The artificial planet Kuran... what on{BR}earth is happening up there?
entries.us: The cause of the system's abnormalities turns out to be in 'Kuran.' The artificial satellite 'Kuran' ...what did you say was happening there?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} クランに行くには、ラジャが{BR}教えてくれた宇宙船を探さないと…{ctl.F4:06}いラジャの寺院から北西の{BR}タイラーの街に行くのね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}あその前にリュオンの街の酒場で、{BR}少し休んでいかんか？{ctl.FD}わしの親友がやってるんじゃ。{BR}ギュナ、っちゅーんじゃがの。{ctl.FD}いろいろユカイな話も聞けるから、コーカイはさせんぞ、ホッホ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} ………。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}To reach Kuran we need the ship{BR}Raja told us about...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}So we head northwest of Raja's{BR}temple, to the town of Tyler.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Before that, why not rest a while{BR}at the tavern in Ryuon?{ctl.FD}An old friend of mine runs it.{BR}Gyuna, his name is.{ctl.FD}You'll hear talk of rare mirth,{BR}and never rue the berth! Ho ho!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}.........
entries.us: To get to Kuran, we'll have to find that space ship Raja told us about. So that means we're going to the town of Tyler northwest of Raja's temple? Before doing that, why don't we take a little break at the inn in Ryuon? You'll be able to hear a lot of fun stories, you won't regret it, ha, ha! Great...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} ギュナの話だと、タイラーの街の{BR}地下に宇宙船があるって。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}いお墓に 秘密が{BR}あるらしいけど…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}あハカったかのような{BR}ハカバカしい展開じゃの。ホッホ！{ctl.F4:01} ………。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Gyuna says the ship is underground,{BR}beneath the town of Tyler.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Something about a secret{BR}in the graveyard?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}A grave development, no doubt about{BR}it. Ho ho!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}.........
entries.us: According to Gyuna's story, the space ship is underground in the town of Tyler. I hear there's some secret with the grave... This seems like a planned turn of events. Ha, ha! Hmm...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}あ「ランディール」も見つかったし、クランへ行くしかないだろう。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}いいよいよね…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}あ至急 環境維持システムの{BR}暴走の原因を解明しましょう。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} よし、行こう！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}We've found the Landeel. Kuran{BR}is the only road left.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}This is it, then...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Let us determine at once why the{BR}environmental system ran wild.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Right. Let's go!
entries.us: Well, we've found the 'Landale' so we'll just have to go to Kuran. Finally! Let's immediately identify reason the environmental control system is out of control. OK. Let's go!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:06}いダーク・ファルスをやっつけても、デゾリスの異常が回復しないわ…！{ctl.F4:09}あだぁから、あれはガルベルクの塔が原因だと言うとろうが！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}あ何にせよ、デゾリスは{BR}調査する必要を認めます。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}いともかく、{BR}あちこち行ってみましょ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} ガルベルクの塔、か…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:06}We beat Dark Falz, and still{BR}Dezolis hasn't recovered!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}I keep telling you, it's the{BR}Gallberg Tower behind it all!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}In any case, I concede Dezolis{BR}warrants investigation.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Either way, let's go look around!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}The Gallberg Tower, then...!
entries.us: We've beaten Dark Force, but Dezolis is not recovering! I've been telling you, the problem lies in the Garuberk Tower! In any event, I do acknowledge there's a need to investigate Dezolis. Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go! Hmm...the Garuberk Tower...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:06} 北のガルベルクの塔に、エスパーのシェスが ひとりで向かったって！{ctl.F4:04}い塔のまわりは、人食い樹の森が{BR}広がっていて危険という話だったな{ctl.F4:01}あ放ってはおけない。{BR}助けに行かなきゃ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:06}Shess the Esper went off to the{BR}Gallberg Tower in the north, alone!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}They say the forest around it is{BR}full of man-eating trees.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}We can't leave her to it.{BR}We have to help!
entries.us: Apparently Kyra from Esper has headed towards the Garuberk Tower alone! I've heard the forest surrounding the tower is full of carnivorous trees. We can't let her go alone. We've got to go help her!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:0A} 「ルツ」様だったら、人食い樹を{BR}滅ぼす方法をご存知かも…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}いふーん…エスパーの長、ねぇ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A} 「ルツ」様に{BR}お目通りを お願いしてみるわ！{ctl.FD}エスパーの館に行きましょう！{BR}ミースの街の南東よ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:0A}Lord Lutz might know how to{BR}destroy the man-eating trees...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Hmm... chief of the Espers, huh.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}I'll ask for an audience{BR}with Lord Lutz!{ctl.FD}Let's go to the Esper Mansion!{BR}Southeast of Meese!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:0A}い早く奥の院に行きましょう。そこにルツ様は いらっしゃるはずよ。{ctl.FD}ああ…ルツ様にお会いできるなんて夢みたい…。どうしよう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} はぁ…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:0A}Let's hurry to the inner sanctum.{BR}Lord Lutz should be there.{ctl.FD}Oh... to meet Lord Lutz, it's{BR}like a dream... what'll I do!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Sigh...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} スレイがルツだったなんて…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}あ人食い樹には{BR}「イクリプストーチ」だ！{ctl.FD}急いで エスパーの館の西、{BR}「ガンビアス大寺院」に向かうぞ！ルディ！ 短い脚で{BR}トロトロ歩いてんじゃねぇよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}いあーん。{BR}ルツ様のイメージがぁー！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Thray was Lutz all along...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}For the man-eating trees,{BR}we need the Eclipse Torch!{ctl.FD}We make for the Gungbius Grand{BR}Temple, west of the Esper Mansion!{ctl.FD}Rudy! Quit dawdling along{BR}on those short legs!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Nooo! My image of Lord Lutz!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:06}いイクリプストーチが{BR}持ち去られちゃったわ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} 何者なんだ、あいつら…{BR}「エアキャッスル」って…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}あとにかく、ランディールのセンサーで調べてみましょう。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} エアポートに戻ればいいんだな。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:06}The Eclipse Torch has been{BR}carried off!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Who were they...?{BR}And this "Air Castle''...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}In any case, let us search{BR}with the Landeel's sensors.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Back to the airport, then.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} エアキャッスルか…{BR}不気味な城だ…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}いあーら。怖いならシェスお姉さんの後ろから ついてらっしゃいよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} うっ、うるさぁい！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あ………。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}So this is the Air Castle...{BR}What an eerie place...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Oh my. If you're frightened, just follow{BR}close behind big sister Shess!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}S-shut up!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}.........

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}あ3人衆は倒した。後は親玉を見つけイクリプストーチを取り返すのみ！{ctl.F4:01} 親玉って……？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}あ………。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}We took down the trio. Now to find{BR}their master and take the Torch back!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Their master......?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}.........

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} イクリプストーチを{BR}ようやく取り返したぞ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}いよくやりましたね、ファル。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あありがとう、フォーレン。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}いこれで、ガルベルクの塔のまわりのあの人食い樹も 怖くないわね！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}We've got the Eclipse Torch{BR}back at last!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Well done, Fal.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Thank you, Forren.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Now we don't need to fear those man-{BR}eating trees around Gallberg Tower!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}あ人食い樹は イクリプストーチの{BR}聖なる光が焼きつくした。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} ようやく ガルベルクの塔に{BR}入れるというわけか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}いよーし！{BR}ミースのみんな、待ってて…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}The holy light of the Eclipse{BR}Torch has burned the trees away.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}So now we can finally get{BR}into Gallberg Tower!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Right! Hold on, everyone in Meese...!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} ダーク・ファルスは倒したのに、{BR}あの火柱は いったい…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あガンビアス大寺院の{BR}方角だったわ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}いとにかく 行ってみよう！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}We beat Dark Falz, so what{BR}was that pillar of fire...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}It came from the direction of{BR}the Gungbius Grand Temple...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Whatever it was, let's just go and see!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}い「リュクロス」の所在を示すと{BR}いわれる「エアロプリズム」…{ctl.FD}それは、モタビアの{BR}「戦士の神殿」にある！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あクルップの村から見えた{BR}小島の神殿ね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} リュクロス…{BR}すべての秘密の答が眠る場所、か…
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}The Aeroprism, said to reveal{BR}where Ryucross lies...{ctl.FD}It rests in the Warriors' Temple,{BR}on Motavia!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}The temple on that islet we{BR}could see from the village of Krupp.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Ryucross... where the answer to{BR}every secret sleeps, huh...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} フロームーバーが{BR}手に入ったぞ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}いこれで、海だろうが湖だろうが{BR}渡り放題ってわけだな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あクルップから「戦士の神殿」にも{BR}行けるようになったのね。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}We've got the Flow Mover.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Sea or lake, we can cross{BR}whatever we please now!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}So we can reach the Warriors'{BR}Temple from Krupp as well.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} ヘンなヤツが{BR}ついてきちゃったなぁ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0B}いあいや、おかまいなく。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}あルディ！ 神殿に急ぐぞ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} あ…ああ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}We've picked up a strange one.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0B}No, no, pay me no mind.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Rudy! To the temple, quickly.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}R-right.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}あこれがエアロプリズムか…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0B}いほほぅ…なかなかの珍品ですな。{BR}ちょっと見せてもらえませんかな？{ctl.F4:01} ああ、ほら どうぞ…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}あダメだ、ルディ！{ctl.FD}…シアム、悪いが これは{BR}我々にとって大事なものなんだ。{ctl.FD}興味本意に扱われては迷惑だな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0B}いあ、こりゃ失礼。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あもう、ルディ！{BR}お人好しなんだから…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} …こいつのどこに リュクロスの{BR}秘密が隠されてるってんだ？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}So this is the Aeroprism...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0B}Oho... quite the rarity.{BR}Might I have a look at it?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Sure, here you go...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Don't, Rudy!{ctl.FD}Siam, forgive me, but this is{BR}precious to us.{ctl.FD}We'd rather it not be handled{BR}out of idle curiosity!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0B}Ah, my apologies.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Honestly, Rudy! You are far{BR}too trusting!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Where in this thing is the secret{BR}of Ryucross meant to be hidden?
entries.us: So this is the Aero-Prism. My...quite a curiosity. May I take a look at it? Oh, here... No, don't, Chaz! Sorry about this, Seth, but this thing is very important to us. We can't just have it handled out of curiosity! Oh, forgive me. Oh, Chaz! You're just too good-natured! So, where is this secret of Rykros hidden?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:06}いシアムさんが、あんな…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}あ敵さんも なりふり{BR}かまわなくなってきたな。{ctl.FD}もたもたしては いられない。{BR}リュクロスに急がねば！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01} リュクロスって、{BR}いったい何なんだ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}い行ってみるしかないわ、{BR}ルディ…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:06}Siam did something like that...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Our enemy is clearly getting more{BR}desperate and reckless.{ctl.FD}We cannot waste any time.{BR}We must hurry to Ryucross!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Ryucross... what in the{BR}world is it!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}We have no choice but to go see for{BR}ourselves, Rudy...!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:06}あ「勇気の塔」と「力の塔」…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}い二つの塔の番人に会ってこないと、レ・ルーフから話が聞けないのか…{ctl.F4:01} 儀式と言っていたな…{BR}どういうことなんだ？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:06}The Tower of Courage and the{BR}Tower of Power...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}So Le Roof will not speak to us{BR}until we meet both keepers...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}A rite, he called it...{BR}What did he mean by that?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}いスレイ…エスパーの館に{BR}いったい何があるっていうんだ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04} いいから、だまって{BR}オレについてこい！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}い………。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Thray... what exactly is waiting{BR}at the Esper Mansion?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Never mind that. Keep quiet{BR}and follow me!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}.........

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} エルシディオンに「会う」…{BR}どういうことなんだろう…？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}To "meet'' the Elcidion...{BR}What could that mean...?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} モタビアに いったい{BR}何がおこったていうんだ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}いくわしい内容は 不明です。大至急来てくれ、という事以外は何も…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}What on earth has happened{BR}on Motavia?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}The details are unknown. Nothing{BR}beyond a plea to come at once...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} これが最後の戦いだ！{ctl.FD}行くぞ、ピアタの北の大穴へ！{BR}「深遠なる闇」の懐へ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あええ、ルディ…行きましょう！{BR}行って、いっしょに戦いましょう！{ctl.F4:08}い動作確認完了。わたしの{BR}全ての機能に支障ありません。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}あおうよ…行ってみるか！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}This is the last battle!{ctl.FD}To the great chasm north of Piata! Into{BR}the heart of the Profound Darkness!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Yes, Rudy... let's go!{BR}Let's go and fight together!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Diagnostics complete. All my{BR}functions are unimpaired.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Yeah... let's do it!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01} これが最後の戦いだ！{ctl.FD}行くぞ、ピアタの北の大穴へ！{BR}「深遠なる闇」の懐へ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あええ、ルディ…行きましょう！{BR}行って、いっしょに戦いましょう！{ctl.F4:08}い動作確認完了。わたしの{BR}全ての機能に支障ありません。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}あおうよ…行ってみるか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}い今こそ、ぼくの秘密特訓の{BR}成果を見せるときだよ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}This is the last battle!{ctl.FD}To the great chasm north of Piata! Into{BR}the heart of the Profound Darkness!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Yes, Rudy... let's go!{BR}Let's go and fight together!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Diagnostics complete. All my{BR}functions are unimpaired.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Yeah... let's do it!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Now's the time to show what my{BR}secret training has done!

entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}This is the last battle!{ctl.FD}To the great chasm north of Piata!
