entries.jp: {ctl.F2:000030}{ctl.F4:03}教授！ よくご無事で！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}おお、ハーン！ 助けにきて{BR}くれたのか！ でかした！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}どうやらここは安全みたいね。でもよくひとりで逃げてこられたわね？{ctl.F4:0D}ああ、いや、危ないところを{BR}この人に助けられての。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:0392}{ctl.F2:000031}{ctl.F4:06}ようこそ、みなさん。{BR}歓迎します。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…………！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}あ…あんたは…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ファル、っていいます。{BR}よろしく。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}……ファル……{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}その耳…！ あんた、何者なの…？それにここはいったい……！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ここは バイオプラント…{ctl.FD}千年前の文明が作りだした{BR}生命工学の研究施設です。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000032}{ctl.F4:03}こ、これが古代超文明の…！{BR}まだ動いてるじゃないか！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ええ、そうです。{BR}それも、ここだけではありません。他にも千年前のシステムで、機能を維持してる物はたくさんあります。そういうシステムが「大崩壊」後もモタビアの気象や地殻・生態系を…コントロールしてきたからこそ、{BR}人間は絶滅をまぬがれたのです。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}…ほ、本当なのか、それは…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}しかし、それにしては最近の{BR}環境破壊…ひどすぎやせんか…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}コントロールシステムが{BR}機能を維持していたといっても、{ctl.FD}あなた方がかろうじて生きていけるレベルを保つのがせいぜいでした。でも、それらのシステムさえも{BR}今や 暴走を始めているんです！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}ルディ………わかる？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}え？………いやぁー……。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}じゃあ最近増えたバイオモンスターって…もしかしてここから……！？{ctl.F4:06}ええ…残念ながら…。{ctl.FD}……あとは「シード」から{BR}お聞きください……こちらです。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}「シード」？？
entries.en: {ctl.F2:000030}{ctl.F4:03}Professor! Thank goodness{BR}you're safe!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}Oh, Hahn! You came to help me!{BR}Well done, lad!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Seems safe enough here.{BR}But how did you get out on your own?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}Well, actually, I was in danger,{BR}and this person here saved me.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:0392}{ctl.F2:000031}{ctl.F4:06}Welcome, all of you.{BR}I humbly bid you welcome.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}............!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Wh... who are you...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}My name is Fal.{BR}How do you do.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}......Fal......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Those ears...! What are you...?{BR}And what is this place......!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}This is the Bio-plant...{ctl.FD}A bio-engineering research facility{BR}built by a civilization from a{ctl.FD}thousand years ago.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000032}{ctl.F4:03}Th-this is from the ancient advanced{BR}civilization...! It's still operational!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Yes, it is. And this is not{BR}the only one, either.{ctl.FD}Many other systems from a thousand{BR}years ago are still functioning.{ctl.FD}Because those systems continued{BR}to govern Motavia's weather, its{ctl.FD}crust, and its ecosystem after the{BR}Great Collapse, humankind{ctl.FD}managed to avoid extinction.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}...I-is that really true...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}But even so, the recent environmental{BR}destruction... isn't it excessive...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Although the control systems continued{BR}to function, they still only produced{ctl.FD}conditions barely sufficient for human{BR}survival.{ctl.FD}And now, even those systems have{BR}begun to run wild!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Rudy......... following this?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Eh? ......Not really......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Then the bio-monsters that have{BR}multiplied lately... are from here...!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Yes... I'm afraid so...{ctl.FD}......You should hear the rest from{BR}Seed...... This way.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Seed??
entries.us: Professor! Thank goodness you're safe! Oh, it's you, Hahn! You came to rescue me! Good job! Well, it seems pretty safe here, but, how on earth were you able to escape on your own? Well, you see, this person here came to my rescue. Who? Welcome, everybody. I'm glad to have you here. What?! Who are you? My name is Rika. Pleased to meet you. Rika. Those ears... What on earth are you? And what is this place!? This is the Bio-plant. It's a research facility for bio engineering created by a thousand year-old civilization. Th...this is from an ancient advanced civilization! Is it still operational? Oh, yes. What's more, this isn't the only one. There are many such systems that have maintained their functionality. And it's thanks to these systems which control Motavia's climate, soil, and ecology systems that the human race was able to avoid total destruction after the 'Great Collapse.' Really? Is that true? If that's the case, how come this recent environmental destruction is taking place? Even though the control system is still functioning, it can barely maintain the minimal conditions for your existence. Even now this system is starting to run out of control! Chaz....do you understand? What? Well...ah... Then, does that mean the recent increase of Bio-monsters is coming from here? Yes, unfortunately so. ...If you want to know more, talk to 'Seed'. He's over there. 'Seed'?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:02}で、シードとかって人はどこだい？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}…目の前にいますよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}え…な、何？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}わたしはこのバイオプラントの{BR}管理コンピュータ「シード」です。{ctl.F4:03}す…すごい…！ 人工知能だ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}し、信じられん！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}おっしゃる通り、こことて例外ではありません。暴走を始めています。システムは わたしの手を離れ、{BR}有害モンスターを生み続けています{ctl.F4:03}やはり……！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}このまま 各システムの暴走を{BR}放置し続ければ…{ctl.FD}モンスターに加えて、異常気象や{BR}地殻変動が さらに激しくなり、{ctl.FD}このモタビアは{BR}滅亡してしまうでしょう…！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}……………{ctl.FD}どっ、どどどどどどーしよう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}システムを止めるしかないね！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}だって止めたら止めたで生きていく環境は保てなくなるんじゃ…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}わざわざ{BR}かきまわしてるよりはいい！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}でもそのシステムって あちこちにたくさんあるんじゃないの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}だいじょうぶ。各システムに{BR}エネルギーを供給しているプラント「ナルバス」さえ停止させれば{BR}すべてのシステムがダウンします。{ctl.F4:00}まず ナルバスの管理アンドロイド「{ctl.F2:000035}フレナ」を助けてください！{ctl.FD}ナルバスを止められるのは{BR}彼女しかいないのです！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}助ける？{BR}助けるってどういうことよ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}フレナは今、ジオという男に{BR}捕らわれているのです。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}またジオか！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}いったい何者なんだ！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}ジオという男が何者なのかは{BR}わたしにもわかりません。{ctl.FD}しかしジオがフレナを幽閉しているという情報は確かに得ています。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}わかったよ、そのフレナってのを{BR}助ければいいんだろ？{ctl.FD}いったい{BR}どこに捕まってるっていうんだい？{ctl.F4:06}ジオの城です…{BR}{ctl.F2:000036}その名を「ジオスフォート」…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}それってもしかして…{BR}マイルの流砂の向こうの……？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}あの まがまがしい城か！！{ctl.FD}あの場所だったら、{BR}ゼマの北から回りこむしか…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F9:13}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:02}かなり遠回りだけど…でもこんな話聞いちまっちゃ行くっきゃないね！フフ…なんだか久しぶりに{BR}わくわくしてきちゃった！{ctl.FD}ついでに いけすかない{BR}ジオとかってのもノシてやるか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}おお！ そうか！{BR}そうこなくちゃな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F9:1D}{ctl.F2:000037}{ctl.F4:00}行ってくれますか？ ではファルを…連れて行ってあげてください。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}このコはいったい何なの？ 妙にそのへんの事情にもくわしいし…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}わたしの…子供です。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}もしや…あんたの作った{BR}人工生命だというのか！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}そうです。「大崩壊」前の{BR}プロトタイプの遺伝子情報を元に、千年間改良を重ねてきたものです。一通りの教育もほどこしてあります必ずあなたがたの力になりますよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000038}{ctl.F4:02}シード……わかった、あずかるよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}よろしくお願いします！{ctl.FD}あたし、一度 外の世界へ{BR}行ってみたかったんです！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}ファル…気をつけて…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}よし！{BR}ジオスフォートへ向かうよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}わしは一足先にアカデミーに戻る！このことを広く世間に知らせねばな
entries.en: {ctl.F4:02}So where's this Seed person?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}...Right in front of you.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Eh... wh-what?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}I am Seed, the managing computer{BR}of this Bio-plant.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}A-astonishing...! An artificial{BR}intelligence!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}I-I don't believe it!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}As she says, this place is no{BR}exception. It has begun to run wild.{ctl.FD}The system is out of my hands and{BR}continues breeding harmful monsters.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Just as I thought......!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}If the systems are left to run{BR}wild in this manner...{ctl.FD}then besides the monsters, the foul{BR}weather and the shifting of the{ctl.FD}crust will worsen further, and Motavia{BR}will face total destruction...!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:03}...............{ctl.FD}Wh-wh-what do we do!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}We stop the system, that's what!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}But if we stop it, wouldn't we lose{BR}the conditions needed to survive...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Better than letting things continue{BR}to spiral out of control!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}But aren't there many of these{BR}systems, all over the place?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}It's all right. Every system draws{BR}its energy from one plant.{ctl.FD}Stop Nurvus and they all go down.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}First, please rescue Nurvus's{BR}managing android,{ctl.F2:000035} Frena!{ctl.FD}She alone can stop Nurvus!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Rescue?{BR}What do you mean, rescue?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}Frena is held prisoner by a man{BR}called Zio.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Zio again!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Who in the world is this guy, anyway!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}What manner of man Zio is, I do{BR}not know either.{ctl.FD}But that he holds Frena captive,{BR}of that I am certain.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}All right. We rescue this Frena{BR}person, and that's that?{ctl.FD}Where exactly is she being held?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}A certain castle...{BR}{ctl.F2:000036}Its name is Zio's Fort...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}Isn't that the one beyond the{BR}quicksand at Mile......?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}That sinister-looking castle!!{ctl.FD}To get there we'd have to come{BR}around from north of Zema...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F9:13}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:02}It's quite a detour... but having heard{BR}all that, we've got to go!{ctl.FD}Heh... it's been a while since{BR}my blood's been pumping this much!{ctl.FD}And while we're at it, maybe we'll take{BR}down this insufferable Zio guy, too!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Ha! That's more like it!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F9:1D}{ctl.F2:000037}{ctl.F4:00}You will go? Then please...{BR}take Fal along with you.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}What is this girl, exactly? She seems{BR}strangely knowledgeable about all this...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}She is... my child.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}You don't mean... an artificial{BR}lifeform you created!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}I do. Built on genetic data from a{BR}prototype from before the Great{ctl.FD}Collapse, refined over a thousand{BR}years. She has an education, too.{ctl.FD}She will be a great help to you.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000038}{ctl.F4:02}Seed...... All right, we'll{BR}bring her along!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Thank you!{ctl.FD}I've always wanted to see the{BR}outside world!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}Fal... take care...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Right!{BR}We're off to Zio's Fort!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0D}I'll go on ahead to the Academy!{BR}The world must know about this.
entries.us: So, where's this person called Seed? He's right in front of you. What's going on? I am 'Seed', the control computer for this Bio-plant. Wow! An artificial intelligence! I...I can't believe it! That's right, this is no exception. Check my status here. The system is beyond my control. It is continuously breeding harmful monsters. Just as I thought. If we leave each of these systems running out of control... along with the monster problem, we will have abnormal climate conditions and violent changes in the planet's surface. Motavia will be destroyed! What shall we do? The only thing we can do is shut down the system! But stopping the system itself will cause problems. We won't be able to maintain the ecosystem! That's better than the system ruining everything! But, these systems are spread out all over the place! Don't worry. All we have to do is to shut down the plant 'Nurvus' which supplies energy to each system. That will shut them all down. First, please rescue the control android 'Demi.' She's the only one that can stop Nurvus. Rescue? What do you mean rescue? Right now, Demi is being held hostage by a man named Zio. Zio again! Who on earth is this Zio!? I myself don't know what Zio is all about. So all we have to do is rescue this Demi, right? Where is she being held hostage? She is with Zio, And the name of that castle is Zio's Fort! Is that by any chance... beyond the quicksand of Mile? Oh, that sinister-looking castle north of Zema. It's a pretty long way to go, but having heard all this we have no choice. Hee hee, it's been a long time since I've felt so excited! And while we're at it, why don't we get rid of that disgusting character, Zio! Hey! That's the spirit! So, you will go? Please take Rika with you. Who is this girl anyway? She seems curiously knowledgeable about these matters... She is...my child. Are you saying that she is an artificial life form? That's right. She is a product of a thousand years of improvement on genetic information from a prototype prior to the 'Great Collapse.' I have also given her a basic education. She will surely be a great help to you. All right, Seed. We'll take her! Thank you! I've always wanted to be able to see the outside world! Rika, take care... OK! Let's get going to Zio's Fort! I must first go back to the academy! We have to spread this information as much as possible.

entries.jp: わたしが モンスターの発生を{BR}抑えるには 方法はただ一つ…{ctl.FD}千年にわたる研究の成果を{BR}世に送り出した今、{ctl.FD}それを実行するに{BR}なんら支障はない…
entries.en: There is only one method for me to{BR}suppress the emergence of monsters...{ctl.FD}Now that the fruits of a thousand years{BR}of research has been unleashed to the{ctl.FD}world, nothing stands in the way{BR}of enacting it...
entries.us: There is only one way for me to stem the outbreak of monsters. Now that I have sent into the world the fruit of a thousand years worth of research, there are no obstacles to its execution.

entries.jp: {ctl.F2:000039}{ctl.F4:06}外だぁああ！{ctl.FD}空って…こんなに青い…！{BR}お花…きれい…！{ctl.FD}うわぁああ…すてき…！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00003A}{ctl.F4:01}今までずっとプラントの奥にいて、見る物すべてが新鮮なんだなぁ…。
entries.en: {ctl.F2:000039}{ctl.F4:06}The outsiiide!{ctl.FD}The sky... it's so blue...!{BR}Flowers... so pretty...!{ctl.FD}Ohhh... how wonderful...!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00003A}{ctl.F4:01}After being shut away in the Bio-plant all{BR}this time, everything must be so novel...
entries.us: We're outdoors! Wow, I didn't know the sky was so blue! These flowers... they're so beautiful! How lovely! Being cooped up all this time underground, everything must be so novel...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}え…爆発！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}…………！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00003D}{ctl.F4:06}シード！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}ファル、あんたはシードの{BR}意志を継いで行くんだ！{ctl.FD}もう後ろを見るのはやめな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}………はいっ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}What... an explosion!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}............!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00003D}{ctl.F4:06}Seed!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Fal, you are the one who's going to{BR}carry on Seed's legacy from here!{ctl.FD}No more looking back!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}.........Yes!!
entries.us: What was that? An explosion! Seed! Rika, you must carry on the will of Seed! You can't look back now! I know...

entries.jp: {ctl.F2:000053}{ctl.F4:01}やったぁ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}このサイコウォンドさえあれば{BR}ジオも恐るるに足らず、ってわけだ{ctl.F2:03FB}{ctl.F4:07}…おふた方、{BR}どうかなさいましたの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000054}{ctl.F4:04}ファル…きみもか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}スレイ……。{ctl.F2:000055}{ctl.F9:27}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}ど、どうしたんだい、二人とも？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ルディ！{BR}すぐクルップに戻るんだ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}え？？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}もたもたすんな！ 行くぞ！！
entries.en: {ctl.F2:000053}{ctl.F4:01}We did it!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}With this Psycho Wand, Zio{BR}won't be a threat anymore!{ctl.F2:03FB}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}...You two, is something{BR}the matter?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000054}{ctl.F4:04}Fal... you feel it too?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Thray......{ctl.F2:000055}{ctl.F9:27}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Wh-what is it, you two?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Rudy!{BR}Back to Krupp, now!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What??{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Don't dawdle! Move!!
entries.us: We did it! So, as long as we have this Psycho-wand, there's no need to fear Zio. You two, is anything wrong? Rika...you too! Rune... What's going on, you two? Chaz! We've got to return to Krup right away! Huh? Get a move on it! We're leaving!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}スレイ！ やっぱり{BR}ここにいたのか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:0394}{ctl.F4:04}来たか、ルディ！{ctl.FD}その短い脚で{BR}よく ここまで登ってきたな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}スレイ、{BR}冗談言ってる場合じゃないんだ！{ctl.FD}頼む！ オレたちに{BR}力をかしてくれ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ん？ …ライラはどうした？{BR}何か、あったのか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}実は…{ctl.FD}………………{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}そうか…そんなことが…。{BR}ライラ…。{ctl.FD}まぁしかし、話は早い。{BR}「サイコウォンド」さえあれば…！{ctl.F4:06}「サイコウォンド」…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ああ、オレは{BR}そいつを取りに来たんだ。{ctl.FD}それこそがジオのマジックバリアを打ち消せる、唯一の武器だ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}じゃあ…スレイ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}サイコウォンドはこのラデアの塔の最上階に封印されているはずだが…実はまだ手に入れていないんだ。{ctl.FD}これから取りに行くんだが…、{BR}つきあってもらえるか？{ctl.FD}サイコウォンドが手に入ったら、{BR}その時こそ 喜んで手を貸そう。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}あ…ああ、わかったよ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Thray! I knew you'd be here!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:0394}{ctl.F4:04}You made it, Rudy!{ctl.FD}I'm impressed you climbed all the way up{BR}here on those short legs of yours!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Thray, this is no time{BR}for jokes!{ctl.FD}Please! Lend us your strength!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Hm? ...Where's Laila?{BR}Has something happened?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}The truth is...{ctl.FD}..................{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}I see... so that's what happened...{BR}Laila...{ctl.FD}Well, that simplifies things. So long{BR}as we have the Psycho Wand...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}The Psycho Wand...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Yes. That's what I came here for.{ctl.FD}It is the one weapon that can dispel{BR}Zio's magic barrier!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Then, Thray--!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}The Psycho Wand should be sealed on{BR}the top floor of the Ladea Tower...{ctl.FD}so I don't actually have it yet.{ctl.FD}I'm on my way go to get it now.{BR}Want to come along?{ctl.FD}Once we have the Psycho Wand in hand,{BR}then I'll gladly lend my aid.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}A-all right, understood.
entries.us: Rune! So you were here after all! You've come, Chaz! Amazing that you got all the way up here with those short legs of yours! Rune, this is no time for jokes! I implore you. Give us your assistance! Hey? What happened to Alys? Is something wrong? Well, the fact is... Is that right... Such a thing happened...  Alys... But let's not be hasty. As soon as we get the Psycho-wand... 'Psycho-wand'? Yep, I came here to get it. The Psycho-wand is the only weapon that can break through Zio's magic barrier! So...Rune! The Psycho-wand is supposedly sealed up in the uppermost level of The Ladea Tower. I haven't got my hands on it yet. I'm on my way to get it now. Will you accompany me? Once you find the Psycho-wand, I will be more than happy to lend a helping hand. OK, OK, I get it.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}これが…サイコウォンド！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}結界を解くぞ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}So this is... the Psycho Wand!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Now to break the barrier!
entries.us: So, this is the Psycho-wand! We can now break the barrier!

entries.jp: ふぁはははは！ これだぁ！{BR}この時を待っていたのだぁ！{ctl.F7}ジオさまの命により この{BR}サイコウォンド、いただいていく！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}ジオの手下か！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ふん、品のない客が来たもんだ。{BR}ルディ、サイコウォンドを渡すな！{ctl.F4:01}言われるまでもないさ！{BR}いちいち命令すんな！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}もう！ そんなこと言ってる場合？来るわよ！
entries.en: Fwahahaha! This is it!{BR}I have waited for this moment!{ctl.F7}By Lord Zio's command, I am{BR}taking the Psycho Wand!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}One of Zio's minions!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Hmph, what a boorish guest.{BR}Rudy, don't give up the wand!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I don't need to be told that!{BR}Stop bossing me around!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Honestly! Is now really the time?{BR}It's coming!
entries.us: Ha, ha, ha! This is it! I've been waiting for this moment! Upon the decree of Zio I am taking the Psycho-wand! You're Zio's underling!? Hmmph, what a brain dead kid you are. Chaz, don't let him get the Psycho-wand! You don't have to tell me that! Stop ordering me around all the time! Come on! Is this any time to bicker? It's coming!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:06}ここも…生きているんですね。{BR}シードやナルバスから独立して…{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:07}ここには、他にも多くのマシンが{BR}格納されていますのよ。{ctl.FD}でも 長いこと使っていなかった{BR}から、メインテナンスが必要かも…{ctl.F4:01}なんだか知らないけどすごいなー。こんな機械、よく扱えるね。{ctl.FD}その調子でシステム暴走を止めようとして、ジオに捕まったのかい？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}ええ、そうですわ。{BR}乱暴な方ですね、あの方。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}フフ…面白いこと言うな、あんた。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}でも、みなさん、ジオを倒しても{BR}根本的解決にはなりませんのよ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}え？ システムの暴走は{BR}ジオが起こしたんじゃないの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}ええ。「ゼラン」が異常な命令を{BR}出したのが原因ですの。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}そんな！ ゼランが、まさか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ゼラン、って何だよ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00004E}{ctl.F4:07}アルゴル星系の環境維持システムを統括する総合管理ベース「ゼラン」モタビアの反対側を公転する{BR}軌道ステーションですわ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}ひゃあー。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そこまでいくと手に負えないなぁ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}まず、ジオを倒して ナルバスを{BR}止めることを考えようぜ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:01}ああ、そうだな…！{ctl.FD}ジオを倒してもダメ…？ となると気になるのは…ダーク…ファルス！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:07}良かったぁ！ 大丈夫です！{ctl.FD}ランドマスターは{BR}今すぐ動かせますわ！{ctl.FD}外に出ましょう。{BR}ランドマスターが出てきますわ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:06}This place is alive too...{BR}Independent of Seed and Nurvus...{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:07}A great many other machines are{BR}housed here, you know.{ctl.FD}Though they've gone unused for so long,{BR}they may require maintenance...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I don't understand a bit of it, but{BR}it's impressive.{ctl.FD}You handle machines like these so well.{ctl.FD}Is that how Zio caught you? Trying{BR}to stop the systems running wild?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Yes, that's right.{BR}He is a rather violent person, isn't he?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Heh... that's an interesting way for{BR}you to phrase it.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}But beating Zio won't solve{BR}the underlying problem, you know?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}What? Zio didn't set the systems{BR}running wild?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}No. Zelan gave out abnormal orders.{BR}That is the cause.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}That can't be! Not Zelan!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What's Zelan?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00004E}{ctl.F4:07}The central base governing every{BR}climate system in the Algol system.{ctl.FD}An orbital station, circling{BR}opposite Motavia.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}Whoa...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}That's beyond anything we{BR}can handle.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}First let's think about beating Zio{BR}and stopping Nurvus!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:01}Yes... you're right!{ctl.FD}Beating Zio isn't enough...? Then{BR}what worries me is... Dark... Falz!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:07}Oh, good! It's all right!{ctl.FD}The Land Master can be moved{BR}right away!{ctl.FD}Let's go outside.{BR}It will come out to us.
entries.us: This place is still alive... It has become independent from Seed and Nurvus! A lot of other machines are housed here, but they haven't been used for a long time. They probably need some repairs. I have no idea what these machines are, but this is some place. You're pretty adept at handling these machines. Were you caught by Zio while you were trying to get the system back under control? Yes, that's right. Zio is very violent. Very funny. Defeating Zio is not going to solve the problem. What? Isn't the system being out of control a result of Zio's doing? No. The real cause of the problem is that Zelan has been issuing abnormal commands. Impossible! Not Zelan! Zelan, what's that? Zelan is the central control for the Algo solar system's environmental maintenance systems. It's an orbiting station on the other side of Motavia. Wow. How are we going to get there?! First, let's think about defeating Zio and stopping Nurvus! Yeah, you're right. It's not enough just defeating Zio? If that's the case this makes me worry about... Dark Force! Don't worry, it'll be alright! I'll start the Land Rover up! Let's go outside. It will be waiting.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}うわっ！ なんだ！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}しっ、死ぬーっ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}大の男がオタオタすんじゃないよ！…なんでもないじゃないか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ほ、ほんとだ…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Whoa! What was that!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:03}W-we're going to die!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:02}Stop acting like a flustered child!{BR}You're a grown man... It's nothing at all!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Th-that's right.
entries.us: Yikes! What's that!? We..we're going to die! Stop cowering! Men are such cowards! It's nothing!  That...that's true.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:4401}{ctl.F4:07}すみません。{BR}わたしとしたことが…{ctl.FD}コントロールキーがないと{BR}マシンの機動はできないんですわ…
entries.en: {ctl.FA:4401}{ctl.F4:07}Forgive me.{BR}How careless of me...{ctl.FD}Without the Control Key the{BR}machine cannot be started...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:07}他のマシンは{BR}メインテナンスしないと…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}残念だなぁ{BR}巨大ロボットに乗りたかったのに
entries.en: {ctl.F4:07}The other machines need{BR}maintenance first...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What a shame.{BR}I wanted to pilot a giant robot.
entries.us: So, this is the Psycho-wand! We can now break the barrier!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:13}ば…かな…！{BR}わたしは不死のはず…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00006E}そうでは…なかったのですか…{BR}か、神よ…なぜ…{ctl.FD}なぜ…私をお見捨てになる…{BR}ダーク…{ctl.F9:13}ファ{ctl.F9:13}…{ctl.F9:13}…ぐわぁあ！！{ctl.F2:03B9}{ctl.F9:27}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:039E}{ctl.F2:00006F}{ctl.F4:05}やった！ やったぞ、ジオを！！{BR}うっ…うぉおおおおおおおおお！！{ctl.F4:01}……ライラ……！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:07}もはや 通常の操作ではナルバスの暴走を止めることはできません…！今からナルバスのシステムにわたし自身を直結し、強制介入しますわ！{ctl.F4:01}強制介入？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}お別れですわ、ルディ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}フレナ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}さようなら、みなさん…{BR}感謝しています。{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:07}メインシステムにアクセス…{BR}最上位インタラプト発行……………{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}と、止まったのか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}成功です。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}フレナ！ 今どこなの？{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:07}ナルバスの、{BR}メインシステム中枢部ですわ。{ctl.FD}今は、このモタビアを維持してきたシステムが みな止まった状態。{ctl.FD}これで もう急な災害などは{BR}起こらなくなりました。{ctl.FD}でも、環境維持システム全てが{BR}停止しているのですから…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000071}このままでは遅かれ早かれこの星は不毛の地になってしまいますわ。{ctl.FD}各システムの機能を{BR}回復させない限りは…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}でも、それには{BR}ゼランを何とかしないと…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:07}そう、人工惑星ゼランから{BR}異常な電波が出ている限り、{ctl.FD}ここでシステムを再起動しても、{BR}また暴走する可能性が大きいですわ{ctl.F4:06}ルディ！ …行こう？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}………うん！！{BR}行こう、ゼランへ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00004F}{ctl.F4:05}でもゼランって、{BR}宇宙にあるんだろ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}それは大丈夫。非常用のシャトルがナルバスには用意されています。{ctl.FD}今、地上に出しているところです。それをお使いになってください。{ctl.FD}わたしは各システムの管理のため、今しばらくここを離れられません…ゼランには私のマスター、{BR}{ctl.F2:000072}「フォーレン」がいるはず。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}フォーレン？ あたし、知ってる！{ctl.FD}バイオプラントにいたころ、{BR}通信でよく話してたわ！{ctl.FD}半年くらい前から 回線が{BR}つながらなくなって心配してたの！そう…フォーレンがゼランの……。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}みなさん、ゼランを頼みます…。{BR}どうか無事で…！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:05}ルディ…すまないが……{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}わかってるよ。まだ小さい妹は{BR}おいていけないよな…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}……すまん……！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:13}Im... possible...!{BR}I am supposed to be immortal...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00006E}Was that... not the case after all...?{BR}M-my god... why...{ctl.FD}Why... have you forsaken me...{BR}Dark...{ctl.F9:13}Fa{ctl.F9:13}...{ctl.F9:13}...gwaaah!!{ctl.F2:03B9}{ctl.F9:27}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:039E}{ctl.F2:00006F}{ctl.F4:05}We did it! We actually did it! We got Zio!!{BR}Ugh... uwooooooooooh!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}......Laila......!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:07}Nurvus can no longer be stopped{BR}by ordinary means...!{ctl.FD}I shall link myself directly into{BR}its system and force an override!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Force an override?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}This is farewell, Rudy.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Frena...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Goodbye, all of you...{BR}I am grateful to you.{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:07}Accessing the main system...{BR}Issuing highest-priority interrupt.........{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}H-has it stopped?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Success.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Frena! Where are you now?{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:07}In the core of Nurvus's{BR}main system.{ctl.FD}Every system that has sustained{BR}Motavia is now at a halt.{ctl.FD}There will be no more{BR}sudden disasters.{ctl.FD}But the whole climate control{BR}system has stopped, and so...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000071}left as it is, sooner or later{BR}this world will become barren.{ctl.FD}Unless each system's function{BR}is restored...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}But for that we have to do{BR}something about Zelan...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F4:07}Yes. So long as the artificial{BR}planet Zelan sends abnormal signals,{ctl.FD}restarting the system here would{BR}very likely result in chaos again.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Rudy! ...Shall we go?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}......Yes!!{BR}To Zelan!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00004F}{ctl.F4:05}But Zelan is out in space, isn't it?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}That is no trouble. Nurvus keeps{BR}an emergency shuttle ready.{ctl.FD}I am bringing it up to the{BR}surface now. Please use it.{ctl.FD}I must manage the systems, and{BR}cannot leave here for a while...{ctl.FD}On Zelan you should find my master,{BR}{ctl.F2:000072}Forren.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Forren? I know him!{ctl.FD}When I was in the Bio-plant{BR}we often spoke over the comms!{ctl.FD}About half a year ago, the line{BR}went dead, and I was worried!{ctl.FD}So... Forren is on Zelan......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:07}Everyone, Zelan is in your hands...{BR}Please be safe...!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:05}Rudy... forgive me......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I know. You can't leave your{BR}little sister behind...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:05}......I'm sorry......!!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}あ…あんたがフォーレン？{BR}デカイなァ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}いかにも、{BR}{ctl.F2:000077}わたしの名は フォーレン。{ctl.FD}アルゴル太陽系の各惑星にある{BR}環境システムの全てを統合制御するこの人工惑星ゼラン…{BR}それを司る アンドロイドです。{ctl.FD}ファル…こうして{BR}実際に会うのは初めてですね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}はいっ、フォーレン！ …こんなに背が高かったなんて知らなかった！{ctl.F4:08}こちらは…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000078}{ctl.F4:06}あたしのお友達のルディとスレイ。とーっても仲の良い二人なの！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}だれがだれと仲がいいって！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ま、とにかく よろしく頼むわ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あたしたち、モタビアのシステムが暴走した原因がここにあるって…{ctl.FD}フレナに聞いて…{BR}それを修復するために来たの！{ctl.FD}でも…見た感じ、そんなに……。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}そう、ゼランは モタビアの{BR}システムを暴走させてはいませんよしかし…制御してもいないのです。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}それは…どういうことなんだ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F2:000079}{ctl.F4:08}現在、ゼランは{BR}無力化しているという事です。{ctl.FD}モタビアのシステムを狂わせているのは、人工惑星「クラン」…。{ctl.FD}本来、ゼランの機能を{BR}サポートするためのものですが、{ctl.FD}何者かがそこを占拠し、システムの制御機能を乗っ取ったのでしょう。{ctl.F4:04}そうか…本来 命令系統は{BR}ゼランにあるから…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}フレナは ゼランがおかしいって{BR}判断したのね…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}ゼランの通信機能もマヒしてしまい連絡もつきませんでした。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}それで音信不通だったのね！{BR}心配したんだから！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}…ってことは…クランに{BR}行かなきゃならないってことか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}ルディ、よろしければ同行させて{BR}いただけませんか？{ctl.FD}ゼランは今や 全システムから{BR}完全に孤立しています。{ctl.FD}努力はしましたが、ここからでは{BR}システムの復旧は不可能です。{ctl.FD}事態収拾のため、いずれ{BR}クランには おもむく予定でした。{ctl.F4:06}フォーレン、あなたがいっしょに{BR}行ってくれるのなら心強いわ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}へぇ…信用してるんだな、{BR}フォーレンのこと！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}そうよ！ フォーレンと{BR}シードはあたしの先生だもの！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}今回の事件は 私の力不足が招いたものです。責任は取らなければ。{ctl.FD}シードがそうしたようにね…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}フォーレン…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F2:000078}{ctl.F4:04}じゃあ ボチボチ行こうぜ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}おまえがシキるなよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}じゃあ おまえがシキってみろよ、{BR}シキれるもんならな、あー？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}なんだとォ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}ファル、…これは？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}いつものコトよ…！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}S-so you're Forren?{BR}You're huge...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Indeed.{BR}{ctl.F2:000077}My name is Forren.{ctl.FD}This artificial world, Zelan,{BR}integrates and governs every climate{ctl.FD}system on every planet of the Algol{BR}system. I am the android who runs it.{ctl.FD}Fal... this is the first time we{BR}have met in person, isn't it?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Yes, Forren! I never knew you{BR}were so tall!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}And these two are...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000078}{ctl.F4:06}My friends, Rudy and Thray.{BR}They're the very best of friends!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Who's the best of friends with who!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Well, that aside,{BR}nice to meet you.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Frena told us the cause of Motavia's{BR}systems running wild was here...{ctl.FD}so we came to fix it!{ctl.FD}But... looking at it, it doesn't{BR}seem......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Correct. Zelan is not driving{BR}Motavia's systems haywire.{ctl.FD}But neither is it governing them.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What... does that mean?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F2:000079}{ctl.F4:08}It means Zelan has, at present,{BR}been rendered powerless.{ctl.FD}The source of Motavia's chaotic{BR}systems is the artificial world Kuran.{ctl.FD}Its primary role is to support{BR}Zelan's function,{ctl.FD}but someone has seized it and hijacked{BR}control of the systems with it.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}I see... the chain of command{BR}normally sits with Zelan...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}So Frena judged that Zelan{BR}had something go wrong...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Zelan's communications were disabled{BR}as well. We could not make contact.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}So that's why we lost contact!{BR}I was so worried!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}...Which means we have to{BR}go to Kuran!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Rudy, if you would permit it,{BR}might I come with you?{ctl.FD}Zelan is now wholly isolated from{BR}every system.{ctl.FD}I have tried, but from here the{BR}systems cannot be restored.{ctl.FD}I had planned to go to Kuran{BR}to resolve the situation.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Forren, it would be very reassuring{BR}to have you accompany us!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Huh... you really trust Forren,{BR}don't you!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Of course! Forren and Seed were{BR}my mentors!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}This crisis was brought on by my own{BR}inadequacy, so I must take responsibility.{ctl.FD}Just as Seed did...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Forren...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F2:000078}{ctl.F4:04}Okay, let's get moving!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Don't you go bossing us around!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}You take charge then, if you{BR}think you can handle it...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Say that again!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Fal... what is this?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}The usual routine...!
entries.us: You...are you Wren? Wow, you're huge! In verity, my name is Wren. This is the man-made satellite Zelan, which has complete control over all the environmental systems for all the planets in the Algo solar system. I am the android who manages it all. Rika, finally we meet face to face. Yes, Wren! I didn't know that you were so tall! And these other people? These are my friends Chaz and Rune. They're great pals! Who and who are great pals? Whatever. Anyway, glad to meet you. Demi told us that the reason the systems in Motavia are out of control could be found here... We've come to try to cure the problem, but from the looks of it, it doesn't seem likely. That's right. Zelan is not causing the systems in Motavia to run out of control. We have no control at all. What does this all mean? Presently, Zelan is losing power. It is the artificial satellite Kuran that is causing the Motavian systems to run amok. Originally, Kuran was supposed to play a supportive role to Zelan, but somebody has occupied Kuran and usurped our control. Is that so? Since Zelan is at the top of the chain of command... Demi must have determined that it was Zelan that had gone awry! Zelan's telecommunication functions are paralyzed. There isn't even a way to communicate. So that's why we were incommunicado! I was so worried! So this means we have to go to Kuran! Chaz, if it is OK with you, may I accompany you? Zelan is presently completely cut off from all the other systems. It is impossible to do any system restoration from here. I was hoping to go to Kuran to get the situation under control. Oh Wren, it would be so reassuring if you came with us! Wow...you have a lot of faith in Wren! Oh, yes! Wren and Seed were my teachers! This current crisis was brought about by my lack of power. I must take responsibility. It seems that Seed has left me responsible, too... Wren... Why don't we get a move on! Stop trying to take charge, Rune! All right then, you take charge - if you can. What did you say?! Rika...what's going on here? Oh, this happens all the time.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}あれ？ ちょっと調子が{BR}おかしいんじゃないの…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00007B}{ctl.F2:0A}{ctl.F4:08}エンジンルームに 正体不明の{BR}エネルギー反応があります。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}エンジンルームはやばいな…。{BR}よし、見に行こう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}シキるなっていうのに！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}うわっ！ お、おまえは！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}おや、もう見つかってしまったか。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00007F}フッ…まぁエンジンに細工するも{BR}ここでおまえらを殺すのも同じ事！{ctl.FD}クランへは行かせん！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Hm? Something doesn't feel{BR}right, does it...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00007B}{ctl.F2:0A}{ctl.F4:08}There is an unidentified energy{BR}reading in the engine room.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}The engine room? That's bad news...{BR}Well, let's go check it out!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I told you not to take charge!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:01}Agh! W-who in the...!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:00}Oh, I've been spotted already.{BR}Well, whether I sabotage the engines{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00007F}or kill you right here makes no{BR}difference to me...!{ctl.FD}I won't let you reach Kuran!
entries.us: What's going on? Something feels wrong... There is an unidentified energy reaction coming from the engine room. Problems in the engine room... that's bad. Well, let's go see what's going on! I told you, stop taking charge! Yikes! Who...who are you!? Oh my, I've been found out already. Well, it doesn't matter now whether I sabotage the engines or kill you right here! You're not getting to Kuran!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}うわわわわ！ 勝ったはいいけど…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000081}{ctl.F4:04}こりゃ本格的に いかれたな。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}スレイ！ もう少し{BR}手加減できなかったのかよ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}るせえ！ おまえこそ{BR}見境いなく 暴れてたくせに！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000082}{ctl.F4:08}予定の軌道をはずれました。{BR}軌道修正は不可能…。{ctl.FD}しかし このコースなら第3惑星、「デゾリス」に不時着が可能です。不時着しますか？{ctl.F2:02}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000083}{ctl.F4:01}しますか、って…{BR}それしかないんだろ！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000084}{ctl.F4:08}まぁそうです。{BR}では 不時着を実行します。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000085}{ctl.F4:06}きゃー！ 不時着、かっこいーっ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}何いってんだ！ ちょ、ちょっと！大丈夫なの？ ねぇ？ ねぇ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}ルディ、あんまり騒ぐと 血中{BR}アドレナリン濃度が上がりますよ。{ctl.F4:04}…………{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}なんでみんな そんな平気な顔{BR}してんだよー！！ うわぁーー！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Whoaoaoa! We won, sure,{BR}but...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000081}{ctl.F4:04}We're totally done for, now.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Thray! Couldn't you have held{BR}back a little!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Shut it! You were the one flailing{BR}around with no thought for anything!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000082}{ctl.F4:08}We have diverted from the planned route.{BR}Course correction is impossible...{ctl.FD}But on this path, an emergency landing{BR}on the third planet, Dezolis,{ctl.FD}is possible.{BR}Shall I proceed with the crash landing?{ctl.F2:02}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000083}{ctl.F4:01}"Shall you''-- that's our only option,{BR}isn't it!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000084}{ctl.F4:08}That is correct.{BR}Initiating emergency landing.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000085}{ctl.F4:06}Eeee! A crash landing! So cool!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What are you saying! W-wait!{BR}Is this safe? Well? Hey!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Rudy, shouting this way will raise the{BR}adrenaline in your bloodstream.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}..........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Why is everybody so calm about{BR}this!! Aaaaaah!!
entries.us: Yippee! It's great that we won... Well, we're really out of commission now. Rune! Couldn't you have applied a little bit of self-control?! Shut up! You're in no position to talk! We're off our intended flight-path. It's impossible to get back in that orbit! We will be able to make a crash landing on Dezolis, the third planet in the system. Shall we try? What do you mean 'shall we'? We have no choice, do we? This is true. One crash landing coming up. Wheee! A crash landing! Cool! What are you saying! Hey. Hey! Are you OK? Hey! Calm down, Chaz. You should endeavor not to let your blood pressure become too high. Relax. Why are you all looking so unconcerned?! Yikes!!!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}ここが 全コントロールシステムの暴走の原因、人工惑星クランか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}頭がクランクランするのぅ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}……さァ、先に行こうか！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}ええ、{BR}メインブロックに急ぎましょう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}お、おのれ、きさまら！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}So this is Kuran, the artificial planet{BR}at the source of the malfunctions!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}This place has my KURAN-ium{BR}spinning!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}......Okay, let's go!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Yes, let us hurry to the{BR}main block!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}Y-you, all of you!
entries.us: So this is the artificial satellite Kuran that has sent the entire planetary control system out of whack. My head is out of whack! Man am I dizzy! Come on, let's go! Yes, we must hurry to the main control center! You, you...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}これがメインブロックか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}急いで 異常の原因を調べます！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}待って！ 何、あれ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}え？ 何？ どこ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}あそこよ！ あの奥！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Is this the main block?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}I shall search for the cause of the{BR}anomaly at once!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Wait! What is that!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Eh? What? Where?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}There! In the back!!
entries.us: So this is the main control center? I shall search for the cause of the malfunction right away. Wait! What's that? What? Where? Over there! In the shadows!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:06}なに… この圧迫感…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ダーク…ファルス！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ダーク・ファルスだって！？{ctl.FD}あれが ジオが神とあがめていた{BR}ダーク・ファルスだっていうのか？{ctl.F4:08}どうやら、あれが全ての元凶の{BR}ようですね。…排除しましょう。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}簡単に言ってくれるよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}よーし！ やってやる！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:06}What is... this overwhelming pressure...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Dark... Falz!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Dark Falz, you said!?{ctl.FD}That's the Dark Falz that Zio{BR}worshipped as his god?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}It appears to be the root of all{BR}of it. ...Let us eliminate it.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}You make it sound easy.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}All right! Let's do it!!
entries.us: What on earth? This feeling of oppression...! Dark...Force! Did you say Dark Force!? You mean the Dark Force who revived Zio as a god? It appears that Dark Force is the cause of everything. Let us remove it. Easier said than done. OK! I'm going for it!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}……やった、…のか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そうだよ！{BR}オレたちの勝ちだ！！{ctl.FD}よし、フォーレン！{BR}クランを正常に戻してくれ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00008F}{ctl.F4:08}了解！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}…………{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}スレイ、{BR}ちょっと聞いていいか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}……何だ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}あの怪物……なぜジオの言った{BR}ダーク・ファルスだとわかった？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:02}{ctl.F2:000180}……ああ……{BR}前に、見たことがあるからな…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000090}{ctl.F4:01}何！？ 前に、って…{BR}どういうことだよ！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}いずれ、話す…{BR}それまで、待ってくれ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}………{ctl.F9:3B}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}スレイ……。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000091}{ctl.F9:1D}{ctl.F4:08}全て機能を回復させました。後は{BR}ゼランで最終的な調整が必要です。……どうかしましたか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ううん…何でもないわ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そう…そうだな。{BR}じゃあ…行こう、ゼランへ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}......Did we... do it?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}We did!{BR}We won!!{ctl.FD}All right, Forren!{BR}Get Kuran back to normal!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00008F}{ctl.F4:08}Understood!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}..........{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Thray,{BR}can I ask you something?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}......What?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}That monster...... how did you know{BR}it was the Dark Falz Zio spoke of?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:02}{ctl.F2:000180}......Ah......{BR}Because I've seen it before.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000090}{ctl.F4:01}What!? Seen it before --{BR}what does that mean!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}I'll tell you in time...{BR}Please wait until then.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}.........{ctl.F9:3B}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Thray......{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000091}{ctl.F9:1D}{ctl.F4:08}All functions restored. The final{BR}adjustments must be made at Zelan.{ctl.FD}......Is something wrong?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}No... it's nothing.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Right... I see.{BR}Then... on to Zelan!
entries.us: Did we...do it? Yep! We've won! OK Wren! Get Kuran back to normal! Roger! Hmph... Rune, can I ask you something? What is it? How did you know...that monster was the Dark Force Zio was talking about? Ah! ...er... I've seen it before. What? What do mean you've seen it before?! I'll tell you sometime... Just wait until then, will you? Well... Rune... All functions have been restored. Now all we have to do is make some final adjustments at Zelan. What is the matter? Ah...nothing. Let's go to Zelan!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:08}OKです。これでアルゴルの環境{BR}保全システムは全て回復しました。{ctl.F4:01}色々あったけど、{BR}これですべて解決か…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}{ctl.F2:039F}待って！ {ctl.F2:000094}あれを見て！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}雪嵐が止まらない？ デゾリスの{BR}システムも回復してるんだろ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}正しいコントロール信号が{BR}発信されているはずですが…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}だ・か・ら！ ガルベルクの塔が{BR}原因だと言ったじゃろうが！{ctl.FD}ガルベルクの塔に住む魔物が{BR}雪嵐を巻き起こしておるのじゃい！たまには{BR}ワシの言うコトを聞けー！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}……うーん。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}とにかく、デゾリスの雪嵐には{BR}他に何か原因があるってことよね。{ctl.F4:08}このまま{BR}あの雪嵐が続けば…{ctl.FD}パルマ人はもとよりデゾリアンまで全滅する恐れがありますね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F9:09}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F9:09}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F9:31}{ctl.F2:0389}{ctl.F2:000095}{ctl.F4:01}考えてたってしょうがない！{BR}行くぞ！ デゾリスへ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000096}{ctl.F4:06}ええ！{BR}あたしも行くわ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}目的が達成されていない以上、{BR}私の任務も継続しています。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000097}{ctl.F4:09}面白くなってきたのぉ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}フン…オレがいなきゃあ{BR}何もできないだろ、ルディ？{ctl.FD}しかし、氷の壁で デゾリスは{BR}自由に動けないぜ。どうする？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}「アイスデッカー」を使えば、{BR}氷の壁くらいは突破可能です。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}「アイスデッカー」？{BR}何だいそれ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}ゼランは いざというときは{BR}万能要塞としても機能します。{ctl.FD}デゾリスでの作戦行動を想定して{BR}砕氷車両も搭載されています。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そんなのがあるなら{BR}早く言ってよ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}では ランディールに{BR}積み込んでおきますね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}よし！ じゃあ{BR}準備ができしだい出発だ！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}やまない雪嵐…か…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:08}Confirmed. Every environmental{BR}system in Algol is restored.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}It took some doing, but{BR}that settles everything...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}{ctl.F2:039F}Wait! {ctl.F2:000094}Look at that!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}The snowstorm hasn't stopped?{BR}Dezolis is restored too, isn't it?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}The correct control signals{BR}should be transmitting...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:09}I TOLD YOU! I told you the Gallberg{BR}Tower caused the blizzard!{ctl.FD}The monster that lives in the{BR}Gallberg Tower is raising that storm!{ctl.FD}Listen to me once in a while!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}......Hmm.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Anyway, that means something else{BR}is behind the snowstorm on Dezolis.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}If that storm continues with this{BR}ferocity, there is a real probability that{ctl.FD}not only the Palmans, but also{BR}the Dezolians will be wiped out.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F9:09}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F9:09}{ctl.F2:01}{ctl.F9:31}{ctl.F2:0389}{ctl.F2:000095}{ctl.F4:01}No use standing here thinking!{BR}Let's go! To Dezolis!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000096}{ctl.F4:06}Yes!{BR}I'm going too!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}As the objective is not achieved,{BR}my mission continues as well.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:000097}{ctl.F4:09}Now this is getting interesting!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Hmph... You can't do a thing{BR}without me, can you, Rudy?{ctl.FD}But those walls of ice mean we{BR}can't move freely on Dezolis.{ctl.FD}What can we do?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}With the Ice Decker, a wall of ice{BR}is no great obstacle.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}The Ice Decker?{BR}What's that?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}In a pinch, Zelan serves as an{BR}all-purpose fortress at need.{ctl.FD}An ice-breaking vehicle is carried{BR}aboard for operations on Dezolis.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}If you had one of those,{BR}you could have said so sooner!{ctl.FD}Alright! Then we'll leave{BR}as soon as we're ready!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}I shall load it aboard{BR}the Landeel, in that case.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}A never-ending snowstorm...{BR}huh...

entries.jp: {ctl.F6}ヨし

{ctl.F4:01}あれ？ なんだこれ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}アンドロイド用の{BR}内蔵武器ユニットですね。{ctl.FD}「ハイパージャマー」の{BR}ユニットではないかと推測します。{ctl.F4:06}「ハイパージャマー」？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}強力な電磁波で メカのAIを{BR}一時的にマヒさせる電子兵器です。規格の方は問題ないようですから、私のボディに組み込みましょう。{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:08}デバイスセットアップ OK…{BR}「ハイパージャマー」使用可能です
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Hm? What's this?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}An internal weapon unit{BR}for androids.{ctl.FD}A HyperJammer unit,{BR}I would surmise.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}A HyperJammer?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}An electronic weapon that paralyzes{BR}a machine's AI for a time,{ctl.FD}using strong electromagnetic waves.{ctl.FD}The specification appears sound, so{BR}I shall fit it into my body.{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:08}Device setup complete...{BR}HyperJammer is available.
entries.us: Hello. What's this? It's an internal weapon unit for Androids. I surmise that it is a Hyper-Jammer. Hyper-Jammer? It is a weapon that temporarily scrambles the AI of machines with strong electromagnetic waves. There seems to be no incompatibility in its specification, so let's install it. Device installed. Hyper-Jammer can now be used.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:13}ほぅ…？{BR}ここまで来たか…やはりな。{ctl.FD}だが…今よりの一歩は 死に至る{BR}道行（みちゆき）と心得よ…。{ctl.FD}今度は…逃がさん！{BR}大いなる神よ！ 我に力を！！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:13}Oh...?{BR}You came this far... as I thought.{ctl.FD}But know that one step further{BR}is a road that ends in death...{ctl.FD}This time... you do not escape!{BR}Great god! Grant me power!!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:08}待って下さい！{ctl.FD}現在「クラン」は{BR}ステルスモードに入っています。{ctl.FD}シャトルのレーダーでは{BR}おそらく発見できません。{ctl.FD}「ステルスキャンセラー」が{BR}右のカーゴルームにありますから{ctl.FD}持って行きましょう。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:08}One moment!{ctl.FD}Kuran is currently in{BR}stealth mode.{ctl.FD}The shuttle's radar will most{BR}likely not find it.{ctl.FD}There is a Stealth Canceler device in the{BR}cargo hold to the right.{ctl.FD}Let us take it with us.
entries.us: Wait a moment! Presently Kuran is in Stealth mode. You will not be able to locate it with the shuttle's radar. There is a 'Stealth Canceller' in the cargo room on the right. I will go get it.

entries.note: trailing bytes, no terminator

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}ようこそ、ガンビアス大寺院へ。{BR}パルマ人の方も歓迎しますよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}Welcome to the Gungbius Grand{BR}Temple. Palmans are welcome too.
entries.us: Welcome to the Gumbious Temple. We even welcome Parmanians.

entries.jp: ようこそ、と言いたいが{BR}今イクリプストーチは…！
entries.en: I would bid you welcome, but the{BR}Eclipse Torch is...!
entries.us: I want to say 'welcome' but the Eclipse Torch is...

entries.jp: おお、イクリプストーチを{BR}取り返してくださったのですね！
entries.en: Oh, you have brought back the{BR}Eclipse Torch!
entries.us: Oh, you have recovered the Eclipse Torch!

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}パルマ人とは おめずらしい。{BR}観光でいらっしゃいますかな？
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}A Palman! How rare.{BR}Are you here to see the sights?
entries.us: How rare to see a Parmanian. Are you here sight-seeing?

entries.jp: あああ 何てこった！{BR}イクリプストーチが…！
entries.en: Oh, what a disaster!{BR}The Eclipse Torch is...!
entries.us: Oh, what a shall we do? The Eclipse Torch is...

entries.jp: 良かった良かった。
entries.en: Thank goodness. Thank goodness.
entries.us: Oh, thank goodness.

entries.jp: ここはデゾリアンの聖地。{ctl.FD}いつも大勢がおとずれるのですが、最近は雪嵐で 人もまばらです。
entries.en: This is the Dezolians' holy ground.{ctl.FD}Great numbers usually come, but the{BR}snowstorms have thinned them out.
entries.us: This is a sacred Dezolisian area. Usually many people come to visit, but recently there's been a snowstorm and visitors are few and far between.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}我らが神聖なる炎は、{BR}実に美しい！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}Our sacred flame is{BR}truly beautiful!
entries.us: This holy flame of ours is truly beautiful!

entries.jp: どうしよう どうしよう！
entries.en: What shall we do? What shall we do?!
entries.us: Oh, what shall we do?

entries.jp: 一安心です。{BR}ありがとうございました。
entries.en: I feel safe again.{BR}Thank you very much.
entries.us: Now I feel safe. Thank you very much.

entries.jp: ここは その昔、「コロナ」と{BR}呼ばれる塔が建っていたそうな。
entries.en: They say a tower called Corona{BR}once stood upon this spot.
entries.us: They say there used to be a tower called 'Corona' that stood here in the past.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}ここガンビアス大寺院は、聖なる炎「イクリプストーチ」を頂く、{ctl.FD}デゾリスの、信仰ばかりでなく{BR}政治の中核をもなすところだ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}Here at the Gungbius Grand Temple{BR}we keep the sacred Eclipse Torch.{ctl.FD}It is the heart of Dezolis in{BR}government as well as in faith.
entries.us: Here at Gumbious Temple, we not only guard the Eclipse Torch, the symbol of the Dezolisian belief, but also we are the central government.

entries.jp: 聖なる輝きは 我らの心の支え。{BR}それが失われては…！
entries.en: That holy light is what holds our{BR}hearts up. To lose it...!
entries.us: The holy flame gives us strength. That it is lost is...

entries.jp: 我らの炎を持って行きなさるか。{BR}ゆめゆめ粗末に扱わんでくだされ。
entries.en: You would carry our flame away?{BR}Never treat it lightly, I beg you.
entries.us: You're going to bring our flame back? You must never handle it with disrespect.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}「イクリプストーチ」は{BR}聖なる炎…。{ctl.FD}「この世ならざる物」を焼きつくす焼滅の光を発すると伝え聞きます。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}The Eclipse Torch is a sacred{BR}flame...{ctl.FD}They say it sheds a light that{BR}consumes what is not of this world.
entries.us: The Eclipse Torch is a holy flame. The legend states that it emits a burning light that reduces any object unworthy of this world to ashes.

entries.jp: 何ということだ！{BR}聖なる炎が持ち去られるなど…！
entries.en: Unbelievable! The sacred flame,{BR}carried off...!
entries.us: Oh horrors! Our holy flame has been stolen!

entries.jp: パルマの方、我らの宝を持ち行く{BR}からには、志しを貫いてくだされ。
entries.en: Palman, if you take our treasure{BR}with you, see your purpose through.
entries.us: My dear Parmanian, if you say you'll get our treasure, please follow through on your promise.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}「来るべき日、イクリプストーチの聖なる炎が一切の不浄を焼滅する」古くからの{BR}言い伝えでございます。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}"The day will come when the sacred{BR}flame will burn away all impurities.''{ctl.FD}So goes the ancient legend.
entries.us: 'One day, the flame of the Eclipse Torch will reduce to ashes all that is unclean.' That is the legend of the Eclipse Torch.

entries.jp: 「来るべき日、イクリプストーチの聖なる炎が一切の不浄を焼滅する」この言い伝えは{BR}ウソだったのでしょうか？
entries.en: "The day will come when the sacred{BR}flame will burn away all impurities.''{ctl.FD}Was that saying a falsehood?
entries.us: 'One day, the flame of the Eclipse Torch will reduce all that is unclean to ashes.' I wonder if this legend is true?

entries.jp: 「来るべき日、イクリプストーチの聖なる炎が一切の不浄を焼滅する」その時が{BR}来たのかもしれませぬな。
entries.en: "The day will come when the sacred{BR}flame will burn away all impurities.''{ctl.FD}That time may have come at last.
entries.us: 'One day, the flame of the Eclipse Torch will reduce all that is unclean to ashes.' That time may be now.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}私は ひどい凍傷になったことが{BR}あったんですが…{ctl.FD}イクリプストーチの光をあびると、またたく間に治ったんです！{ctl.FD}まさしく あれは{BR}聖なる光ですよ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}I once suffered from a severe case{BR}of frostbite...{ctl.FD}One touch of the Eclipse Torch's{BR}light and it healed in moments!{ctl.FD}That is a holy light, make no mistake.
entries.us: I once got terribly frostbitten. But the light of the Eclipse Torch cured me in moments! That is truly a holy flame.

entries.jp: あの光が失われるなど{BR}あってはならないこと。{ctl.FD}お願いです、パルマの方。我らの{BR}聖なる炎を取り返してください！
entries.en: That light must never be lost to us.{ctl.FD}Please, Palman. Bring our sacred{BR}flame back to us!
entries.us: That light must never be lost. Please, my dear Parmanian. Bring back our holy flame!

entries.jp: おお、あなた方ならば 我らの{BR}聖なる炎を託すに足るでしょう。
entries.en: Ah, you are surely fit to be{BR}trusted with our sacred flame.
entries.us: Ah, I'm sure we can trust people like you with the holy flame.

entries.jp: ここより先は お通しできません。お引き取りを。
entries.en: You may not pass beyond this{BR}point. Please turn back.
entries.us: You may not go beyond this point. Please go back.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}ありがたいありがたい。{ctl.FD}イクリプストーチの光を{BR}こんな間近に拝めるなんて！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}How grateful I am. How grateful.{ctl.FD}To behold the Eclipse Torch's light{BR}from such a close distance!
entries.us: I'm so grateful. It's so wonderful to be able to worship the flame of the Eclipse Torch again!

entries.jp: あわわわわわわわわわわ。
entries.en: Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaah.
entries.us: Waaaaaaaaaaaaa.

entries.jp: イクリプストーチを取り戻して{BR}くださったか。ありがたい事です。
entries.en: You brought the Eclipse Torch{BR}back to us? Bless you for it.
entries.us: Oh, you have retrieved the Eclipse Torch. That's wonderful.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}見れば見るほど清々しい光だ。{BR}心が洗われる思いがしますなぁ！
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}The longer I look, the purer the{BR}light. It washes the heart clean!
entries.us: The more I look at it the more refreshing the light is. I feel as if my heart is being cleansed!

entries.jp: イクリプストーチを公然と奪うとはぶぶぶぶ無礼千万！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}腰がヌケてるよ、おじさん。{BR}ホラ、しっかりして。
entries.en: To brazenly snatch the Eclipse Torch,{BR}how u-u-utterly insolent!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Your knees have buckled, sir.{BR}Come on, pull yourself together.
entries.us: Wh...what total disrespect to steal the Eclipse Torch so openly! You're unsteady, sir. Here, pull yourself together.

entries.jp: ああ、早く用を済ませて{BR}返してくだされよ。
entries.en: Ah, finish your business quickly{BR}and bring it back to us.
entries.us: Oh, hurry and finish whatever you need to do and give it back.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}いかなる宝石も これほど神々しい輝きを発することはかないませぬ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}No jewel on any world could shed{BR}so divine a radiance.
entries.us: Not even the most precious jewel could emit such a divine light.

entries.jp: 全デゾリアンの宝が奪われた！{BR}いったいどうすればよいのか…。
entries.en: The treasure of every Dezolian,{BR}stolen! What are we to do...
entries.us: The treasure of all Dezolisians has been stolen! What should we do?

entries.jp: なにはともあれ、{BR}ようございました。
entries.en: Well, for whatever else may come,{BR}I'm glad this turned out well.
entries.us: I'm glad it turned out well.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}わたしは修行中の身。{ctl.FD}この地に足を踏み入れる時、いつも身が引きしまる思いがします。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9B02}{ctl.FA:9801}I am still in training.{ctl.FD}Every time I set foot in this place,{BR}I always feel a sense of solemnity.
entries.us: I'm a trained monk. Every time I step into this place I feel stronger.

entries.jp: わ、わたしが至らないばかりに{BR}こんな…こんなことに！
entries.en: That my own failings should bring{BR}us to... to this!
entries.us: Oh, that such a thing could happen because of my inattentiveness!

entries.jp: 安心しました。心置きなく{BR}再び修行の旅に出られます。
entries.en: I am relieved. Now I can take up my{BR}training journey again with a clear mind.
entries.us: I'm so relieved. Now I can get back to my training with peace of mind.

entries.jp: {ctl.FA:9801}{ctl.FA:9711}{ctl.F4:1A}よくいらっしゃいました。{BR}どなたさまの参拝も歓迎しますぞ。
entries.en: {ctl.FA:9801}{ctl.FA:9711}{ctl.F4:1A}You are most welcome here.{BR}We greet those from all walks of life.
entries.us: Welcome, welcome. We welcome any visitor to the temple.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:1A}よろしく{BR}お願いいたしますぞ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:1A}We are counting on you!
entries.us: I wish you well!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:06}見て！{BR}人が襲われてる！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}あれがシェスか？
entries.en: {ctl.F4:06}Look!{BR}Someone's under attack!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Is that Shess?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}くっ！{BR}後から後から生えてくる！{ctl.FD}これじゃキリがない！{BR}いったん、ひきあげだ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}Ngh!{BR}They keep growing back!{ctl.FD}There's no end to it!{BR}Pull back for now!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:0A}ありがとう、助けてくれて…。{ctl.FD}わたしは、シェス・ティアニー…{BR}あなたたちは…？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}{ctl.F2:00009A}あなたの仲間に言われてきたの。{BR}とにかく、無事でよかったわ！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0A}そう…{BR}それでここまで…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}{ctl.F2:00009C}しかし…ひとりでくるなんて{BR}ホント、無茶するなァ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}何とかなると思ったのよ…{BR}いえ、何とかしなきゃいけないの！あの…苦しそうにしてる人たちを{BR}見てたら カッとなっちゃって…{ctl.FD}でも、あの人食い樹、{BR}ウワサ以上に手ごわかったわ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}うーん…人食い樹を何とかする{BR}いい方法はないのかなぁ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}知ってるかもしれない…{BR}あたしたちの長（おさ）なら…！{ctl.FD}あたしたちの…{BR}エスパーの館の長…{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00009D}「ルツ」…！{ctl.FD}今から二千年前…{BR}アリサという勇者とともに、{ctl.FD}このアルゴルを救ったといわれる{BR}伝説の魔法使いよ！！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ちょっと待ってよ！ 二千年前の{BR}人がまだ生きてるっていうのかい？{ctl.F4:0A}生きていると言われているわ。{BR}エスパーの館の…奥の院で…！{ctl.FD}けど、館でもトップクラスの人{BR}以外は 奥の院には入れないの。{ctl.FD}だから、あたしも昔 何かの式典で一度 遠くから見かけただけ…！{ctl.FD}でも…{BR}遠くからでもわかるわ！{ctl.FD}理知的で…優雅で…気品があって…素晴らしく立派な方よ！！{ctl.FD}あの方なら きっと{BR}良い方法をご存知に違いないわ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ふーん…{BR}二千年間生きてる、ねぇ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}信用しないの！？{ctl.FD}ルツ様は いくつもの伝説を産んだ史上最高の魔法使いなのよ！！{ctl.FD}きっと 不老不死の術さえも{BR}マスターしてらっしゃるんだわ！！{ctl.F4:01}ホントかなぁ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}常識的に考えれば、{BR}人工冬眠といったところでしょう。{ctl.F4:0A}何にしても、もうミースの人たちをほうってはおけないわ。{ctl.FD}ルツ様に お目通りを{BR}お願いしてみる！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}うん！ ね、ルディ、{BR}そのルツって人に会ってみようよ！{ctl.F4:0A}わたしが案内するわ。{BR}いっしょに行きましょう！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そうだな。{BR}エスパーの館に行ってみよう！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:0A}Thank you for saving me...{ctl.FD}I am Shess Tierney...{BR}And you are...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}{ctl.F2:00009A}Your people sent us.{BR}I'm just glad you're safe!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:0A}I see...{BR}So that is how you came...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}{ctl.F2:00009C}Still... coming out here alone,{BR}that really was reckless!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}I thought I could manage...{BR}No, I had to manage!{ctl.FD}When I saw those people{BR}suffering, I lost my head...{ctl.FD}But those man-eating trees were{BR}worse than the rumors...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Hmm... isn't there some good{BR}way to deal with the trees...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}Someone may know...{BR}Our leader might...!{ctl.FD}The chief of our Esper Mansion...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F2:00009D}Lutz...!{ctl.FD}Two thousand years ago...{BR}together with a hero named Alisa,{ctl.FD}the legendary mage who is said{BR}to have saved all of Algol!!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Hold on a moment! Someone from{BR}two thousand years ago, still alive?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}So it is said. In the Esper{BR}Mansion... in the inner sanctum...!{ctl.FD}But none save the highest ranks{BR}of the mansion may enter there.{ctl.FD}I only glimpsed him once, from{BR}afar, at some ceremony...!{ctl.FD}But...{BR}even from a distance you can tell!{ctl.FD}Wise... graceful... noble...{BR}a truly magnificent person!!{ctl.FD}If anyone knows a good way,{BR}surely he does!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Hmm...{BR}Alive for two thousand years, huh...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}You don't believe me!?{ctl.FD}Lord Lutz is the greatest mage in{BR}history, father of countless legends!!{ctl.FD}He has surely mastered even{BR}the art of eternal life!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}I wonder...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Sensibly considered, it would likely be{BR}a form of artificial hibernation.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}In any case, I can't leave the{BR}people of Meese as they are.{ctl.FD}I will ask for an audience with Lord Lutz!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Yes! Rudy, let's go and meet this Lutz{BR}person!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}I'll guide you there.{BR}Let's go together!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}All right.{BR}Let's go to the Esper Mansion!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:04}この先は{BR}人食い樹で危険だ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:04}Beyond here it is dangerous.{BR}The man-eating trees!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:06}やったぁ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}長い道のりだったわねー。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}よし！{BR}ガルベルクの塔に突入だ！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:06}We did it!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:0A}That was a long road.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Right!{BR}Into Gallberg Tower!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}あれは！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ダーク・ファルスなの！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}確かに！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}サーチデータを照合…！ クランのものとは異なる個体のようです。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}ダーク・ファルスは二匹いたの？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ラジャの言うとおり、こいつが{BR}デゾリスを狂わせているのか…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}いや、デゾリスだけじゃない。{BR}このアルゴル星系全てを、だ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}ダーク・ファルスが こちらに{BR}気づきました。 接近してきます！{ctl.F4:01}望むところだ！{BR}いくぞ、みんな！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}That's...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Dark Falz!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}It sure is!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Comparing sensor data...! It seems to be{BR}a different entity from Kuran's.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}There were two Dark Falzes?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}So Raja was right. This is what{BR}has been corrupting Dezolis...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}No, not Dezolis alone.{BR}The whole Algol solar system!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Dark Falz has noticed us.{BR}It is approaching!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Bring it on!{BR}Let's go, everyone!

entries.jp: どこからか 強力な念波が{BR}大寺院をおそったのじゃ…！
entries.en: A powerful psychic wave struck the{BR}Grand Temple from somewhere...!

entries.jp: 大僧正様も この一室を守るのが{BR}精いっぱいだったのです。
entries.en: Even the High Priest could do no{BR}more than shield this one room.

entries.jp: 突然のことで、対処のしようが{BR}ありませんでした。{ctl.FD}我々が無事だったのさえも、まさに奇跡！ さすがは大僧正様です！！
entries.en: It came so suddenly, there was simply no{BR}way to react to it.{ctl.FD}Our survival alone is a miracle.{BR}The High Priest is magnificent!!

entries.jp: 暗雲が晴れ、デゾリスをつつむ{BR}邪気が消えて安心したとたん…！
entries.en: The clouds broke and the malice{BR}over Dezolis lifted...{ctl.FD}And the moment we breathed easy...!

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:1A}イクリプストーチを{BR}お貸しした方々じゃな。{ctl.FD}よくぞ来てくれた…。{BR}大僧正様がお待ちじゃ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:1A}You are the ones who lent us{BR}the Eclipse Torch.{ctl.FD}It is good that you came...{BR}The High Priest is waiting.

entries.jp: {ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:1B}たのむぞ、ルディ・アシュレ…。{BR}このアルゴルをな。
entries.en: {ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:1B}I leave it to you, Rudy Ashley...{BR}Look after Algol.
entries.us: So this is the Eclipse Torch?

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:1A}なんと？ …ならんならんならん！この聖なる炎は 門外不出の品！！たとえ ルツどのの頼みといえど、軽々しく貸すなど できない相談！{ctl.F4:01}わっかんない おっさんだなぁ！{BR}ワケは今 話しただろう？{ctl.FD}これには、全アルゴルの{BR}未来が かかってるんだ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1A}ならんならんならん！！{BR}ダメなものはダメだ！{ctl.FD}………？{ctl.FD}何だ！？{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:1D}ハーッハッハッハ！{BR}イクリプストーチはいただく！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}なんだ、おまえら！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1F}ハーッハッハッハ！ 我らは{BR}「エアキャッスル」を居とする者！{ctl.F4:1D}そこな白装束の者！ きさまが{BR}ルツならば 覚えていよう？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1F}エアキャッスルで待っておるぞ！{BR}「あのお方」がな！！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:1D}イクリプストーチ、{BR}確かに申し受けた！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1F}取り戻したくば 来るがよいぞ！{BR}命がおしくなければ、だがなァ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1D}ハーッハッハッハァ！！{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:1A}うわぁああああ{BR}何ということだ！{ctl.FD}我らが聖なる炎が奪い去られて…{BR}私の心の狭さが招いた罪だ！{ctl.FD}うう…いったいどうやって{BR}責任を取ればいいのか…ううう…。{ctl.F4:01}そんなに落ち込むなよ、{BR}司祭さん！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}強引に持って行かれたんだ。{BR}あんたの責任じゃない。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}取られた物は取り返せばいいんだ！オレたちが取り返してきてやるよ！{ctl.F4:1A}おおお…本当でございますか？{BR}お、お願いいたします！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そのかわり、取り返してきたら{BR}今度はちゃんと貸してくれよな！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1A}そ、それはもう…はい！{BR}もちろんでございます！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}…スレイ、エアキャッスルって？{BR}あなたが知ってるって言ってたけど{ctl.F4:04}うむ、オレが、というより{BR}ルツの記憶にあるものだ…。{ctl.FD}はるか昔、パルマ星の空に{BR}浮かんでいた 天空の城！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}パルマ星…！ だったら千年前に{BR}消滅してしまっているはず…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}パルマ星は爆発し、その空域は今、アステロイドベルトが残るのみです{ctl.F4:04}奇跡的にエアキャッスルは助かり、アステロイドにまぎれて 今も…？{ctl.F4:08}その可能性は{BR}低いでしょうが…{ctl.FD}とにかく ランディールの{BR}センサーで調べてみましょう。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}スレイ、{BR}もうひとつ聞きたい…。{ctl.FD}やつらの言ってた「あのお方」って…誰のことなんだ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}エアキャッスルで 初代のルツと{BR}その仲間は、ある男と戦った…。{ctl.FD}その名は、ラシーク！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そいつなのか！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}しかし、ラシークは{BR}初代ルツが確かに倒したはず！{ctl.FD}何が待っているのか…{BR}行ってみなければわからんよ。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:1A}What? ...No, no, no! This holy{BR}flame must never leave these walls!!{ctl.FD}Even if it's Lord Lutz's request, to lend{BR}it to anyone is out of the question!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What a stubborn old man!{BR}We just told you why!{ctl.FD}The future of all Algol hangs on this!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1A}No, no, no!!{BR}What cannot be, cannot be!{ctl.FD}.........?{ctl.FD}What is that!?{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:1D}Hah hah hah hah!{BR}We'll be taking the Eclipse Torch!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Who are you!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1F}Hah hah hah hah! We are those{BR}who dwell in the Air Castle!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1D}You there in white! If you are{BR}Lutz, surely you will remember?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1F}We will be waiting in the Air{BR}Castle! And so will He!!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:1D}The Eclipse Torch is{BR}duly claimed!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1F}Come and take it back, if you dare!{BR}If your lives mean little, that is!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1D}Hah hah hah haaa!!{ctl.F7}{ctl.F4:1A}Waaaah,{BR}what have I done!{ctl.FD}Our holy flame stolen away...{BR}My own narrow-mindedness brought this!{ctl.FD}Ohh... how am I ever to answer{BR}for this... ohhh...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Don't take it so hard, priest!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}They took it by force.{BR}It's not your fault.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What was taken can be taken back!{BR}We'll go get it for you!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1A}Ohhh... do you truly mean it?{BR}P-please, I beg you!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}In return, when we bring it back,{BR}you'll lend it to us like we asked!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1A}Th-that of course... yes!{BR}Of course I shall!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}...Thray, what is the Air Castle?{BR}They said that you knew of it.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Mm. Not I, so much as{BR}what lies in Lutz's memory...{ctl.FD}Long ago, it was a castle in the sky that{BR}floated above the world of Palma!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}Palma...! But that was destroyed{BR}a thousand years ago...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}Palma exploded. Only an asteroid{BR}belt remains in that region now.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}And the Air Castle survived by{BR}some miracle, hidden among them...?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}The odds are slight,{BR}but...{ctl.FD}In any case, let us search{BR}with the Landeel's sensors.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Thray,{BR}one more thing I want to ask...{ctl.FD}This "He'' they spoke of...{BR}who did they mean?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}In the Air Castle, the first Lutz{BR}and his companions fought a man...{ctl.FD}His name was LaSheek!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Is it him!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}But LaSheek was surely struck{BR}down by the first Lutz!{ctl.FD}What awaits...{BR}we won't know until we get there.

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:1B}よくぞ参った…。{ctl.FD}わしは、二千年の時を生きる{BR}ガンビアス大寺院の大僧正…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}大僧正…これは いったい{BR}どういうことなのですか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}大寺院が 跡形もなく{BR}吹き飛ばされているわ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ダーク・ファルスは倒した。{BR}それで終わりなんじゃないのか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}「深遠なる闇」は健在じゃ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}何だ、その「深遠なる闇」って？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}はるか太古の昔よりこのアルゴルに破壊と死をもたらしてきた根源…{ctl.FD}ダーク・ファルスなどは{BR}その手足にすぎんよ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}！！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}なんて…こった…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}ダーク・ファルス…{ctl.FD}やつは「リュクロス」の場所を{BR}探るためにデゾリスに来た…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}「リュクロス」…！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}しかし、おぬしらの手によって{BR}それも かなわぬものとなった…。{ctl.FD}だから、{BR}「深遠なる闇」が動いたのだ…。{ctl.FD}自らが手にできぬものならば、{BR}おぬしらの手にも渡すまい、とな…{ctl.F4:04}大僧正、我々にはわかりません。{BR}「リュクロス」とは何なのですか？{ctl.F4:01}そんなにやっきになって探すほど{BR}大事な物がある場所なのか？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}…すべての秘密の答が眠る場所…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}？？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}どういうことです？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}わしにも わからぬ。{ctl.FD}「リュクロス」とは何なのか…。{BR}そして いずこにあるのか…。{ctl.FD}「リュクロス」還るとき、{BR}「エアロプリズム」が道を示す…{ctl.FD}この古い言い伝え以外はな…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}「エアロプリズム」！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}あらゆるものを照らし出すという、エアロプリズムの光か…！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}スレイ、知ってるのか！？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}ルディ！{BR}モタビアへ戻るぞ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}モタビアへ？{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}「エアロプリズム」は、初代ルツが戦士の神殿に納めたはずなんだ！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}クルップのそばの湖の島にあった{BR}あの神殿か！{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}水上を渡れるマシンが必要ですね。至急 フレナに連絡してみます。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}大僧正…さん、ありがとう。{BR}イクリプストーチは返すよ。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}行くのか、リュクロスへ…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}そうだな。{BR}ここまできたら、ね。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}そうか…わしも大任を{BR}果たせたということか…。{ctl.FD}わしは、おぬしらをリュクロスへと導くためのしるべにすぎん…。{ctl.FD}歴史を創るのは、おぬしらじゃよ…たのむぞ、若いの…。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}ルディ。{BR}ルディ・アシュレです。{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}そうか…。たのんだぞ、{BR}ルディ・アシュレよ…。
entries.en: {ctl.F4:1B}You have done well to come here...{ctl.FD}I am High Priest of the Gungbius Grand{BR}Temple, aged of two thousand years...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}High Priest... what has happened here?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}The Grand Temple has been{BR}blown away without a trace.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}We beat Dark Falz.{BR}Wasn't that the end of it?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}The Profound Darkness still endures...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}What is this Profound Darkness?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}The root that has brought ruin and{BR}death to Algol since the ancient past...{ctl.FD}Dark Falz and his ilk are{BR}no more than its limbs...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}!!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}This... this can't be...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}Dark Falz...{ctl.FD}He came to Dezolis to discover{BR}the location of Ryucross...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Ryucross...!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}But by your hands even that{BR}was denied to him...{ctl.FD}And so the Profound Darkness{BR}has stirred...{ctl.FD}What it cannot hold itself, it will{BR}not leave in your hands either...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}High Priest, we do not understand.{BR}What is Ryucross?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Is it really a place worthy of{BR}so desperate a search?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}...Where the answer to every{BR}secret sleeps...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}??{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}What do you mean?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}I do not know either.{ctl.FD}What Ryucross is...{BR}and where it may be...{ctl.FD}"When Ryucross returns, the Aeroprism{BR}shall show the way''...{ctl.FD}Beyond that old saying,{BR}I know nothing...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:06}The Aeroprism!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}The light of the Aeroprism, that{BR}is said to illuminate all things...!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Thray, do you know about it!?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}Rudy!{BR}We must return to Motavia!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}To Motavia?{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:04}The first Lutz laid the Aeroprism{BR}in the Warriors' Temple!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}That temple on the island in{BR}the lake near Krupp!{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:08}We shall need a machine that crosses{BR}water. I will contact Frena at once.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}High Priest... thank you.{BR}I'll give back the Eclipse Torch now.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}So, you are going, to Ryucross...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}That's right.{BR}We've come this far, after all.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}I see... then I, too, have{BR}fulfilled my great duty...{ctl.FD}I am no more than a guide to{BR}lead you toward Ryucross...{ctl.FD}It is you who shall shape history...{BR}I leave it to you, young one...{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:01}Rudy.{BR}Rudy Ashley.{ctl.FD}{ctl.F4:1B}I see... I leave it to you,{BR}Rudy Ashley...

entries.jp: {ctl.F4:01}だめだ{BR}マシンでも 突破できない！
entries.en: {ctl.F4:01}No good.{BR}Even this vehicle can't break through!

{ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}これがイクリプストーチ…。
entries.en: {ctl.F3}{ctl.F4:01}So this is the Eclipse Torch...
entries.us: So this is the Eclipse Torch?
